- Persistent title: `His mentor told him to drop the question. He played the recording at the press conference.`
- Cover text: `Drop the question—or play the recording?`
- Post title: `A trainee reporter puts his career choice in the spotlight.`
- Annotation: Only when the teleprompter goes dark, add `He chose to switch off the prepared script.` Leave the rest of the dialogue free of annotations.

“His mentor was investigated and punished” and “He exposed the entire cover-up” go beyond the evidence in the clip. This fictional segment was designed to illustrate the method; it has no real publishing data or viewing results.

heading.zh: 一批切片怎样避免标题长得一样？
heading.en: Keep a Batch of Clip Titles from Sounding Alike

body.zh:
先按观看理由分组，再比较句式。同一素材的两个切片共享人物，也可能分别卖“关系决裂”和“证据出现”；它们无需合并成同一标题。反过来，五条都写“他终于反击了”，即使替换近义词，仍在重复同一种承诺。

批量复查时记录：每条的观看理由、关键动作、代价、兑现位置和揭示边界。优先保留最具体、最能被片内支撑的一条，其他条从不同真实回报重新写。
body.en:
Group clips by their reasons to watch before comparing sentence structures. Two clips from the same material may share characters while offering different payoffs: a relationship breaking down in one, evidence emerging in the other. They do not need the same title. Conversely, five titles saying “He finally fought back” repeat the same promise even if you substitute synonyms.

For each clip in a batch review, record the reason to watch, key action, cost, payoff location and limits on what can be revealed. Prioritise the most specific title with the strongest support inside its clip. Rewrite the others around different payoffs the material actually delivers.

heading.zh: 常见文案问题与修正
heading.en: Common Copy Problems and Fixes

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 把人物许诺写成既成事实 | 写他做出的选择和当前结果 |
| 单向凝望直接写成相爱 | 写可见动作与关系变化 |
| 受伤直接写成死亡或胜负 | 承诺只到证据呈现的程度 |
| 每层文字重复同一句话 | 按处境、画面焦点、背景、补充信息分工 |
| 花字越加越多 | 没有必要信息就撤掉 |
| 用包装遮住结构问题 | 把需要改镜头或声音的问题单独处理 |
body.en:
| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Presenting a character’s promise as an accomplished fact | Describe the choice they make and the current result |
| Treating a one-sided gaze as proof of mutual love | Describe visible actions and changes in the relationship |
| Treating an injury as proof of death, victory or defeat | Promise no more than the evidence establishes |
| Repeating the same sentence in every text layer | Divide the work: situation, visual focus, background and supplementary information |
| Adding more and more annotations | Remove any that supply no necessary information |
| Using promotional text to conceal structural problems | Address problems that require changes to shots or sound separately |

q.zh: 标题可以用疑问句吗？
q.en: Can a title be a question?

a.zh: 可以。问题必须来自片内真实悬念，正文还要给出答案或明确进展。片内没有触及的问题会制造空承诺。
a.en: Yes. The question must come from genuine suspense within the clip, which should provide an answer or clear progress towards one. A question the clip never addresses creates an empty promise.

q.zh: 花字需要一直留在屏幕上吗？
q.en: Should annotations remain on screen throughout?

a.zh: 按它承担的信息决定。提示完成后即可离开，关键动作和人物表情需要让出画面。具体出入点应在制作阶段对照真实成片核准。
a.en: Decide according to the information they carry. An annotation can leave once it has done its job; give key actions and facial expressions room on screen. Check exact entry and exit points against the actual finished video during production.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /video-recap 为这些切片分别写常驻标题、封面字、发布标题和必要花字；先列观看理由与片内证据，各层分工，不提前宣布未呈现结果。”
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /video-recap to write a persistent on-screen title, cover text, post title and any necessary annotations for each of these clips. First list the reason to watch and the evidence within each clip. Give the text layers distinct jobs, and do not announce results that have not been shown.”

title.zh: 复仇打脸短剧怎么写：每次翻盘都拿回一项权力
title.en: Writing Revenge Micro-Dramas: Win Back Power with Every Reversal

seo_title.en: How to Write a Revenge Micro-Drama | ZenStory

description.zh: 把旧账写成可核对损失，让翻盘改变签字权、货源、名单或公开解释权，并控制公开场面成本。
description.en: Make past losses verifiable. Let each reversal change sign-off rights, supplies, lists or who can explain events publicly. Keep public scenes affordable.

answer.zh: 复仇短剧先把主角曾失去的东西写成可核对旧账，再让每次反击拿回一项能继续使用的权力。对手必须拥有程序、资金、关系或舆论等真实手段，并在受挫后学习；翻盘后的见证者要改变签字、供货、站队或行动。
answer.en: Start a revenge micro-drama with a verifiable account of what the protagonist lost. Each counterattack should reclaim a form of power they can use again. Give the opponent real means of control—procedures, money, relationships or public opinion—and let them learn from setbacks. After a reversal, witnesses should change what they sign, what they supply, whom they support or what they do.

heading.zh: 先列旧账与权力账
heading.en: List Past Losses and Present Forms of Control

body.zh:
| 旧损失 | 对手仍能使用的手段 | 本次可见偿还 |
|---|---|---|
| 被划出供应名单 | 采购签字权 | 签字被驳回、名单恢复 |
| 作品署名被拿走 | 展示与解释权 | 展签更正、旧稿公开核验 |
| 探视被阻断 | 日程与门禁 | 约定落字、门禁权限改变 |

羞辱只能显示态度，权力变化才能推动下一集。主角每次出手也要消耗证据、暴露身份或牵连要保护的人。
body.en:
| Past loss | A means of control the opponent still has | Visible redress this time |
|---|---|---|
| Removal from the supplier list | Procurement sign-off authority | The sign-off is rejected and the supplier is reinstated |
| Losing credit for creative work | Control over its display and public explanation | The exhibition label is corrected and an earlier draft is checked publicly |
| Being denied visits | Control over schedules and entry access | The arrangement is put in writing and access permissions change |

Humiliation shows an attitude; a shift in power gives the next episode something to build on. Each move should also cost the protagonist evidence, expose their identity or implicate someone they are trying to protect.

heading.zh: 屏幕上怎样让翻盘成立
heading.en: Make the Reversal Convincing on Screen

body.zh: 先建立能拍到的判断标准，再让主角用行动穿过它。见证者按功能选择：能拍板、能作证、有利益、纯旁观。重点给前三类反应。大型宴会可换成走廊、柜台、地库或玻璃隔断外的工位区，让少量见证人完成公开裁决；文件原件、复印件和涂改件需要在画面上可区分。
body.en: Establish a standard the camera can show, then have the protagonist meet that standard through action. Choose witnesses by function: decision-makers, people who can testify, interested parties and mere onlookers. Give most attention to the first three groups’ reactions. Replace a large banquet with a corridor, a service counter, an underground car park or a workspace beyond a glass partition. A small number of witnesses can make the decision public. Original documents, copies and altered versions must be visually distinguishable.

heading.zh: 原创范例：被注销的维修资格
heading.en: Original Example: The Deleted Repair Certification

body.zh:
钟表维修师唐芮曾被合伙人删除认证记录。她没有在发布会上报出头衔，而是在售后柜台要求对方按现行规则接收一只返修表。合伙人认定她无权拆机；她请柜员扫描旧保修章，系统显示这批编号只能由原校准人复核。柜员暂停合伙人的结算权限，等认证中心核对。

唐芮拿回的是一次正式复核权，同时暴露了旧章仍在手里。对手下一集会封锁编号查询，反制来自刚才的结果。
body.en:
Watch repairer Tang Rui’s former business partner deleted her certification records. Instead of announcing her credentials at a launch event, she goes to the after-sales counter and asks for a watch to be accepted for further repairs under the current rules. Her former partner insists that she has no authority to open the watch. She asks the clerk to scan an old warranty stamp. The system shows that watches in this serial-number range can only be rechecked by the person who originally calibrated them. The clerk suspends the former partner’s settlement privileges pending verification by the certification centre.

Tang Rui has regained the right to one formal recheck, while revealing that she still has the old stamp. In the next episode, her opponent will block serial-number lookups. That countermove grows out of what just happened.

heading.zh: 防止连续打脸变重复
heading.en: Keep Repeated Comeuppances from Feeling Repetitive

body.zh:
让对手改变口径、渠道或替罪人；让每次回报使用不同货币结算，如程序、名声、关系、资源；早期给小额兑现，中期让有效手段伤及主角要保护的人；结尾让最初剥夺以新形式回来，迫使主角选择完整清算或接受有限偿还。

复查每次翻盘时，再写一行“对手下一步还能做什么”。答案若仍和上次一样，说明权力没有真正移动；答案若只能靠突然出现的新大人物，说明前面的裁决没有建立。让对手利用剩余资源反击，主角的胜利才会成为后续剧情的原因。
body.en:
Let the opponent change their story, their channels of influence or their scapegoat. Make each payoff take a different form: procedural authority, reputation, relationships or resources. Deliver modest gains early on. In the middle, let a method that works also hurt someone the protagonist wants to protect. At the end, bring back the original deprivation in a new form, forcing a choice between settling the whole account and accepting limited redress.

For each reversal, add one line: “What can the opponent still do next?” If the answer is unchanged from last time, power has not really shifted. If the only answer requires a newly introduced powerful figure, the earlier decision has not been properly established. Let the opponent counterattack using their remaining resources, so the protagonist’s victory becomes a cause of what happens next.

q.zh: 短剧方法需要固定时长或固定集数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed runtime or episode count?

a.zh: 不需要。先让目标、反制、转向和结果成立，再按项目已经接受的篇幅与制作条件调整容量。
a.en: No. First make the goal, countermove, change of direction and result work. Then adjust the amount of material to the length and production conditions already agreed for the project.

q.zh: 可以直接套用表格吗？
q.en: Can I use the table as it is?

a.zh: 表格用于发现缺口。正文仍要写成人物可执行的行动、对白与后果，空字段无需硬填。
a.en: Use the table to find gaps. The script still needs actions the characters can perform, dialogue and consequences. Do not force an entry into a field you do not need.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /short-drama-develop 按本文方法处理我的短剧，保留已有事实，不添加固定集数或平台规则”（Codex 中使用对应 skill）。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /short-drama-develop to work on my micro-drama using this article’s method. Preserve the established facts and do not add a fixed episode count or platform rules.” In Codex, use the corresponding skill.

title.zh: 萌宝短剧怎么写：让孩子拥有自己的目标
title.en: Writing Secret-Baby Dramas: Give the Child a Goal of Their Own

seo_title.en: How to Write a Secret-Baby Micro-Drama | ZenStory

description.zh: 固定四层信息权限，让孩子按自己的目标行动，并让血缘揭示落实为签字、接送或监护责任变化。
description.en: Define four layers of knowledge, give the child an independent goal, and turn a parentage reveal into changes in signing, pickups or care responsibilities.

answer.zh: 萌宝短剧先固定孩子掌握的事实、守秘者掌握的事实、关系另一方的认知和旁人相信的版本，再给孩子一个与成年人不完全相同的具体目标。孩子的行动要改变成年人的处境；血缘或身世揭示之后，必须有人改变签字、接送、探视、监护或公开称呼，关系才真正推进。
answer.en: For a secret-baby micro-drama, establish what the child knows, what the person keeping the secret knows, what the other person in the relationship understands and what everyone else believes. Then give the child a specific goal that does not wholly match the adults’ goals. The child’s actions should change the adults’ situation. After a reveal about parentage or origins, the story must visibly change who signs, who picks the child up, who may visit, who assumes responsibility for their care, or how people address one another in public. That is how the relationship moves forward.

heading.zh: 四层信息先固定
heading.en: Establish Four Layers of Knowledge

body.zh: 分别写孩子掌握哪些事实、守秘者握有哪些信息、关系另一方如何理解、旁人相信哪套说法。孩子可以全知、半知或误信，选定后保持一致。隐瞒需要具体理由和正在造成的损失；“怕说了会乱”无法支撑连续剧情。
body.en: Write down the facts the child knows, the information held by the person keeping the secret, the other person’s understanding of the relationship and the version believed by outsiders. The child may know everything, know part of the truth or believe something false. Once you choose, stay consistent. Concealment needs a specific reason and a loss it is currently causing. “Telling them would make things complicated” cannot sustain an ongoing plot.

heading.zh: 孩子要争取自己的结果
heading.en: Let the Child Pursue Their Own Outcome

body.zh: 孩子的目标可以是留在学校、让某人参加家长会、保护一个照料者或查清一句谎话。成年人争血缘时，孩子可能更在意谁能按时接他、谁尊重他的选择。让他通过藏起签到表、拨出手表电话或拒绝改紧急联系人采取行动，避免只负责卖萌和说金句。
body.en: The child might want to stay at their school, have someone attend a parent–teacher meeting, protect a caregiver or find out the truth behind a lie. While adults argue about biological ties, the child may care more about who arrives on time to collect them and who respects their choices. Let them act by hiding a sign-in sheet, calling someone on their smartwatch or refusing to change their emergency contact. Give them more to do than look cute and deliver quotable lines.

heading.zh: 原创范例：科学展的监护人栏
heading.en: Original Example: The Guardian Field on a Science-Fair Form

body.zh:
女孩米粒想让一直照顾她的姨父参加科学展，母亲却准备在报名表上填刚出现的生父。米粒没有撮合大人，她把需要监护人协助的实验改成个人项目，并把原登记表藏进作品箱。她重新填写个人项目登记表，暂时空着紧急联系人一栏。生父看到新表上的空栏，主动提出签字；姨父拒绝代替孩子决定。最终米粒自己把两人叫到学校，要求保留姨父为紧急联系人，生父先从普通访客开始。

揭示没有自动带来团圆，行动权限发生了可见变化。
body.en:
Mili wants her uncle, her aunt’s husband who has always cared for her, to attend the science fair. Her mother instead plans to put her biological father, who has only just entered their lives, on the registration form. Mili does not try to bring the adults together. She changes an experiment requiring a guardian’s help into an individual project and hides the original form in her project box. She fills out a new form for the individual project, temporarily leaving the emergency-contact field blank. Her biological father sees the blank field and offers to sign; her uncle refuses to decide on the child’s behalf. In the end, Mili herself asks both men to come to the school. She wants her uncle to remain her emergency contact and her biological father to start as an ordinary visitor.

The revelation does not automatically reunite the family. Instead, there is a visible change in who is allowed to do what.

heading.zh: 儿童角色与制作怎样兼顾
heading.en: Balance the Child’s Role with Production Needs

body.zh:
集中孩子必须在场的场次，让高情绪信息更多由动作、画、手表录音或随身物件承担；关键事实准备不依赖长台词的载体。成人争执不靠孩子反复生病升级。报告、签到表等关键道具要保证内容可读；动画形态也需按儿童认知和反应节奏写动作。

复查时把成人线和孩子线分别写一句目标。两句完全相同，孩子仍可能只是道具；让孩子争取自己的日常结果，再看他的行动怎样迫使成人表态。结尾还要检查孩子的意见是否真正改变安排，避免成人和解后自动替他决定。
body.en:
Group together the scenes in which the child must be present. Let actions, drawings, smartwatch recordings or personal objects carry more of the emotionally charged information. Prepare ways to convey key facts without relying on long speeches. Do not escalate adult disputes by repeatedly making the child ill. Keep important props such as reports and sign-in sheets legible. Even in animation, write actions to fit a child’s understanding and pace of response.

During review, write one sentence stating the adults’ goal and another stating the child’s. If they are identical, the child may still be functioning as a plot device. Let the child pursue an outcome that matters in daily life, then examine how their actions force the adults to take a position. At the ending, check whether the child’s wishes actually change the arrangements. Do not let the adults automatically decide for the child simply because they have reconciled.

q.zh: 短剧方法需要固定时长或固定集数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed runtime or episode count?

a.zh: 不需要。先让目标、反制、转向和结果成立，再按项目已经接受的篇幅与制作条件调整容量。
a.en: No. First make the goal, countermove, change of direction and result work. Then adjust the amount of material to the length and production conditions already agreed for the project.

q.zh: 可以直接套用表格吗？
q.en: Can I use the table as-is?

a.zh: 表格用于发现缺口。正文仍要写成人物可执行的行动、对白与后果，空字段无需硬填。
a.en: The table is for finding gaps. The prose still needs actions characters can perform, dialogue, and consequences; leave irrelevant fields blank rather than forcing them in.

text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /short-drama-develop to work on my micro-drama using this article’s method. Preserve the established facts and do not add a fixed episode count or platform rules.” In Codex, use the corresponding skill.

title.zh: 短剧剧本怎么写：把故事写成可表演的场景
title.en: Writing Micro-Drama Scripts: Turn Stories into Playable Scenes

seo_title.en: How to Write a Micro-Drama Script | ZenStory

description.zh: 从单集结果到场景目标、反对、转向和退出，附原创剧本片段与自查方法。
description.en: Work from an episode’s result to scene goals, opposition, turns and exit states. Includes an original script excerpt and a self-review method.

answer.zh: 短剧剧本先锁定本集必须交付的结果，再把它拆成不可替代的场景。每个冲突场景明确人物现场目标、对手筹码、策略受阻后的转向和退出状态；内心意义要通过行动、证据、空间、对白或有意声音让演员能够执行。
answer.en: First establish the result this episode must deliver, then break it into scenes that each do indispensable work. In every conflict scene, define the character’s immediate goal, the opponent’s leverage, the change of strategy when resistance blocks the first approach, and the state at the exit. Express inner meaning through action, evidence, space, dialogue or deliberate sound choices that actors can perform.

heading.zh: 从故事到剧本的最短路径
heading.en: The Shortest Route from Story to Script

body.zh:
先写本集进入事实、当集目标、局部结果和出去状态。随后只选择能完成目标争夺、证据获取、关系变化或带代价选择的场景。场景内用四问推进：谁想让什么发生；谁用什么阻止；哪项动作让旧策略失效；离场时谁取得或失去什么。

| 层次 | 写什么 | 避免什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 单集 | 本集完成的状态变化 | 平均分配事件 |
| 场景 | 目标、反对、转向、退出 | 人物坐着复述设定 |
| 动作 | 可见选择与物件结果 | 微表情清单 |
| 台词 | 对他人采取行动 | 替观众读资料 |
body.en:
Write the facts at the episode’s opening, its immediate goal, its local result and the state it leaves behind. Then choose only scenes that stage a contest over a goal, obtain evidence, change a relationship or force a costly choice. Use four questions within each scene: Who wants what to happen? Who prevents it, and how? Which action makes the old strategy fail? Who gains or loses what by the time they leave?

| Level | What to write | What to avoid |
|---|---|---|
| Episode | The change of state completed in this episode | Spreading events evenly across episodes |
| Scene | Goal, opposition, turn and exit | Characters sitting around restating the setting |
| Action | Visible choices and what happens to objects | Lists of micro-expressions |
| Dialogue | An action directed at another person | Reading background information aloud for the audience |

heading.zh: 动作和台词怎样写得可拍
heading.en: Make Action and Dialogue Filmable

body.zh: 动作使用现在时，一个段落聚焦一个行动或注意变化。场景标题交代内外、地点和时段即可；摄影参数、资产提示词留给后续环节。表演提示写策略，如“把威胁说成提醒”，少写连续情绪标签。必须读清的屏幕文字、关键画外音或音效单独标明，普通动作已经说明的事实无需重复标注。
body.en: Write action in the present tense, with each paragraph focusing on one action or shift in attention. A scene heading only needs interior or exterior, location and time of day; leave camera settings and asset prompts to later stages. Performance notes should specify a tactic, such as “make the threat sound like a reminder,” rather than a string of emotional labels. Mark screen text that must be legible, important off-screen voices and sound effects separately. Do not annotate facts already made clear by ordinary action.

heading.zh: 原创范例：洗衣店的取件牌
heading.en: Original Example: The Laundry Collection Tag

body.zh:
闭店前，许遥要取回被店主扣下的旧衣，店主要求她先承认欠费。

> 内 · 自助洗衣店 · 夜
>
> 店主把取件牌压在收银抽屉下。许遥没有伸手，转身拔掉正准备送走的打包车电源。
>
> 店主：欠款补齐，衣服归你。
>
> 许遥展开取件票，衣物特征栏写着“单粒金属扣”。
>
> 许遥：票据写的是返工。你先把缝坏的袖口拿出来。
>
> 店主推来一只封好的袋子。许遥隔着袋子摸到两粒金属扣，停住。她把取件票放在袋子旁，指向“单粒金属扣”。
>
> 许遥：这不是我的。现在该你找衣服了。

目标从取衣转为逼店主承认交付错误，物件改变了下一动作。例子为方法设计，未进行拍摄。
body.en:
Just before closing, Xu Yao wants to collect an old garment the shop owner is withholding. The owner first demands that she admit she owes money.

> INT. SELF-SERVICE LAUNDRY – NIGHT
>
> The owner traps the collection tag beneath the cash drawer. Instead of reaching for it, Xu Yao turns and unplugs the powered packing cart being readied for dispatch.
>
> OWNER: Pay what you owe, and the clothes are yours.
>
> Xu Yao unfolds her collection slip. Under identifying details: “One metal button.”
>
> XU YAO: The ticket says this was returned for rework. First, bring out the cuff you stitched badly.
>
> The owner pushes a sealed bag towards her. Through the bag, Xu Yao feels two metal buttons. She stops. She places the slip beside the bag and points to “One metal button.”
>
> XU YAO: This isn’t mine. Now you’re the one who needs to find the clothes.

The goal shifts from collecting the garment to forcing the owner to acknowledge the wrong item has been handed over. An object changes the next action. This example was designed to illustrate the method and has not been filmed.

heading.zh: 常见失败怎样修
heading.en: Fix Common Script Problems

body.zh:
| 失败 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 场景只交代信息 | 把信息放进争夺、验证或交换 |
| 对手只重复拒绝 | 给他能改变条件的筹码 |
| 转向只是更生气 | 加入使旧策略失效的事实或选择 |
| 内心全靠作者说明 | 找行为、证据、空间或声音载体 |
| 结尾恢复原状 | 留下知识、权力、关系或持物变化 |
body.en:
| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| The scene only conveys information | Put the information inside a contest, a verification or an exchange |
| The opponent only keeps saying no | Give them leverage that can change the terms |
| The turn amounts to getting angrier | Introduce a fact or choice that makes the old strategy fail |
| The author explains every inner feeling | Find a way to convey it through behaviour, evidence, space or sound |
| The ending restores the original state | Leave a change in knowledge, power, relationships or who holds an object |

q.zh: 短剧方法需要固定时长或固定集数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed runtime or episode count?

a.zh: 不需要。先让目标、反制、转向和结果成立，再按项目已经接受的篇幅与制作条件调整容量。
a.en: No. First make the goal, countermove, change of direction and result work. Then adjust the amount of material to the length and production conditions already agreed for the project.

q.zh: 可以直接套用表格吗？
q.en: Can I use the table as it is?

a.zh: 表格用于发现缺口。正文仍要写成人物可执行的行动、对白与后果，空字段无需硬填。
a.en: Use the table to find gaps. The script still needs actions the characters can perform, dialogue and consequences. Do not force an entry into a field you do not need.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /short-drama-write 按本文方法处理我的短剧，保留已有事实，不添加固定集数或平台规则”（Codex 中使用对应 skill）。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /short-drama-write to work on my micro-drama using this article’s method. Preserve the established facts and do not add a fixed episode count or platform rules.” In Codex, use the corresponding skill.

title.zh: 短剧一集怎么写：用因果链完成一次状态变化
title.en: Micro-Drama Episode Structure: Build a Chain of Consequences

seo_title.en: Micro-Drama Episode Structure | ZenStory

description.zh: 用进入状态、目标反制、方向转折、当集兑现和出去状态写完整单集，并用所以/但是测试。
description.en: Build an episode from entry state, goal and resistance, a turn, payoff and exit state. Test the causal chain with “therefore” and “but.”

answer.zh: 一集短剧要完成一次有边界的状态变化。先写可验证的进入状态，再让当前压力逼人物行动；每次选择触发反制，迫使人物换策略或付代价；结尾先兑现本集承诺，再留下由结果产生的下一步压力。
answer.en: An episode of a micro-drama should complete a bounded change of state. Establish a verifiable starting state, then let current pressure force the characters to act. Each choice triggers resistance that makes them change strategy or pay a cost. At the end, deliver this episode’s promised result before leaving new pressure that grows out of that result.

heading.zh: 单集结构的五个支点
heading.en: Five Anchors for an Episode

body.zh:
| 支点 | 核心问题 |
|---|---|
| 进入状态 | 人物带着哪些知识、持物和已启动行动进入？ |
| 目标与反对 | 谁想改变什么，对手能怎样真正阻止？ |
| 因果升级 | 前一选择怎样增加下一步难度？ |
| 当集兑现 | 观众在本集实际得到什么结果？ |
| 出去状态 | 谁知道什么、拿着什么、已经决定做什么？ |

分集大纲安排整季故事如何分配到各集；这里检查一集内部的选择与结果能否相互推动。集尾钩子则聚焦最后一拍如何留下下一步压力。
body.en:
| Anchor | Core question |
|---|---|
| Entry state | What do the characters know, what do they hold, and which actions are already underway? |
| Goal and opposition | Who wants to change what, and how can the opponent genuinely prevent it? |
| Causal escalation | How does the previous choice make the next step harder? |
| This episode’s payoff | What result do viewers actually get in this episode? |
| Exit state | Who knows what, holds what and has already decided to do what? |

An episode outline distributes the season’s story across episodes. Here, you are checking whether choices and results within one episode drive each other forward. An episode-ending hook focuses specifically on how the final beat leaves pressure for the next step.

heading.zh: 用“所以/但是”检查因果
heading.en: Test Causality with “Therefore” and “But”

body.zh: 把相邻节拍读成：“因为前一结果，所以人物这样做；但是对手利用新状态反制；所以人物换策略或承担代价。”只能用“然后”连接时，通常缺少选择、反制或状态变化。再做删集测试：删掉本集后，后续知识、权力、关系和行动若毫无损失，本集需要合并或重设结果。
body.en: Read adjacent beats as a chain: “Because of the previous result, the character therefore does this. But the opponent uses the new state to counter them. Therefore, the character changes strategy or accepts a cost.” If you can only connect the beats with “and then,” a choice, countermove or change of state is usually missing. Next, try removing the episode. If subsequent knowledge, power, relationships and actions lose nothing, merge the episode with another or give it a different result.

heading.zh: 原创范例：停办前的最后一堂课
heading.en: Original Example: The Last Class Before Closure

body.zh:
社区陶艺室收到停办通知。老师乔宁想让管理方接受安全整改，对方用未登记窑炉拒绝。她先交出维修单，所以管理员同意复查；但是维修单缺少设备编号，管理员当场贴封条；所以乔宁放弃保住全部设备，只申请带走学员尚未烧制的作品。管理员同意，却要求当晚清空。

本集兑现了“作品能取回”，也产生新压力“当晚如何完成搬运”。出去状态明确：窑炉被封、作品获准搬走、乔宁持有许可。
body.en:
A community pottery studio receives a closure notice. Teacher Qiao Ning wants management to approve her proposed safety fixes, but the administrator refuses because the kiln is unregistered. She presents a repair invoice, so the administrator agrees to inspect it again. But the invoice has no equipment ID, and the administrator seals the kiln on the spot. Qiao Ning therefore gives up on saving all the equipment and asks only to take away her students’ unfired pieces. The administrator agrees, but requires the approved pieces to be removed that night.

The episode delivers the result “the students’ pieces can be retrieved” and creates new pressure: “How will they move it all tonight?” The exit state is clear: the kiln is sealed, removal of the pieces is authorised, and Qiao Ning holds the permit.

heading.zh: 单集写散的修法
heading.en: Repair an Episode That Feels Disconnected

body.zh:
| 症状 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 开头刺激与目标无关 | 从正在执行的压力进入 |
| 每场可任意换序 | 让前场结果改变后场条件 |
| 所有答案推到下集 | 给本集一个局部结果 |
| 结尾突然来陌生事故 | 从本集胜利、代价或新知识长出压力 |
| 两集状态相同 | 合并，或让其中一集产生独有台阶 |
body.en:
| Symptom | Repair |
|---|---|
| The opening incident has nothing to do with the goal | Enter through pressure that is already taking effect |
| Scenes can be reordered arbitrarily | Make the result of one scene change the conditions of the next |
| Every answer is postponed until the next episode | Give this episode a partial result |
| The ending introduces an unrelated accident out of nowhere | Grow the new pressure from this episode’s victory, cost or newly acquired knowledge |
| Two episodes leave the same state | Merge them, or give one a distinct step forward |

a.en: No. First make the goal, countermove, change of direction and result work. Then adjust the amount of material to the length and production conditions already agreed for the project.

title.zh: 什么样的小说适合改短剧：先看能否变成屏幕行动
title.en: Which Novels Suit Micro-Drama Adaptation? Look for Screen Action

seo_title.zh: 什么样的小说适合改短剧｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Which Novels Work as Micro-Dramas? | ZenStory

description.zh: 按可直接上屏、需要换载体和文字专属三类判断小说改编价值，附开篇替换点和负担清单。
description.en: Sort material into screen-ready, requiring a new vehicle, or prose-only. Assess adaptation value with new openings and a production-burden checklist.

answer.zh: 判断小说是否适合改短剧，要按剧情单元检查功能由什么承载：可见行动、可听对白和空间关系可直接进入候选；内心或叙述承担的功能需要设计新载体；依赖叙述者与读者关系的效果要诚实舍弃。随后比较开篇转折、制作负担和可持续的分集结果。
answer.en: To judge whether a novel suits micro-drama adaptation, examine what carries each story unit’s function. Visible action, audible dialogue and spatial relationships are immediate candidates for the screen. Functions carried by thoughts or narration need a new vehicle. Be explicit about giving up effects that depend on the narrator’s relationship with the reader. Then compare opening turns, production demands and the potential to keep delivering results episode by episode.

heading.zh: 三类屏幕适配判断
heading.en: Three Ways Material Can Relate to the Screen

body.zh:
| 判断 | 读者问题 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 可直接上屏 | 关键变化已由行动、对白或空间完成吗？ | 保留并压缩 |
| 需要换载体 | 功能成立，但当前只在叙述或内心里吗？ | 写出物证、关系动作、对白策略或第三方反应 |
| 文字专属 | 效果依赖叙述视角欺骗或长期文字回扣吗？ | 明说舍弃及损失 |

“需要换载体”必须指出新载体保住什么、改变什么。仍靠旁白解释一切，问题尚未解决。
body.en:
| Category | Question to ask | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Screen-ready | Is the key change already conveyed through action, dialogue or spatial relationships? | Retain it and compress it |
| Needs a new vehicle | Does the function work, but currently exist only in narration or thought? | Convey it through physical evidence, an action that affects a relationship, a dialogue tactic or a third party’s reaction |
| Prose-only | Does the effect depend on deception through narrative perspective or callbacks built up over a long stretch of prose? | State explicitly what you will omit and what will be lost |

For material that needs a new vehicle, specify what the replacement preserves and what it changes. If voiceover still has to explain everything, the problem remains unsolved.

heading.zh: 寻找开篇替换点
heading.en: Find an Alternative Starting Point

body.zh: 短剧开篇优先寻找第一个可见、有代价、当场发生的选择。它可能晚于小说第一章。把此前内容分成两类：观众理解选择必须知道的，移到动作后补入；只服务阅读氛围或长线记忆的，暂不带入。找不到可拍转折，本身就是改编风险。
body.en: For a micro-drama opening, look first for a visible, costly choice made in the moment. It may occur later than the novel’s first chapter. Divide earlier material into two groups: what viewers must know to understand the choice, which you can supply after the action, and what serves only the atmosphere of the prose or long-term recall, which you can leave out for now. An inability to find a filmable turn is itself an adaptation risk.

heading.zh: 原创快评：钟表铺学徒记
heading.en: Original Quick Assessment: The Watchmaker’s Apprentice

body.zh:
虚构小说前段大量依赖主人公辨认钟声时的内心联想。单元一“听声认出假零件”需要换载体：让她停下全店钟摆，只留下故障表的异响，并据此拒绝签收；保住专业判断，失去部分诗性联想。单元二用叙述者故意省略她早已认识送货人，属于文字专属，改编需放弃骗局或重建观众信息位置。

可用开篇从她拒签一箱昂贵零件开始。场景集中在店面和仓库，同框人数少；可读标签和多版本零件会增加连续性负担。
body.en:
The opening of this fictional novel relies heavily on the protagonist’s internal associations as she recognises the sounds of clocks. In the first unit, “identifying a counterfeit part by sound” needs a new vehicle. Have her stop every pendulum in the shop, leaving only the faulty watch’s unusual noise, and refuse to sign for the delivery on that basis. This preserves her professional judgment while losing some of the poetic associations. In the second unit, the narrator deliberately omits that she already knows the delivery person. That effect is prose-only: the adaptation must abandon the deception or rebuild what the audience knows and when.

A workable opening is her refusal to sign for a box of expensive parts. Scenes are concentrated in the shop and storeroom, with few people in the same frame. Legible labels and multiple versions of the parts will add continuity demands.

heading.zh: 选书时还要检查什么
heading.en: What Else Should You Check When Choosing a Novel?

body.zh: 检查主角是否会作出可见选择；对手是否有可执行筹码；每个单元能否产生局部结果；核心回报是否需要观众记住大量细节；群戏、动作、特效、可读文字和跨时造型是否与制作形态匹配。结论只覆盖读过的内容，抽样快评应保留可被全量阅读推翻的余地。
body.en: Check whether the protagonist makes visible choices; whether the opponent has leverage they can actually use; whether each unit can deliver a partial result; and whether the central payoff requires viewers to remember many details. Assess whether ensemble scenes, action, visual effects, legible text and changes in character appearance across time fit the production format. Limit conclusions to material you have read. A quick assessment based on a sample must remain open to being overturned by a full reading.

q.en: Does this method require a fixed runtime or episode count?

a.zh: 不需要。先让目标、反制、转向和结果成立，再按项目已经接受的篇幅与制作条件调整容量。
a.en: No. First make the goal, countermove, change of direction and result work. Then adjust the amount of material to the length and production conditions already agreed for the project.

a.zh: 表格用于发现缺口。正文仍要写成人物可执行的行动、对白与后果，空字段无需硬填。
a.en: Use the table to find gaps. The script still needs actions the characters can perform, dialogue and consequences. Do not force an entry into a field you do not need.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 中用 /short-drama-novel-analyze（Codex 中用 $short-drama-novel-analyze）对已提供的小说做只读适配快评：哪些冲突可以上屏，哪些内心信息需要换载体，哪些关键效果难以保留？结论限于实际读取的范围，暂不进入剧本开发。
text.en: In Claude Code, use /short-drama-novel-analyze (in Codex, use $short-drama-novel-analyze) for a read-only adaptation assessment of the novel you have supplied: which conflicts can be shown on screen, which internal information needs a new vehicle, and which key effects will be hard to preserve? Limit conclusions to the material actually read, and do not start script development yet.

title.zh: 短剧台词怎么写：让每句话改变现场
title.en: Writing Micro-Drama Dialogue: Make Every Line Change the Scene

seo_title.en: How to Write Micro-Drama Dialogue | ZenStory

description.zh: 从人物议程、潜台词风险、可见锚点和策略变化写短剧对白，附交换说话者测试与原创对谈。
description.en: Build dialogue from agendas, subtext risks, visible anchors and tactical shifts. Includes a speaker-swap test and an original exchange.

answer.zh: 短剧台词先写说话者想让对方做什么，再选择字面表达。对方反制后，人物要换策略、付代价或退出；潜台词来自不能直说的风险，并由动作、称呼、物件或公开范围给观众推断依据。关键台词之后要有可见行为变化。
answer.en: Before choosing the words of a line, decide what the speaker wants the other person to do. When the other person counters, the speaker must change tactics, pay a cost or withdraw. Subtext grows from the risk of speaking openly. Actions, forms of address, objects and who can hear the exchange give viewers evidence to infer what remains unsaid. A key line should lead to a visible change in behaviour.

heading.zh: 先写议程，再写句子
heading.en: Write the Agenda Before the Sentence

body.zh: 为双方写：当前要求、手中筹码、不能公开的事、最怕被看见的风险、第一策略和受阻后的换策。同一句“门要关了”可以催促、推责、试探、威胁或保护。台词的字面相近，现场行动不同。
body.en: For each participant, write down their immediate demand, leverage, what they cannot reveal, the risk they most fear exposing, their first tactic and how they will change tactics if blocked. The same line, “The door’s about to close,” can hurry someone along, deflect responsibility, probe, threaten or protect. The words may be similar while the action they perform in the scene is different.

heading.zh: 短剧对白的屏幕特性
heading.en: Make Dialogue Work on Screen

body.zh: 一室对谈也要不断改变谁能做什么。用门、电话、录音、文件或争夺中的物件作为可见锚点；停顿期间让人物拆钥匙、藏证据或改变公开范围；长发言只有在内部议程转折时才用动作断开。画面已经证明的机制无需台词复述。
body.en: Even a conversation in one room should keep changing who can do what. Use a door, a phone, a recording, a document or an object under dispute as a visible anchor. During pauses, let characters take a key off a key ring, hide evidence or change who can hear or see what is happening. Break a long speech with action only when its internal agenda shifts. Dialogue need not repeat a mechanism the images have already demonstrated.

heading.zh: 原创范例：被撤下的展板
heading.en: Original Example: The Removed Exhibition Panel

body.zh:
策展人苏禾要恢复一块被撤下的学生展板，场地方罗致想让她签“自愿撤展”。

> 罗致把笔放到表格上：签完，作品今晚还能入库。
>
> 苏禾：入库的人是谁？作者，还是你们？
>
> 罗致把表格翻到签名页：你现在只需要保住作品。
>
> 苏禾将自己的工作证压在签名处：那就写我拒绝代作者签字。

罗致用保存作品诱导签字，苏禾重定义签字权，再用工作证承担职业代价。每句都改变现场选择。例子为原创文本。
body.en:
Curator Su He wants to reinstate a student’s exhibition panel that has been removed. Luo Zhi, representing the venue, wants her to sign a statement that the work is being withdrawn voluntarily.

> Luo Zhi places a pen on the form. “Sign, and the work can still go into storage tonight.”
>
> Su He: “Who’s putting it into storage? The artist, or you?”
>
> Luo Zhi turns to the signature page. “Right now, you just need to protect the work.”
>
> Su He places her staff ID over the signature space. “Then write that I refuse to sign on the artist’s behalf.”

Luo Zhi uses the offer to preserve the work to induce a signature. Su He reframes who has the right to sign, then uses her staff ID to accept a professional cost. Each line changes the choices available in the room. This is an original written example.

heading.zh: 四个修订测试
heading.en: Four Revision Tests

body.zh:
标注每句在逼问、遮掩、交换、划界还是验证；检查它是否回应上一动作；删除人物共同已知的说明；交换说话者后，若情节仍成立，就补入各自目标、证据观和关系风险。最后朗读，确认打断、沉默和动作都有行动原因。

对白写完后遮住人名快速读一遍，再对照相邻动作。辨认说话者的依据应来自他关注的证据、愿意承担的代价和面对听者的关系策略。若只靠口头禅区分，换掉词汇后声音会再次混在一起。

修订后的句子还要服从本场既定结果。金句再锋利，也不能偷偷改掉人物选择。
body.en:
Label what each line does: press for an answer, conceal, trade, set a boundary or verify. Check whether it responds to the preceding action. Remove explanations of what both characters already know. Swap the speakers; if the scene still works, add their distinct goals, attitudes towards evidence and relationship risks. Finally, read it aloud to check that interruptions, silences and actions all have a purpose.

Once the dialogue is written, hide the names and read it quickly, then compare it with the surrounding actions. A speaker should be recognisable through the evidence they attend to, the costs they will accept and the tactics they use in this relationship. If catchphrases are the only distinction, replacing those words will make the voices blur again.

Revised lines must still serve the scene’s established result. However sharp a line sounds, it must not quietly change the character’s choice.

q.zh: 短剧方法需要固定时长或固定集数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed runtime or episode count?

a.zh: 不需要。先让目标、反制、转向和结果成立，再按项目已经接受的篇幅与制作条件调整容量。
a.en: No. First make the goal, countermove, change of direction and result work. Then adjust the amount of material to the length and production conditions already agreed for the project.

q.zh: 可以直接套用表格吗？
q.en: Can I use the table as-is?

a.zh: 表格用于发现缺口。正文仍要写成人物可执行的行动、对白与后果，空字段无需硬填。
a.en: The table is for finding gaps. The prose still needs actions characters can perform, dialogue, and consequences; leave irrelevant fields blank rather than forcing them in.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /short-drama-write 按本文方法处理我的短剧，保留已有事实，不添加固定集数或平台规则”（Codex 中使用对应 skill）。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /short-drama-write to work on my micro-drama using this article’s method. Preserve the established facts and do not add a fixed episode count or platform rules.” In Codex, use the corresponding skill.

title.zh: 短剧中段拖沓怎么办：让故事循环换代
title.en: Fixing a Micro-Drama’s Sagging Middle: Renew the Story Cycle

seo_title.en: Fix a Micro-Drama’s Sagging Middle | ZenStory

description.zh: 用顺序打乱测试识别重复循环，通过换向量、抬代价、收束、改造或移交恢复中段动力。
description.en: Spot repetition by shuffling sequences. Restore momentum with a new line of proof, higher costs, closure, a changed mechanism or a handover.

answer.zh: 短剧中段拖沓常来自同一机制免费重复：场面更大，人物掌握的信息、可用筹码、知情者和退路却没变。先把几次运行调换顺序；若毫无损失，就是重复。保留核心追问，改变证明方式与代价，并在机制耗尽时收束、改造或移交。
answer.en: A micro-drama’s middle often sags when the same mechanism repeats without cost: the scenes get bigger, but what the characters know, the leverage available, who knows the secret and the escape routes all stay the same. Swap the order of several repetitions. If nothing is lost, they are redundant. Keep the central question, change how it is tested and what it costs, and close, reshape or hand over the mechanism when it runs out of possibilities.

heading.zh: 先找反复运行的机制
heading.en: Identify the Mechanism That Keeps Repeating

body.zh: 写清主角每次用什么优势、对手为何会行动、观众提前知道什么、本次改变哪项状态、主角付出什么成本。免费循环最先耗尽。若对手吃过亏仍按原办法配合，机制已经要求人物变笨。
body.en: Write down the advantage the protagonist uses each time, why the opponent acts, what the audience knows in advance, which state changes this time and what the protagonist pays. A cycle that costs nothing wears out first. If an opponent has already lost but keeps cooperating with the same setup, the mechanism now depends on the opponent acting foolishly.

heading.zh: 顺序打乱与换向量
heading.en: Shuffle the Order and Change the Line of Proof

body.zh: 把中段三次运行交换位置。认知、难度、知情者、适用条件和退路没有变化，就需合并。修订时保持同一靶心，换回应向量：上次用钱证明资格，下次改由权限、关系选择或对手反制验证；避免换成弱相关新线。
body.en: Change the order of three iterations in the middle. If nothing changes in knowledge, difficulty, who knows the truth, the conditions under which the method works or the available ways out, combine them. During revision, keep the same central question but test it differently. If money served as proof of qualification last time, use authority, a relationship choice or an opponent’s countermove next. Do not replace the cycle with a loosely related new storyline.

heading.zh: 原创范例：修鞋摊的保修章
heading.en: Original Example: The Shoe-Repair Stall’s Warranty Stamp

body.zh: 主角每次用隐藏的老师傅身份纠正同行，前两次都靠展示手艺，第三次已可预测。改造后：第一次完整演示修复假裂纹；第二次店主不再比手艺，质疑她没有保修权，她请真正返修过的顾客拿出保修章；第三次对手学会避开公开比较，直接停掉材料供应。主角必须把方法移交给徒弟，由徒弟用另一家供应渠道完成订单。靶心仍是“谁有资格承担修复”，难度、知情者和代价持续变化。
body.en: The protagonist keeps correcting other shoe repairers while concealing that she is a master craftsperson. The first two encounters both rely on displaying her skill, making the third predictable. After revision, the first encounter shows the complete repair of a fake crack. In the second, the shop owner refuses another skill contest and instead challenges her right to offer a warranty. She asks a customer who has previously brought an item back for a warranty repair to show the warranty stamp. In the third, the opponent has learned to avoid public comparisons and cuts off her material supply instead. She must pass the method to her apprentice, who completes the order using another supplier. The central question remains “Who is qualified to take responsibility for the repair?” while difficulty, who knows what and costs keep changing.

heading.zh: 循环耗尽后的三种处理
heading.en: Three Options When a Cycle Runs Out

body.zh:
**收束**让机制在一次不可重复的运行中结清；**改造**保留机制，改变适用条件、代价或承担者；**移交**让另一个人物使用同一机制，改变观众立场。新循环要继承旧循环的时限、退出成本和观众已经在意的人或物，先处理余波，再抬起下一股压力。

换代前另做一次“什么都不做”测试：主角若退出，新循环会造成什么具体损失？答案比旧循环更抽象，说明紧迫性没有交接。把旧循环中已经在意的人、物、时限或责任带入新机制，再开始下一轮。

换代完成后，给旧回报留出一拍余波，让观众确认损失与关系变化。
body.en:
**Close it:** Settle the mechanism in one final use that cannot be repeated. **Reshape it:** Keep the mechanism but change its conditions, cost or the person who bears it. **Hand it over:** Let another character use the same mechanism, changing the audience’s perspective. The new cycle must inherit the old one’s time limits, cost of walking away and people or objects the audience already cares about. Deal with the aftermath before introducing the next source of pressure.

Before the transition, run a “do nothing” test: if the protagonist walks away, what specific loss will the new cycle cause? If the answer is more abstract than in the old cycle, the urgency has not carried over. Bring an established person, object, deadline or responsibility into the new mechanism before starting the next round.

Once the transition is complete, leave a beat for the previous payoff’s aftermath so viewers can register the losses and changes in relationships.

title.zh: 小说改游戏选什么类型：把原作的反复行动变成玩法
title.en: Choosing Gameplay for a Novel Adaptation: Start with Repeated Actions

seo_title.zh: 小说改游戏怎么选玩法｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Choosing Gameplay for a Novel Adaptation | ZenStory

description.zh: 从原作反复出现的行动、规则与代价选择游戏玩法，比较解谜、经营和互动叙事的承载方式。附原创同题三案与可填写的概念卡。
description.en: Use recurring actions, rules and costs to compare puzzles, management and interactive narrative. See three original designs and a fill-in concept card.

answer.zh: 先找玩家能够反复决定的事，再选游戏类型。原作有战斗不等于必须做动作游戏，有大量对白也不等于只能做视觉小说。把一个核心情境分别写成几种玩法，比较玩家改变了什么、原作规则怎样影响操作、世界如何回应，以及第一段能否在现有条件下做出来。
answer.en: Find decisions the player can make repeatedly before choosing a game genre. Combat in the novel does not automatically call for an action game, nor does abundant dialogue restrict you to a visual novel. Turn one central situation into several gameplay concepts. Compare what the player changes, how the source’s rules affect their actions, how the world responds and whether you can build the opening section with your current resources.

heading.zh: 先从小说里找玩法材料
heading.en: Extract Gameplay Material from the Novel

body.zh:
| 小说里看到的内容 | 转成设计问题 | 暂时别急着做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 主角反复查证、比较或试探 | 玩家能根据什么信息作出不同判断？ | 把所有查案场面直接改成找隐藏物品 |
| 主角管理资源与承诺 | 分配会改变谁的行动机会？ | 给每段剧情加一条金币进度条 |
| 人物关系决定事情能否办成 | 玩家选择向谁求助、透露什么、承担什么？ | 把全部具体关系压成一个好感度 |
| 世界规则有条件和例外 | 玩家怎样学会规则、利用限制、承受反制？ | 只把规则写进开场说明 |
| 原作只有一次的高潮 | 这一幕适合作为结局还是可以重复变化？ | 把一次奇观当作全程循环 |

区分已经写在原作里的事实和你新增的设计。原作没有说明资源能否恢复、谁有权限拒绝或失败会怎样，就把它列为改编时需要决定的问题，别悄悄冒充原作设定。
body.en:
| What you find in the novel | Turn it into a design question | Avoid jumping straight to this |
|---|---|---|
| The protagonist repeatedly investigates, compares or probes | What information could lead the player to different judgments? | Turning every investigation scene into a hidden-object search |
| The protagonist manages resources and commitments | Whose opportunities to act change when resources are allocated? | Adding a gold progress bar to every plot segment |
| Relationships determine whether something can be accomplished | Whom does the player ask for help, what do they disclose and what do they take on? | Reducing all specific relationships to one affinity score |
| World rules have conditions and exceptions | How does the player learn the rules, exploit constraints and face countermoves? | Putting the rules only in the opening explanation |
| The source has a one-off climax | Does this scene work as an ending, or can it recur with variation? | Treating a singular spectacle as the loop for the whole game |

Distinguish facts already established in the source from design decisions you add. If the novel does not say whether a resource replenishes, who can refuse or what failure causes, record that as a question to decide during adaptation. Do not quietly present the answer as part of the original setting.

heading.zh: 先写循环，再贴类型标签
heading.en: Write the Loop Before Naming the Genre

body.zh:
用下面这张概念卡写每个候选方案：

> **玩家身份**：他能接触什么，不能替谁作决定？
>
> **反复行动**：观察或接收什么 → 选择什么 → 执行什么。
>
> **反馈**：玩家如何知道自己的判断产生了后果？
>
> **持续变化**：哪项信息、资源、关系或机会带到下一轮？
>
> **原作特征**：哪条规则改变动作的对象、顺序、代价或世界回应？
>
> **第一段范围**：用一个什么情境就能看见这个循环是否成立？

动作可以很少。关键在于玩家如何判断与介入，以及世界是否记得具体发生过的事。固定结局的故事也可以让过程有意义，例如改变谁愿意同行、哪项承诺被兑现、人物如何理解最后的结果。
body.en:
Fill out this concept card for each candidate:

> **Player role:** What can they access, and whose decisions can they not make?
>
> **Repeated action:** What do they observe or receive → what do they choose → what do they carry out?
>
> **Feedback:** How does the player know their judgment had consequences?
>
> **Persistent change:** What information, resource, relationship or opportunity carries into the next round?
>
> **Source-specific feature:** Which rule changes the target, order or cost of an action, or the world’s response?
>
> **Opening scope:** What single situation would show whether this loop works?

You may need very few actions. What matters is how the player judges and intervenes, and whether the world remembers specific events. Even a story with a fixed ending can give the journey meaning: who agrees to accompany the player, which promise is kept or how characters understand the final outcome can change.

heading.zh: 原创同题三案：修补声音的工坊
heading.en: Three Original Designs: A Workshop That Repairs Voices

body.zh:
**虚构原作种子**：一座小城用陶片保存人的声音。工匠只能修复裂纹附近的一段录音；修复时会磨掉相邻片段。委托人常想保住不同的那句话，而陶片上也可能留下他们不愿承认的往事。

下面是基于这一种子的三种新增游戏设计，具体操作与反馈均属于本例的改编方案。

| 候选方向 | 玩家反复做什么 | 原作规则怎样进入玩法 | 世界如何回应 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 声音解谜 | 试听残片，判断哪处值得修复，选择处理顺序 | 恢复一段会损失相邻信息，顺序影响剩余线索 | 新片段支持或推翻原假说，部分线索永久失去 |
| 工坊经营 | 接委托、安排处理、协商客户希望保留的内容 | 订单价值不能只由收入决定，还受不可兼得的声音片段约束 | 客户根据实际留下的话选择继续委托、撤单或带来新请求 |
| 互动叙事 | 在听完局部录音后，决定向谁说明已知事实、保留哪项承诺 | 工匠知道的信息有限，损失的片段让解释存在空缺 | 人物按被告知的具体内容改变合作与信任，而非只增加一个关系数值 |

这三个方案可以共享陶片设定，体验重点却不同：第一种重在证据与修复顺序，第二种重在承诺之间的安排，第三种重在信息与关系后果。

如果你最想让玩家感受“救回一句话就会失去另一句”，第一种最直接地把这种张力放进操作。若创作重点是工匠与小城居民长期相处，后两种可能更贴近目标。选型依据是希望玩家亲自承担什么，而非哪种类型听起来规模更大。
body.en:
**Fictional source seed:** A small town preserves people’s voices in pottery shards. A craftsperson can restore only the stretch of recording near a crack; the repair grinds away adjacent passages. Clients often want to save different lines, and a shard may contain a past they would rather not acknowledge.

The following are three new game designs based on that seed. Their specific actions and feedback are adaptation decisions introduced for this example.

| Direction | What the player repeatedly does | How the source rule enters play | How the world responds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Audio puzzles | Listen to fragments, judge what is worth repairing and choose a treatment order | Restoring one passage destroys neighbouring information, so the order changes the clues that remain | New passages support or overturn the current hypothesis; some clues are lost permanently |
| Workshop management | Accept commissions, schedule work and negotiate which content clients want preserved | Revenue alone cannot determine an order’s value: some voice passages cannot both be saved | Clients choose to return, cancel or bring new requests based on the words actually preserved |
| Interactive narrative | After hearing part of a recording, decide whom to tell what and which promise to keep | The craftsperson has limited knowledge; lost passages leave gaps in any explanation | Characters change their cooperation and trust according to the specific information shared, rather than merely adding to a relationship score |

All three can share the pottery-shard setting while emphasising different experiences. The first centres on evidence and repair order; the second on managing competing promises; the third on information and relationship consequences.

If you most want players to feel that “saving one sentence means losing another,” the first puts that tension most directly into their actions. If the creative focus is the craftsperson’s long-term relationships with the town’s residents, the other two may fit better. Choose according to what you want players to take responsibility for themselves, not which genre sounds bigger.

heading.zh: 怎样识别“只换了小说皮”的方案？
heading.en: Spot a Design That Only Reskins the Novel

body.zh:
把专有名词暂时换成普通称呼，再看玩法是否仍保留原作差异。

在工坊例子里，如果操作只是点一次按钮、花固定金币、播放既定对白，陶片磨损规则完全不影响可选行动，小说的关键张力就停在说明文字里。可以进一步问：

- 玩家改变的是事情的原因和方向，还是只付费放行同一段剧情？
- 世界回应了玩家做过的具体选择，还是无论保住哪句话都给同一句评价？
- 原作规则改变了行动顺序、代价或可获得的信息吗？
- 所谓成长有没有改变能力、理解或机会，还是只有数值变大？

同类游戏可以使用相似的基础操作。区别应当体现在操作对象、取舍和后果，而无需为了显得原创额外堆出很多系统。
body.en:
Temporarily replace proper nouns with ordinary labels and see whether the gameplay still retains what distinguishes the source.

In the workshop example, suppose the player only clicks a button, pays a fixed amount of gold and hears predetermined dialogue. If the shard’s wear rule never changes the available actions, the novel’s central tension remains trapped in explanatory text. Ask:

- Does the player change the causes and direction of events, or merely pay to let the same plot segment proceed?
- Does the world respond to their specific choices, or deliver the same assessment regardless of which sentence they save?
- Do source rules change action order, costs or available information?
- Does progression change abilities, understanding or opportunities, or do only the numbers get larger?

Games in the same genre can share basic actions. Distinction should appear in what those actions affect, the trade-offs and the consequences. You do not need to pile on systems just to appear original.

heading.zh: 用最小情境比较方案，而非先做整本书
heading.en: Compare Small, Complete Situations Before Adapting the Whole Book

body.zh:
为候选方向各写一个可以走完的小情境：一位委托人、一块陶片、一处会影响后续的决定，以及一个可观察结果。先在纸上推演，明确哪些信息来自原作、哪些是新增设计，再决定实现什么。

**解谜方案的首段**可以提供两段可试听碎音，让玩家先判断要恢复哪一侧；恢复后显示获得与失去的内容，允许回看决定之前已知的信息。它验证“修复顺序是否真的影响理解”。

**经营方案的首段**则需要至少能看见承诺之间的冲突和协商结果。如果现有时间只够做一个无需取舍的订单，它还不足以证明经营循环成立；此时可以缩小设计承诺，或优先比较其他方向。

不要用短小演示宣称整本书已经可玩。概念选型只确定值得继续验证的方向；[小说改游戏流程](/novel-to-game/quick-start)再处理设计、构建与实际运行检查。
body.en:
Write a small situation you can complete for each direction: one client, one shard, one decision affecting what follows and one observable result. Walk through it on paper first, marking what comes from the source and what is new design, then decide what to implement.

**The opening of the puzzle design** could offer two short audio fragments and ask players which side to restore first. Afterwards, show what they gained and lost, and let them revisit the information available before the decision. This tests whether repair order genuinely changes understanding.

**The opening of the management design** must at least make a conflict between commitments and the result of negotiation visible. If you only have time for one order that requires no trade-off, that is not enough to establish a management loop. Narrow the design promise or compare other directions first.

Do not claim that the entire book is playable on the strength of a brief demo. Concept selection only identifies a direction worth testing further. The [novel-to-game workflow](/novel-to-game/quick-start) then covers design, implementation and testing in a running build.

q.zh: 对白多的小说适合做视觉小说吗？
q.en: Does a dialogue-heavy novel suit a visual novel?

a.zh: 可以把视觉小说作为候选，再检查对白中是否存在值得玩家判断的信息、关系和选择。若玩家只能连续点下一页，这仍是阅读体验；想承诺互动后果，就要设计对话如何改变之后的机会或回应。
a.en: Consider a visual novel as one candidate, then check whether the dialogue contains information, relationships and choices that give the player meaningful judgments to make. If they can only keep clicking to the next page, the experience remains reading. To promise interactive consequences, design how conversations change later opportunities or responses.

q.zh: 一定要让玩家扮演原作主角吗？
q.en: Must the player take the role of the original protagonist?

a.zh: 如果身份尚未确定，可以比较主角、原创角色、势力或观察者各能访问什么行动空间。换身份会改变可知道的信息与可执行的决定，需要明确作为改编设计，而非直接继承主角的一切权限。
a.en: If the role is not fixed yet, compare the actions available to the protagonist, an original character, a faction or an observer. Changing roles changes what can be known and which decisions can be made. Identify this as adaptation design rather than automatically inheriting every power of the protagonist.

text.zh: 在已有 SOURCE_BIBLE.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 的项目中，在 Claude Code 中说：“用 /game-concept 基于已经分析的小说范围提出不同玩法概念，比较玩家反复行动、原作规则如何影响操作、具体世界回应和最小可验证情境。将新增设计与原作事实分开。”Codex 中使用 `$game-concept`。
text.en: In a project that already has SOURCE_BIBLE.md and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, say in Claude Code: “Use /game-concept to propose different gameplay concepts based on the novel material already analysed. Compare repeated player actions, how source rules affect those actions, specific world responses and the smallest testable situation. Separate new design from source facts.” In Codex, use `$game-concept`.

title.zh: 网文写什么题材好：从兴趣、承诺到试写验证
title.en: Choosing a Web-Fiction Genre: From Interest to a Trial Scene

seo_title.en: Choosing a Genre for Web Fiction | ZenStory

description.zh: 不用追逐未经核实的热度。用素材储备、读者承诺、持续发动机和试写成本筛选题材。
description.en: Skip unverified hype. Choose a genre using your material, a promise to readers, a sustainable story engine and the cost of a trial draft.

answer.zh: 选择网文题材时，先把“我喜欢”拆成能持续写出的素材，再用一句话说明读者反复来看什么。随后检查这个承诺能否产生多轮不同冲突、自己是否理解其中的生活与规则，最后用一段开头试写检验人物、节奏和题材声音。题材结论始终是待验证假设。
answer.en: When choosing a genre for web fiction, turn “I like this” into material you can keep writing about, then state in one sentence what readers will return for. Check whether that promise can generate several rounds of different conflicts and whether you understand the lives and rules involved. Finally, draft an opening passage to test the characters, pacing and the genre’s voice. Your choice of genre remains a hypothesis to test.

heading.zh: 选题四步
heading.en: Four Steps to Choosing a Genre

body.zh:
1. **列素材**：写出自己熟悉的职业、关系、生活经验与长期兴趣。
2. **定承诺**：用一句话说明读者将反复获得的体验。
3. **查发动机**：列出几种性质不同的冲突，看承诺能否持续运转。
4. **低成本试写**：写开头的一段完整运动，检查人物目标、阻力、回报和后续空间。

外部榜单只在来源、日期和样本边界清楚时用作证据；没有当前数据时，不把印象包装成趋势。
body.en:
1. **List your material:** Note occupations, relationships, life experiences and lasting interests you know well.
2. **Define the promise:** State in one sentence the experience readers will repeatedly get.
3. **Test the story engine:** List several fundamentally different conflicts to see whether the promise can keep generating a story.
4. **Try a low-cost draft:** Write one complete opening sequence and examine the character’s goal, resistance, payoff and room to continue.

Use external rankings as evidence only when their source, date and sample boundaries are clear. Without current data, do not present an impression as a trend.

heading.zh: 题材与作者怎样匹配
heading.en: Match the Genre to the Writer

body.zh:
| 检查 | 可回答的问题 |
|---|---|
| 知识 | 我能否写出规则怎样限制选择？ |
| 情绪 | 我真正想反复体验哪种满足或痛感？ |
| 人物 | 除主角外，谁有独立目标与筹码？ |
| 长线 | 第一轮解决后，什么会变得更难？ |
| 风险 | 最可能在哪一段耗尽素材？ |

“自嗨”常见于作者只享受设定，却没有把乐趣转换成读者可感知的期待、行动和结果。保留个人兴趣，同时补上读者进入故事的入口。
body.en:
| Check | Question to answer |
|---|---|
| Knowledge | Can I show how rules limit choices? |
| Emotion | What satisfaction or pain do I genuinely want to explore repeatedly? |
| Characters | Besides the protagonist, who has independent goals and leverage? |
| Long-term potential | What becomes harder after the first round is resolved? |
| Risk | Where am I most likely to run out of material? |

Self-indulgence often arises when the author enjoys a setting but has not turned that enjoyment into expectations, actions and results readers can perceive. Keep your personal interests while giving readers a way into the story.

heading.zh: 原创范例：修复档案的都市悬疑
heading.en: Original Example: An Urban Mystery About Restoring Records

body.zh:
作者熟悉社区档案整理，也喜欢亲属秘密。初始想法“主角能从旧纸张看见过去”很宽。整理后承诺变成：每个单元用一份被改写的公共记录，迫使一个家庭重新选择要公开什么。

发动机可以变化：住址注销影响继承、旧名单影响荣誉、借阅记录影响证词。试写只写主角在拆迁登记处发现同一户号有两种墨水，并决定暂缓盖章。若这一场只能解释能力、没有人物因此改变行动，题材还需调整。
body.en:
The author knows community archive work and enjoys family secrets. The initial idea, “The protagonist can see the past through old sheets of paper,” is broad. After refinement, the promise becomes: each story unit uses an altered public record to force a family to reconsider what to make public.

The engine can vary: a cancelled address registration affects inheritance, an old list affects an honour, and a borrowing record affects testimony. For the trial draft, write only the protagonist discovering two different inks under the same household number at a demolition registration office and choosing to postpone stamping the record. If the scene merely explains the ability without anyone changing their actions because of it, the concept still needs adjustment.

heading.zh: 什么时候确定或放弃
heading.en: When to Commit, Revise or Walk Away

body.zh: 试写后记录：最自然的一场冲突、最难写的背景、读者承诺是否出现、下一单元是否仍有新变化。能写出人物主动选择与可持续后果，就进入大纲；只能依赖百科说明、重复同一种胜利或作者私人才懂的梗，就缩小题材、换主角任务或停止。一次试写提供创作证据，不证明市场结果。
body.en: After the trial draft, record the conflict that came most naturally, the background that was hardest to write, whether the promise to readers appeared and whether the next unit still offers a fresh change. If you can write active character choices with consequences that can keep developing, move on to an outline. If you can only rely on encyclopaedic explanations, repeated victories of the same kind or private jokes only you understand, narrow the concept, change the protagonist’s task or stop. A trial draft provides evidence about the writing, not proof of a market outcome.

q.zh: 这种方法需要固定章节数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。章节与阶段由故事实际变化决定，表格只帮助检查因果、资源与关系是否前进。
a.en: No. Let actual changes in the story determine chapters and stages. The table only helps check whether causality, resources, and relationships are moving forward.

q.zh: 可以直接套用示例情节吗？
q.en: Can I reuse the example plot directly?

a.zh: 示例用于展示方法。应替换故事发动机、人物选择与后果，避免只改姓名和场景。
a.en: The example demonstrates the method. Replace the story engine, character choices and consequences rather than merely changing names and locations.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /story-long-write 按本文方法规划我的故事，先写核心承诺、人物目标和可持续推进方式，不写完整正文”（Codex 里使用 `$story-long-write`）。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /story-long-write to plan my story with this article’s method. Start with the core promise, character goals and a sustainable way to move the story forward. Do not write the full prose.” In Codex, use `$story-long-write`.

title.zh: 快穿小说怎么写：让每个世界改变总任务
title.en: Writing Quick Transmigration: Make Each World Change the Mission

seo_title.en: How to Write Quick Transmigration Fiction | ZenStory

description.zh: 用身份、关系压力、任务限制和原剧情后果构成单世界发动机，并让跨世界经验产生代价。
description.en: Build each world around a role, relationship pressure, mission limits and changes to the original plot. Make experience from other worlds carry a cost.

answer.zh: 快穿文每个世界先给主角一个具体身份、眼前关系压力、任务缺口和不能随意越过的限制。主角利用跨世界经验改变原剧情后，当前人物要按自己的利益回应，并产生会影响本世界结算或总任务的新后果。
answer.en: In quick-transmigration fiction, give the protagonist a specific role in each world, immediate relationship pressures, an unmet mission requirement and limits they cannot simply ignore. When they use experience from other worlds to change the original plot, the people in this world should respond according to their own interests. Those responses create consequences that affect the outcome of this world or the overarching mission.

heading.zh: 先把题材发动机写清
heading.en: Define What Drives Each World’s Story

body.zh: 单世界发动机可以写成：原身份欠下的关系债＋当前必须处理的危机＋任务限制＋主角可用但有边界的经验。系统只交代目标、限制和风险。当前世界人物拥有自己的愿望，避免成为进度条。跨世界长线则记录主角带走了什么能力、判断、情感债或误解。
body.en: A single world’s story engine can combine the relationships and obligations inherited with the role, an immediate crisis, mission constraints and useful but limited experience the protagonist brings with them. The system supplies only goals, limits and risks. People in the current world have desires of their own; do not turn them into progress bars. For the cross-world arc, track the abilities, judgments, emotional obligations or misunderstandings the protagonist takes away.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repeating the Same Pattern

body.zh:
| 重复风险 | 变化方向 |
|---|---|
| 每次都靠预知打脸 | 让原剧情因介入提前、偏移或失效 |
| 世界结束就清零 | 保留能力代价、价值判断或总线索 |
| 任务只报数字 | 让进度变化影响关系与选择 |
| 原住民等待主角 | 给关键人物独立目标与反制 |

一世界完成一种核心变化，下一世界用不同限制检验主角已经形成的策略。
body.en:
| Repetition risk | How to vary it |
|---|---|
| Foreknowledge delivers comeuppance every time | Let intervention bring events forward, divert them or invalidate the original plot |
| Everything resets at the end of a world | Carry forward the cost of an ability, a value judgment or a clue to the overarching story |
| Missions report only numbers | Make changes in progress affect relationships and choices |
| Local people wait for the protagonist to act | Give key characters independent goals and countermoves |

Let each world complete one central change. In the next world, use different constraints to test the strategies the protagonist has already developed.

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
架空快穿中，沈砚进入一座即将撤销夜校的海岛，身份是被学生投诉的代课老师。任务要求他保住三名学生的结业资格，另有附加奖励：保住教师身份才能获得下一世界的身份预览。原主曾伪造考勤，揭开此事会使他失去任教资格。沈砚用上一世界学会的修表手艺带学生修复气象站，换取实习证明；校长随即提前核验考勤。

他提交实习证明，承认原主伪造考勤，争取让学生凭实际完成的实习结业。学生获准结业，他的教师身份则被撤销；系统结算时取消了身份预览，下一世界将无法提前准备角色经历。离开时，一名学生送来的坏表在系统仓库里继续走动，成为跨世界异常。
body.en:
In an invented quick-transmigration story, Shen Yan arrives on an island whose night school is about to close. He takes the role of a substitute teacher who has been the subject of student complaints. His mission is to preserve three students’ eligibility to graduate. There is an extra reward: if he keeps his teacher status, he will receive a preview of his role in the next world. The original host had falsified attendance records; exposing this will disqualify him from teaching. Shen Yan uses watch-repair skills learned in the previous world to lead the students in repairing a weather station, securing proof of their practical training. The headteacher responds by bringing forward the attendance checks.

Shen Yan submits the training documents, admits that the original host falsified attendance records and argues that the students should graduate on the basis of the practical work they actually completed. They are allowed to graduate, but his teacher status is revoked. When the system settles the mission, it cancels the role preview, leaving him unable to prepare for his character’s background in the next world. As he leaves, a broken watch given to him by one student keeps ticking in the system’s storage, becoming an anomaly that crosses between worlds.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 开头长讲系统 | 从身份困局和眼前危机进入 |
| 知道剧情等于稳赢 | 让介入改变后续条件 |
| 每界只换布景 | 更换限制、关系债与结算方式 |
| 只顾任务忘记情绪 | 让本世界选择留下真实余波 |

每个世界结算前再写两行：主角改变了哪项原后果，当前人物为此作出什么无法撤回的选择。总任务若只累计分数，世界容易互不相干；让某种价值判断、能力代价或异常线索跨界留下，长线才会增长。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| Opening with a long explanation of the system | Enter through the predicament attached to the role and the immediate crisis |
| Treating plot knowledge as a guaranteed win | Let intervention change the conditions that follow |
| Changing only the scenery between worlds | Vary constraints, relationship obligations and how outcomes are settled |
| Focusing on missions and forgetting emotion | Let choices in this world leave a genuine aftermath |

Before settling each world’s outcome, write two more lines: which consequence from the original plot did the protagonist change, and what irreversible choice did someone in this world make as a result? If the overarching mission merely accumulates points, the worlds can feel disconnected. Carry a value judgment, the cost of an ability or an anomalous clue across worlds so the larger story develops.

q.zh: 这种方法需要固定章节数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。章节与阶段由故事实际变化决定，表格只帮助检查因果、资源与关系是否前进。
a.en: No. Let actual changes in the story determine chapters and stages. The table only helps check whether causality, resources, and relationships are moving forward.

q.zh: 可以直接套用示例情节吗？
q.en: Can I reuse the example plot directly?

a.zh: 示例用于展示方法。应替换故事发动机、人物选择与后果，避免只改姓名和场景。
a.en: The example demonstrates the method. Replace the story engine, character choices and consequences rather than merely changing names and locations.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /story-long-write 按本文方法规划我的故事，先写核心承诺、人物目标和可持续推进方式，不写完整正文”（Codex 里使用 `$story-long-write`）。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /story-long-write to plan my story with this article’s method. Start with the core promise, character goals and a sustainable way to move the story forward. Do not write the full prose.” In Codex, use `$story-long-write`.

title.zh: 女频种田文怎么写：让生活资源和关系一起增长
title.en: Female-Oriented Farming Fiction: Grow Resources and Relationships

seo_title.en: Writing Female-Oriented Farming Fiction | ZenStory

description.zh: 用生计缺口、经营循环、人情账和家庭边界推进种田文，避免物资清单与无成本外挂。
description.en: Drive farming fiction with livelihood needs, business cycles, obligations and family boundaries. Avoid supply lists and cost-free special powers.

answer.zh: 女频种田文从具体生计缺口开始，让主角用判断、手艺、人情和有限资源完成一次小改善。每轮经营都要同时改变钱粮、住处、口碑或家庭话语权中的至少一项，并让新的规模带来周转、分工和关系责任。
answer.en: Female-oriented farming fiction starts with a specific gap in the protagonist’s livelihood. Let her use judgment, craft, personal connections and limited resources to make one small improvement. Each business cycle should change at least one of these: money and food, housing, reputation or influence within the family. Growth should bring new demands on cash flow, division of labour and responsibilities to others.

heading.zh: 先把题材发动机写清
heading.en: Define the Story Engine

body.zh: 发动机是“低资源状态—发现可经营机会—投入有限资源—遭遇流程或人情阻力—获得可触摸的改善—承担扩大后的新责任”。物件只有进入选择才有戏：粮袋影响谁先吃，账本决定谁能发言，门店位置改变邻里评价。
body.en: The engine is: scarce resources → a workable business opportunity → investment of limited resources → operational or interpersonal obstacles → a tangible improvement → new responsibilities created by growth. Objects become dramatic when they enter a choice: a sack of grain affects who eats first, a ledger determines who gets a say, and a shop’s location changes how neighbours see it.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repetition

body.zh:
| 账本 | 每轮记录 |
|---|---|
| 生计账 | 钱粮、住房、工具怎样变化 |
| 口碑账 | 谁愿意买、赊、介绍或阻挠 |
| 人情账 | 谁帮过谁，偿还条件是什么 |
| 家庭账 | 谁拥有决定权，谁承担照料 |

慢章也可通过修屋、备货、分工或一次坦白推进。经营规模变大后，难题应从“有没有”变成“如何稳定、分配与守住”。
body.en:
| Ledger | What to track each round |
|---|---|
| Livelihood | Changes in money, food, housing and tools |
| Reputation | Who will buy, offer credit, make introductions or obstruct |
| Obligations | Who has helped whom, and on what terms that help must be repaid |
| Family | Who decides, and who provides care |

A quiet chapter can still advance the story through house repairs, stocking up, dividing work or an honest admission. As the business grows, the problems should move from “Do we have enough?” to “How do we keep it stable, distribute it and protect it?”

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
架空河湾镇，寡居木匠宁秋带女儿住进漏雨船屋。她用废弃鱼箱做可折叠晒架，先替邻居晒药材换来防水布。订单增多后，码头管事要求独占晒架；女儿却把一处架位答应给了曾帮她们过冬的老人。

宁秋拒绝独占，改成按潮汐分时出租，并请老人管理登记。她赚到修屋的钱，也把私人恩情变成公开规则，因此招来管事压价。
body.en:
In the fictional town of Hewan, widowed carpenter Ning Qiu and her daughter move into a leaking houseboat. Ning Qiu makes folding drying racks from discarded fish crates. She first dries medicinal herbs for a neighbour in exchange for a tarpaulin. As orders increase, the wharf manager demands exclusive use of the racks. But her daughter has promised one rack space to an older resident who helped them through the winter.

Ning Qiu refuses exclusivity. Instead, she rents out time slots according to the tides and asks the older resident to keep the booking register. She earns the money to repair their home and turns a private obligation into a public set of rules. In response, the manager pressures her to lower her prices.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 只罗列吃穿用度 | 让资源限制选择并改变关系 |
| 一次秘方永远赚钱 | 加入周转、模仿、季节和分工问题 |
| 亲戚只会吵架 | 落到土地、账目、照料或名声后果 |
| 感情线与经营分离 | 让信任体现在共担风险和决定权 |

每轮改善后检查谁获得了决定权、谁承担新增劳动。收入上涨却始终由主角一人完成，经营线很快会变成结果清单。通过招人、分账、信用和规则把个人手艺变成可持续家业，也会自然制造新的关系冲突。让每次改善都留下下一步。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| Merely listing food, clothes and household supplies | Make resources constrain choices and change relationships |
| One secret recipe making money forever | Introduce problems with cash flow, imitation, seasonality and division of labour |
| Relatives doing nothing but quarrelling | Give the disputes consequences for land, accounts, care or reputation |
| Keeping romance separate from the business | Express trust through shared risks and decision-making power |

After each improvement, check who gains authority and who takes on the extra work. If income rises but the protagonist still does everything alone, the business plot will soon become a list of results. Hiring, sharing profits, credit and rules can turn personal skill into a sustainable family enterprise while naturally creating new relationship conflicts. Let each improvement set up the next step.

title.zh: 科幻末世小说怎么写：资源、规则与信任同时倒计时
title.en: Writing Apocalyptic Sci-Fi: Resources, Rules and Trust Under Pressure

seo_title.en: How to Write Apocalyptic Sci-Fi | ZenStory

description.zh: 把灾变规律、资源消耗和队伍信任连成选择链，让每次生存收益都带来损耗或暴露。
description.en: Connect disaster patterns, resource use and group trust through choices. Make every survival gain bring depletion or exposure.

answer.zh: 科幻末世文先建立一项可观察的灾变规律和一个立即影响选择的资源缺口。人物通过试错确认规则，每次求生行动都消耗水、电、药、时间或信任；得到资源时也会暴露位置、扩大队伍或触发基地制度，让危险持续变形。
answer.en: Begin apocalyptic science fiction with an observable disaster pattern and a resource shortage that immediately affects choices. Characters establish the rules through trial and error. Every attempt to survive uses water, power, medicine, time or trust. Acquiring resources can also expose a location, expand the group or bring base regulations into play, continually changing the shape of the danger.

heading.zh: 先把题材发动机写清
heading.en: Define the Story Engine

body.zh: 三条线同时运转：外部灾变怎样变化，资源按什么速度消耗，队伍中谁愿意承担风险。科技或能力必须说明适用条件与代价。设定解释跟随试错：人物先依据有限证据行动，结果再修正规则，避免开篇用百科全书宣布世界。
body.en: Keep three strands moving together: how the external disaster changes, how quickly resources are consumed and who in the group will take risks. Establish the conditions and costs of technology or special abilities. Explain the setting through trial and error: characters act on limited evidence, then use the result to revise their understanding of the rules. Avoid opening with an encyclopaedic announcement of the world.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repetition

body.zh:
| 获得 | 同时带来的问题 |
|---|---|
| 新水源 | 位置暴露、净化负担 |
| 避难所名额 | 规则约束、队伍取舍 |
| 能源设备 | 噪声、维护、使用权限 |
| 新成员 | 技能增加、信任成本上升 |

每次循环至少改变规则认知、资源余量、队伍结构或退路。连续打怪却不改变这些状态，只会变成重复动作。
body.en:
| Gain | Problems it also brings |
|---|---|
| A new water source | An exposed location and the burden of purification |
| Places in a shelter | Rules to comply with and choices about the group |
| Energy equipment | Noise, maintenance and permission to use it |
| A new member | More skills, but a higher cost of building trust |

Each cycle should change at least one of these: understanding of the rules, remaining resources, group composition or ways out. Repeated monster fights that leave all these states unchanged become repetitive action.

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
极寒后的地下交通站只剩一块有电的便携电池，够广播终端短时工作。终端面板标着“定位请求会自动回传站点编号”。工程师乔岚此前见过另一站发出请求后，巡查机沿隧道抵达；她怀疑所谓安全广播正在追踪求救者，但还不知道回传能否中断。队伍急需终端里的药库路线。

她把终端和电池带到已经撤空的站台，其他人留在不联网的维修间。接通后，屏幕先显示本站编号“已发送”，再出现药库坐标；她记下坐标立刻拔电。稍后，巡查机停在撤空站台逐个扫描出口。这个结果支持“发出的编号会引来巡查，拔电不能撤回已经发送的信息”，却还无法证明维修间已暴露。

队伍拿到了路线，也失去了站台这条近路。有人指责乔岚擅自拿撤离口试验，她必须说明自己实际看见了什么，并接受下一次联网由队伍共同决定。能源、可走路线和决定权都进入下一段求生冲突。
body.en:
After extreme cold, an underground transit station has just one portable battery with any charge left, enough to run a broadcast terminal briefly. The panel reads: “Location requests automatically transmit the station ID.” Engineer Qiao Lan previously saw a patrol machine arrive through the tunnel after another station sent a request. She suspects that the supposed safety broadcast tracks people seeking help, but does not yet know whether she can interrupt the transmission. The group urgently needs the route to a medicine depot stored in the terminal.

She takes the terminal and battery to an evacuated platform; everyone else stays in an offline maintenance room. Once connected, the screen first marks their station ID as “Sent,” then displays the depot coordinates. She notes the coordinates and immediately disconnects the power. Later, a patrol machine stops at the empty platform and scans its exits one by one. This supports the conclusion that a transmitted ID draws a patrol and that disconnecting power cannot retract information already sent. It does not yet prove that the maintenance room has been exposed.

The group gains a route but loses the platform as a shortcut. Someone accuses Qiao Lan of experimenting with an escape route without their agreement. She must explain what she actually observed and accept that the group will decide together before the next connection. Power, available routes and decision-making authority all carry into the next survival conflict.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 囤货没有消耗 | 记录使用、维护与暴露代价 |
| 灾变规律随时改 | 用试错证据逐步修正规则 |
| 队友靠宣誓建立信任 | 用分配、守夜、救援与违约证明 |
| 危机像观光 | 让普通人的选择和损失持续存在 |

设计基地规则时同时写明执行者、违规后果和可被人物利用的边界。规则只用广播宣布却从不影响分配和行动，会沦为背景。让人物在遵守、质疑或绕开规则时付出不同代价，秩序线才能与生存线合流。队伍因此必须重新选择。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| Stockpiles that never diminish | Track use, maintenance and the cost of exposure |
| Disaster rules changing arbitrarily | Revise the rules gradually through evidence from trial and error |
| Teammates establishing trust through oaths alone | Demonstrate it through allocation, night watches, rescues and broken commitments |
| Crises feeling like sightseeing | Keep ordinary people’s choices and losses present throughout |

When designing base rules, identify who enforces them, the consequences of breaking them and the limits characters can exploit. Rules announced only over a broadcast, but never affecting allocation or action, become background decoration. Make compliance, questioning and circumvention carry different costs so the struggle over order joins the struggle for survival. The group must then choose again.

title.zh: 西幻小说怎么写：让制度和魔法代价进入行动
title.en: Writing Western Fantasy: Put Institutions and Magic Costs into Action

seo_title.en: How to Write Western Fantasy | ZenStory

description.zh: 用身份制度、职业权限、契约和能力代价塑造西幻冲突，避免只把东方升级换成西式名词。
description.en: Build conflicts through status, professional permissions, contracts and costs of power. Avoid reskinning cultivation progression with Western terms.

answer.zh: 西方奇幻先选一套会直接限制人物行动的制度：领地税、行会资格、神殿裁决、种族身份或契约义务。魔法能力同时写明能做什么、要付什么和由谁承认结果；专名只在本章会影响任务、交易或关系时出现。
answer.en: Start Western fantasy with an institution that directly constrains action: territorial taxes, guild qualifications, temple rulings, racial status or contractual obligations. For magic, establish what it can do, what it costs and who recognises its results. Introduce specialised names only when they affect the chapter’s task, a transaction or a relationship.

heading.zh: 先把题材发动机写清
heading.en: Define the Story Engine

body.zh: 题材发动机来自制度、身份与能力代价的交叉。主角想完成具体任务，制度决定他有没有资格，身份影响谁相信他，魔法代价迫使他取舍。胜利要由行会、契约、领地或同伴行动承认，避免打完怪后世界秩序毫无变化。
body.en: The story engine lies where institutions, identity and the cost of abilities intersect. The protagonist wants to complete a specific task. Institutions determine whether they qualify, identity affects who believes them, and magic’s costs force trade-offs. A victory should be recognised through a guild, a contract, a territory’s response or companions’ actions. Avoid leaving the world’s order unchanged after every monster fight.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repetition

body.zh:
| 世界要素 | 进入剧情的方式 |
|---|---|
| 职业 | 决定许可、报酬和责任 |
| 契约 | 给出义务、漏洞与违约代价 |
| 魔法 | 解决一类问题，同时制造损耗 |
| 种族/信仰 | 改变信任、法律位置与联盟 |
| 领地 | 把资源、税收和保护责任绑在一起 |

新地图应改变制度组合与任务难度，不能只换更强怪物。
body.en:
| World element | How it enters the plot |
|---|---|
| Occupation | Determines permissions, payment and responsibilities |
| Contract | Establishes obligations, loopholes and the cost of breach |
| Magic | Solves one kind of problem while causing depletion or harm |
| Race or faith | Changes trust, legal standing and alliances |
| Territory | Binds resources, taxation and duties of protection together |

A new location should change the combination of institutions and the difficulty of the task, not merely introduce stronger monsters.

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
架空港城禁止无行会徽章者使用潮汐魔法。混血抄写员伊莱为救被困船队，能读取海墙上的古契约，却每读一段就失去一段近期记忆。他先与码头工人签临时见证契约，让他们记录他的指令；神殿随后质疑工人没有见证资格。

伊莱放弃独占功劳，把解读权交给行会书记，换取工人获得临时资格。船队得救，他却忘记了提出方案的人是谁。
body.en:
An invented port city forbids anyone without a guild badge from using tidal magic. To save a trapped fleet, Eli, a scribe of mixed heritage, can read the ancient contract on the seawall. But every passage he reads costs him a recent memory. He first signs a temporary witness agreement with dockworkers so they can record his instructions. The temple then challenges their right to act as witnesses.

Eli gives up his claim to sole credit and transfers the right to interpret the contract to a guild clerk, in exchange for temporary recognition of the workers as qualified witnesses. The fleet is saved, but he has forgotten who proposed the plan.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 专名堆满开头 | 只介绍当前任务会触发的制度 |
| 魔法解决一切 | 写清适用条件、代价与替代方案 |
| 西式名称配东方宗门逻辑 | 从领地、行会、契约与信仰关系重建制度 |
| 冒险任务互不影响 | 让结果改变资格、联盟或责任 |

建立新制度时先写一场普通人如何办事：谁发许可、怎样申诉、违约会失去什么。读者通过行动理解世界，比连续术语更牢。之后让主角的特殊能力穿过同一制度，差异与代价都会更清楚。制度也会因此显得可信。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| Filling the opening with specialised names | Introduce only the institutions the current task brings into play |
| Magic solving everything | Specify conditions, costs and alternatives |
| Western names attached to the logic of Eastern cultivation sects | Rebuild institutions around territories, guilds, contracts and faith relationships |
| Adventures having no effect on one another | Let outcomes change qualifications, alliances or responsibilities |

When introducing an institution, first write a scene showing how an ordinary person gets something done: who issues permission, how to appeal and what a breach costs. Readers understand a world more firmly through action than through a stream of terminology. Then put the protagonist’s special ability through that same institution. The differences and costs become clearer, and the institution feels more credible.
