He rereads A’s public decision: A held the wording while the internal catalog formally recorded B’s work. In light of their earlier credit dispute, B can read the named entry as archival procedure, renewed recognition of his contribution, or both. A’s full motive remains for later evidence to reveal.

heading.zh: 让 AI 规划一个有证据边界的潜台词场景
heading.en: Ask AI to Plan One Scene with Evidence Boundaries

body.zh:
把已经确认的人物关系和事实贴给 AI，让它依据这些设定规划一个场景：

> 请根据下列事实，输出一张双男主潜台词场景规划卡。
> 
> 甲此时愿意公开说什么：
> 甲私下做了什么，依据是什么：
> 乙实际看见或听见什么：
> 甲知道／乙知道／读者知道的信息：
> 两人已经确认的关系事实：
> 本场情节边界与不可改动事实：
> 
> 输出字段：公开话语承担的场合功能；私下行动留下的具体痕迹；乙基于现有证据的一种解释；如有依据，再给另一种合理解释；读者何时得知各项信息；后续可以验证或修正判断的证据。
> 请沿用输入中已确认的人物、规则和关系事实。把缺少依据的内容标记为“需要作者补充”；依据作者给定的视角和人物实际获得的线索安排解释。输出规划卡，供作者继续选择与扩写。

检查每项推断对应的线索；需要作者定夺的感情、动机或关系变化标为待选项。信息公开而场景目的明确时，按场景目标直接规划。
body.en:
Give AI established character and story facts, then ask it to plan one scene within that canon:

> Using the confirmed facts below, return a subtext-scene planning card for two male leads.
> 
> What A is willing to say publicly:
> What A does privately, and the basis for that action:
> What B actually sees or hears:
> What A knows / what B knows / what the reader knows:
> Relationship facts already established between them:
> Scene boundaries and fixed canon:
> 
> Output fields: the public line’s function in the situation; a concrete trace left by the private action; one interpretation B can make from current evidence; an alternative reading when it has support; when readers learn each fact; and later evidence that could verify or revise a reading.
> Use the supplied characters, rules, and relationship facts. Mark unsupported details as “author input needed.” Follow the provided viewpoint and the evidence each character has encountered. Return a planning card for the author to develop.

Match every inference to a clue. Mark feelings, motives, or relationship changes that need author judgment as options. For scenes with open information and a clear purpose, plan directly from that purpose.

q.zh: 双男主的单视角和双视角怎么选？
q.en: How Do You Choose a Single or Dual Viewpoint?

a.zh: 单一视角让读者跟随一位主角，观察他眼中的另一人；双视角可以提前呈现另一人的选择，也可以让读者与两位角色同步等待证据。根据当前场景的信息需要安排视角切换。
a.en: A single viewpoint keeps readers with one protagonist as he observes the other man’s visible actions. Dual viewpoints can reveal the other lead’s choice early or let readers wait for evidence alongside both men. Use the scene’s information needs to choose when viewpoints shift.

q.zh: 怎样让角色对同一痕迹产生不同判断？
q.en: How Can Two Leads Read the Same Trace Differently?

a.zh: 列出人物亲眼看到的行为、获得的记录和可靠转述，再用已经建立的经历解释他的判断。读者比人物多知道什么，应由信息出现顺序决定。安排沟通时机、公开场合或时间压力等现成条件，说明角色何时能够核实；后续证据可以补齐缺失的一环。
a.en: List the actions, records, and reliable accounts each character has encountered, then ground his reading in established experience. The order of information determines what readers know ahead of a character. Use existing conditions such as timing, a public setting, or time pressure to shape when they can verify a clue; later evidence can fill a gap.

q.zh: 哪些双男主对手戏适合用潜台词？
q.en: Which Scenes Between Two Male Leads Benefit from Subtext?

a.zh: 选择人物有充分理由保留信息、且读者能从具体痕迹中推理的场景。事务性对话可以清楚直接；连续几个叙事单元都使用同一种隐瞒或误读时，检查关系表达是否需要新的线索或表达方式。把潜台词留给确实承载信息的时刻。
a.en: Choose a scene where a character has a grounded reason to hold information back and readers can infer meaning from concrete traces. Practical dialogue can stay direct. When several narrative units repeat the same concealment or misreading, look for a fresh clue or expression of the relationship. Reserve subtext for moments that carry information.

text.zh: 先整理两位男主已经确认的关系事实、公开立场、具体行动、彼此知道的信息和读者视角，再在 Claude Code 中使用 /story-short-write（Codex 中使用 `$story-short-write`），要求它规划一个带潜台词的场景：话语功能、行动痕迹、另一人的合理解释、读者得知顺序及可验证的新证据。沿用已确认设定；把信息缺口标记为作者待补充，让心意类型、信息揭示和关系结果服从人物设定。
text.en: List established relationship facts, public positions, concrete actions, each lead’s knowledge, and the reader’s viewpoint. Then use /story-short-write in Claude Code (or `$story-short-write` in Codex) to plan one subtext scene: the spoken line’s function, an action trace, the other lead’s plausible reading, when readers learn each fact, and later evidence that can verify or revise an inference. Preserve canon and mark unsupported details for author input; let character facts guide the bond, reveal, and outcome.

title.zh: AI游戏角色配音怎么做：用台词表对齐语音、字幕与触发
title.en: How to Organize AI-Assisted Voice Lines for a Small Game

seo_title.en: AI-Assisted Game Voice Line Sheet | ZenStory

description.zh: 用稳定台词ID把说话者、准确台词、触发、读音、字幕、来源、音频输出与文字降级方案连起来，并检查跳过、静音、缺音和重开。
description.en: Track approved game lines by ID, speaker, trigger, subtitle, source, output, and fallback; check pronunciation, skip, mute, missing audio, and restart.

answer.zh: 给文字游戏或小型互动游戏制作AI辅助角色语音时，先冻结作者已批准的逐句台词，再为每句分配稳定的 line_id。每一行同时记录说话者、真实触发条件、准确台词、语言与读音、表演方向、字幕键、音色来源与许可记录、计划输出、文字降级方案和当前状态。先做几句能覆盖不同触发的小样，不要直接扩成全量。台词一改，旧音频立即失效；语音和字幕都回到同一份批准文本。把候选文件接入真实场景后，逐项检查触发、说话者、台词与字幕、专名读音、跳过、静音、缺音和重开。任务提示、选择后果和其他必需信息始终保留可读文字，让音频失效时玩家仍能理解并完成游戏。
answer.en: For AI-assisted character speech in a text or small interactive game, freeze each author-approved line before producing audio and assign it a stable line_id. One row should bind the speaker, real trigger, exact text, language and pronunciation, performance direction, subtitle key, voice-source and permission record, planned output, text fallback, and current status. Produce only a few lines that cover different triggers before expanding. Any text edit invalidates the old audio, and both speech and subtitles return to the same approved text. After placing candidate files in the real scene, check the trigger, speaker, spoken text and subtitle, proper-name pronunciation, skip, mute, missing-audio, and restart behavior. Keep quest hints, choice consequences, and other required information readable so players can still understand and complete the game when audio fails.

heading.zh: 先确认语音服务哪一段游戏，不让它承担唯一信息
heading.en: Define the Approved Interactive Game Moment

body.zh:
游戏语音资产服务于已经批准的角色、场景和台词。先指出它出现在哪个可玩切片、由谁说、玩家做了什么才触发，以及静音时玩家仍能从哪里读到同一信息。语音可以加强人物存在感和节奏，但不能成为任务提示、操作说明、选择后果或通关条件的唯一载体。

本页负责**互动游戏角色语音资产**：逐句 ID、玩家触发、规范字幕、音频设置与失败降级。相邻工作各有自己的交付边界：

- **线性短剧或视频配音**负责演员阵容、旁白和成片声音，不使用本页的互动触发验收代替其制作流程。
- **玩家实时语音聊天**负责实时通话、审核、录音上传和网络语音，另行处理其产品与安全要求。
- **整款游戏验收**负责启动、输入、核心循环、结果和重开；本页的专项检查只确认语音层仍保留理解与完成路径。

若角色语音尚未进入批准的美术或产品方向，先停在台词整理，不生成音频。默认把语音当作构建期准备的本地资产；任何运行时联网合成都要另有明确的产品决定，包括外部文本处理、成本、隐私与失效方式。本页不推荐供应商，也不判断某种音色或素材是否取得法律许可。作者只记录项目实际拥有的来源与许可依据，并把未确认项留为未确认。
body.en:
A game voice asset serves an already approved character, scene, and line. First identify the playable slice where it appears, who speaks, what player action triggers it, and where the same information remains readable when audio is muted. Speech can strengthen presence and pacing, but it must not be the sole carrier of a quest hint, control instruction, choice consequence, or completion condition.

This page owns **interactive game character voice assets**: per-line IDs, player triggers, canonical subtitles, audio settings, and failure fallbacks. Adjacent work keeps separate deliverables:

- **Linear drama or video voice production** owns casting, narration, and final-cut audio; its production workflow remains separate from interactive trigger acceptance.
- **Live player voice chat** owns real-time calls, moderation, recording uploads, and network voice, with its own product and safety requirements.
- **Whole-game acceptance** owns launch, input, the core loop, outcomes, and restart. The checks here cover only whether the voice layer preserves understanding and completion.

If character speech has not entered the approved art or product direction, stop at organizing the dialogue instead of generating audio. Treat build-time local assets as the default. Any runtime network synthesis needs a separate product decision covering external text processing, cost, privacy, and failure behavior. This page does not recommend a provider or determine whether a voice or source is legally cleared. The author records the source and permission basis the project actually has and leaves unresolved items unresolved.

heading.zh: 用一张可编辑台词表绑定文本、触发与输出
heading.en: Bind Text, Trigger, and Output in an Editable Line Sheet

body.zh:
每句采用语音的台词只占一行。`line_id` 是台词表、字幕、音频文件和场景触发之间的稳定连接点；不要用角色名加行号之外的模糊文件名代替它。复制下面的空表，每轮只填作者已经批准的台词。

| line_id | speaker | trigger | exact_text | language / pronunciation | voice_direction | subtitle_key | provenance / rights record | output | fallback | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ |

各字段回答不同问题：

- **line_id：** 这句在台词表、文件名和触发位置共同使用的固定标识。
- **speaker：** 批准的说话者；不要让生成工具自行换人或新增角色。
- **trigger：** 玩家实际做什么、进入哪里或选择什么后播放；写可重现条件，不写“合适时”。
- **exact_text：** 允许说出的准确文本。标点或文字改变后，旧音频标为失效并重新处理。
- **language / pronunciation：** 语言、专名、缩写、数字或容易误读词的读法，只给必要说明。
- **voice_direction：** 已批准的节奏、态度和距离感；写可执行方向，不模仿真实人物。
- **subtitle_key：** 解析到与语音完全相同的批准台词。界面可以换行或改变显示方式，但不能在这个键下另写不同措辞。
- **provenance / rights record：** 音色或录音来源、项目内许可记录的位置和未决项；它仅作生产记录，不提供法律结论。
- **output：** 计划或实际文件路径。尚未生成时明确写“planned”，不要让路径看起来像现成证据。
- **fallback：** 音频不播时显示同一批准台词；若项目确实需要不同的可读替代，必须另行记录并由作者批准，不能把它藏在 `subtitle_key` 下。
- **status：** 例如待作者批准、待来源确认、待生成、已接入或已实测。自然度、魅力与音色偏好不要写成机器 PASS。

这张表不应收进整部小说、完整设计文档或无关私人材料。若使用外部工具，只提供该句所需的批准文本和必要读音。
body.en:
Use one row for each spoken line. The `line_id` is the stable join across the line sheet, subtitle, audio file, and scene trigger; do not replace it with a vague filename based only on a character name and sequence number. Copy the blank table below and enter only dialogue the author has approved.

| line_id | speaker | trigger | exact_text | language / pronunciation | voice_direction | subtitle_key | provenance / rights record | output | fallback | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ | ____ |

Each field answers a different question:

- **line_id:** The fixed identifier shared by the sheet, filename, and trigger location.
- **speaker:** The approved speaker; do not let a generation tool swap speakers or add a character.
- **trigger:** The reproducible player action, entry, or choice that plays the line—not “when appropriate.”
- **exact_text:** The exact words allowed to be spoken. A punctuation or wording edit invalidates the old audio and sends the line back through production.
- **language / pronunciation:** Language plus only the necessary reading of names, abbreviations, numbers, or easily misread words.
- **voice_direction:** Approved pace, attitude, and sense of distance. Give playable direction without imitating a real person.
- **subtitle_key:** A key that resolves to exactly the same approved line used by the audio. Interface wrapping or presentation may differ, but this key must not contain alternate wording.
- **provenance / rights record:** The voice or recording source, the location of the project's permission record, and open questions. This is a production record, not a legal conclusion.
- **output:** The planned or actual file path. Label an ungenerated path as planned rather than making it look like evidence.
- **fallback:** Show the same approved line when audio does not play. If the project genuinely needs a different readable alternative, record and approve it separately rather than hiding it under the `subtitle_key`.
- **status:** For example, awaiting author approval, awaiting source confirmation, awaiting generation, integrated, or runtime-checked. Do not turn naturalness, charm, or voice preference into a machine PASS.

Do not send a whole novel, complete design document, or unrelated private material with this sheet. If an external tool is used, provide only the approved line and pronunciation needed for that line.

heading.zh: 先做覆盖不同触发的小批量，再扩展
heading.en: Test a Small Batch Across Different Triggers Before Expanding

body.zh:
不要在第一轮把整章台词全部变成音频。可以先做一个可选的小样批次，挑少量台词覆盖进入场景、检查物件、作出选择或重复进入等不同触发；可包含项目专名或易错读法，并选择能验证字幕和跳过后状态的台词。小样规模服从项目需要，不套用固定句数。

按下面的顺序推进：

1. 作者批准 `speaker`、`exact_text`、`trigger` 和这句是否确实需要语音。
2. 为台词分配 `line_id` 与 `subtitle_key`，把可读降级方案写好。
3. 记录音色或录音来源及项目现有的许可依据；来源未确认时不要生成。
4. 补充必要读音和表演方向，先检查它们有没有偷偷改写台词含义。
5. 生成或录制候选文件，把实际输出位置回写到同一行。
6. 在真实触发位置接入候选，不用文件播放器里的单独试听代替场景检查。
7. 台词有任何改动时，将旧音频标为失效；字幕、音频任务和降级文本都重新对照最新版 `exact_text`。

小批量用于尽早暴露表格缺项、错误触发、专名误读、字幕漂移或失败时卡住的问题，结论只覆盖这批候选。项目可以记录主观试听偏好，但自然度、魅力和音色偏好始终保留为非自动化备注。
body.en:
Do not turn an entire chapter into audio in the first pass. An optional small pilot can use a limited set of lines spanning different triggers such as entering a scene, inspecting an object, making a choice, or returning to a location. It can include a project name or easily misread term and a line that exposes subtitle alignment and the post-skip state. Let project needs determine the pilot size instead of applying a fixed line count.

Proceed in this order:

1. The author approves the `speaker`, `exact_text`, `trigger`, and whether the moment needs speech at all.
2. Assign a `line_id` and `subtitle_key`, and write the readable fallback.
3. Record the voice or recording source and the permission basis currently held by the project. Do not generate while that source is unresolved.
4. Add only necessary pronunciation and performance direction, checking that neither quietly changes the line's meaning.
5. Generate or record a candidate file and write its actual output location back to the same row.
6. Integrate the candidate at the real trigger. A standalone media-player listen is not a substitute for the scene check.
7. If the line changes at all, mark the old audio invalid. Reconcile the subtitle, audio task, and fallback against the latest `exact_text`.

The batch exposes missing fields, wrong triggers, mispronounced names, subtitle drift, and failure paths that stall play; its conclusion covers only these candidates. A project may record subjective listening preferences, while naturalness, charm, and voice preference remain non-automated notes.

heading.zh: 原创说明性示例：植物档案室的两句修复提醒
heading.en: Original Illustrative Example: Two Notes in a Botanical Archive

body.zh:
**以下内容是本文原创的纸面示例，仅演示台词表写法；当前状态仅限纸面，未构建游戏，未实际生成或试听音频，也没有运行测试或权利结论。** 虚构互动故事《叶脉登记册》中，小型植物档案室的纸张修复员段栗会对两项日常纸张修复与馆藏保管工作作简短说明。标本名称、操作步骤和玩家选择始终显示为文字；这两句语音只补充人物存在感。

| line_id | speaker | trigger | exact_text | language / pronunciation | voice_direction | subtitle_key | provenance / rights record | output | fallback | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BA_REPAIR_001 | 段栗 / Duan Li | 玩家本次运行首次检查含羞草标本夹 | 这张含羞草标本的衬纸起皱了，先别压上护页。 | zh-CN；“含羞草”逐字清楚；“栗”读 lì | 对身边同事说话，平静、清楚，不模仿真实人物 | sub.BA_REPAIR_001 | VOICE-SOURCE-TBD；作者尚未填写来源与许可记录，生成前阻断 | planned: audio/zh/BA_REPAIR_001.ogg | 显示同一句批准文本；标本夹旁的操作文字仍保留 | 待来源确认；未生成；未测试 |
| BA_REPAIR_002 | 段栗 / Duan Li | 玩家确认湿度卡读数并把它登记到当日记录后 | 湿度读数已登记到今日记录。 | zh-CN；“读数”读作 dú shù | 简短确认，平静、清楚 | sub.BA_REPAIR_002 | VOICE-SOURCE-TBD；作者尚未填写来源与许可记录，生成前阻断 | planned: audio/zh/BA_REPAIR_002.ogg | 显示同一句批准文本；记录面板继续保留湿度条目 | 待来源确认；未生成；未测试 |

这个示例刻意保留阻断状态：计划路径只表示未来意图，虚构角色也不会自动产生可用音色。作者先补齐项目选择的来源与许可记录，再决定是否制作候选。若把“先别压上护页”改成“先换一张衬纸”，`BA_REPAIR_001` 的旧音频立即失效；对应字幕键必须解析到新批准台词，音频任务和同文降级也重新处理。若另需更短的可读替代，则要作为独立文本另行记录和批准，不能塞进同一个 `subtitle_key`。

两句使用不同触发，便于检查首次检查标本夹与登记湿度读数是否串线。标本名称、操作步骤和湿度条目另有持续可读的界面文字，因此音频缺失时，玩家仍能理解场景并继续。
body.en:
**The material below is an original paper example created for this article. Its current state is paper-only: no game was built, no audio was generated or listened to, and no runtime test or rights determination was made.** In the fictional interactive story *The Vein Register*, Duan Li, a paper conservator in a small botanical archive, briefly comments on two routine paper-conservation and collection-care tasks. Specimen names, handling steps, and player choices remain visible in text; these spoken lines add character presence only.

| line_id | speaker | trigger | exact_text | language / pronunciation | voice_direction | subtitle_key | provenance / rights record | output | fallback | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BA_REPAIR_001 | Duan Li | The player inspects the sensitive-plant specimen folder for the first time in this run | The backing paper under this sensitive-plant specimen has buckled. Do not press the cover sheet down yet. | en; keep “sensitive-plant specimen” distinct | Calm and clear, spoken to a nearby coworker; do not imitate a real person | sub.BA_REPAIR_001 | VOICE-SOURCE-TBD; the author has not recorded a source or permission basis, so generation is blocked | planned: audio/en/BA_REPAIR_001.ogg | Show the same approved line; keep the handling instruction beside the specimen folder | Source unresolved; not generated; not tested |
| BA_REPAIR_002 | Duan Li | After the player confirms the humidity-card reading and logs it in today's record | The humidity reading is logged in today's record. | en; keep “humidity reading” distinct | A brief confirmation, calm and clear | sub.BA_REPAIR_002 | VOICE-SOURCE-TBD; the author has not recorded a source or permission basis, so generation is blocked | planned: audio/en/BA_REPAIR_002.ogg | Show the same approved line; keep the humidity entry visible in the record panel | Source unresolved; not generated; not tested |

The example deliberately retains a blocking status. A planned path records future intent, and a fictional character does not automatically provide an authorized voice source. The author records the project's selected source and permission basis before deciding whether to produce a candidate. If “Do not press the cover sheet down yet” changes to “Replace the backing paper first,” the old `BA_REPAIR_001` audio immediately becomes invalid. Its subtitle key must resolve to the newly approved canonical line, and the audio task and same-text fallback must be updated. If a shorter readable alternative is genuinely needed, record and approve it as separate text rather than placing it under the same `subtitle_key`.

The two lines use different triggers so a check can reveal a mix-up between the first specimen-folder inspection and logging the humidity reading. Specimen names, handling steps, and the humidity entry also remain persistently readable in the interface, so the player can understand the scene and continue when audio is absent.

heading.zh: 在真实场景检查触发、字幕和四种降级行为
heading.en: Check the Real Trigger, Subtitle, and Four Degraded States

body.zh:
选一条能实际到达小样台词的代表路径，从定义好的初态进入。检查记录要写明候选版本、运行环境、输入顺序和实际观察，不用“文件能播放”代替场景证据。

- [ ] **触发：** 该句只在表中写明的动作或状态出现，不提前、串线或无故重复。
- [ ] **说话者与准确文本：** 角色、音频内容和最新版 `exact_text` 一致；旧稿音频没有混入。
- [ ] **字幕配对：** 正确的 `subtitle_key` 与音频都解析到最新版批准规范台词；只能调整换行或显示方式，不能在同一键下改写措辞。
- [ ] **读音与方向：** 使用项目实际选定的读音检查方法核对表中点名的专名、数字和停顿，并记录所用方法与限制；自然度、魅力和音色偏好只作为非自动化主观备注。
- [ ] **跳过：** 玩家跳过后进入这句原本应到达的下一状态；任务信息或选择后果仍可读。
- [ ] **静音：** 音频设置为静音时不偷播声音，字幕或作者批准的文字替代仍出现，流程继续。
- [ ] **缺音：** 暂时移除或指向缺失的候选文件后，游戏不因这句卡死；文字降级出现，玩家仍能理解并完成该路径。
- [ ] **重开：** 从定义初态重新开始后，首次触发与重复触发符合表中规则，不继承上一次运行里只属于语音播放的临时状态。

一次检查失败，就回到对应台词行修文本、触发、输出或降级方案，再重走受影响路径。这里的停止条件是：这批代表台词在记录的环境里通过上述语音专项检查，失败时仍保留理解与完成路径，未测平台和主观音色意见明确保留为限制。它不等于整款游戏已经通过通用玩法、无障碍、本地化、性能或发布验收。
body.en:
Choose a representative path that reaches the sample lines and begin from a defined initial state. Record the candidate version, runtime environment, input sequence, and observed result. “The file plays” is not scene evidence.

- [ ] **Trigger:** The line appears only after the action or state named in the sheet, without playing early, crossing into another trigger, or repeating without cause.
- [ ] **Speaker and exact text:** The character, audio content, and latest `exact_text` agree; no audio from an older draft is present.
- [ ] **Subtitle pairing:** The correct `subtitle_key` and audio both resolve to the latest approved canonical line. Only wrapping or presentation may differ; alternate wording must not appear under the same key.
- [ ] **Pronunciation and direction:** Use the project's selected pronunciation-check method for the named terms, numbers, and pauses in the row, and record that method and its limits. Naturalness, charm, and voice preference remain non-automated subjective notes.
- [ ] **Skip:** Skipping reaches the next state the line should lead to, while required task information or choice consequences remain readable.
- [ ] **Mute:** With audio muted, no sound leaks through, the subtitle or author-approved text alternative still appears, and play continues.
- [ ] **Missing audio:** With the candidate file temporarily removed or unavailable, the line does not stall the game. The text fallback appears, and the player can understand and complete the path.
- [ ] **Restart:** After returning to the defined initial state, first-play and repeat behavior follow the sheet rather than inheriting transient playback state from the prior run.

When a check fails, return to the affected row, repair its text, trigger, output, or fallback, and replay the impacted path. Stop when this representative batch passes the voice-specific checks in the recorded environment, failure still preserves understanding and completion, and untested platforms and subjective voice opinions remain explicit limitations. This result does not mean the whole game has passed general gameplay, accessibility, localization, performance, or release acceptance.

heading.zh: 可复制提示词：只整理作者已批准的台词
heading.en: Copyable Prompt: Organize Author-Approved Lines Only

body.zh:
把方括号换成项目里的实际材料。这个提示词只生成台词表草稿和缺口清单，不生成音频，不替作者选音色，也不作权利判断。

> 你正在为一个小型文字／冒险游戏整理语音资产表。只处理下面由作者批准的台词，不新增、续写、改写或合并台词，不补剧情事实，不模仿真实人物，也不推断任何来源已经取得许可。  
> **批准的场景与用途：** [场景、这批语音服务的已批准体验、不能只靠语音传达的信息]  
> **批准台词：** [逐句给出 line_id（如已有）、speaker、trigger、exact_text、language]  
> **已有读音与表演方向：** [只写作者已决定的内容]  
> **字幕记录：** [subtitle_key 与批准文本；没有就标缺失]  
> **来源与许可记录：** [音色／录音来源、项目记录位置、未决项；不要粘贴无关私人材料]  
> **输出与降级约定：** [计划路径、静音或缺音时显示的文字、跳过后的下一状态]  
> **运行路径：** [从定义初态到各句真实触发的输入顺序]
>
> 返回一张列为 `line_id | speaker | trigger | exact_text | language/pronunciation | voice_direction | subtitle_key | provenance/rights record | output | fallback | status` 的表。准确复制批准台词；若同一 line_id 的文本、字幕或输出版本冲突，标为阻断，不自行选择。另列缺失 ID、触发、读音、字幕、降级方案、来源记录和运行路径。最后给出只覆盖这批台词的检查顺序：真实触发、说话者与准确文本、字幕、点名读音、跳过、静音、缺音、重开。不要生成媒体，不要推荐供应商，不要宣布自然度、许可、可访问性或整款游戏已经通过。

作者逐行确认最终文本、说话者、表演方向、来源记录和是否继续制作。AI整理出的表只是草稿；只有实际生成、接入并走过场景的候选，才可以记录相应的运行结果。
body.en:
Replace the brackets with real project material. This prompt produces only a draft line sheet and a gap list. It does not generate audio, select a voice for the author, or make a rights determination.

> You are organizing a voice-asset sheet for a small text or adventure game. Work only with the author-approved lines below. Do not add, continue, rewrite, or merge dialogue. Do not add plot facts, imitate a real person, or infer that any source has permission.  
> **Approved scene and purpose:** [scene, approved experience served by this batch, information that must not be carried by audio alone]  
> **Approved lines:** [for each line, provide line_id if one exists, speaker, trigger, exact_text, and language]  
> **Existing pronunciation and performance direction:** [author decisions only]  
> **Subtitle record:** [subtitle_key and approved text; mark missing fields]  
> **Source and permission record:** [voice/recording source, project record location, open questions; omit unrelated private material]  
> **Output and fallback agreement:** [planned path, text shown on mute or missing audio, state after skip]  
> **Runtime path:** [input sequence from a defined initial state to each real trigger]
>
> Return a table with these columns: `line_id | speaker | trigger | exact_text | language/pronunciation | voice_direction | subtitle_key | provenance/rights record | output | fallback | status`. Copy approved dialogue exactly. If one line_id has conflicting text, subtitle, or output versions, mark it blocked instead of choosing one. Separately list missing IDs, triggers, pronunciation, subtitles, fallbacks, source records, and runtime paths. End with a check order limited to this batch: real trigger, speaker and exact text, subtitle, named pronunciation, skip, mute, missing audio, and restart. Do not generate media, recommend a provider, or announce that naturalness, permission, accessibility, or the whole game has passed.

The author confirms every final line, speaker, performance direction, source record, and production decision. An AI-organized sheet remains a draft. Record a runtime result only for a candidate that was actually generated, integrated, and exercised in the scene.

q.zh: 字幕可以和配音台词写得不一样吗？
q.en: Can the Subtitle Differ from the Spoken Line?

a.zh: 字幕键必须解析到与语音相同的批准规范台词；界面只能调整换行或显示方式，不能在同一个 `subtitle_key` 下改写措辞。若项目确实需要不同的可读降级文本，把它作为独立记录另行交给作者批准。任何规范台词改动都会使旧音频失效，字幕与音频任务都要重新对照新版本。
a.en: The subtitle key must resolve to the same approved canonical line used by the audio. The interface may change wrapping or presentation, but it must not place alternate wording under the same `subtitle_key`. If the project genuinely needs a different readable fallback, record it separately and obtain author approval. Any change to the canonical dialogue invalidates the old audio, and both subtitle and audio tasks must be reconciled with the new version.

q.zh: 只在播放器里听过音频，能把状态改成已测试吗？
q.en: Is a File Tested After Listening to It in a Media Player?

a.zh: 不能。单独试听可以发现明显读音或文件问题，但无法证明真实触发、说话者与字幕配对、跳过、静音、缺音和重开行为。只有候选接入实际场景并按记录路径运行后，才填写相应的运行结果。
a.en: No. A standalone listen can reveal an obvious pronunciation or file problem, but it cannot establish the real trigger, speaker/subtitle pairing, skip, mute, missing-audio, or restart behavior. Record those runtime results only after integrating the candidate and exercising the documented scene path.

q.zh: 关键提示用语音说一遍、字幕一闪而过可以吗？
q.en: Can a Critical Hint Be Spoken Once with a Brief Subtitle?

a.zh: 不要让一次性音频成为关键提示的唯一载体。把提示、规则、选择后果或通关条件保留在可再次阅读的文字位置，并让静音、跳过或音频缺失时仍能找到。语音可以加强表达，但不能决定玩家是否还能理解和完成游戏。
a.en: Do not make a one-time clip the sole carrier of a critical hint. Keep hints, rules, choice consequences, and completion conditions in a readable place the player can revisit and still reach after mute, skip, or missing audio. Speech can strengthen delivery, but it must not determine whether the player can understand and complete the game.

text.zh: 当 PRODUCT_BRIEF、GAME_DESIGN 与正式制作所需的 ART_DIRECTION 已批准语音后，在 `/game-build`（Codex 用 `$game-build`）中读取语音生产合同：只处理批准台词，为每句维护稳定 ID、触发、字幕、来源记录、输出与降级方案，并把小批候选接入真实场景。台词变化使旧音频失效；缺音、静音或跳过后仍保留可读信息与完成路径。不要让构建阶段新增剧情、模仿真实人物或替作者作许可判断。
text.en: After PRODUCT_BRIEF, GAME_DESIGN, and the production ART_DIRECTION approve speech, use `/game-build` (`$game-build` in Codex) with its voice-production contract. Process approved dialogue only, maintaining a stable ID, trigger, subtitle, source record, output, and fallback for every line, then integrate a small candidate batch at its real scene triggers. A line edit invalidates old audio, and readable information plus a completion path remain available after missing audio, mute, or skip. Do not let the build stage add plot, imitate a real person, or make permission decisions for the author.

title.zh: AI短剧镜头不连贯怎么办：逐剪点排查前后状态
title.en: How to Find Continuity Breaks Between AI Short-Drama Shots

seo_title.zh: AI短剧镜头连续性检查表｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: AI Video Shot Continuity Checklist | ZenStory

description.zh: 逐剪点对照前镜终点与后镜起点，检查站位、持物、伤势、光线、文字和动作阶段，定位首个断点并给出最小修正。
description.en: Compare each shot's end with the next shot's start across position, props, visible state, light, text, and action stage; find and repair the first break.

answer.zh: AI短剧单镜看起来正常，剪在一起却跳变时，先把每个剪点拆成两栏：前一镜的绝对终点，以及后一镜的绝对起点。只比较这场戏真正需要连续的字段，例如人物位置与朝向、手中物件、可见服装或伤势、光态、可读文字和动作阶段。若状态变化有意发生，就写清承载变化的可见动作；若记录里没有连接，定位第一个出现冲突的剪点，保留已经确认的边界，修正最小范围内的镜头起点、终点或动作链。文字记录能直接暴露字段冲突；故事原意、观众知情时机、遮挡、证据可读性和切镜价值仍由创作者结合画面审查。
answer.en: When individual AI short-drama shots look acceptable but jump when edited together, split every cut into two records: the previous shot's absolute end and the next shot's absolute start. Compare only the fields that matter in that scene, such as character position and facing, objects in hand, visible costume or injury state, lighting, readable text, and action stage. If a state change is intentional, name the visible action that carries it. If no connection is recorded, locate the first conflicting cut, preserve the accepted boundary, and revise the smallest relevant start, end, or action chain. Text records can expose field conflicts directly; the creator still reviews story meaning, viewer knowledge, occlusion, evidence legibility, and whether the cut earns its place.

heading.zh: 先按剪点检查相邻两镜
heading.en: Audit One Adjacent Cut at a Time

body.zh:
连续性排查从一个剪点开始。前一镜写到切出前最后可见的状态，后一镜写从切入后首先成立的状态。两边都用绝对事实，避免“接上镜”“保持原样”这类无法比较的说法。

逐剪点执行下面的顺序：

1. 写出前镜终点和后镜起点。
2. 圈出当前场景需要连续的字段。
3. 逐字段标记相同、变化或缺失。
4. 对有意变化指出承载它的可见动作或已经确认的省略。
5. 对无连接的变化写成可修订的发现：位置、证据、影响、必须达到的结果和负责人。
6. 由负责人完成修正后，继续检查下一处剪点，直到场景结束。

每镜保留一个主导职责，边界记录只重复下游执行所需的局部状态。无需在每一镜复制完整人物设定、场景说明或整张状态表。
body.en:
Start a continuity audit at a single cut. Record the final visible state before the outgoing shot ends and the first established state after the incoming shot begins. Use absolute facts on both sides. Phrases such as “same as before” or “continues from the previous shot” cannot be compared reliably.

Work through each cut in this order:

1. Write the outgoing shot's end and the incoming shot's start.
2. Select the fields that need continuity in this scene.
3. Mark each field as matching, changed, or missing.
4. For an intentional change, identify the visible action or approved omission that carries it.
5. Turn an unconnected change into an actionable finding: location, evidence, impact, required result, and owner.
6. After the owner completes the correction, continue to the next cut until the scene ends.

Keep one leading narrative job for each shot, and repeat only the local state needed at the boundary. There is no need to copy the full character design, setting description, or state sheet into every shot.

heading.zh: 复制这张前后镜连续性检查表
heading.en: Copy This End-to-Start Continuity Table

body.zh:
| 剪点 | 前镜终点：绝对事实 | 后镜起点：绝对事实 | 有意变化与连接动作 | 冲突、影响与修订结果 | 负责人 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 镜___ → 镜___ | ___ | ___ | ___ | ___ | ___ |

按场景需要从下列字段中选择，空白字段可以省略：

- **位置与朝向：** 人在空间中的位置、面向以及与固定物的关系。
- **持物与双手：** 谁拿着什么、哪只手参与、物件处于折叠、开启、破损或其他可见状态。
- **服装与伤势：** 只记录当前画面看得见并会影响下一镜的变化。
- **光态：** 已经建立的主要光源、开关状态和明显色态。
- **可读文字：** 观众需要辨认的牌子、屏幕、纸面或标签内容及其朝向。
- **动作阶段：** 动作处于起势、接触、交接、完成还是结果；避免让同一动作在剪点后倒退或重复。
- **负责人：** 实际修改这条镜头记录的人或角色，例如本场分镜作者；未指定时写“待指定”，不要让工具猜测。

一行只处理一个相邻剪点。若同一剪点有多个冲突，将它们分别写进对应字段，再判断是否源自同一个漏掉的动作。这样可以看见根因，也能防止只修道具却留下位置或光线跳变。
body.en:
| Cut | Outgoing end: absolute facts | Incoming start: absolute facts | Intended change and connecting action | Conflict, impact, and required result | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shot ___ → Shot ___ | ___ | ___ | ___ | ___ | ___ |

Choose only the fields the scene needs; omit empty ones:

- **Position and facing:** Where a person is in the space, which way they face, and their relationship to fixed objects.
- **Carried objects and hands:** Who holds what, which hand is involved, and whether an item is folded, open, damaged, or in another visible state.
- **Costume and injury:** Record visible changes that affect the incoming shot.
- **Lighting state:** The established main source, its on/off state, and any clear color state.
- **Readable text:** The content and orientation of a sign, screen, paper, or label that viewers need to read.
- **Action stage:** Whether an action is beginning, making contact, transferring, completing, or showing a result. Keep an action from moving backward or repeating after the cut.
- **Owner:** The person or role that will revise this shot record, such as the storyboard author for the scene. Write “unassigned” when no owner has been named; do not let a tool guess.

Use one row for one adjacent cut. If several fields conflict at the same cut, record each conflict in its field, then ask whether they come from one missing action. This exposes the root cause and prevents a prop-only fix from leaving a position or lighting jump behind.

heading.zh: 把字段核对与语义审查分开
heading.en: Separate Record Checks from Semantic Review

body.zh:
文字镜头记录能直接核对清楚的事实有限。先用字段检查找出明确矛盾，再把需要理解剧情和画面的判断留给创作者。

| 直接核对镜头记录 | 结合故事与画面人工审查 |
|---|---|
| 前镜终点和后镜起点是否都写成绝对事实 | 状态变化是否守住故事原意与观众知情时机 |
| 位置、朝向、持物、伤势、光态和文字是否冲突 | 相似覆盖是否带来新的反应、证据或理解 |
| 动作在剪点两侧是否缺段、倒退或重复 | 调度与遮挡是否让主要动作、表情或证据可读 |
| 有意变化是否注明连接动作 | 当前起点与终点是否给表演和后续动作留下可行空间 |

人工审查也要形成可执行结论。写明“镜1→镜2；镜1终点篮球仍在教练手中，镜2起点已经由学员持球；传球和接球缺失，观众无法确认球权如何变化；修订结果为现有镜头呈现完整的反弹传球与接球；负责人为本场分镜作者”。这比“画面不顺”更容易定位和返工。
body.en:
A written shot record can prove only a limited set of facts. Use field checks to find explicit contradictions, then leave judgments that require story and image understanding to the creator.

| Check directly in the shot records | Review manually with the story and images |
|---|---|
| Both the outgoing end and incoming start use absolute facts | The state change preserves story meaning and the timing of viewer knowledge |
| Position, facing, objects, injury, lighting, and text do not conflict | Similar coverage adds a new reaction, piece of evidence, or understanding |
| An action is not missing a stage, moving backward, or repeating across the cut | Staging and occlusion keep the main action, expression, or evidence readable |
| An intentional change names its connecting action | The chosen start and end leave viable room for performance and the following action |

Manual review should still produce an actionable conclusion. For example: “Shot 1 → Shot 2; the coach still holds the basketball at Shot 1's end, while the learner holds it at Shot 2's start; the pass and catch are absent, so viewers cannot tell how possession changed; revise an existing shot to show the complete bounce pass and catch; the owner is the storyboard author for this scene.” This is easier to locate and revise than “the edit feels wrong.”

heading.zh: 原创示例：社区球场漏掉的反弹传球
heading.en: Original Example: The Missing Bounce Pass at a Community Court

body.zh:
下面用一场为检查表设计的原创社区篮球训练场景，演示如何定位球权跨剪点跳变。教练许衡在社区球场示范反弹传球，学员罗晴站在罚球线标记点接球，随后转身开始下一项练习。

**原记录**

| 镜头 | 起点 | 镜内可见动作 | 终点 | 主导职责 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 镜1 | 位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点后一步，面向罚球线黄色标记点；罗晴站在罚球线黄色标记点靠篮筐一侧一步，面向蓝色标记点。篮球与双手：许衡右手持球在身侧，罗晴双手自然下垂。动作阶段：两人尚未站上各自的标记点。 | 许衡和罗晴各自向前一步站上标记点；许衡把球从右手交到双手并停在腰前；罗晴把双手抬到胸前张开。 | 位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点，面向站在罚球线黄色标记点的罗晴；罗晴面向许衡。篮球与双手：许衡双手持球在腰前，罗晴双手张开在胸前。动作阶段：反弹传球尚未开始。 | 建立传球前的球权、站位和朝向 |
| 镜2 | 位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点，面向站在罚球线黄色标记点的罗晴；罗晴面向许衡。篮球与双手：罗晴双手在胸前持球，许衡双手空着。动作阶段：接球已经完成，镜头从接球后的状态开始。 | 罗晴把球从胸前降到腰前并稳住；许衡双手保持空着。 | 位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点，面向站在罚球线黄色标记点的罗晴；罗晴面向许衡。篮球与双手：罗晴双手把球稳在腰前，许衡双手空着。动作阶段：罗晴已经稳住球，等待下一指令。 | 展示罗晴接球后的准备状态 |
| 镜3 | 位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点，面向站在罚球线黄色标记点的罗晴；罗晴面向许衡。篮球与双手：罗晴双手把球稳在腰前，许衡双手空着。动作阶段：罗晴已经稳住球，等待下一指令。 | 罗晴在黄色标记点转身面向篮筐，同时把球从腰前举到胸前；许衡留在蓝色标记点，继续面向罗晴。 | 位置与朝向：罗晴站在黄色标记点，面向篮筐；许衡站在蓝色标记点，面向罗晴。篮球与双手：罗晴双手持球在胸前，许衡双手空着。动作阶段：下一项投篮练习已经开始。 | 让接球结果进入下一项练习 |

- **发现位置：** 镜1→镜2。
- **证据：** 镜1终点由许衡双手持球，反弹传球尚未开始；镜2起点已经由罗晴双手持球，接球已经完成。
- **观看影响：** 传球、落地反弹和接球全部缺失，观众看见球权在剪点处直接换人。
- **必须达到的修订结果：** 现有镜2从镜1终点开始，完整承载反弹传球与接球，并结束在镜3已经接受的起点。
- **负责人：** 本场分镜作者。

镜1已经完成传球前的状态建立，镜3需要从罗晴稳住球后进入下一项练习，因此本例把修改归到镜2。

**最小修正**

保留镜1的确认终点和镜3的起点，改写现有镜2：

- **镜2起点：** 精确接住镜1终点。位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点，面向站在罚球线黄色标记点的罗晴；罗晴面向许衡。篮球与双手：许衡双手持球在腰前，罗晴双手张开在胸前。动作阶段：反弹传球尚未开始。
- **镜2动作链：** 许衡屈膝把球推向地面 → 篮球在两人之间的场地反弹 → 罗晴双手接球并把球稳在腰前。
- **镜2终点：** 位置与朝向：许衡站在弧顶蓝色标记点，面向站在罚球线黄色标记点的罗晴；罗晴面向许衡。篮球与双手：罗晴双手把球稳在腰前，许衡双手空着。动作阶段：罗晴已经稳住球，等待下一指令。
- **镜2主导职责：** 清楚呈现传球、落地反弹和接球。具体机位、时长和运动由当前项目决定。

这次修正没有增加过渡镜。现有镜2承载完整的可见状态转换后，镜1终点、镜2起终点与镜3起点形成连续链条。
body.en:
The following original community-basketball practice scene is designed to show how the checklist locates a possession jump across a cut. Coach Xu Heng demonstrates a bounce pass on a community court. Learner Luo Qing receives the ball at a free-throw-line marker, then turns to begin the next drill.

**Original record**

| Shot | Start | Visible action within shot | End | Leading job |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shot 1 | Position and facing: Xu Heng stands one step behind the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing stands one step on the basket side of the yellow free-throw-line marker, facing the blue marker. Ball and hands: Xu Heng holds the ball at the right side with the right hand; Luo Qing's arms hang naturally. Action stage: neither person has stepped onto the assigned marker. | Xu Heng and Luo Qing each step forwards onto their marker; Xu Heng transfers the ball from the right hand to both hands and holds it at the waist; Luo Qing raises both open hands to chest height. | Position and facing: Xu Heng stands on the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing Luo Qing on the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing faces Xu Heng. Ball and hands: Xu Heng holds the ball with both hands at the waist; Luo Qing holds both hands open at chest height. Action stage: the bounce pass has not begun. | Establish possession, positions, and facing before the pass |
| Shot 2 | Position and facing: Xu Heng stands on the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing Luo Qing on the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing faces Xu Heng. Ball and hands: Luo Qing holds the ball with both hands at chest height; Xu Heng's hands are empty. Action stage: the catch is already complete, and the shot begins after the reception. | Luo Qing lowers the ball from chest to waist height and steadies it; Xu Heng keeps both hands empty. | Position and facing: Xu Heng stands on the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing Luo Qing on the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing faces Xu Heng. Ball and hands: Luo Qing steadies the ball with both hands at the waist; Xu Heng's hands are empty. Action stage: Luo Qing has secured the ball and waits for the next instruction. | Show Luo Qing's ready state after the catch |
| Shot 3 | Position and facing: Xu Heng stands on the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing Luo Qing on the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing faces Xu Heng. Ball and hands: Luo Qing steadies the ball with both hands at the waist; Xu Heng's hands are empty. Action stage: Luo Qing has secured the ball and waits for the next instruction. | Luo Qing pivots on the yellow marker to face the basket while raising the ball from waist to chest height; Xu Heng remains on the blue marker and continues facing Luo Qing. | Position and facing: Luo Qing stands on the yellow marker, facing the basket; Xu Heng stands on the blue marker, facing Luo Qing. Ball and hands: Luo Qing holds the ball with both hands at chest height; Xu Heng's hands are empty. Action stage: the next shooting drill has begun. | Carry the result of the catch into the next drill |

- **Finding location:** Shot 1 → Shot 2.
- **Evidence:** At Shot 1's end, Xu Heng holds the ball with both hands and the bounce pass has not begun. At Shot 2's start, Luo Qing already holds the ball with both hands and the catch is complete.
- **Viewing impact:** The pass, floor bounce, and catch are all absent, so possession changes directly at the cut.
- **Required revision result:** The existing Shot 2 must begin at Shot 1's end, carry the complete bounce pass and catch, and finish at the accepted start of Shot 3.
- **Owner:** Storyboard author for this scene.

Shot 1 has already established the state before the pass, and Shot 3 needs to begin after Luo Qing has secured the ball so the next drill can start. The revision therefore belongs in Shot 2.

**Minimal correction**

Keep the accepted end of Shot 1 and the start of Shot 3, then rewrite the existing Shot 2:

- **Shot 2 start:** Match Shot 1's end exactly. Position and facing: Xu Heng stands on the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing Luo Qing on the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing faces Xu Heng. Ball and hands: Xu Heng holds the ball with both hands at the waist; Luo Qing holds both hands open at chest height. Action stage: the bounce pass has not begun.
- **Shot 2 action chain:** Xu Heng bends the knees and pushes the ball towards the floor → the ball bounces on the court between them → Luo Qing catches it with both hands and steadies it at the waist.
- **Shot 2 end:** Position and facing: Xu Heng stands on the blue marker at the top of the arc, facing Luo Qing on the yellow marker at the free-throw line; Luo Qing faces Xu Heng. Ball and hands: Luo Qing steadies the ball with both hands at the waist; Xu Heng's hands are empty. Action stage: Luo Qing has secured the ball and waits for the next instruction.
- **Shot 2 leading job:** Show the pass, floor bounce, and catch clearly. The project decides the specific angle, duration, and movement.

This correction adds no transition shot. Once the existing Shot 2 carries the complete visible state change, Shot 1's end, Shot 2's boundaries, and Shot 3's start form one continuous chain.

heading.zh: 从第一个断点开始修，避免连锁返工
heading.en: Repair the First Break Before It Cascades

body.zh:
同一物件在后面多镜持续错误时，先找它第一次偏离确认状态的位置。后续镜头可能只是继承了早先的错误；从中间随手修一镜，会让两侧产生新的冲突。

按下面的顺序决定改动位置：

1. **确认哪一侧已经成立。** 依据故事顺序和已经接受的镜头职责，保留可信的终点或起点。
2. **定位缺失的状态转换。** 写出触发、主体完成的可见变化和必要反应。交接时明确接触、归属和落点。
3. **选择最小承载处。** 调整前镜终点、后镜起点，或让现有镜头补全动作链。只有现有覆盖无法让必要变化清楚成立时，才考虑新增镜头。
4. **同步受影响字段。** 道具变化也可能影响双手、人物位置、可读文字和后续动作阶段。
5. **指定负责人。** 写明实际修改镜头记录的人或角色；尚未分配时标记“待指定”。
6. **向后复查。** 从修正后的终点继续逐剪点核对，直到状态重新稳定。

把每条发现写成“剪点 + 冲突事实 + 观看影响 + 必须达到的修订结果 + 负责人”。修改方向因此保持明确，也不会把“更有电影感”一类模糊评价当成连续性结论。
body.en:
When the same object remains wrong across several later shots, find where it first departs from the accepted state. Later shots may merely inherit an earlier error. Fixing one shot in the middle can create new conflicts on both sides.

Choose the revision point in this order:

1. **Confirm which boundary already works.** Use story order and the accepted job of each shot to preserve the trustworthy end or start.
2. **Locate the missing state change.** Write the trigger, the visible change completed by the subject, and any necessary reaction. For a handoff, make contact, ownership, and destination clear.
3. **Choose the smallest place that can carry it.** Adjust the outgoing end, the incoming start, or the action chain inside an existing shot. Add coverage only when the necessary change cannot remain clear in the available shots.
4. **Update affected fields together.** A prop change may also alter hands, position, readable text, and later action stages.
5. **Assign an owner.** Name the person or role that will revise the shot record; mark it “unassigned” until someone is named.
6. **Recheck forward.** Continue from the revised endpoint, cut by cut, until the state is stable again.

Write every finding as “cut + conflicting facts + viewing impact + required revision result + owner.” This keeps the correction specific and prevents vague reactions such as “make it more cinematic” from posing as continuity findings.

heading.zh: 让AI只辅助比对你提供的镜头记录
heading.en: Limit AI Assistance to the Shot Records You Provide

body.zh:
AI可以整理作者提供的镜头起终记录，把相邻字段并排并指出文字中的明确冲突。输入只放当前场景需要的镜头号、起点、终点、主导职责和已确认的有意变化。输出要求逐条引用镜头号与冲突字段，同时保留作者已经声明的变化。

这项辅助工作不分析真实成片，也不补写剧情动作、机位、时长或数值。故事含义、观众应在何时知道信息、表演是否可读、遮挡是否妨碍证据，都由创作者查看素材后判断。若记录不足，结果应列出缺失字段并请作者选择修订方向。页面末尾的可选提示词遵守这一边界。
body.en:
AI can organize the shot starts and ends supplied by the author, place adjacent fields side by side, and identify explicit conflicts in the text. Provide only the current scene's shot labels, starts, ends, leading jobs, and confirmed intentional changes. Require the output to cite each shot label and conflicting field while preserving every change the author has already declared.

This assistance does not inspect finished footage or invent story actions, camera choices, durations, or numerical settings. The creator reviews the material to judge story meaning, when viewers should learn information, whether performance is readable, and whether occlusion hides evidence. If the records are incomplete, the result should list the missing fields and ask the author to choose a revision direction. The optional prompt at the end of this page follows that boundary.

q.zh: 前后镜状态不同就一定是连续性错误吗？
q.en: Is every state change between shots a continuity error?

a.zh: 有意变化可以成立。镜头记录要指出变化由哪个可见动作承载，或说明创作者已经确认省略，并由人工审查该省略是否守住故事含义和观众理解。缺少连接又没有创作依据的跳变才进入修订清单。
a.en: An intentional change can work. The shot record should name the visible action that carries it or note an omission the creator has approved. A human then reviews whether that omission preserves story meaning and viewer comprehension. A jump with no connection or creative basis belongs on the revision list.

q.zh: 发现断点后需要补一个过渡镜头吗？
q.en: Does a continuity break require an extra transition shot?

a.zh: 先检查前镜、后镜或现有动作镜能否承载缺失的状态转换。调整起点、终点或动作链通常能接通边界。只有必要变化在现有覆盖中无法清楚成立时，再评估新增镜头；新增镜头也要有明确的信息职责。
a.en: First check whether the outgoing shot, incoming shot, or an existing action shot can carry the missing state change. Revising a start, end, or action chain often reconnects the boundary. Consider another shot only when the necessary change cannot remain clear in the available coverage, and give that shot a specific information job.

q.zh: 镜头表已经对上，成片还需要人工看吗？
q.en: If the shot records match, does the finished edit still need human review?

a.zh: 需要。字段一致只能证明文字记录没有显式冲突。生成画面可能让手部交接、伤势、文字或光线变得模糊，也可能让正确状态在错误时机出现。创作者仍要看相邻画面和剪辑，判断原意、知情时机、遮挡与可读性。
a.en: Yes. Matching fields prove only that the written records contain no explicit conflict. Generated images may blur a handoff, injury, text, or lighting state, or reveal the correct state at the wrong moment. The creator still reviews adjacent images and the edit for meaning, information timing, occlusion, and legibility.

q.zh: 一个错误延续了很多镜，应该从哪一镜改？
q.en: Where should I revise an error that continues across many shots?

a.zh: 找到状态第一次偏离已确认边界的剪点。保留可信的一侧，把缺失的转换放进最小可行的现有镜头，再从修正后的终点向后复查。后续镜头只继承早先错误时，无需逐镜分别发明修法。
a.en: Find the cut where the state first departs from an accepted boundary. Preserve the trustworthy side, place the missing change in the smallest viable existing shot, then review forward from the corrected endpoint. If later shots merely inherited the earlier error, they do not need separate invented fixes.

text.zh: 可选：在 Claude Code 中说：“用 `/short-drama-storyboard` 只比对我提供的镜头记录。按相邻剪点列出前镜终点与后镜起点，逐项检查位置与朝向、持物、可见服装或伤势、光态、可读文字和动作阶段。每条冲突引用镜头号与字段，写明证据、观看影响、必须达到的修订结果和我提供的负责人；没有负责人时标记“待指定”，不要自行猜测。保留我标注的有意变化；不要补写剧情动作、机位、时长或数值。信息不足时列出缺失字段，并让我选择修订方向。”Codex 中使用 `$short-drama-storyboard`。
text.en: Optional: In Claude Code, say: “Use `/short-drama-storyboard` only to compare the shot records I provide. For each adjacent cut, place the outgoing end beside the incoming start and check position and facing, carried objects, visible costume or injury, lighting, readable text, and action stage. Cite the shot label and field for every conflict, then state the evidence, viewing impact, required revision result, and owner I provide. Write “unassigned” when no owner is given; do not guess. Preserve intentional changes I have marked. Do not invent story actions, camera choices, durations, or numerical settings. When information is missing, list the missing fields and ask me to choose the revision direction.” In Codex, use `$short-drama-storyboard`.

title.zh: AI视频配乐在剪辑点重启怎么办：跨镜头接续表
title.en: How to Keep Music Continuous Across AI-Generated Video Shots

seo_title.zh: AI视频配乐怎么跨镜头接续
seo_title.en: AI Video Music Continuity Across Shots

description.zh: 分别生成的镜头一拼接，配乐就重启或硬切？用逐镜状态表把观众专属配乐放回时间线，标清延续、进入、退出和对白让位，再回听实际成片接点。
description.en: Does music restart or hard-cut when separately generated shots are joined? Map its entry, exit, continuation, or dialogue ducking, then replay the joined cut.

answer.zh: 如果 AI 视频由多个独立镜头组成，想让观众专属配乐跨镜延续，默认把配乐实现放在整条时间线上，而不是让每个镜头各自烧入一段音乐。逐镜只标记音乐在这里是延续、进入、退出，还是给对白让位；相邻镜标注要互相接得上。收音机、现场演奏等画内声源仍属于镜头声音。拼接后要实际回听剪辑点，不能把写了方案或导出成功当作已经验证了混音。
answer.en: When an AI video is assembled from separately generated shots, keep audience-only score on the sequence timeline by default instead of baking a separate music segment into every shot. Mark whether the score continues, enters, exits, or yields to dialogue in each shot, and make neighboring labels agree. A radio or live performance heard in the scene remains shot audio. Replay the actual joined edit at its cuts; a written plan or successful export does not prove that the mix was checked.

heading.zh: 先分清配乐轨与镜头里的声音
heading.en: Separate the Score from Sounds in the Scene

body.zh:
分镜分别生成时，如果每个文件都带着各自的一段观众专属配乐，剪到一起就可能在镜头边界重新起头、突然截断，或让前后乐段对不上。单镜预览不一定能看出问题；它会在相邻镜头真正接上时暴露。

在默认流程里，配乐的情绪意图可以逐镜记录，但音乐本身作为一条连续轨道在总时间线上实现。单镜素材按项目需要保留对白、画外声、环境底声和事件音效；不要因为要移除烧入的配乐，就一并删除这些镜头声音。

先判断听到的是什么：

- **观众专属配乐**：角色听不见的音乐，例如用来支撑整场气氛的弦乐，通常按全片时间线安排。
- **画内声源**：角色也能听见的收音机、手机、现场演奏或隔壁排练，属于场景声音，随镜头中的空间与事件处理。

如果项目已经接受单个容器自带配乐等交付方式，就按该项目确认过的方案执行，不要机械套用默认值。
body.en:
When shots are generated separately and each file contains its own segment of audience-only score, joining them can make the music restart, stop abruptly, or jump to an incompatible phrase at a cut. A problem may not be audible in a single-shot preview; it appears when neighboring shots are actually joined.

In the default workflow, record the intended musical role shot by shot, but implement the score as a continuous track on the sequence timeline. Keep dialogue, off-screen voices, ambience, and effects in shot media as the project requires. Removing baked-in score should not remove those other shot sounds.

First identify what you are hearing:

- **Audience-only score**: music the characters cannot hear, such as strings supporting the scene's mood; it is usually arranged across the sequence timeline.
- **A diegetic source**: a radio, phone, live performance, or neighboring rehearsal that characters can hear; treat it as part of the scene's sound and space.

If the project has already approved a delivery plan with music embedded in a single container, follow that agreed plan instead of applying the default mechanically.

heading.zh: 用四种状态写清每镜配乐位置
heading.en: Use Four States to Map Music Across Shots

body.zh:
把下表复制到分镜或剪辑单。记录的是这镜与同一条配乐轨的关系，不是为每镜重新选一段音乐。

| 镜头 | 配乐状态 | 与对白的关系 | 画内声源 | 接点备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A01 | 进入 | 尚无对白 | 投影机风扇持续 | 第一组星点出现时进入，并延续到下一镜 |
| A02 | 延续；对白处让位 | 台词前短暂压低，话音落下后恢复 | 风扇声仍在 | 不在切点重启音乐；记下让位的台词 |
| A03 | 延续后退出 | 无对白 | 风扇声随画面保留 | 星图稳定后退出，风扇不随配乐一起消失 |

状态只用来明确交接：**延续**表示同一轨道越过剪点；**进入**标出该轨道从何处开始；**退出**写清它在哪里结束；**让位**指出对白期间如何暂时降低存在感、何时恢复。让位不是删除对白或环境声，也不要自定通用的音量百分比。

剪点两侧要能对上：前镜写“延续到下一镜”，后镜就不能又写成“从头进入”。若有意换曲或中断，直接标成有意变化，并写清对应事件。
body.en:
Copy this table into the storyboard or edit sheet. It records each shot's relationship to one score track, not a new music choice for every shot.

| Shot | Music state | Relation to dialogue | Diegetic source | Cut note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A01 | Enters | No dialogue yet | Projector fan continues | Enter when the first stars appear; carry the score into the next shot |
| A02 | Continues; yields under dialogue | Briefly lower it before the line; restore after the line ends | Fan remains audible | Do not restart at the cut; note which line gets room |
| A03 | Continues, then exits | No dialogue | Fan remains with the image | Exit after the star pattern stabilizes; do not remove the fan with the score |

Use the states to make handoffs explicit: **continues** means the same track crosses the cut; **enters** identifies where it begins; **exits** says where it ends; **yields** marks where it should become less prominent under dialogue and when it returns. Yielding does not mean deleting dialogue or ambience, and it does not require a universal volume percentage.

The two sides of a cut must agree: if the outgoing shot says “continues into the next shot,” the incoming shot must not also say “starts from the beginning.” If a change or break is intentional, label it as intentional and name the event that motivates it.

heading.zh: 原创示例：天文馆开门前的试映
heading.en: Original Example: A Planetarium Test Before Opening

body.zh:
下面是为说明表格而设计的虚构示例，不是实际生成、剪辑或试听结果。小型天文馆的技术员在开门前检查新星图：

1. **A01，全景**：圆顶先是暗的。第一组星点亮起时，观众专属配乐进入；投影机风扇作为画内环境声持续。
2. **A02，镜头转到调焦环**：同一条配乐越过切点继续。技术员说：“木星边缘还在发虚。”台词期间配乐让位，风扇声仍在；话音结束后按计划恢复。
3. **A03，回到圆顶全景**：配乐从 A02 延续过来，星图稳定后退出；风扇声继续留在画面空间里。

这里的配乐交接是 A01 进入 → A02 延续并给对白让位 → A03 延续后退出。若 A02 文件已带配乐，先确认它是否有独立音轨：能单独处理时只处理配乐层，再把同一条音乐放到序列时间线上；若音乐已与台词或风扇声混在一起，就把素材问题退回制作阶段，不要假定后期能无损剥离。表格表达的是计划，实际剪好后仍要回听接点。
body.en:
This fictional example was designed to explain the table; it is not a real generation, edit, or listening result. Before opening, a technician at a small planetarium checks a new star projection:

1. **A01, wide shot:** The dome is dark. Audience-only score enters when the first stars appear; the projector fan continues as in-scene ambience.
2. **A02, close-up of the focus ring:** The same score carries across the cut. The technician says, “Jupiter's edge is still out of focus.” The score yields under the line while the fan remains; it returns afterward as planned.
3. **A03, back to the wide dome:** The score continues from A02 and exits after the star pattern stabilizes; the fan remains part of the space.

The score handoff is A01 enters → A02 continues and yields to dialogue → A03 continues, then exits. If A02's file already contains score, first check whether it is a separate track: remove only that layer if it can be handled separately, then place one track on the sequence timeline. If music is mixed with the line or fan, return the material issue to production rather than assuming it can be cleanly separated later. The table describes intent. Replay the cuts after the edit is made.

heading.zh: 修剪辑点后，要回听拼接成片
heading.en: After Repairing the Cut, Replay the Joined Sequence

body.zh:
发现配乐跳变后，按这个顺序排查：

1. **先确认声源类型。** 判断问题来自观众专属配乐，还是来自角色能听见的收音机、手机或现场演奏。不要把画内声误删为“多余 BGM”。
2. **看单镜文件，再看整段拼接。** 若独立镜头各自带入新配乐，先确认它是否能与其他声音分开处理：有独立配乐轨时只处理该轨；若配乐已和对白、环境声混在一起，就退回制作阶段补齐符合已确认方案的素材。不要为去掉音乐而静音整条声音。
3. **检查剪辑单上的相邻状态。** 从切点前后对读：延续、进入、退出或给对白让位是否矛盾？有意换曲、留白或突然中止时，写明对应事件。
4. **按已确认的声音意图实施。** 把观众专属配乐放在整段时间线上，再按需要安排进入、退出、循环或对白让位。交叉淡入淡出只是可选手段，不是每个剪点都要套的规则。
5. **回听实际拼接输出。** 从每个剪点前一点开始听到剪点后，检查音乐是否重启、断裂、意外消失，或盖住必须听清的对白；同时确认环境底声与画内声没有被误伤。把实际听到的问题和修正记录下来。

剪辑单写了“连续”或导出按钮显示成功，都不能证明混音已经按计划发生。若还没有回听成片，就把状态记为“待试听”，不要写成已验证。
body.en:
After you hear a jump, investigate in this order:

1. **Identify the source.** Decide whether the problem is audience-only score or a radio, phone, or live performance that characters can hear. Do not delete a diegetic source as “extra BGM.”
2. **Check the shot files and then the joined sequence.** If separate shots each contain a new score segment, first check whether it can be handled separately from other sound: work only on a separate score track; if music is mixed with dialogue or ambience, return to production for material that fits the accepted plan. Do not mute the whole sound track just to remove music.
3. **Compare neighboring states in the edit sheet.** Read both sides of each cut: do “continues,” “enters,” “exits,” or “yields to dialogue” conflict? If a change, silence, or abrupt stop is intentional, name the event.
4. **Implement the accepted sound intent.** Place audience-only score on the sequence timeline, then arrange entry, exit, looping, or dialogue ducking as needed. Crossfades are an option, not a rule to apply at every cut.
5. **Replay the actual joined output.** Listen from just before each cut to just after it. Check whether music restarts, breaks, disappears unexpectedly, or masks dialogue that needs to be heard; also make sure ambience and diegetic sound were not damaged. Record what you actually heard and changed.

Writing “continuous” on an edit sheet or seeing a successful export does not prove that the mix followed the plan. If no one has replayed the sequence, mark it “awaiting listen-through,” not verified.

heading.zh: 常见配乐接续问题与修正
heading.en: Common Music-Continuity Problems and Fixes

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正方向 |
|---|---|
| 每个镜头都从音乐开头重新起 | 默认把观众专属配乐移到整段时间线，逐镜写延续/进入/退出，而不是重复烧入 |
| 切点突然没音乐，但音乐本来应延续 | 检查前镜的退出点和后镜的进入点；改为同一轨延续，或记录一个有意的音乐变化 |
| 对白一出来，配乐和环境声一起消失 | 只让配乐按意图给对白让位；保留需要的同期声、底声与事件音效 |
| 把收音机声当配乐删除 | 标清它是角色能听见的画内来源，再按镜头中的空间与事件处理 |
| 剪辑单写了连续，成片却没检查 | 回听拼接输出并记下真实结果；纸面状态不能代替试听 |
body.en:
| Problem | Repair direction |
|---|---|
| Music starts over at the beginning of every shot | By default, put audience-only score on the sequence timeline and mark where it continues, enters, or exits instead of baking it into each shot |
| Music drops at a cut even though it should continue | Check the outgoing exit and incoming entry; carry the same track across, or document an intentional change |
| Dialogue makes the score and ambience disappear together | Let only the score yield as intended; preserve needed sync sound, ambience, and effects |
| A radio is removed as if it were score | Label it as a source characters can hear, then handle it according to the shot's space and action |
| The edit sheet says “continuous,” but no one checked the output | Replay the joined sequence and record the actual result; a written state is not a listen-through |

q.zh: 配乐已经烧进镜头文件怎么办？
q.en: What if score is already baked into a shot file?

a.zh: 先确认配乐是否是可单独处理的音轨。若能分开，就只调整这条配乐；若它与对白、环境声或音效混在一起，退回制作阶段补齐符合已确认方案的素材，不要把整条声音静音，也不要承诺后期一定能无损分离。之后再把观众专属配乐安排在序列时间线上。
a.en: First check whether the score is a separate, editable track. If it is, adjust only that track. If it is mixed with dialogue, ambience, or effects, return to production for material that fits the accepted plan; do not mute the whole sound track or promise clean separation in post. Then arrange audience-only score on the sequence timeline.

q.zh: 每个剪辑点都应该加交叉淡化吗？
q.en: Should every edit point use a crossfade?

a.zh: 不需要。先看已确认的声音意图：同一条配乐是否应连续、进入、退出、循环或让位。交叉淡化可以用于需要的接点，但不是修复所有剪辑点的固定公式；做完仍要回听实际输出。
a.en: No. Start with the accepted sound intent: should the same score continue, enter, exit, loop, or yield? A crossfade may help at a particular join, but it is not a universal formula for every cut. Replay the actual output after making the change.

q.zh: 角色能听见的手机铃声或收音机也放在配乐轨吗？
q.en: Does a phone ringtone or radio that characters hear belong on the score track?

a.zh: 它们是画内声源，应该明确标为手机、收音机或其他具体来源，再按镜头空间、动作和相邻镜头的关系处理。不要为了让观众专属配乐连续而把角色能听见的声源一并挪走或静音。
a.en: Those are diegetic sources. Label the phone, radio, or other source explicitly, then handle it according to the shot's space, action, and neighboring shots. Do not move or mute a sound characters can hear just to keep the audience-only score continuous.

q.zh: 怎么确认修复真的生效了？
q.en: How do I know the repair actually worked?

a.zh: 回听已经拼接的成片，至少跨过每个有问题的剪点，确认配乐按计划延续或变化，对白与必要环境声仍可听见。只看单镜、剪辑单或导出成功提示都不够；记录实际回听结果。
a.en: Replay the joined sequence across each affected cut and confirm that the score continues or changes as planned while dialogue and needed ambience remain audible. Individual shots, an edit sheet, or a successful-export notice are not enough; record the actual listening result.

text.zh: 可选：把已确认的分镜和配乐意图交给 AI，并要求：“只根据我提供的镜头记录整理配乐状态表。逐镜标注延续、进入、退出或给对白让位；核对相邻镜状态是否矛盾；单独列出我标明的画内声源。不要创作音乐、改写对白、发明声源、决定混音或声称已经试听/渲染。信息不足时标出缺项，不要替我猜测。”
text.en: Optional: Give an AI your approved shot list and score intent, then ask: “Organize a music-state table using only the shot records I provide. Mark where score continues, enters, exits, or yields to dialogue; flag contradictions between neighboring shots; list the diegetic sources I identify separately. Do not compose music, rewrite dialogue, invent sound sources, decide the mix, or claim to have listened or rendered. Mark missing information instead of guessing.”

title.zh: AI视频换镜后环境声忽变怎么办：同场底声检查表
title.en: AI Video Room Tone Jumps Between Shots: A Checklist

seo_title.zh: AI视频环境底声接续检查表
seo_title.en: AI Video Room-Tone Continuity Guide

description.zh: 同一场景的AI镜头拼接后，风扇、雨声或远处人声忽然改变？逐镜记录地点/视角与底声状态，查明变化原因，再回听实际剪点。
description.en: Does ambience jump between AI-generated shots of the same space? Track location/view and recurring sound, explain changes, then replay the actual cut.

answer.zh: 同一场景、同一地点与视角的相邻 AI 镜头，默认要保留一致的环境底声成分和相对层级；否则每段各自生成的房间底噪可能在剪点突然换了空间。只有场景或 Location/View 确实变化时，才让底声变化，并说明触发原因。逐镜区分连续环境声与具体动作音效，拼接后回听真实剪点；写了声音方案或导出成功，都不能代替实际检查。
answer.en: For adjacent AI-generated shots in the same scene and the same location/view, keep the ambience components and their relative prominence consistent by default; otherwise independently generated room tone can make the space change abruptly at each cut. Change the bed only when the scene or Location/View actually changes, and state the cause. Separate continuous ambience from event sounds shot by shot, then replay the real cuts in the joined sequence; a written plan or successful export is not a substitute for checking.

heading.zh: 先把环境底声和单次音效分开
heading.en: Separate the Ambient Bed from One-Off Effects

body.zh:
同一房间里的通风声、窗外远雨或持续运转的设备声，可能组成一条环境底声：它建立空间，并在镜头之间延续。书本落入回收箱、门锁扣上或手机响一次，则是由具体动作触发的事件声，不应被误写成整场都持续的底声。

声音层也不要混为一谈：对白是角色发声，观众专属配乐属于时间线处理（见[跨镜配乐接续](/drama-skills/music-continuity-across-shots)）；本页只检查环境底声。目标不是让每个音轨“听起来差不多”，而是说明相邻镜头属于同一空间时，哪些连续声源应该保留、层级是否突然变化。
body.en:
Ventilation in one room, distant rain outside its window, or a machine running continuously may form an ambient bed: it establishes the space and carries between shots. A book dropping into a return slot, a latch clicking, or one phone ring is an event sound caused by an action; it should not be mislabeled as a bed that lasts through the scene.

Keep the layers distinct: dialogue is spoken by a character, while audience-only score follows the sequence timeline (see [music continuity across shots](/drama-skills/music-continuity-across-shots)). This page checks ambience only. The goal is not to make every track “sound similar,” but to say which continuous sources should remain when neighboring shots depict the same space and whether their prominence suddenly changes.

heading.zh: 按地点、视角和底声状态填表
heading.en: Map Location, View, and Ambience State

body.zh:
把这张表加入分镜或剪辑记录。每行只记这一镜实际需要的环境声，不把所有可听见的东西都塞进“底噪”。

| 镜头 | 地点/视角 | 持续底声 | 相对层级 | 状态与变化原因 | 拼接后听到什么 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A01 | 阅读室全景 | 通风声、窗外远雨 | 低、稳定 | 进入；场景开始 | 待实际回听 |
| A02 | 同一阅读室，回收口近景 | 同样的通风声和远雨 | 与 A01 接近 | 延续；无空间变化 | 待实际回听 |
| A03 | 转向走廊的门口 | 室内声逐渐远；走廊人声进入 | 依视角变化 | 因开门并转向走廊而变化 | 待实际回听 |

**延续**表示同一空间的底声跨过剪点继续；**进入**标记一个持续声源开始变得可闻；**退出**标明底声何时结束。若场景或 Location/View 变了，写出变化原因和对应可见事件；若没有变化理由，就不要让同一空间在每个生成镜头里各自换一套房间底噪。相对层级用“稳定、远一些、被门隔住”等项目可理解的描述，不套通用分贝值。

`拼接后听到什么` 一栏必须在实际播放相邻素材后填写。规划阶段可先写“待实际回听”，不能预填“已连续”。
body.en:
Add this table to the storyboard or edit record. Each row notes only the ambience needed in that shot; do not put every audible sound under “background noise.”

| Shot | Location/view | Recurring ambience | Relative prominence | State and reason for change | What the join actually sounds like |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A01 | Reading-room wide | Ventilation, distant rain at the window | Low, steady | Enters; scene begins | Awaiting listen-through |
| A02 | Same reading room, close on return slot | Same ventilation and distant rain | Similar to A01 | Continues; no spatial change | Awaiting listen-through |
| A03 | Doorway looking into corridor | Interior bed recedes; corridor voices enter | Changes with the view | Changes because the door opens and view turns to corridor | Awaiting listen-through |

**Continues** means the bed carries across a cut in the same space; **enters** marks when a continuous source becomes audible; **exits** records where the bed ends. If the scene or Location/View changes, state the reason and the visible event that motivates it. Without such a reason, do not let each generated shot of the same space acquire a different room tone. Describe relative prominence in terms the project understands—“steady,” “farther away,” or “muffled by the door”—rather than applying a universal decibel value.

Fill in `What the join actually sounds like` only after playing the adjacent media. During planning, write “awaiting listen-through”; do not prefill “continuous.”

heading.zh: 原创示例：开门前的社区图书馆
heading.en: Original Example: A Community Library Before Opening

body.zh:
这是为说明表格而设计的虚构例子，不是实际生成或试听结果。管理员在开门前把一本书放入回收口：

1. **A01，阅读室全景**：房间里有稳定的通风声，窗外下着远雨。它们是本场的环境底声。
2. **A02，回收口近景**：视角仍在同一阅读室，通风声与远雨应继续，不能因为切成另一个生成文件就突然换房间质感。书落入箱中的短促声跟随动作，是事件音效，不是持续底声。
3. **A03，走廊门口**：管理员打开门，画面转向走廊。此时走廊里的人声才进入；阅读室底声可以因门和视角改变而退远。表里写明变化由“开门并转向走廊”触发。

如果 A02 的房间底声在拼接时忽然更响、变成完全不同的设备声，先判断这是有意的空间变化还是独立生成造成的接缝；记录第一处异常，并按项目确认的方式修正该镜环境素材或接续。不要为补背景声发明剧本没有的广播、人物或事件。示例中的 `待实际回听` 只是提醒，不能当成已经完成的试听记录。
body.en:
This fictional example was designed to explain the table; it is not a real generation or listening result. Before opening, a library attendant puts a book into the return slot:

1. **A01, reading-room wide:** Steady ventilation fills the room, with distant rain outside the window. These are the scene's ambient bed.
2. **A02, close on the return slot:** The view is still inside the same reading room, so ventilation and distant rain should continue; a new generated file should not suddenly sound like a different room. The brief thud of the book landing follows the action and is an event effect, not a continuous bed.
3. **A03, doorway to the corridor:** The attendant opens the door and the view turns into the corridor. Voices there enter only now; the reading-room bed may recede because the door and viewpoint have changed. Record “door opens and view turns to corridor” as the cause.

If A02's room tone suddenly gets louder or changes to a different machine sound in the edit, first decide whether this is an intentional spatial change or a seam between independently generated shots. Record the first mismatch, then repair that shot's ambience or the handoff using the project's accepted method. Do not invent an announcement, person, or event that the script does not contain just to fill the background. `Awaiting listen-through` in the example is a reminder, not a claim that anyone has checked the audio.

heading.zh: 沿着剪点回听，定位第一处变化
heading.en: Replay Each Cut and Locate the First Change

body.zh:
拿到拼接版后，逐个剪点执行：

1. **先写清空间是否连续。** 前后镜属于同一场景、地点与视角，还是已经进入不同房间、走廊或位置？
2. **听底声由哪些持续声源组成。** 把通风、雨、风或远处活动等连续声源，与台词、配乐和书本落地等事件声分开。
3. **比较相邻镜头的组成和相对层级。** 同一空间本应延续时，记录哪一种声源突然变响、消失、靠近或换了质感。不要只写“听起来怪”。
4. **检查变化有没有可见原因。** 如果镜头转到走廊、开门或离开室内，底声变化可能有原因；若画面仍在同一阅读室，文件各自生成的房间底噪跳变就需要修订。
5. **回到能修正的最小素材或接点。** 用项目已确认的环境声实现方式处理；若现有素材不足以保持底声，就退回制作阶段补齐，不承诺任何降噪或音源分离一定无损。
6. **再听实际成片。** 回听剪点前后，确认底声按意图延续或因空间变化而改变，同时没有盖住必需对白。记录真正听到的结果。

计划表、单镜预览或“导出成功”都不能证明拼接后的环境声已经一致；只有回听实际序列，才能把检查状态记为完成。
body.en:
Once you have an assembled sequence, check each cut in order:

1. **State whether the space continues.** Are the two shots in the same scene, location, and view, or has the sequence moved to another room, corridor, or position?
2. **List the recurring sources in the bed.** Separate continuous sounds such as ventilation, rain, wind, or distant activity from dialogue, score, and event sounds such as a book landing.
3. **Compare components and relative prominence across the cut.** When the space should continue, record which source suddenly gets louder, disappears, moves closer, or changes texture. “It sounds strange” is not a useful finding by itself.
4. **Check for a visible reason.** A view into a corridor, an opening door, or leaving the room may explain a change. If the picture is still in the same reading room, a jump between independently generated room tones needs correction.
5. **Return to the smallest material or handoff that can be corrected.** Use the project's accepted ambience method. If the existing material is insufficient to keep the bed consistent, return to production for suitable material; do not promise that noise removal or source separation will always be lossless.
6. **Replay the actual sequence.** Listen across the cut and confirm that the bed continues or changes as intended without masking required dialogue. Record what you actually hear.

A plan, a single-shot preview, or a “successful export” does not prove the assembled ambience is consistent. Mark the check complete only after replaying the actual sequence.

heading.zh: 环境底声接缝常见错误
heading.en: Common Ambient-Bed Continuity Errors

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正方向 |
|---|---|
| 同一房间的每个镜头都像换了一个空间 | 让相邻镜头保留同一组持续声源和相近的相对层级；回听拼接结果 |
| 把一次书本落地声写进整场底声 | 将持续环境声与有明确触发动作的事件音效分开标注 |
| 还没开门，走廊人声已进入 | 把声音变化与实际地点/视角转移及可见原因对齐 |
| 只用“环境声保持一致”，没有列声源 | 写清本场哪些连续声源需要留下，以及谁负责每镜实现 |
| 导出完成就当成环境声验收 | 回听实际相邻剪点并记录结果；尚未回听就标待检查 |
body.en:
| Problem | Repair direction |
|---|---|
| Each shot of the same room sounds like a different space | Keep the same recurring sources and similar relative prominence across neighbors; replay the joined cut |
| A one-time book drop is listed as part of the whole-scene bed | Record continuous ambience separately from an event effect with a specific trigger |
| Corridor voices enter before the door opens | Align the sound change with the actual location/view transition and visible cause |
| The notes say only “keep ambience consistent” | Name the recurring sources that should remain and who implements them in each shot |
| Export completion is treated as ambience approval | Replay the actual adjacent cuts and record the result; mark it pending until someone listens |

q.zh: 环境底声和所有背景噪声是同一回事吗？
q.en: Is an ambient bed the same as every background noise?

a.zh: 不是。环境底声是持续建立空间的声源，例如同一房间里的通风声或远雨；一次书本落地、门锁声或手机铃声是被动作触发的事件音效。台词和观众专属配乐也各有自己的层，不要统称为底噪。
a.en: No. An ambient bed is a recurring source that establishes a space, such as ventilation in one room or distant rain. A book landing, latch, or phone ring is an event effect triggered by an action. Dialogue and audience-only score also have their own layers; do not label everything as room tone.

q.zh: 同一个房间的环境声必须每个镜头完全一样吗？
q.en: Must ambience be identical in every shot of the same room?

a.zh: 默认保持的是需要连续的声源组成和相对层级，不是要求复制完全相同的音频波形。若视角或地点实际改变，允许变化，但要写明变化原因；不要用固定分贝值代替判断。
a.en: By default, keep the recurring sources and their relative prominence consistent; this does not require copying an identical audio waveform. If the location or view actually changes, a change is allowed, but state why. Do not replace that judgment with a fixed decibel value.

q.zh: 环境声也要像配乐一样统一放到整条时间线吗？
q.en: Should ambience be moved to one timeline track like score?

a.zh: 项目默认不同。这里的环境底声留在单镜素材里，但同一场景的相邻镜头要接得上；观众专属配乐默认属于总时间线。若项目明确采用连续环境底层，按已确认方案执行，并回听成片。
a.en: Not by default. Ambient beds remain in shot media, but adjacent shots in the same scene must connect; audience-only score belongs on the sequence timeline by default. If the project explicitly uses a continuous ambience layer, follow that accepted plan and replay the result.

q.zh: 环境底声接不上时，直接降噪能解决吗？
q.en: Can noise reduction fix an ambience mismatch?

a.zh: 不一定。先定位是持续声源、相对层级还是空间变化造成接缝；若可用素材不足以实现已确认的环境声方案，就退回制作阶段补齐。不要假设某种降噪或分离处理一定保留对白与事件声。
a.en: Not necessarily. First locate whether the seam comes from a recurring source, its relative prominence, or a change in space. If the available material cannot realize the accepted ambience plan, return to production for suitable material. Do not assume a noise-reduction or separation process will always preserve dialogue and effects.

text.zh: 可选：只用我提供并确认过的逐镜记录，整理“地点/视角、持续环境声源、相对层级、进入/延续/退出、相邻剪点待核对项”表。不要发明声源、声称已经试听、设置通用分贝或混音规则、修改对白或配乐，也不要承诺降噪或音源分离一定无损。标出缺失信息和无法解释的相邻差异；除非我提供了实际回听记录，否则将拼接结果标为“待实际回听”。
text.en: Optional: Using only shot records I provide and approve, organize a table of Location/View, recurring ambience sources, relative prominence, enter/continue/exit state, and neighboring cut mismatches to check. Do not invent sources, claim to have listened, set universal decibel or mixing rules, alter dialogue or score, or promise lossless denoising or source separation. Flag missing information and unexplained differences; mark the joined result “awaiting actual listen-through” unless I provide a real listening record.

title.zh: 短剧剧本格式模板：场景、动作和对白怎么分
title.en: Vertical Drama Script Format: A Scene and Dialogue Template

seo_title.zh: 短剧剧本格式模板与示例
seo_title.en: Vertical Drama Script Template and Example

description.zh: 短剧剧本的场次、动作、对白和OS/VO怎么标？用可复制的Markdown模板开稿，先选定项目格式，再检查AI整理是否改了原意。
description.en: Use this Markdown template for scene headings, action, dialogue, and production cues. Choose a format, then check AI edits against the source.

answer.zh: 先选定团队实际使用的一种格式：按集与场景标出稳定位置，让可见动作单独成段，让对白明确对应说话人，只在制作必须知道时添加声音、屏显文字或连续性标签。本文给出可复制的 Markdown 场景骨架和原创示例。`△/▲` 与 `OS/VO` 的含义按项目所选方言确定；用 AI 整理时也要对照原稿复核。
answer.en: Choose one format your team actually uses: identify episodes and scenes consistently, keep visible action in its own paragraph, label every speaker, and add sound, on-screen text, or continuity cues only when production needs them. This page provides a reusable Markdown scene skeleton and an original example. The meaning of `△/▲` and `OS/VO` follows the project's selected dialect. Compare any AI-formatted draft with its source.

heading.zh: 先选格式，再填集名和场次
heading.en: Choose a Format Before Naming Episodes and Scenes

body.zh:
同一个项目先确定一份可编辑的剧本作为文字事实来源；分镜、图片/视频提示词和制作清单引用它，不要各自改写剧情。下面是项目 Markdown 格式的最小骨架：

| 行 | 示例 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| 集标题 | `# EP001 【集名】` | 稳定集 ID；改集名时保留 ID |
| 场景标题 | `## EP001-SC001 内 · 社区服务台 · 傍晚` | 场景 ID、内外、地点和对后续有用的时段 |
| 动作 | `林遥把登记回执推回窗口。` | 观众能看见、演员能执行的行动 |
| 对白 | `林遥：我五点前交过。` | 说话人明确，台词跟在角色名后 |
| 生产标签 | `[画面文字] 登记时间：16:52` | 只记录观众必须读到的文字或制作必需事实 |

**可复制的空白骨架**（替换填写提示；标签行都按需选择，不要求全填）：

> # EP001 【集名】  
> ## EP001-SC001 内 · 地点 · 时间/天气  
> （填写可见、可表演的动作）  
> 角色名（可选的表演/策略提示）：台词  
> [OS] 角色名：同场景画外对白（可选）  
> [VO] 角色名：非现场主观/叙述声音（可选）  
> [SFX] 会改变注意、行动或信息的声音（可选）  
> [画面文字] 载体：观众必须读清的准确文字（可选）  
> [连续性] 前文已建立且后续易丢失的状态（可选）  
> [转场] 有叙事作用的转场信息（可选）

这套 Markdown 的空间字段使用“内/外/内外”，按场景选择；标签行都是可选的。不要把 `△/▲` 的制作方言混进来；另一个方言可把角色 `OS` 用作内心声音，含义要分开约定。

集/场景 ID 在这套格式中保持稳定；时间、天气等只填对行动、表演或连续性有用的信息。这是这套项目 Markdown 约定；团队若采用其他制作格式，应在开稿前写明各标记的定义。需要把剧本转换成逐镜方案时，另看[分镜脚本模板](/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard)，不要在故事剧本里提前塞景别、镜头运动、焦段或视频生成参数。
body.en:
Choose one editable script as the source of story text for the project. Storyboards, image/video prompts, and production checklists should refer to it rather than rewrite the plot independently. Here is a minimal skeleton for the project's Markdown format:

| Line | Example | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Episode heading | `# EP001 【Episode title】` | Stable episode ID; keep it when the displayed title changes |
| Scene heading | `## EP001-SC001 内 · Community desk · Evening` | Scene ID, space, location, and a useful time of day |
| Action | `Lin Yao slides the registration receipt back across the counter.` | An action the audience can see and a performer can execute |
| Dialogue | `Lin Yao: I submitted it before five.` | The speaker is explicit and the line follows the character name |
| Production cue | `[画面文字] Registered: 16:52` | The exact label in the source format; agree on a translation for English scripts |

**Copyable blank skeleton** (replace the prompts; every tagged line is optional):

> # EP001 【Episode title】  
> ## EP001-SC001 内 · Location · Time/weather  
> (Visible, performable action)  
> Character (optional performance/strategy cue): Dialogue  
> [OS] Character: off-screen dialogue in the same scene (optional)  
> [VO] Character: non-local subjective/narrative voice (optional)  
> [SFX] A sound that changes attention, action, or information (optional)  
> [画面文字] Surface: exact words the audience must read (optional)  
> [连续性] A previously established state that could be lost later (optional)  
> [转场] A transition with a story purpose (optional)

This Markdown format uses one of the literal space markers `内/外/内外`; choose the one that fits. Its labels are shown in Chinese here; document any translated labels before using them. Do not mix in the separate `△/▲` production dialect, where a character’s `OS` may mean inner voice.

The source format spells its on-screen-text tag `[画面文字]`; a bilingual team can agree on a translated tag in its format note. Keep episode and scene IDs stable in this format. Include time or weather only when it matters to action, performance, or continuity. This is the project Markdown convention; teams using another production format should define its marks before drafting. For a shot-by-shot plan, use the separate [storyboard template](/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard); do not put shot size, camera movement, focal length, or video-generation parameters into the story source.

heading.zh: 把可见动作和角色对白分开写
heading.en: Separate Visible Action from Character Dialogue

body.zh:
动作段落写正在发生、可以表演或看见的事；动作焦点、信息或空间关系变化时另起一段。对白用“角色名（可选的表演/策略提示）：台词”，说话人始终明确；提示只写一个可执行选择，例如“压低声音阻止门外的人听见”，不堆“愤怒、悲伤、激动”等同义情绪词。

| 容易混淆 | 建议写法 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| `抽屉里的东西：一张回执。` | `抽屉半开，露出一张回执。` | 行首“短语＋冒号”容易被误认成角色台词 |
| `她很紧张地看着柜台。` | `她把回执压在手心，手指停在签名处。` | 用能表演的动作承担情绪 |
| `办事员：（叹气）你先等等。` | `办事员（把复印件收回文件夹）：你先等等。` | 提示给出与当下行动相关的策略 |

对白张力由说话人的目的、关系、潜台词和谈话造成的变化建立；台词长度与动作/对白比例按具体场景选择。场景目标和对手筹码属于剧作决策；格式模板只负责把已选定的故事事实写清楚。
body.en:
Write an action paragraph for something happening now that can be performed or seen. Start a new paragraph when the focus, information, or spatial relationship changes. Format dialogue as `Character (optional performance/strategy cue): Line`; keep the speaker explicit. A cue should name one executable choice, such as “lowering her voice so the person outside cannot hear,” rather than piling on synonyms for emotion.

| Easy to misread | Clearer version | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `Inside the drawer: a receipt.` | `The drawer is half open, revealing a receipt.` | A phrase followed by a colon at line start can look like dialogue |
| `She watches the desk nervously.` | `She presses the receipt into her palm, one finger resting on the signature.` | A performable action carries the emotion |
| `Clerk: (sighing) Wait a moment.` | `Clerk (putting the copy back in the folder): Wait a moment.` | The cue gives a strategy tied to the current action |

Build dialogue tension through each speaker's goal, relationship, subtext, and what the exchange changes; choose line length and action/dialogue balance for the scene. Scene goals and opposition are story decisions; a format template only makes those choices clear on the page.

heading.zh: 制作标签只标必需的信息
heading.en: Use Production Labels Only for Necessary Information

body.zh:
先把项目采用的标记写进一页格式说明，再在剧本里按需使用。当前 Markdown 格式对标签的约定如下：

| 标签 | 在本格式中的用途 | 不要用来 |
|---|---|---|
| `[OS]` | 同一场景中画外说话人的对白 | 代替明确说话人 |
| `[VO]` | 非现场主观或叙述声音 | 隐藏普通可见动作 |
| `[SFX]` | 会改变注意、行动或信息的声音 | 罗列全部环境声 |
| `[画面文字]` | 观众必须读清的载体和精确文字 | 重复一般道具描述 |
| `[连续性]` | 后续容易丢失且影响故事的状态 | 复制整套人物设定 |
| `[转场]` | 有叙事作用的转场要求 | 写成完整剪辑方案 |

制作方言各自定义标记，也可能给 `OS` 不同含义。在项目格式说明中，`△` 可标环境/空镜、`▲` 可标人物动作；这套方言里的角色 `OS` 也可表示内在声音。当前 Markdown 格式却把 `[OS]` 用作同一场景中的画外对白。两种定义都必须限定在各自格式里；不要混用，更不要向读者宣称它们是全行业统一标准。
body.en:
Write the project's notation in a one-page format note before using it in a script. In the current Markdown format, the labels have these roles:

| Label | Meaning in this format | Do not use it to |
|---|---|---|
| `[OS]` | Dialogue from a speaker off screen in the same scene | Replace an identifiable speaker |
| `[VO]` | Non-local subjective or narrative voice | Hide an ordinary visible action |
| `[SFX]` | A sound that changes attention, action, or information | List every ambient sound |
| `[画面文字] (on-screen text)` | The exact text and surface the audience must read | Repeat a generic prop description |
| `[连续性] (continuity)` | A story state that could be lost later | Copy the entire character bible |
| `[转场] (transition)` | A transition with a story purpose | Become a full editing plan |

The pinned source uses the Chinese labels `[画面文字]`, `[连续性]`, and `[转场]`; agree on translated labels before using them in an English-language script. Production dialects define their own marks and may assign a different meaning to `OS`. In one project dialect, `△` can mark environment/empty frames and `▲` character action; that dialect may use a character's `OS` for inner voice. The current Markdown format instead uses `[OS]` for off-screen dialogue in the same scene. Keep each definition inside its own format. Do not mix them or claim a single industry-wide standard.

heading.zh: 原创示例：服务台复核登记时间
heading.en: Original Example: Rechecking a Service-Desk Time

body.zh:
以下是格式演示用的原创虚构片段，不是已拍摄或验证的成片：

> # EP001 【回执复核】
> ## EP001-SC001 内 · 社区服务台 · 傍晚
> 林遥把手写回执推回窗口，指着右上角手写的 18:10。
> 林遥：可我五点前就交了。
> [OS] 走廊里的同事：打印回执出来了。
> 办事员从打印机取出刚打好的回执，转向林遥。
