title.en: How to Write a Spoiler-Free Movie Recap Video
title.zh: 无剧透电影解说视频怎么写

seo_title.en: Write a Spoiler-Free Movie Recap

description.en: Set the premise, genre, and viewing appeal while stopping before reveals that change the experience.
description.zh: 介绍前提、类型和观影看点，并在改变观影体验的揭示前停下。

answer.en: A spoiler-free recap explains a film’s setup, central tension, and viewing appeal without revealing the twists or outcomes that provide its main payoff. Decide what counts as a spoiler for this film, then review narration and visuals for accidental reveals.
answer.zh: 无剧透解说介绍电影前提、核心张力和观影看点，不透露构成主要回报的反转或结局。先判断这部电影哪些内容算剧透，再检查旁白和画面是否意外揭示答案。

heading.en: Set a clear spoiler boundary
heading.zh: 先划清剧透边界

body.en: Decide whether the recap can include the premise, early inciting event, or a named character. Do not assume every viewer defines spoilers the same way; state the boundary in the video and follow it consistently.
body.zh: 先决定能否提及故事前提、早期触发事件或角色姓名。不要假设所有观众对剧透的定义一致；在视频中说明边界，并始终遵守。

heading.en: Describe the hook without revealing its answer
heading.zh: 介绍钩子，但不揭晓答案

body.en: Explain the protagonist’s situation, what makes it unusual, and what question draws viewers in. Use the setup or a non-revealing example instead of narrating the scene that resolves the mystery or relationship.
body.zh: 说明主角处境、它的特别之处，以及吸引观众的问题。用前提或不会泄底的例子说明，不要复述解开谜团或确定关系的场景。

heading.en: Check visuals and framing too
heading.zh: 画面和包装也要检查

body.en: A thumbnail, clip, title, or reaction shot can reveal more than narration. Remove images that show late-film characters, outcomes, or visual clues the script avoids, and check the final cut as a first-time viewer.
body.zh: 缩略图、片段、标题或反应镜头可能比旁白泄露更多。删掉出现后段人物、结果或关键线索的画面，并以初次观看者的视角检查成片。

q.en: Can I show clips from a film in a spoiler-free recap?
q.zh: 无剧透解说可以放电影片段吗？

a.en: Choose clips that establish tone or premise without exposing a reveal. Follow the platform’s and rights holder’s requirements; a spoiler-free edit does not itself grant permission to use footage.
a.zh: 选择能建立基调或前提、又不会暴露揭示的片段。遵守平台和权利人的要求；无剧透剪辑本身并不代表获得素材使用许可。

title.en: How to Write a Video Call to Action That Fits the Story
title.zh: 视频 CTA 怎么写：让行动邀请贴合内容

seo_title.en: Write a Video Call to Action

description.en: Ask for one useful next step at the moment viewers understand why it matters.
description.zh: 在观众明白价值时，邀请他们采取一个有用的下一步。

answer.en: A useful video call to action asks viewers for one relevant next step and gives a clear reason to take it. Place it after the content has earned the request, make the action easy to understand, and avoid interrupting an unresolved story beat.
answer.zh: 有效的视频行动号召只邀请观众采取一个相关的下一步，并说明理由。等内容建立价值后再提出，动作要清楚易懂，也不要打断尚未结束的故事节拍。

heading.en: Choose the action that matches the video
heading.zh: 选择与视频内容匹配的行动

body.en: Ask for a comment when a specific question invites useful responses, a subscription when the series offers ongoing value, or a resource visit when it helps complete the task. Do not stack unrelated requests into one line.
body.zh: 具体问题能引出有用回应时邀请评论；系列能持续提供价值时邀请订阅；资源有助于完成任务时引导访问。不要在一句话里堆叠无关请求。

heading.en: Connect the request to a clear benefit
heading.zh: 把邀请和明确收益连起来

body.en: Tell viewers what they will get or help improve by acting. Keep the benefit honest and specific; avoid promising access, results, or future content that is not confirmed.
body.zh: 说明观众采取行动后能获得什么，或能帮助改善什么。收益要真实具体；不要承诺尚未确定的权限、结果或后续内容。

heading.en: Place it after value and keep it brief
heading.zh: 先交付价值，再简短邀请

body.en: Put the request near the answer, recap, or natural pause. Keep it to one sentence and return promptly to the story or ending. Review whether the video still feels complete if viewers skip the request.
body.zh: 把邀请放在答案、总结或自然停顿附近。用一句话说完，并及时回到故事或结尾。检查观众跳过 CTA 后，视频是否仍然完整。

q.en: How many calls to action should a video have?
q.zh: 一条视频应该放几个 CTA？

a.en: Use the fewest needed for the video’s goal. One clear action is easier to remember and measure than several competing requests.
a.zh: 按视频目标使用必要的最少数量。一个清晰行动比多个互相竞争的请求更容易记住和衡量。

title.en: How to Edit a Video Essay Script for a Clear Argument
title.zh: 视频论文脚本怎么修改：让论点清楚推进

seo_title.en: Edit a Video Essay Script

description.en: Check the claim, evidence, counterpoint, and conclusion before polishing narration or pacing.
description.zh: 先检查主张、证据、反方观点和结论，再润色旁白与节奏。

answer.en: Revise a video essay by checking that its central claim is specific, every section advances or tests it, and the ending follows from the evidence. Then edit for listening, visual support, and runtime without flattening the argument into a list of facts.
answer.zh: 修改视频论文时，先确认核心主张具体、各部分都在推进或检验它，且结论能从证据推出。再调整听觉表达、画面支持和时长，别把论证削成事实清单。

heading.en: State the claim and question plainly
heading.zh: 清楚写出主张和问题

body.en: Write the essay’s question and answer in one sentence each. If the answer is only a topic, such as a film’s history, narrow it to an interpretation a viewer could examine.
body.zh: 分别用一句话写出视频要回答的问题和结论。如果答案只是题目，比如介绍电影历史，就缩小成观众能够检验的一种解读。

heading.en: Give each section a reasoning job
heading.zh: 让每一部分承担推理任务

body.en: Label sections as evidence, context, counterexample, or implication. Remove a section that repeats a point without adding proof or changing the viewer’s understanding. Use transitions to show how one part follows from another.
body.zh: 把各部分标为证据、背景、反例或推论。若某部分只重复观点，没有增加证明或改变理解，就删掉。用过渡说明前后部分如何相连。

heading.en: Test evidence and the ending
heading.zh: 核对证据和结尾

body.en: Check quotations, dates, and context against sources. Make space for a real counterpoint when it changes the conclusion. End by answering the opening question with what the argument established, not a broader claim than the evidence supports.
body.zh: 对照来源核查引语、日期和语境。若真实反例会改变结论，就留出讨论空间。结尾用论证确立的内容回答开篇问题，不要超出证据范围。

q.en: Should a video essay script include counterarguments?
q.zh: 视频论文脚本要写反方观点吗？

a.en: Include a counterpoint when it tests an assumption or changes how strong the conclusion can be. Address it with evidence rather than mentioning it only for balance.
a.zh: 当反方观点能检验假设或改变结论力度时，就应纳入。用证据回应，而不是为了表面平衡提一下就算。

title.en: How to Write a Cold Open for a TV Pilot
title.zh: 电视剧试播集冷开场怎么写

seo_title.en: Write a TV Pilot Cold Open

description.en: Open on a specific dramatic question that shows the series engine before the title sequence.
description.zh: 用具体戏剧问题开场，在片头前展示剧集持续运转的核心机制。

answer.en: A TV-pilot cold open gives viewers a compact scene that creates a question and demonstrates the kind of story the series can sustain. Connect its character, conflict, or image to the pilot’s main movement instead of adding a detached teaser.
answer.zh: 电视剧试播集的冷开场用短场景提出问题，并展示剧集能持续讲述哪类故事。让人物、冲突或画面连上试播集主线，不要放一个脱离剧情的预告片段。

heading.en: Choose a question that belongs to the series
heading.zh: 选一个属于本剧的问题

body.en: Start with a mystery, choice, disruption, or contradiction that reflects the premise. The audience should wonder what happens next and understand why this kind of problem can return across episodes.
body.zh: 从谜团、选择、变故或矛盾切入，并体现剧集前提。观众应好奇接下来会怎样，也能看出这类问题为何可以延续到后续集数。

heading.en: Make the scene work before the title
heading.zh: 确保片头前的场景本身成立

body.en: Give the opening a clear point of view, immediate tension, and a change by the end. A striking image without a character goal or consequence may look polished but feel like an advertisement.
body.zh: 为开场明确视角、眼前张力和场景结束时的变化。若只有醒目画面，却没有人物目标或后果，可能像广告而非故事。

heading.en: Hand off to the pilot’s main story
heading.zh: 把观众带入试播集主线

body.en: Let the next scene answer, complicate, or reframe the cold-open question. Check that the teaser does not promise a genre, character, or tone that the rest of the pilot abandons.
body.zh: 让下一场戏回应、加深或重新解释冷开场的问题。检查预告段是否承诺了后续试播集并未延续的类型、人物或基调。

q.en: How long should a TV pilot cold open be?
q.zh: 试播集冷开场应该多长？

a.en: Only long enough to establish the question, tension, and handoff. Cut once viewers have a reason to continue and the main pilot can take over.
a.zh: 以建立问题、张力并完成交接所需为限。观众已有继续观看的理由、试播集主线能够接手时就可以切入片头。

title.en: How to Write a Short-Film Scene on a Low Budget
title.zh: 低预算短片场景怎么写：用限制创造戏剧张力

seo_title.en: Write a Low-Budget Film Scene

description.en: Use limited locations, props, and cast to sharpen the choice and conflict rather than shrink the story.
description.zh: 用有限地点、道具和演员突出选择与冲突，而不是把故事写小。

answer.en: A low-budget scene works when practical limits focus the drama. Choose a location that creates pressure, give characters a conflict that can play through action and dialogue, and use a few meaningful props instead of expensive spectacle.
answer.zh: 低预算场景要让制作限制聚焦戏剧。选择能制造压力的地点，让人物冲突通过行动和对白展开，并用少量关键道具代替昂贵奇观。

heading.en: Start from what the scene must change
heading.zh: 从场景必须改变的事情出发

body.en: Write down the decision, discovery, or relationship shift the scene must deliver. Choose the simplest location and cast that make this change difficult; constraints work when they intensify the obstacle.
body.zh: 写下场景必须完成的决定、发现或关系变化。选能让变化变得困难的最简地点和人物配置；限制只有在强化阻碍时才有用。

heading.en: Build conflict from behavior and objects
heading.zh: 从行为和物件构建冲突

body.en: Let characters want incompatible things in the same space. Use a letter, phone, key, or shared task to give their conflict something playable without adding costly locations or effects.
body.zh: 让人物在同一空间追求不相容的目标。用信件、手机、钥匙或共同任务，让冲突能够被演出来，而不必增加昂贵场地或特效。

heading.en: Plan production needs during drafting
heading.zh: 起草时就考虑拍摄需要

body.en: Track speaking roles, locations, night scenes, crowd needs, stunts, and special effects as the script grows. Replace expensive elements only when the alternative preserves the scene’s cause, choice, and payoff.
body.zh: 随剧本发展记录台词角色、地点、夜戏、群众、特技和特效需求。只有在替代方案保留因果、选择和回报时，才删换昂贵元素。

q.en: Should a low-budget screenplay avoid all special effects?
q.zh: 低预算剧本要避开所有特效吗？

a.en: No. Use an effect when it is central to the story and can be achieved within the real production plan. Build other beats around performance, sound, framing, and practical details.
a.zh: 不必。若特效是故事核心且制作计划能够实现，就可以保留。其他节拍则用表演、声音、构图和实景细节来完成。

title.en: How to Write a Reveal Scene for Short Drama
title.zh: 短剧揭示场景怎么写：让真相改变局面

seo_title.en: Write a Short-Drama Reveal Scene

description.en: Prepare the question, reveal understandable evidence, and show how the truth changes the next choice.
description.zh: 铺好疑问、呈现易懂证据，并展示真相如何改变下一步选择。

answer.en: A strong reveal scene answers a question viewers understand, with evidence they can read, then changes a character’s options or relationships. Prepare what the audience needs to recognize and let reactions carry the consequence into the next beat.
answer.zh: 有力的揭示场景回答观众已经理解的问题，给出看得懂的证据，再改变人物的选择或关系。先铺好辨认线索，让反应把后果带入下一节拍。

heading.en: Make the question and proof legible
heading.zh: 让问题和证据都看得懂

body.en: Before the reveal, establish what viewers are trying to confirm. Use a readable document, object, message, or action; avoid a crucial clue hidden in a shot no one can inspect.
body.zh: 揭示之前先让观众知道要确认什么。用清晰可读的文件、物件、消息或行动；不要把关键线索藏在没人看得清的镜头里。

heading.en: Time recognition and reaction
heading.zh: 安排发现真相和反应的节奏

body.en: Give viewers a moment to recognize the evidence, then show the person most affected. A delayed reaction can build tension, but do not obscure who saw what or what they now understand.
body.zh: 给观众一点时间认出证据，再展示受影响最大的人。反应稍有延迟可以增加张力，但别让人看不清谁看到了什么、如今明白了什么。

heading.en: Make the truth change the next move
heading.zh: 让真相改变下一步行动

body.en: End the beat with a new decision, lost option, public consequence, or counter-move. If everyone reacts but the plan and relationship remain unchanged, the reveal needs a stronger story consequence.
body.zh: 让这一节拍以新决定、选项消失、公开后果或反制行动结束。如果所有人都在反应，计划和关系却没改变，揭示就需要更强的故事后果。

q.en: Should a reveal scene explain every clue?
q.zh: 揭示场景要解释每条线索吗？

a.en: Explain only what viewers need to understand the answer and its consequence. Let earlier clues connect in retrospect; a full recap can drain the emotional force from the moment.
a.zh: 只解释理解答案及其后果所必需的内容。让观众回想时自行串起早前线索；全面复盘可能削弱当下的情绪力量。

title.en: How to Write a Scene Where Characters Want Different Things
title.zh: 人物目标冲突的场景怎么写

seo_title.en: Write a Scene with Conflicting Goals

description.en: Give each character a clear immediate goal, then let tactics and consequences change the balance in the scene.
description.zh: 明确每个人的眼前目标，再让策略与后果改变场景中的力量关系。

answer.en: A scene with conflicting goals gives each participant something specific to get, a reason they cannot both get it easily, and tactics that change as pressure rises. The scene ends with a decision, cost, or altered relationship—not just louder disagreement.
answer.zh: 目标冲突场景让每个人都有明确诉求，双方难以同时如愿，并会随压力变化策略。场景应以决定、代价或关系改变收尾，而不是只让争执越来越大声。

heading.en: Make each want concrete
heading.zh: 让每个人的诉求具体

body.en: Replace broad needs like respect with a scene-sized request: keep a secret, sign a form, leave now, or hand over an object. Distinct goals give actors and readers something observable to track.
body.zh: 把“需要尊重”等宽泛需求换成场景内可完成的请求：保守秘密、签字、立刻离开或交出物件。目标不同且可观察，演员和读者才有具体线索。

heading.en: Give both sides usable tactics
heading.zh: 给双方都安排可用策略

body.en: One character may appeal, bargain, distract, threaten, or withhold information; the other can resist or change terms. Let tactics respond to what just happened rather than repeat the same demand.
body.zh: 人物可以请求、讨价还价、转移话题、威胁或隐瞒信息；另一方可以抵抗或改变条件。策略要回应刚发生的事，不要重复同一个要求。

heading.en: End with a changed state
heading.zh: 用状态变化结束场景

body.en: Someone gains leverage, accepts a cost, reveals a fact, or changes the relationship. If the scene could be removed without changing the next choice, strengthen its consequence or connect it to the story goal.
body.zh: 让一方获得筹码、接受代价、透露事实或改变关系。如果删掉场景也不影响下一步选择，就加强后果，或把它连到故事目标。

q.en: Do characters need to argue for a scene to have conflict?
q.zh: 有冲突的场景必须让人物争吵吗？

a.en: No. Conflicting goals can appear through politeness, silence, delay, or competing actions. The conflict is the incompatible outcome each person is trying to produce.
a.zh: 不必。目标冲突可以通过客气话、沉默、拖延或相互竞争的行动表现。关键是每个人都在追求不相容的结果。

title.en: How to Use Dramatic Irony to Build Suspense
title.zh: 戏剧反讽怎么写：用信息差建立悬念

seo_title.en: Use Dramatic Irony to Build Suspense

description.en: Give readers and characters different information, then make that gap shape a choice, danger, or emotional payoff.
description.zh: 让读者和人物掌握不同信息，并让信息差影响选择、危险或情感回报。

answer.en: Dramatic irony occurs when viewers know something a character does not, or understand a risk the character misreads. Build it with clear information, a believable reason the character lacks it, and consequences that make the gap matter.
answer.zh: 戏剧反讽是读者知道人物不知道的事，或看懂人物误判的风险。用清晰信息、人物暂时不知情的合理原因，以及能让信息差产生影响的后果来建立它。

heading.en: Decide who knows what
heading.zh: 明确谁知道什么

body.en: Write down what the audience knows, what the viewpoint character believes, and what another character is hiding. Make the difference explicit enough that viewers can follow without confusing it with a continuity error.
body.zh: 记下观众知道什么、视角人物相信什么、另一个人物隐瞒什么。让差异清楚到观众能跟上，不会误以为是前后矛盾。

heading.en: Give the information gap a believable cause
heading.zh: 让信息差的成因可信

body.en: The character may lack access, trust the wrong source, or interpret evidence through a plausible belief. Avoid keeping them ignorant only because the plot needs them not to ask an obvious question.
body.zh: 人物可能无法接触信息、信错消息来源，或基于合理信念误读证据。不要只因为剧情需要，就让人物不问一个显而易见的问题。

heading.en: Let anticipation change the scene
heading.zh: 让期待改变场景

body.en: Use the gap to make an ordinary action tense, create dread, or sharpen an emotional choice. Reveal or close the gap when it changes what the character can do; do not prolong it after the suspense has stopped evolving.
body.zh: 用信息差让普通行动变紧张、制造不安，或强化情感选择。当它改变人物能做什么时，就揭晓或缩小差距；悬念不再变化时不要硬拖。

q.en: Is dramatic irony the same as a plot twist?
q.zh: 戏剧反讽和情节反转是一回事吗？

a.en: No. Dramatic irony creates tension from unequal knowledge; a twist changes how viewers understand events. A story can use either one or combine them if both are prepared fairly.
a.zh: 不是。戏剧反讽利用信息不对等制造张力；情节反转改变观众对事件的理解。故事可以分别使用，也可以在铺垫充分时结合。

title.en: How to Write a Xianxia Novel with a Clear Cultivation Arc
title.zh: 仙侠小说怎么写：让修炼线推动主线

seo_title.en: How to Write a Xianxia Novel

description.en: Connect cultivation breakthroughs to character choices, sect conflicts, and the cost of pursuing immortality.
description.zh: 把修炼突破连到人物选择、门派冲突和求道代价。

answer.en: A xianxia story needs more than escalating realms. Give cultivation a method, cost, and effect on the protagonist’s relationships or choices. Let each breakthrough change the conflict and create a new limit, responsibility, or danger.
answer.zh: 仙侠故事不能只有境界升级。为修炼设定方法、代价，以及它对主角关系或选择的影响。让每次突破都改变冲突，并带来新的限制、责任或危险。

heading.en: Make cultivation shape the protagonist’s choices
heading.zh: 让修炼影响主角选择

body.en: Decide what the protagonist seeks from cultivation and what they must risk or give up. A technique, resource, or breakthrough should affect a relationship, duty, or moral line rather than exist only as a stronger number.
body.zh: 明确主角修炼所求，以及必须冒险或放弃什么。功法、资源或突破应影响关系、责任或道德底线，而不只是一个更高数字。

heading.en: Give sects and rivals competing interests
heading.zh: 让门派和对手各有利益

body.en: Build factions around access to knowledge, resources, territory, or legitimacy. Let rival methods reflect different values and practical incentives; this gives a duel or alliance consequences beyond winning a fight.
body.zh: 围绕知识、资源、地盘或正统性建立门派利益。让不同修炼道路体现价值观与现实诉求，使比斗或结盟的后果超出输赢。

heading.en: Make each breakthrough change the story
heading.zh: 让每次突破改变故事状态

body.en: Before adding a new realm, ask what the protagonist can now do, what remains impossible, and who responds to the change. Vary progress with discovery, setbacks, alliances, and costs so advancement does not become a repeated training loop.
body.zh: 增加新境界前，先问主角现在能做什么、什么仍做不到、谁会回应这次变化。让发现、挫折、结盟和代价交替出现，避免升级变成重复修炼。

q.en: Does every xianxia novel need a cultivation-level chart?
q.zh: 仙侠小说都需要境界表吗？

a.en: No. A chart helps when readers must compare many ranks. If the story has few stages, explain each through its limits and consequences when they matter in a scene.
a.zh: 不一定。境界较多、读者需要对照时，境界表才有帮助。阶段不多就可以在影响场景时，通过限制和后果说明。

title.en: How to Write a Wuxia Story Where Martial Skill Has Meaning
title.zh: 武侠故事怎么写：让武艺体现人物立场

seo_title.en: How to Write a Wuxia Story

description.en: Tie martial skill to a code, debt, rivalry, and consequence in the wider jianghu.
description.zh: 让武艺与江湖规矩、人情债、对手和更大后果相连。

answer.en: A wuxia story uses martial skill within a social world of loyalties, debts, reputation, and conflicting codes. Make a fight express what a character will protect or refuse, then show how its outcome changes obligations in the jianghu.
answer.zh: 武侠故事把武艺放在忠义、人情债、名声和相冲规矩组成的江湖里。让打斗表现人物要守护或拒绝什么，再展示结果如何改变江湖中的责任关系。

heading.en: Give the jianghu rules people can act on
heading.zh: 建立人物能据以行动的江湖规矩

body.en: Decide how reputation, hospitality, sect ties, debts, and public challenges work. Show a character honoring or breaking a rule and let others respond, so the setting feels social rather than a list of martial factions.
body.zh: 确定名声、待客、门派关系、人情债和公开挑战如何运作。展示人物遵守或破坏规矩，并让旁人回应，使江湖成为社会关系，而不只是一串门派。

heading.en: Make martial skill reveal a point of view
heading.zh: 让武艺体现人物立场

body.en: Give each fighter a method tied to training, temperament, or a limitation. A defensive style, a refusal to draw first, or a move that risks injury can reveal values during action without pausing for explanation.
body.zh: 让每位角色的打法关联训练、性格或限制。防守路数、拒绝先拔兵器，或会伤及自身的招式，都能在行动中展现立场，无需暂停解释。

heading.en: Let a victory create a new obligation
heading.zh: 让胜负带来新的责任

body.en: After a duel, track who was shamed, protected, indebted, or exposed. The result can force an alliance, invite a challenge, or damage trust; that consequence should drive the next decision.
body.zh: 比试后追踪谁受辱、获救、欠债或身份暴露。结果可以迫成结盟、引来挑战或损害信任，并推动下一次决定。

q.en: Does a wuxia story need realistic martial arts?
q.zh: 武侠故事必须写真实武术吗？

a.en: It needs consistent action readers can picture. Ground techniques in clear range, timing, and consequence, even when the world allows heightened abilities.
a.zh: 关键是动作前后一致、读者能想象。即使世界允许夸张能力，也要让招式的距离、时机和后果清楚。

title.en: How to Write Progression Fantasy Without Repeating Power-Ups
title.zh: 升级流奇幻怎么写：避免重复堆叠战力

seo_title.en: Write Progression Fantasy

description.en: Make each advancement unlock a new decision, test, or responsibility instead of repeating the same victory.
description.zh: 让每次提升带来新选择、考验或责任，避免重复同一种胜利。

answer.en: Progression fantasy centers on a character’s growing abilities, but each advance should change what they can attempt and what it costs. Vary tests across skill, judgment, relationships, and responsibility so improvement keeps creating story rather than erasing conflict.
answer.zh: 升级流奇幻关注人物能力成长，但每次提升都应改变其可尝试之事和承担的代价。让考验涵盖技巧、判断、关系与责任，使成长不断生成故事，而非抹掉冲突。

heading.en: Define what advancement changes
heading.zh: 明确成长会改变什么

body.en: Set the new capability, its limit, and how the protagonist earns it. If a level only increases strength, show why that matters to a goal or obstacle the reader already understands.
body.zh: 设定新能力、限制和主角如何获得它。如果升级只是增加力量，就说明它为何影响读者已理解的目标或阻碍。

heading.en: Vary the tests of growth
heading.zh: 变化成长考验的类型

body.en: Use different tests: applying a technique under pressure, recognizing a bad trade, coordinating with allies, or deciding when not to use power. This makes progress visible beyond comparison charts.
body.zh: 安排不同考验：在压力下运用技巧、识别不公平交易、与盟友配合，或判断何时不该使用力量。成长就不只体现在等级对照表里。

heading.en: Keep consequences after a breakthrough
heading.zh: 突破之后保留后果

body.en: A new ability can attract attention, consume a scarce resource, change a relationship, or create a duty. Carry one consequence into the next arc so advancement opens new conflict instead of resetting the story.
body.zh: 新能力可能引来关注、耗尽稀缺资源、改变关系或带来职责。让至少一个后果进入下一篇章，使提升开启新冲突，而非重置故事。

q.en: How often should a progression fantasy character level up?
q.zh: 升级流主角应该多久提升一次？

a.en: Set the pace around meaningful tests and payoffs, not a fixed chapter count. Readers need time to understand a new capability and see its limits before another advance arrives.
a.zh: 按有意义的考验和回报安排节奏，不必固定每几章升级一次。读者需要时间理解新能力并看到限制，再迎来下一次提升。

title.en: How to Write Portal Fantasy That Makes Both Worlds Matter
title.zh: 穿越奇幻怎么写：让两个世界都影响主线

seo_title.en: How to Write Portal Fantasy

description.en: Connect the crossing, the protagonist’s goal, and the consequences that travel between worlds.
description.zh: 把穿越、主角目标和往返两个世界的后果连成一条主线。

answer.en: Portal fantasy works when crossing into another world changes the protagonist’s goal, tools, or relationships. Give both worlds a dramatic purpose, establish what crossing costs or permits, and let choices in one place affect the other.
answer.zh: 穿越奇幻要让进入异世界改变主角目标、工具或关系。让两个世界都承担戏剧作用，说明穿越的代价或条件，并让一边的选择影响另一边。

heading.en: Give the crossing a story reason
heading.zh: 让穿越由故事需要推动

body.en: Choose what pulls or pushes the protagonist across: escape, duty, accident, or a deliberate search. Tie the crossing to a personal problem so it does more than deliver a tour of a new setting.
body.zh: 确定什么把主角带往另一边：逃离、责任、意外或主动寻找。让穿越连着人物的具体困境，不只为了参观新世界。

heading.en: Differentiate the worlds through choices
heading.zh: 用选择区分两个世界

body.en: Give each place rules, resources, and relationships that make different actions possible. Introduce rules when a character uses them; avoid front-loading a guide that does not affect the next decision.
body.zh: 让两个地方拥有不同规则、资源和关系，使人物能采取不同行动。人物用到规则时再介绍，别先塞一段与眼前决定无关的设定说明。

heading.en: Make the crossing leave consequences
heading.zh: 让穿越留下实际后果

body.en: Track what the protagonist can carry, whom they leave behind, and what changes while they are gone. Let the final choice reconcile or deepen the conflict between the worlds rather than make one world disposable.
body.zh: 追踪主角能带走什么、把谁留在身后，以及离开期间发生什么。让最终选择解决或深化两个世界的冲突，而不是把其中一个写成可有可无。

q.en: Does portal fantasy need a way back home?
q.zh: 穿越奇幻一定要能回家吗？

a.en: Only if return is part of the story question. Establish the possibility and cost early enough for it to shape choices; otherwise focus on the goal that matters in the world the character entered.
a.zh: 只有当回归属于故事问题时才需要。尽早交代回去的可能与代价，让它影响选择；否则聚焦人物进入新世界后真正追求的目标。

title.en: How to Write a Marriage-of-Convenience Romance That Feels Real
title.zh: 契约婚姻爱情故事怎么写：让关系变化可信

seo_title.en: Write a Marriage-of-Convenience Romance

description.en: Give both partners a credible reason, negotiated boundaries, and a relationship that changes through choices.
description.zh: 给双方可信动机、协商过的边界，并让关系随选择逐步改变。

answer.en: A marriage-of-convenience romance needs a practical reason both characters accept, terms that create pressure, and a growing bond built through choices rather than the contract alone. The arrangement should solve one problem while exposing another emotional need.
answer.zh: 契约婚姻爱情故事需要双方都接受的现实理由、会制造压力的约定，以及通过选择而非契约本身建立的感情。安排要解决一个问题，同时暴露另一种情感需求。

heading.en: Make the arrangement work for both partners
heading.zh: 让约定对双方都有实际作用

body.en: Give each person a concrete benefit and a cost for refusing. A shared deadline, public expectation, or resource can make the arrangement plausible; explain why a simpler option will not work.
body.zh: 给每个人明确收益，也说明拒绝的代价。共同期限、公众期待或资源需求都能让安排合理；还要说明更简单的办法为何行不通。

heading.en: Negotiate boundaries that create scenes
heading.zh: 协商能生成场景的边界

body.en: Terms about privacy, public behavior, money, or time together should affect what characters do. Let them renegotiate after new evidence or a breach, rather than relying on a misunderstanding that could be solved by one question.
body.zh: 关于隐私、公开表现、金钱或相处时间的条款要影响人物行动。出现新证据或越界后让双方重新协商，别依靠一句话就能解决的误会。

heading.en: Make intimacy a series of earned choices
heading.zh: 让亲密感来自逐步作出的选择

body.en: Show each partner noticing a need, taking a risk, or changing a habit. A turning point should alter what they trust each other with, and the ending should resolve both the practical arrangement and the emotional question.
body.zh: 展示双方留意需求、承担风险或改变习惯。关系转折要改变彼此愿意托付的内容，结尾则需同时回应现实安排和情感问题。

q.en: How do I keep a fake marriage romance from feeling forced?
q.zh: 怎么避免契约婚姻爱情故事显得生硬？

a.en: Make the arrangement solve a problem that matters to both people, show what each risks, and let attraction grow through behavior that changes the original terms.
a.zh: 让安排解决双方都在意的问题，说明各自承担什么风险，并通过改变原有约定的行为逐渐发展吸引力。

title.en: How to Write a Forced-Proximity Romance That Builds Trust
title.zh: 被迫相处爱情故事怎么写：让信任慢慢建立

seo_title.en: Write a Forced-Proximity Romance

description.en: Create a believable reason to stay close, then use repeated contact to change how both characters see each other.
description.zh: 设置可信的近距离相处理由，再让反复接触改变双方看法。

answer.en: Forced proximity creates chances for interaction, not automatic intimacy. Give both characters a credible reason to share space, preserve boundaries and outside goals, and make each encounter reveal something that changes a later choice.
answer.zh: 被迫近距离相处提供互动机会，却不会自动产生亲密感。给双方可信的共处理由，保留边界和外部目标，并让每次相遇揭示会改变后续选择的信息。

heading.en: Make the shared situation credible
heading.zh: 让共处情境站得住脚

body.en: Choose a work assignment, journey, deadline, weather problem, or shared responsibility that neither can leave without a real cost. Set the limits of the situation so it does not feel like the author is trapping them without cause.
body.zh: 选择工作任务、旅程、期限、天气困境或共同责任，让任何一方离开都要付出实际代价。说明情境限制，避免像作者无故把人物关在一起。

heading.en: Let contact reveal behavior under pressure
heading.zh: 用压力下的行为揭示人物

body.en: Vary encounters across practical cooperation, disagreement, vulnerability, and repair. Let a small act change trust; repeated proximity without new information or consequences becomes a stagnant loop.
body.zh: 让相处经历实际合作、意见冲突、脆弱时刻和修复关系。一个小行动也能改变信任；若反复共处却没有新信息或后果，情节就会原地打转。

heading.en: Protect boundaries and separate goals
heading.zh: 守住边界并保留各自目标

body.en: Attraction should not erase consent, privacy, or a character’s independent plans. Build closeness through choices both can refuse, then let the climax test whether they will choose one another beyond the forced situation.
body.zh: 吸引力不能抹去同意、隐私或人物独立计划。让亲近来自双方都能拒绝的选择，再用高潮检验离开共处情境后是否仍愿意选择彼此。

q.en: How long should the characters be stuck together?
q.zh: 人物要被迫共处多久？

a.en: Long enough for repeated contact to change trust or understanding, but not so long that the premise repeats without new pressure. Let the duration follow the story’s turning points.
a.zh: 要足以让反复接触改变信任或理解，但别长到情境只在重复、没有新压力。让时长跟随故事转折安排。

title.en: How to Write a Secret-Identity Romance with Fair Clues
title.zh: 身份隐瞒爱情故事怎么写：线索公平，揭晓有后果

seo_title.en: Write a Secret-Identity Romance

description.en: Give the secret a reason, plant clues readers can recognize, and make disclosure change trust or choice.
description.zh: 为秘密设置理由，埋下可辨认的线索，并让揭晓改变信任或选择。

answer.en: A secret-identity romance needs a reason the character hides, clues that are fair in retrospect, and a relationship consequence when the truth emerges. Let the hidden identity complicate genuine intimacy rather than replace the romance’s emotional development.
answer.zh: 身份隐瞒爱情故事需要人物隐藏身份的理由、回看时公平的线索，以及真相揭晓后的关系后果。让秘密增加真实亲密关系的复杂度，而非取代感情发展。

heading.en: Give the secret a character-based reason
heading.zh: 让秘密源于人物处境

body.en: Connect concealment to safety, duty, shame, or a goal with a real deadline. Clarify why the character cannot reveal the truth yet and what they risk by continuing to hide it.
body.zh: 把隐瞒连到安全、责任、羞耻或有期限的目标。说清人物为何暂时不能坦白，以及继续隐瞒会承担什么风险。

heading.en: Plant clues without giving away the answer
heading.zh: 公平埋线，但别直接泄底

body.en: Use consistent habits, knowledge, access, or slips that make sense for both identities. Readers should be able to reinterpret these moments later; avoid clues so faint that the reveal depends on new information.
body.zh: 用两种身份都说得通的习惯、知识、权限或失言作为线索。读者之后应能重新理解这些细节；别把线索藏到必须新增信息才能解释。

heading.en: Make disclosure change the relationship
heading.zh: 让坦白改变关系

body.en: Show what the other person feels deceived about and what care or trust was still genuine. Give both characters a decision after the reveal; reconciliation should address the harm, not erase it with one confession.
body.zh: 展示对方觉得受骗的部分，以及哪些关心或信任仍是真实的。揭晓后让双方都作出决定；和解要回应伤害，不能靠一句坦白把它抹掉。

q.en: Should readers know the secret before the love interest?
q.zh: 读者应该比恋爱对象更早知道秘密吗？

a.en: Either approach can work. Letting readers know creates anticipation; hiding it creates a reveal. Choose based on whether you want suspense about discovery or emotional tension from watching the secret shape intimacy.
a.zh: 两种方式都可行。让读者先知道能制造期待；对读者也隐瞒则能形成揭晓。根据你要写发现秘密的悬念，还是秘密如何影响亲密关系来决定。

title.en: How to Write a Revenge Story with an Earned Ending
title.zh: 复仇故事怎么写：让结局回应代价和选择

seo_title.en: How to Write a Revenge Story

description.en: Build revenge around a specific harm, escalating choices, and a final cost that answers what justice means.
description.zh: 围绕具体伤害、逐步升级的选择和最终代价展开复仇，并回应何为公道。

answer.en: A revenge story gives the protagonist a specific harm to answer, obstacles that test their methods, and consequences that change what victory means. The ending should resolve both the target and the protagonist’s choice about what revenge has cost.
answer.zh: 复仇故事要有主角要回应的具体伤害、检验其手段的阻碍，以及会改变胜利含义的后果。结尾既要处理目标，也要回应主角如何看待复仇代价。

heading.en: Make the harm and target specific
heading.zh: 明确伤害和复仇对象

body.en: Show what was taken, who caused it, and what evidence the protagonist has. A precise grievance gives the pursuit direction and helps readers judge whether the target and response remain proportionate.
body.zh: 展示失去了什么、谁造成伤害，以及主角掌握什么证据。明确的伤害能给追索方向，也让读者判断对象和回应是否相称。

heading.en: Escalate choices as the cost rises
heading.zh: 随着代价增加升级选择

body.en: Each step should require a new tactic, reveal a complication, or put an ally or value at risk. If the protagonist simply repeats punishment, vary the conflict by changing the target’s leverage or the protagonist’s options.
body.zh: 每一步都应要求新手段、揭露复杂情况，或让盟友与价值观面临风险。如果主角只是重复惩罚，就改变对手筹码或主角选项来推动冲突。

heading.en: Resolve what victory costs
heading.zh: 回应胜利的代价

body.en: At the climax, force a choice between immediate payback and a deeper goal such as safety, truth, or protecting someone. Let the ending show what the protagonist gained, lost, or chose to stop doing.
body.zh: 高潮处迫使主角在眼前报复和更深目标之间选择，例如安全、真相或保护他人。结尾要展示主角获得、失去什么，或决定不再做什么。

q.en: Does a revenge story need the protagonist to forgive?
q.zh: 复仇故事一定要让主角原谅吗？

a.en: No. Closure can come from justice, escape, truth, or choosing a different future. Make the resolution answer the harm and the protagonist’s values rather than prescribe forgiveness.
a.zh: 不必。公道、脱身、真相或选择新生活都能带来收束。让结局回应伤害和主角价值观，而不是规定必须原谅。

title.en: How to Write a Paranormal Romance with Clear World Rules
title.zh: 超自然爱情故事怎么写：规则清楚，关系可信

seo_title.en: Write a Paranormal Romance

description.en: Connect supernatural abilities and limits to attraction, consent, conflict, and the relationship’s stakes.
description.zh: 把超自然能力与限制连到吸引力、同意、冲突和关系利害。

answer.en: A paranormal romance combines a developing relationship with supernatural rules that affect what characters can know, risk, or choose. Establish limits, preserve consent, and make the romantic conflict depend on who these people are—not just on a magical obstacle.
answer.zh: 超自然爱情故事把关系发展与影响人物认知、风险和选择的世界规则结合。明确限制，尊重双方同意，并让感情冲突来自人物本身，而不只靠魔法障碍。

heading.en: Set limits on the supernatural element
heading.zh: 为超自然设定明确限制

body.en: Decide what a power or creature can do, what it costs, and what it cannot solve. Introduce rules when they affect a choice, and keep exceptions consistent so tension does not disappear whenever the plot needs an easy answer.
body.zh: 确定能力或生物能做什么、代价是什么、不能解决什么。规则影响选择时再介绍，并保持例外前后一致，避免剧情需要时压力就被轻松化解。

heading.en: Make attraction and consent legible
heading.zh: 让吸引和同意表达清楚

body.en: If magic affects emotion, memory, or desire, define what it does and let characters choose freely within those effects. Build intimacy through trust and behavior, not through a supernatural bond that removes agency.
body.zh: 如果魔法影响情绪、记忆或欲望，就明确它的作用，并让人物在影响之下仍能自由选择。亲密关系要通过信任和行动建立，而非靠剥夺能动性的超自然羁绊。

heading.en: Make the relationship affect the external conflict
heading.zh: 让关系影响外部冲突

body.en: Let the couple’s different needs alter a plan, alliance, or use of power. The resolution should answer both the supernatural threat and the relationship choice, with neither treated as a side issue.
body.zh: 让双方不同需求改变计划、联盟或力量使用方式。结尾既要回应超自然威胁，也要回应关系选择，不能把其中一条当成附带问题。

q.en: Can paranormal romance include a love triangle?
q.zh: 超自然爱情故事可以写三角关系吗？

a.en: Yes, if each relationship reveals a real difference in trust, values, or future goals. Use the supernatural setting to shape those choices rather than making a creature or prophecy choose for the protagonist.
a.zh: 可以，只要不同关系体现真实的信任、价值观或未来目标差异。让超自然设定影响选择，不要让生物或预言代替主角决定。

title.en: How to Write a Historical Romance with Convincing Period Detail
title.zh: 历史言情怎么写：让时代细节服务感情线

seo_title.en: Write a Historical Romance

description.en: Use research to shape the characters’ choices, social limits, and courtship rather than pausing for a history lecture.
description.zh: 用考据塑造人物选择、社会限制和恋爱过程，别让故事停下来讲历史课。

answer.en: Historical romance combines a relationship arc with period-specific choices and constraints. Research the details that affect movement, work, status, and courtship; then show them through scenes so historical context deepens the conflict and attraction.
answer.zh: 历史言情把关系弧线与时代特有的选择和限制结合。重点考据影响行动、工作、身份和恋爱的细节，再融入场景，让历史背景深化冲突与吸引力。

heading.en: Research the details that constrain choices
heading.zh: 先查会限制选择的时代细节

body.en: Focus on law, money, work, travel, privacy, and social expectations that affect the couple’s options. Verify how these rules varied by place and class instead of treating an entire era as uniform.
body.zh: 重点查法律、金钱、工作、出行、隐私和社会期待如何影响两人的选项。核实规则在地区和阶层间的差异，不要把整个时代写成一成不变。

heading.en: Show research through lived scenes
heading.zh: 通过人物经历呈现考据

body.en: Let clothing, rooms, letters, and etiquette affect a meeting, misunderstanding, or decision. Keep details tied to what the viewpoint character notices and needs; move extra facts to notes rather than explaining them all in dialogue.
body.zh: 让服饰、房间、信件和礼仪影响会面、误会或决定。细节要连着视角人物注意到和需要的东西；多余知识可留在设定笔记里，不必让人物全讲出来。

heading.en: Build romance within real constraints
heading.zh: 在真实限制中推进感情

body.en: Give each character agency within the available choices and show the cost of crossing a boundary. Let courtship change through specific acts of trust, negotiation, and risk rather than modern language placed into period costumes.
body.zh: 让人物在当时可行的选择中保有能动性，并展示跨越边界的代价。通过具体的信任、协商和冒险推动恋爱，而不是只给现代对白换上古装。

q.en: How much historical research should I include in the novel?
q.zh: 小说里应该放多少历史考据？

a.en: Include details that affect a character’s options, sensory experience, or the reader’s understanding of a turning point. Keep research that does not change the scene in your reference notes.
a.zh: 只写会影响人物选项、感官体验或读者理解转折的细节。不会改变场景的考据留在参考笔记里。

title.en: How to Write a Crime Novel with a Clear Case and Motive
title.zh: 犯罪小说怎么写：让案件、动机和证据连贯

seo_title.en: How to Write a Crime Novel

description.en: Build a crime, a credible motive, and a chain of evidence that changes the investigator’s next move.
description.zh: 设计可信案件、作案动机和会改变调查方向的证据链。

answer.en: A crime novel links a consequential offense to an investigation in which each discovery changes what the investigator believes or can do. Give the crime a motive, make evidence traceable, and ensure the solution follows from clues readers had a fair chance to see.
answer.zh: 犯罪小说要让重大案件与调查相连，每次发现都改变调查者的判断或行动。给案件可信动机，让证据来源清楚，并确保答案来自读者有机会看到的线索。

heading.en: Define the crime and its human cost
heading.zh: 明确案件和它造成的伤害

body.en: Decide who was harmed, what changed, and why solving the case matters beyond naming a culprit. A victim should have a life and relationships in the story, not exist only as a puzzle object.
body.zh: 明确谁受到伤害、什么因此改变，以及破案为何不只是找出凶手。受害者应在故事中有生活与关系，而不只是谜题道具。

heading.en: Build a traceable clue chain
heading.zh: 建立来源清楚的线索链

body.en: For each clue, note who finds it, how it can be interpreted, and what it rules in or out. Let false leads arise from incomplete evidence or a character’s assumption, not from facts that later change without explanation.
body.zh: 为每条线索记录谁发现、有哪些解释、能排除或支持什么。误导应来自证据不全或人物误判，而不是事实后来无故改变。

heading.en: Make the solution change the investigator
heading.zh: 让破案结果改变调查者

body.en: The final inference should explain the key evidence and leave room for the consequences of the crime. Resolve the case question while showing what justice, truth, or loyalty costs the people involved.
body.zh: 最终推理要解释关键证据，并呈现犯罪带来的后果。解决案件疑问的同时，展示公道、真相或忠诚让相关人物付出了什么。

q.en: Does a crime novel have to reveal the culprit at the end?
q.zh: 犯罪小说一定要在结尾揭晓凶手吗？

a.en: The central crime question needs a satisfying answer, though the final scene may focus on consequences. Make clear what is solved and what remains unresolved.
a.zh: 核心案件问题需要得到令人信服的回答，但最后一场可以聚焦后果。要让读者看清哪些问题已解决、哪些仍未解决。

title.en: How to Write a Domestic Thriller Built on Trust and Secrets
title.zh: 家庭惊悚小说怎么写：让秘密动摇亲密关系

seo_title.en: How to Write a Domestic Thriller

description.en: Use a close relationship, credible secrets, and escalating evidence to turn familiar life into suspense.
description.zh: 用亲密关系、可信秘密和逐步升级的证据，在日常生活中建立悬念。

answer.en: A domestic thriller turns trust inside a family, partnership, or household into a source of danger. Give the protagonist a reason to doubt someone close, evidence that can be interpreted in more than one way, and a personal risk for acting or waiting.
answer.zh: 家庭惊悚把家人、伴侣或同住者之间的信任变成危险来源。让主角有理由怀疑亲近的人，安排存在多种解释的证据，并让行动或等待都带有个人风险。

heading.en: Make the relationship worth protecting
heading.zh: 先让关系值得保护

body.en: Show what the protagonist shares with the person they may distrust: history, money, a home, a child, or a future plan. Specific attachment makes suspicion painful rather than merely convenient for the plot.
body.zh: 展示主角与可能不信任的人共享什么：过往、金钱、住所、孩子或未来计划。具体依赖让怀疑产生痛感，而不只是推动情节的便利工具。

heading.en: Escalate through evidence and choices
heading.zh: 通过证据和选择逐步升级

body.en: Let each discovery raise a different question or force a new action: check a story, protect a record, leave, or confront someone. Avoid repeating the same suspicious look without changing the protagonist’s options.
body.zh: 让每次发现带来不同疑问或迫使人物行动：核对说法、保护记录、离开或当面对质。不要只反复写可疑眼神，却不改变主角选项。

heading.en: Keep the reveal fair and consequential
heading.zh: 让揭晓公平且有后果

body.en: Plant details that gain meaning after the truth appears, and make the hidden motive fit the relationship already shown. The reveal should change who is safe, believed, or in control—not only supply a surprise.
body.zh: 提前埋下真相揭晓后会有新含义的细节，并让隐瞒动机符合已呈现的关系。揭晓应改变谁安全、可信或掌握主动，而不只是制造惊讶。

q.en: How do I keep a domestic thriller from relying on silly misunderstandings?
q.zh: 怎么避免家庭惊悚靠低级误会推进？

a.en: Give characters concrete reasons to withhold, misread, or delay information, and show the cost of doing so. Let new evidence—not a refusal to ask one obvious question—drive the suspense.
a.zh: 给人物隐瞒、误读或拖延信息的具体理由，并展示代价。让新证据推动悬念，而不是靠人物拒绝问一个显而易见的问题。

title.en: How to Write a Spy Thriller Readers Can Follow
title.zh: 间谍惊悚故事怎么写：让任务、身份和风险清楚

seo_title.en: How to Write a Spy Thriller

description.en: Make the mission, competing loyalties, and consequences clear before layering in tradecraft and reversals.
description.zh: 先交代任务、忠诚冲突和后果，再逐步加入行动细节与反转。

answer.en: A readable spy thriller gives the protagonist a mission, an uncertain information source, and a cost for trusting the wrong person. Explain the operational goal before adding jargon, then let each reversal change the mission or its human consequences.
answer.zh: 易读的间谍惊悚故事让主角面对一项任务、不确定的信息来源，以及信错人的代价。先解释行动目标再加入术语，并让每次反转改变任务或人物后果。

heading.en: State the mission and stakes plainly
heading.zh: 清楚说明任务和利害

body.en: Tell readers what must be obtained, protected, or prevented and why the deadline matters. Establish the protagonist’s personal stake as well as the larger political or security outcome.
body.zh: 说明必须获取、保护或阻止什么，以及期限为何重要。既交代更大的政治或安全后果，也写清主角的个人利害。

heading.en: Track information and loyalties
heading.zh: 追踪信息和忠诚关系

body.en: Keep a simple record of who knows each fact, how reliable it is, and who benefits from sharing or hiding it. Let uncertainty come from motive and evidence, not from making basic mission instructions impossible to understand.
body.zh: 简单记录每个人知道什么、信息有多可靠，以及谁会因分享或隐瞒获利。让不确定性来自动机和证据，而不是让基本任务说明难以理解。

heading.en: Make reversals alter the plan
heading.zh: 让反转改变行动计划

body.en: A betrayal, exposed identity, or changed objective should force a new tactic or sacrifice. Follow each reversal with a consequence that the protagonist must handle; do not reset the mission back to its original state.
body.zh: 背叛、身份暴露或目标变化应迫使主角换策略或作出牺牲。每次反转后都要有主角必须处理的后果，不要把任务重置回原点。

q.en: How much spy jargon should a thriller use?
q.zh: 间谍惊悚故事要用多少专业术语？

a.en: Use only terms that help readers understand a decision or risk. Explain unfamiliar language through the action or a concise context clue rather than pausing the story for a glossary.
a.zh: 只用有助读者理解决定或风险的术语。通过行动或简短语境解释生词，不要停下故事讲词汇表。

title.en: How to Write a Dystopian Novel Through Everyday Choices
title.zh: 反乌托邦小说怎么写：从日常选择呈现制度

seo_title.en: How to Write a Dystopian Novel

description.en: Show how a system shapes ordinary choices, then build resistance around a cost the protagonist must face.
description.zh: 展示制度如何影响日常选择，再让反抗指向主角必须承担的代价。

answer.en: A dystopian story makes an unjust system visible through everyday rules and the people who enforce or depend on them. Give the protagonist a concrete need inside that system, then let resistance create personal and social consequences.
answer.zh: 反乌托邦故事通过日常规则及执行或依赖规则的人，让不公制度变得可见。给主角一个身处制度中的具体需求，再让反抗产生个人和社会后果。

heading.en: Build the system from ordinary rules
heading.zh: 从日常规则搭建设定

body.en: Choose a few mechanisms that affect work, movement, privacy, education, or belonging. Show who benefits, who pays, and how people explain the rules to themselves; avoid opening with a history lecture about the whole state.
body.zh: 选择影响工作、行动、隐私、教育或归属感的几项机制。展示谁受益、谁付出，以及人们如何说服自己接受规则；不要一开篇就讲完整政体史。

heading.en: Give the protagonist a need within the system
heading.zh: 给主角一个身处制度中的需求

body.en: A personal goal such as finding a relative, keeping a job, or protecting a record lets readers feel how the system works. Connect that need to a choice that could improve one life while putting another at risk.
body.zh: 寻找亲人、保住工作或保护记录等个人目标，能让读者感受到制度如何运作。让目标牵出一种选择：可能改善一人的生活，却使另一人陷入危险。

heading.en: Make resistance change relationships
heading.zh: 让反抗改变人物关系

body.en: Track allies, bystanders, and people who enforce the system. Resistance may inspire help, deepen surveillance, or force a compromise; let the ending show what changed and what remains difficult.
body.zh: 追踪盟友、旁观者和制度执行者。反抗可能带来帮助、加强监控或迫使妥协；结尾要展示哪些事改变了、哪些仍然困难。

q.en: Does a dystopian novel need a revolution?
q.zh: 反乌托邦小说一定要写革命吗？

a.en: No. The protagonist can expose a practice, protect a community, escape, or change one institution. Choose a scale that follows from the character’s resources and the story’s central question.
a.zh: 不必。主角可以揭露一种做法、保护社区、逃离或改变一个机构。根据人物资源和故事核心问题决定行动规模。

title.en: How to Write a First-Contact Science-Fiction Story
title.zh: 首次接触科幻故事怎么写

seo_title.en: Write a First-Contact Sci-Fi Story

description.en: Build tension from what each side can observe, misunderstand, communicate, and risk during first contact.
description.zh: 围绕双方能观察、误解、沟通和承担的风险建立首次接触的张力。

answer.en: A first-contact story centers on how unfamiliar beings interpret one another with limited evidence. Establish what each side can observe, create a communication problem with consequences, and let discoveries change the approach rather than merely add spectacle.
answer.zh: 首次接触故事聚焦陌生双方如何在证据有限时理解彼此。说明各方能观察到什么，设置会产生后果的沟通难题，并让发现改变行动方式，而不只是增加奇观。

heading.en: Choose the viewpoint and first evidence
heading.zh: 选择视角和最初证据

body.en: Decide who encounters what first: a signal, object, biological trace, or direct meeting. Keep observations distinct from interpretations so readers can share the uncertainty without losing track of known facts.
body.zh: 确定谁最先遇见什么：信号、物件、生物痕迹或直接会面。区分观察事实和人物解释，让读者能共同经历不确定性，同时看清已知信息。

heading.en: Make communication a dramatic problem
heading.zh: 把沟通变成戏剧难题

body.en: Give translation, timing, or incompatible assumptions a practical consequence: a delayed rescue, a threatened boundary, or a decision made from incomplete meaning. Avoid treating the other side as a puzzle with one instant answer.
body.zh: 让翻译、时机或不相容的假设带来实际后果：救援延迟、边界受威胁，或基于不完整理解作出决定。不要把对方写成一题马上能解的谜。

heading.en: Let new understanding change the response
heading.zh: 让新理解改变应对方式

body.en: Each discovery should revise a belief, a plan, or the risks of contact. Give both sides motives and limits, then resolve the central question through a choice that reflects what has been learned.
body.zh: 每次发现都要修正一种信念、计划或接触风险。给双方动机和限制，再用体现新认知的选择回应核心问题。

q.en: Should a first-contact story explain the aliens completely?
q.zh: 首次接触故事要完全解释外星文明吗？

a.en: No. Explain what the characters need to make their choices understandable. Preserve uncertainty that supports the theme, but keep the immediate stakes and observed evidence clear.
a.zh: 不必。解释到足以让人物选择合理即可。可以保留支撑主题的不确定性，但眼前利害和已观察证据要清楚。

title.en: How to Write a Superhero Story About More Than Powers
title.zh: 超级英雄故事怎么写：让力量之外也有冲突

seo_title.en: How to Write a Superhero Story

description.en: Connect powers and limits to identity, responsibility, relationships, and consequences for ordinary people.
description.zh: 把超能力与限制连到身份、责任、关系和普通人的实际后果。

answer.en: A superhero story becomes specific when powers, limits, and public responsibility shape the protagonist’s choices. Give the hero a problem strength cannot solve, an antagonist with a coherent goal, and consequences visible to the people affected.
answer.zh: 当能力、限制和公共责任影响主角选择时，超级英雄故事才有独特性。给英雄一个力量无法解决的问题、一个目标自洽的对手，以及受影响者看得见的后果。

heading.en: Make powers useful but limited
heading.zh: 让能力有用但有限

body.en: Define what the hero can do, what it costs, and which problems require judgment or help. A clear limitation creates choices; it should not disappear whenever the climax needs an easy solution.
body.zh: 明确英雄能做什么、代价是什么、哪些问题仍需要判断或他人帮助。限制能创造选择；高潮需要简单解法时也不能突然失效。

heading.en: Give the conflict a human stake
heading.zh: 给冲突具体的人类利害

body.en: Show who is put at risk by the hero’s plan and who disagrees about what protection means. Let civilian needs, relationships, or public trust affect the strategy rather than appear only in background shots.
body.zh: 展示英雄计划会让谁处于风险中，以及人们对保护有何分歧。让普通人的需求、关系或公众信任影响策略，而不只是出现在背景镜头里。

heading.en: Make the antagonist challenge a value
heading.zh: 让对手挑战一种价值观

body.en: Give the antagonist a goal and methods that test the hero’s principles. The climax should require a decision about responsibility or identity, not only a larger display of power.
body.zh: 给对手明确目标和会考验英雄原则的手段。高潮应迫使英雄选择如何承担责任或定义自我，而不只是展示更强力量。

q.en: Does a superhero need a secret identity?
q.zh: 超级英雄一定要有秘密身份吗？

a.en: No. A public identity can create pressure around trust, accountability, and personal boundaries. Choose secrecy only when it creates meaningful choices and consequences for this character.
a.zh: 不一定。公开身份也能带来信任、问责和个人边界方面的压力。只有当秘密身份会为这个人物创造有意义的选择和后果时才使用。

title.en: How to Write a Cozy Fantasy Story with Real Stakes
title.zh: 舒适奇幻怎么写：温暖氛围也要有真实利害

seo_title.en: Write a Cozy Fantasy Story

description.en: Build a welcoming magical setting, a manageable conflict, and relationships changed by practical choices.
description.zh: 建立宜人的魔法世界、可处理的冲突，并让实际选择改变人物关系。

answer.en: Cozy fantasy pairs an inviting speculative setting with conflicts that matter without requiring constant escalation into world-ending danger. Give the protagonist a concrete problem, a community with different needs, and progress built through care, work, and choice.
answer.zh: 舒适奇幻把宜人的幻想设定与不必不断升级为世界末日的冲突结合。给主角一个具体难题、需求不同的社区，并通过照料、劳动和选择推动变化。

heading.en: Define the scale and tone of the conflict
heading.zh: 明确冲突规模和基调

body.en: A small business, shared home, local festival, or neighborhood problem can carry real emotional stakes. Decide what could be lost and why it matters, while keeping the threat consistent with the calming or hopeful reading experience you promise.
body.zh: 小店、合住空间、社区节庆或邻里难题也能承载情感利害。明确可能失去什么、为何重要，同时让威胁符合你承诺的舒缓或希望感。

heading.en: Make the community more than a backdrop
heading.zh: 让社区不只是背景

body.en: Give neighbors, customers, or magical creatures distinct needs and boundaries. Let helping one person cost time or resources another person needs, creating choices without turning every disagreement into a villain plot.
body.zh: 让邻居、顾客或魔法生物有各自需求和边界。帮助一方可能占用另一方需要的时间或资源，由此产生选择，但不必把所有分歧都写成反派阴谋。

heading.en: Let care produce visible change
heading.zh: 让关怀带来可见变化

body.en: Show progress through a repaired place, shared routine, trusted relationship, or new local agreement. End with a satisfying result for the central problem while leaving ordinary life ready for another story.
body.zh: 通过修复的空间、共同日常、建立的信任或新的社区约定呈现进展。结尾要解决核心问题，同时让日常生活仍有继续讲述的空间。

q.en: Can cozy fantasy include danger or sadness?
q.zh: 舒适奇幻可以出现危险或悲伤吗？

a.en: Yes. The tone depends on how the story frames and resolves difficulty, not on eliminating every hard moment. Keep the conflict proportionate to the promised reading experience and give characters credible support.
a.zh: 可以。基调取决于故事如何呈现和处理困难，而不是完全没有艰难时刻。让冲突符合承诺的阅读体验，并给人物可信的支持。

title.en: How to Write a Sports Romance with Goals Beyond the Game
title.zh: 体育爱情故事怎么写：赛场内外都有目标

seo_title.en: How to Write a Sports Romance

description.en: Give both characters distinct ambitions, make the sport affect their relationship, and let competition carry consequences.
description.zh: 让双方各有目标，让运动影响感情，并让竞争带来实际后果。

answer.en: A sports romance balances relationship development with training, competition, and the pressures around a sport. Give each character a goal beyond the romance, use the game or season to change their choices, and make the relationship affect how they pursue those goals.
answer.zh: 体育爱情故事要平衡关系发展、训练比赛和运动环境带来的压力。让双方在爱情之外各有目标，用赛事或赛季改变选择，也让关系影响他们追求目标的方式。

heading.en: Give each character an independent goal
heading.zh: 让每个人都有独立目标

body.en: A title, team place, recovery, coaching future, or personal record can matter for reasons beyond impressing a love interest. Different ambitions create respectful conflict and keep the relationship from replacing the characters’ lives.
body.zh: 冠军、队内位置、康复、教练前途或个人纪录，都应有超出取悦恋爱对象的意义。不同目标能制造有尊重的冲突，也让恋爱不取代人物生活。

heading.en: Use the sport to create turning points
heading.zh: 让运动成为关系转折的来源

body.en: Training, travel, injury, public performance, or team decisions can reveal how the characters handle pressure. Make sports details understandable to newcomers and relevant to the emotional or plot change.
body.zh: 训练、旅行、受伤、公开表现或团队决定，都能揭示人物如何应对压力。让运动细节对新手读者易懂，并与情感或情节变化有关。

heading.en: Resolve both the relationship and its trade-offs
heading.zh: 同时处理感情和现实取舍

body.en: At a decisive point, show how the characters support or challenge each other without erasing professional costs. The ending should answer the romantic question and clarify what each person chooses for their sporting future.
body.zh: 在关键处展示人物如何支持或挑战彼此，同时保留职业代价。结尾既要回应爱情问题，也要交代双方如何选择运动生涯。

q.en: Does a sports romance need accurate competition details?
q.zh: 体育爱情故事需要准确的比赛细节吗？

a.en: Readers need consistent rules and believable pressure, not a technical manual. Research the details that affect a turning point and explain unfamiliar rules only when the scene depends on them.
a.zh: 读者需要前后一致的规则和可信压力，不需要技术手册。重点查会影响转折的细节，陌生规则只有在场景依赖时才解释。

title.en: How to Write a Dark Romance with Clear Boundaries and Stakes
title.zh: 暗黑爱情故事怎么写：边界清楚，选择有后果

seo_title.en: How to Write a Dark Romance

description.en: Set expectations, preserve character agency, and make risk and consent clear within the relationship arc.
description.zh: 明确故事预期，保留人物能动性，并在关系发展中说清风险与同意。

answer.en: A dark romance explores attraction and intimacy under danger, coercive pressure, or morally troubling circumstances. Establish content expectations, make character choices legible, and let the story recognize harm and power rather than treating intensity as automatic proof of love.
answer.zh: 暗黑爱情在危险、胁迫压力或道德困境中探索吸引与亲密。先明确内容预期，让人物选择清楚，并承认伤害和权力差异，不要把强烈感受直接当作爱的证明。

heading.en: Set the story’s emotional contract
heading.zh: 明确故事的情感约定

body.en: Decide what makes the romance dark and what kind of resolution the book promises. Give readers accurate framing and content notes where useful; do not market a happy ending if the story aims for tragedy or ambiguity.
body.zh: 明确爱情故事的暗黑之处，以及作品承诺怎样的结局。需要时提供准确的内容说明；如果故事走向悲剧或开放结局，就不要宣传成圆满结局。

heading.en: Keep agency visible under pressure
heading.zh: 在压力中保留人物能动性

body.en: Show what each character can refuse, what they fear losing, and how power changes their options. Intense attraction does not erase consent; let decisions and consequences remain visible to the reader.
body.zh: 展示每个人能拒绝什么、害怕失去什么，以及权力如何影响选择。强烈吸引不等于没有同意；让读者看见决定及其后果。

heading.en: Make relationship change earned
heading.zh: 让关系变化有铺垫

body.en: If trust grows, show evidence through changed behavior, accountability, or a meaningful cost. A confession or rescue alone may not repair harm; give characters space to evaluate what happened and decide what comes next.
body.zh: 信任若增长，要通过行为改变、承担责任或实际代价来证明。告白或营救本身未必足以修复伤害；让人物有空间判断经历并决定下一步。

q.en: Does dark romance have to end happily?
q.zh: 暗黑爱情必须圆满结局吗？

a.en: Genre expectations vary. Choose the ending that fits the story, signal its tone honestly, and resolve the central relationship question at the level the book promises.
a.zh: 类型预期各异。选择符合故事的结局，如实传达基调，并按作品承诺的程度回应核心关系问题。

title.en: How to Write a Historical Adventure with Grounded Stakes
title.zh: 历史冒险故事怎么写：让时代限制影响行动

seo_title.en: How to Write a Historical Adventure

description.en: Build a clear journey or mission, research the constraints that shape it, and connect discoveries to character choices.
description.zh: 设计清晰旅程或任务，考据影响行动的时代限制，并让发现连到人物选择。

answer.en: A historical adventure combines a concrete mission or journey with period conditions that shape what characters can attempt. Research the routes, tools, communication, and authority that affect the plot, then make each discovery or obstacle change the plan.
answer.zh: 历史冒险故事把具体任务或旅程与影响人物行动的时代条件结合。查清路线、工具、通信和权力结构，再让每次发现或阻碍改变计划。

heading.en: Give the journey a clear purpose
heading.zh: 给旅程明确目的

body.en: Choose what must be delivered, found, protected, or escaped and why the time matters. Tie the larger mission to a personal goal so travel scenes reveal more than scenery.
body.zh: 明确必须送达、寻找、保护或逃离什么，以及时间为何重要。让大任务连着个人目标，使旅程不只是风景展示。

heading.en: Research practical limits
heading.zh: 考据实际限制

body.en: Check routes, travel speed, weather, communication, weapons, money, and who controls access. These constraints create believable obstacles and help distinguish the period from a modern journey in costume.
body.zh: 核查路线、行速、天气、通信、武器、金钱和通行权归属。这些限制能制造可信阻碍，也让故事不只是人物穿古装进行现代旅行。

heading.en: Let discoveries change the route
heading.zh: 让发现改变路线

body.en: A clue, ally, betrayal, or failed crossing should create a new decision with a cost. Track supplies and obligations so setbacks matter, and make the destination test what the protagonist believes about the mission.
body.zh: 线索、盟友、背叛或行程受阻都应带来有代价的新决定。追踪补给和责任，让挫折真正有影响，也让终点检验主角对使命的信念。

q.en: How much historical detail belongs in an adventure story?
q.zh: 冒险故事里要写多少历史细节？

a.en: Include details that change a route, choice, risk, or relationship. Keep background that does not affect the scene in research notes or introduce it when it becomes relevant.
a.zh: 写会改变路线、选择、风险或关系的细节。不会影响场景的背景留在考据笔记里，等真正相关时再引入。

title.en: How to Use Beta-Reader Feedback to Revise a Novel
title.zh: 怎么用试读反馈修改小说

seo_title.en: Use Beta-Reader Feedback

description.en: Separate reader reactions from proposed fixes, look for patterns, and revise toward your story goals.
description.zh: 区分读者反应和修改建议，寻找共性，并围绕故事目标决定是否调整。

answer.en: Use beta-reader feedback as evidence about how the manuscript is landing, not as a list of commands. Group reactions by issue, look for repeated confusion or loss of interest, and choose a fix that serves the story you intend to write.
answer.zh: 把试读反馈当作稿件实际效果的证据，而非必须照做的命令。按问题归类，留意反复出现的困惑或失去兴趣，再选择服务于创作目标的改法。

heading.en: Ask focused questions before sharing
heading.zh: 分享前先提出具体问题

body.en: Tell readers what kind of response would help: where motivation became unclear, which chapter slowed down, or what they expected after the ending. Ask them to describe their reaction before suggesting a solution.
body.zh: 说明需要哪类反馈：动机何处不清、哪章节奏变慢，或结尾后他们期待什么。先请读者描述反应，再提出修改方案。

heading.en: Look for patterns across readers
heading.zh: 比较多位读者的共同反应

body.en: A single preference may not fit your audience, but repeated confusion about the same cause or character choice is worth checking. Compare feedback with your genre promise and the experience you meant to create.
body.zh: 单个读者的偏好未必代表目标受众，但多人对同一原因或人物选择感到困惑，就值得核查。把反馈与类型承诺和预期阅读体验对照。

heading.en: Choose the fix, not every proposed solution
heading.zh: 判断问题后自行选择改法

body.en: Readers are strong at reporting what did not work for them; they may not know the best repair. Identify the underlying issue, list possible changes, and check each against causality, character agency, and later chapters.
body.zh: 读者擅长指出哪里读起来不顺，但未必知道最佳修法。先判断根本问题，再列出备选改动，并核对因果、人物能动性和后续章节。

q.en: Should I make every change beta readers suggest?
q.zh: 试读者提的每项修改都要做吗？

a.en: No. Keep feedback that helps deliver the intended story and audience promise. If you decline a suggestion, still consider whether the underlying reaction points to a real clarity or pacing issue.
a.zh: 不必。保留有助于兑现故事和受众承诺的反馈。即使不采纳某项建议，也要判断它背后的反应是否指出了真实的清晰度或节奏问题。

title.en: How to Start Writing Your First Novel
title.zh: 第一部长篇小说怎么开始写

seo_title.en: Start Writing Your First Novel

description.en: Choose a story-sized problem, set a manageable scope, and build a routine that gets a first draft moving.
description.zh: 选定适合长篇的核心问题、控制范围，并建立能推进初稿的写作节奏。

answer.en: Start a first novel by choosing a protagonist, a concrete problem, and a reason it cannot be solved quickly. Plan only enough turning points to begin, set a repeatable writing goal, and keep a separate list of questions to answer during revision.
answer.zh: 开始第一部长篇时，先确定主角、具体难题及其不能马上解决的原因。规划足够起步的几个转折，设定可持续目标，并把待确认问题另记下来留到修改时处理。

heading.en: Find a premise with room to change
heading.zh: 找一个能持续变化的故事前提

body.en: Write one sentence about who wants what, what blocks them, and why the problem grows. A novel needs a chain of changing choices, not simply a setting or an idea that sounds interesting.
body.zh: 用一句话写清谁想要什么、什么阻挡他们，以及问题为何会升级。长篇需要一串不断变化的选择，光有有趣设定还不够。

heading.en: Plan enough to reach the next turn
heading.zh: 只规划到能写出下一个转折

body.en: Mark the opening pressure, first major decision, a complication, and a possible ending. If detailed outlining stalls you, leave room to discover scenes; if drafting wanders, add the next few turning points.
body.zh: 标出开篇压力、首次重要决定、一个复杂化因素和暂定结尾。细纲让你停滞时就留空间发现情节；写着走散时，再补接下来几个转折。

heading.en: Set a routine and keep moving
heading.zh: 安排节奏并持续推进

body.en: Choose a time or word target you can repeat on ordinary weeks, not only on your best day. Note continuity questions without reopening every chapter, then finish the draft before judging whether the whole story works.
body.zh: 选择普通一周也能重复的时段或字数目标，而不是只在状态最好时才做得到的目标。记下连续性疑问，但别因此反复重写章节；先完成初稿，再判断全篇是否成立。

q.en: Should I outline my first novel before writing?
q.zh: 写第一部长篇前要先列大纲吗？

a.en: Use the amount of planning that helps you begin and continue. A premise and a few turning points may be enough; add detail when uncertainty repeatedly stops the draft.
a.zh: 规划到足以起步并继续写即可。一句前提和几个转折可能就够；如果反复因不确定而停笔，再补充细节。

text.en: Use the oh-story workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Novel Query Letter Agents Can Evaluate
title.zh: 小说投稿信怎么写：让经纪人看清故事和定位

seo_title.en: Write a Novel Query Letter

description.en: Present the premise, protagonist, conflict, comparable positioning, and requested details in the recipient’s format.
description.zh: 按收件方格式介绍故事前提、主角、冲突、市场定位和投稿信息。

answer.en: A novel query letter helps an agent quickly assess the story, its readership, and the author’s submission. Lead with a concise pitch, include only requested project details, and follow current agency instructions for length, materials, and personalization.
answer.zh: 小说投稿信帮助经纪人快速判断故事、目标读者和投稿信息。先写简洁推介，只加入要求的项目资料，并遵循经纪机构当前的篇幅、材料和个性化要求。

heading.en: Open with a concise story pitch
heading.zh: 用简洁故事推介开头

body.en: Introduce the protagonist, their goal, the obstacle, and the consequence of failure. Give enough detail to make the central tension distinctive, but do not summarize every subplot or describe the whole world.
body.zh: 介绍主角、目标、阻碍和失败后果。提供足以体现核心张力的细节，但不要概括所有支线或解释整个世界。

heading.en: Add accurate positioning and book details
heading.zh: 补充准确定位和作品信息

body.en: State the category or genre, approximate word count, and relevant comparison titles if requested. Choose comparisons that help place the readership or tone; do not claim your novel is the next bestseller.
body.zh: 按要求注明类别或类型、约略字数和相关比较作品。比较对象要帮助说明读者或基调，别宣称自己的小说必成畅销书。

heading.en: Follow each recipient’s submission rules
heading.zh: 按每位收件方的投稿规则准备

body.en: Check whether the agent wants a query only, sample pages, synopsis, or a form. Keep the bio relevant and brief, proofread names and links, and do not attach materials they did not request.
body.zh: 确认经纪人要投稿信、样章、梗概还是在线表格。作者简介保持简短相关，检查姓名和链接，也不要擅自附上未要求的材料。

q.en: Should a query letter reveal the novel’s ending?
q.zh: 投稿信需要透露小说结局吗？

a.en: Follow the recipient’s instructions. A query pitch usually focuses on the setup and central dilemma; a requested synopsis typically explains the full plot, including its resolution.
a.zh: 按收件方要求处理。投稿信通常聚焦故事前提和核心困境；若对方要求梗概，通常要交代完整情节和结局。

text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Logline for a Novel
title.zh: 小说 logline 怎么写：一句话说清故事钩子

seo_title.en: Write a Novel Logline

description.en: Compress protagonist, goal, obstacle, and stakes into a specific sentence that helps readers grasp the story.
description.zh: 把主角、目标、阻碍和利害压缩成一句具体清晰的故事介绍。

answer.en: A novel logline captures the protagonist, goal, central obstacle, and stakes in a short, specific pitch. It is a reader-facing hook, not a substitute for a synopsis; choose details that distinguish this story from others in the same genre.
answer.zh: 小说 logline 用简短而具体的推介呈现主角、目标、核心阻碍和利害。它是吸引读者的一句话钩子，不能代替梗概；细节要体现作品在同类中的区别。

heading.en: Name the protagonist and the want
heading.zh: 写出主角和明确诉求

body.en: Use a role or defining trait that helps readers picture the protagonist, then state what they are trying to do. A vague desire such as finding happiness is harder to evaluate than a specific action.
body.zh: 用身份或显著特点帮助读者想象主角，再说清他们要做什么。与其写寻找幸福，不如写具体行动，让故事更容易理解。

heading.en: Add the obstacle and consequence
heading.zh: 补上阻碍与失败代价

body.en: Explain what makes the goal difficult and what happens if the protagonist fails. A distinctive rule, relationship, deadline, or dilemma can add a hook when it is central to the story.
body.zh: 说明目标为何困难、失败会怎样。若独特规则、关系、期限或两难选择是故事核心，就可以用它形成钩子。

heading.en: Test clarity and promise
heading.zh: 检查清晰度和故事承诺

body.en: Read the line without the manuscript beside it. Can someone identify the genre, the main tension, and what makes the premise specific? Remove names or invented terms that require extra explanation.
body.zh: 不看正文单独读这句话。别人能否看出类型、主要张力和前提的独特之处？删掉需要额外解释的人名或自造术语。

q.en: Is a novel logline the same as a book blurb?
q.zh: 小说 logline 和书籍简介一样吗？

a.en: No. A logline compresses the central premise into a sentence. A blurb gives readers more room to understand the setup, stakes, and tone without revealing the ending.
a.zh: 不一样。logline 用一句话压缩核心前提；书籍简介则有更多篇幅介绍背景、利害和基调，同时不揭晓结局。

title.en: How to Write a Screenplay Treatment That Shows the Full Story
title.zh: 电影剧本 treatment 怎么写：展示完整故事走向

seo_title.en: Write a Screenplay Treatment

description.en: Summarize the film’s key turns, character choices, and ending in the format the reader requested.
description.zh: 按收件方要求概括电影的关键转折、人物选择和结局。

answer.en: A screenplay treatment presents the film’s story in prose so a reader can judge its arc before reading or producing the script. Include the central conflict, major turning points, and resolution at the requested length, and distinguish it from a short logline or pitch.
answer.zh: 电影剧本 treatment 用散文呈现影片故事，让读者在阅读或制作剧本前判断整体弧线。按要求篇幅写出核心冲突、重要转折和结局，并与一句话 logline 或推介区分。

heading.en: Confirm purpose and format first
heading.zh: 先确认用途和格式

body.en: Check who will read it and whether they want a brief pitch, a treatment, or a scene outline. Requirements vary in length, tense, headings, and whether dialogue samples belong.
body.zh: 确认收件对象，以及对方要短推介、treatment 还是分场大纲。不同要求在篇幅、时态、标题和是否需要对白片段上都有差异。

heading.en: Follow the film’s cause-and-effect arc
heading.zh: 沿着影片因果弧线推进

body.en: Introduce the protagonist and disruption, then summarize choices and consequences that drive each major turn. Keep only characters needed to follow the conflict; do not write a scene-by-scene screenplay in prose.
body.zh: 介绍主角和变故，再概括推动关键转折的选择与后果。只保留理解冲突所需的人物，不要用散文逐场复写剧本。

heading.en: Include the ending and production-relevant tone
heading.zh: 写出结局与制作相关的基调

body.en: Explain how the conflict resolves and what changes for the protagonist. Convey visual tone through a few concrete examples, and keep claims about locations, effects, or scale consistent with the intended production.
body.zh: 交代冲突如何解决、主角发生什么变化。用少量具体示例传达视觉基调，并确保对场地、特效或规模的说明符合制作计划。

q.en: Does a treatment include the ending?
q.zh: treatment 需要写出结局吗？

a.en: Usually yes when it is meant to show the full story. Check the reader’s instructions; a pitch or teaser may stop earlier, while a treatment commonly explains the resolution.
a.zh: 若要展示完整故事，通常需要写结局。按收件方说明处理；推介或预告可提前停下，treatment 通常要交代如何收束。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Pitch a Short Film in One Clear Page
title.zh: 短片项目怎么推介：一页讲清故事与制作规模

seo_title.en: Pitch a Short Film

description.en: Present the premise, emotional hook, visual approach, and realistic production scope without retelling every scene.
description.zh: 介绍故事前提、情绪钩子、视觉方向和可执行的制作规模，不必复述每场戏。

answer.en: A short-film pitch helps a reader quickly understand the story, why it works as a short, and what production it requires. Lead with the central character and dilemma, describe the visual approach briefly, and make the intended length and scope credible.
answer.zh: 短片推介帮助读者快速理解故事、它为何适合短片，以及需要怎样的制作条件。先介绍核心人物和困境，简述视觉方向，并让时长和规模可信。

heading.en: Lead with the film’s central tension
heading.zh: 从影片核心张力切入

body.en: Describe who the audience follows, what they want, and the moment that makes the situation difficult. A short premise should reveal the film’s specific hook, not summarize the entire backstory.
body.zh: 说明观众跟随谁、人物想要什么，以及什么时刻让处境变难。简短前提要突出影片独有的钩子，而非概括全部背景。

heading.en: Explain why the idea fits a short
heading.zh: 说明故事为何适合短片

body.en: Name the single decision or change that can carry the film from opening to ending. If the pitch needs several subplots or a large world explanation, narrow the story to one playable situation.
body.zh: 指出贯穿开头到结尾的一个决定或变化。如果推介需要多条支线或大量世界观说明，就缩小到一个能演出来的处境。

heading.en: Show tone and practical scope
heading.zh: 交代基调和实际制作规模

body.en: Use one or two visual references in plain language and state the expected length, main locations, and notable production needs. Match these details to the script and the team expected to make it.
body.zh: 用一两处通俗视觉参考说明基调，并注明预计时长、主要场地和特殊制作需求。内容要符合剧本和实际制作团队能力。

q.en: Should a short-film pitch reveal the ending?
q.zh: 短片推介要透露结局吗？

a.en: For a creative or production pitch, explain enough of the ending to show the arc and feasibility. A public teaser can preserve the reveal if that is its purpose.
a.zh: 创作或制作推介应说明足够的结尾信息，让人判断弧线和可行性。公开预告则可以按目的保留揭示。

title.en: How to Write a Young-Adult Novel with a Distinct Teen Voice
title.zh: 青少年小说怎么写：让视角和声音真实可信

seo_title.en: Write a Young-Adult Novel

description.en: Center a young protagonist’s present choices, relationships, and agency while respecting the intended readership.
description.zh: 围绕年轻主角当下的选择、关系和能动性写作，并尊重目标读者。

answer.en: A young-adult novel centers a young protagonist’s experience and choices without making them a passive lesson for adult characters. Give the protagonist goals that matter now, relationships with distinct pressures, and a voice shaped by their specific life rather than stereotypes.
answer.zh: 青少年小说以年轻主角的经历和选择为中心，不要把他们写成供成人角色教育的对象。给主角当下重要的目标、有不同压力的关系，以及来自具体生活而非刻板印象的声音。

heading.en: Keep the young protagonist at the center
heading.zh: 让年轻主角掌握故事中心

body.en: Let the protagonist make consequential choices and drive the plot, even when adults control resources or rules. Show what they can influence, what they cannot, and how that limit shapes their strategy.
body.zh: 即使资源和规则由成人掌握，也要让主角作出有后果的选择并推动情节。写清他们能影响什么、不能影响什么，以及限制如何改变策略。

heading.en: Write a specific voice, not an age stereotype
heading.zh: 写具体声音，而不是年龄刻板印象

body.en: Build voice from this character’s interests, community, relationships, and way of handling embarrassment or conflict. Read dialogue aloud and check that each person sounds distinct instead of relying on trendy slang alone.
body.zh: 从人物兴趣、社群、关系，以及处理尴尬或冲突的方式塑造声音。朗读对白，检查每个人是否有区别，而不是只靠流行俚语。

heading.en: Balance immediate stakes with lasting change
heading.zh: 平衡眼前利害和长期变化

body.en: A school choice, friendship break, first job, family decision, or public risk can matter deeply without being treated as trivial. Let the ending show what the protagonist learned or changed while keeping room for unresolved life ahead.
body.zh: 学校选择、友情破裂、第一份工作、家庭决定或公开冒险，都可以产生深刻影响。结尾展示主角学到或改变了什么，同时为尚未结束的人生留白。

q.en: Does a young-adult novel need a first-person narrator?
q.zh: 青少年小说一定要用第一人称吗？

a.en: No. Choose the viewpoint that gives readers the right access to the protagonist and story. First person can feel immediate; close third person can provide similar access with more flexibility.
a.zh: 不需要。选择能让读者获得合适人物和故事信息的视角。第一人称更贴近当下，贴近的第三人称也能提供类似亲近感并保留更多灵活性。

title.en: How to Write a Middle-Grade Novel with a Strong Child Protagonist
title.zh: 儿童中年级小说怎么写：让小主角主动解决问题

seo_title.en: Write a Middle-Grade Novel

description.en: Give a child protagonist an understandable goal, age-credible agency, and consequences that matter to young readers.
description.zh: 给儿童主角清楚目标、符合年龄的能动性，以及对年轻读者有意义的后果。

answer.en: A middle-grade novel gives young readers a protagonist whose problem is understandable, whose choices matter, and whose world is shaped by age-credible responsibilities. Keep the voice clear without talking down, and let supporting adults help without taking over the solution.
answer.zh: 儿童中年级小说要让年轻读者理解主角的难题、看到选择产生影响，并呈现符合年龄的责任与处境。语言清楚但不居高临下；成人角色可以帮助，却不要替主角解决问题。

heading.en: Choose a goal a young reader can grasp
heading.zh: 选择年轻读者能理解的目标

body.en: A friendship, mystery, team, family change, or personal challenge can anchor a long story. Make the immediate want concrete, even when the deeper theme concerns belonging, fairness, or growing independence.
body.zh: 友情、谜团、团队、家庭变化或个人挑战都能支撑长篇。即使主题关乎归属、公平或独立成长，也要让眼前目标具体。

heading.en: Give the child meaningful agency
heading.zh: 给儿童主角有意义的行动能力

body.en: Let the protagonist observe, try, make mistakes, ask for help, and change a plan. Adults can set boundaries or provide expertise, but the child’s learning and decisions should resolve the central story problem.
body.zh: 让主角观察、尝试、犯错、求助并调整计划。成人可以设边界或提供经验，但核心故事问题应由儿童主角的学习和决定解决。

heading.en: Keep language lively and readable
heading.zh: 让语言生动易读

body.en: Use concrete action, clear referents, and dialogue suited to each character. Explain unfamiliar facts through the protagonist’s experience; avoid either dense exposition or an overly simplified voice.
body.zh: 使用具体行动、清晰指代和符合人物个性的对话。通过主角经历解释陌生信息，避免堆砌设定，也不要把语言刻意写得幼稚。

q.en: Should every middle-grade novel have a happy ending?
q.zh: 儿童中年级小说都要大团圆吗？

a.en: The resolution should feel emotionally safe enough for the intended audience and honest to the story. It can include loss or uncertainty while showing support, agency, or a meaningful next step.
a.zh: 结局应符合目标读者的情感承受度，也要忠于故事。可以有失去或不确定，但要呈现支持、能动性或有意义的下一步。

title.en: How to Write a Graphic-Novel Script Artists Can Follow
title.zh: 图像小说脚本怎么写：让画手看清每格要画什么

seo_title.en: Write a Graphic-Novel Script

description.en: Organize pages, panels, action, and dialogue so the artist can stage the story without guessing.
description.zh: 按页、格、动作和对白组织脚本，让画手不用猜就能安排叙事。

answer.en: A graphic-novel script communicates the story through page and panel descriptions, visible action, and concise dialogue. Make the reading order and essential information clear while leaving artists room to solve composition and visual style.
answer.zh: 图像小说脚本通过页格说明、可见动作和简洁对白传达故事。明确阅读顺序和必要信息，同时给画手留下处理构图与视觉风格的空间。

heading.en: Choose a clear page and panel structure
heading.zh: 明确页与格的结构

body.en: Number pages and panels consistently, and note any deliberate splash page or unusual reading path. Keep each panel description focused on the moment the reader must see, not every camera detail an artist can decide.
body.zh: 统一标注页码和格数，说明有意设计的大跨页或特殊阅读路径。每格只描述读者必须看到的关键瞬间，不必替画手决定所有镜头细节。

heading.en: Write visible actions and essential text
heading.zh: 写清可见动作和必要文字

body.en: Describe what characters do, where they are, and what changes in the image. Separate dialogue, captions, and sound effects so the production team can identify what appears in the art and what can be revised.
body.zh: 描述人物做什么、身处何处，以及画面发生何种变化。区分对白、旁白框和音效字，让制作团队看清画面内容及可修改部分。

heading.en: Use page turns for reveals
heading.zh: 用翻页安排揭示

body.en: End a page where the next turn can reveal a reaction, threat, or changed image. Read the script as a sequence of page turns and check that each reveal has setup, space, and a consequence.
body.zh: 在翻页后能揭示反应、威胁或变化画面的地方结束一页。按翻页顺序检查脚本，确认每次揭示都有铺垫、空间和后果。

q.en: Should a graphic-novel writer specify every panel?
q.zh: 图像小说作者要规定每一格吗？

a.en: Specify panels when the sequence depends on timing, continuity, or a page-turn reveal. Leave flexible scenes open enough for the artist to find stronger visual solutions.
a.zh: 当节奏、连续性或翻页揭示依赖分格时，就要写清。其他场景可以保留弹性，让画手找到更好的视觉方案。

title.en: How to Write a Webtoon Episode Script for Vertical Reading
title.zh: 条漫单集脚本怎么写：按竖屏阅读节奏安排

seo_title.en: Write a Webtoon Episode Script

description.en: Plan a readable vertical flow, reveal information in scroll order, and end the episode on a satisfying turn.
description.zh: 规划清晰的竖向阅读流，按滚动顺序揭示信息，并以有效转折结束单集。

answer.en: A webtoon episode script plans what readers see as they scroll: panel sequence, spacing, dialogue, reveals, and the episode turn. Keep text readable on a phone, use vertical distance deliberately, and make the ending advance the next episode’s question.
answer.zh: 条漫单集脚本要规划读者滚动时看到的分格、间距、对白、揭示和单集转折。让手机文字易读，有意识地使用竖向留白，并让结尾推进下一集的问题。

heading.en: Write for the scroll, not a printed page
heading.zh: 按滚动阅读写，而不是套纸页版式

body.en: Plan panel size and vertical spacing around attention and pacing. A short gap can keep connected action moving; a larger gap can delay a reveal. Test text size and balloon placement at phone scale.
body.zh: 根据注意力和节奏安排分格大小与竖向间距。短间隔能让连续动作紧凑，大留白可以延迟揭示。要在手机尺寸下检查文字大小和气泡位置。

heading.en: Make each scroll reveal useful information
heading.zh: 让每次向下滚动都有信息回报

body.en: Use the scroll to control what readers see first, what they infer, and when a reaction appears. Avoid long empty stretches that only hide information without adding anticipation or emotional weight.
body.zh: 利用滚动控制读者先看见什么、能推断什么，以及何时看到反应。不要只为藏信息而拉长空白，却没有增加期待或情感分量。

heading.en: End with a turn that belongs to this episode
heading.zh: 以属于本集的转折结束

body.en: Resolve a local action or relationship beat, then open a new consequence, choice, or question. Check the final panels against the episode promise so the ending feels earned rather than an arbitrary cut.
body.zh: 先完成一个局部行动或关系节拍，再引出新的后果、选择或问题。对照本集承诺检查最后几格，让结尾有铺垫，而不是随意截断。

q.en: How many panels should a webtoon episode have?
q.zh: 条漫一集应该有多少格？

a.en: There is no universal count. Use enough panels to deliver the episode’s action and emotional turn at a readable scroll pace, then follow the platform or production team’s specifications.
a.zh: 没有统一数量。按清晰的滚动节奏呈现本集行动和情绪转折，并遵循平台或制作团队的规格。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Introduce a New Character in a Novel
title.zh: 小说新角色怎么登场：让读者记住且知道其作用

seo_title.en: Introduce a Character in a Novel

description.en: Give the character a memorable action, a clear relationship to the scene, and only the details readers need now.
description.zh: 用鲜明行动、清晰的场景关系和眼下必要的信息介绍人物。

answer.en: Introduce a new character through an action or choice that matters in the scene, then reveal only the details readers need to understand their role. Connect the entrance to the viewpoint character’s goal so the introduction feels like part of the story.
answer.zh: 通过影响场景的行动或选择引入新人物，再补充理解其作用所必需的信息。把登场连到视角人物的目标，让介绍成为故事的一部分。

heading.en: Give the character an entrance with a purpose
heading.zh: 让人物以有目的的行动登场

body.en: Show what the character wants, changes, interrupts, or notices. A specific choice or behavior is easier to remember than a static inventory of appearance and biography.
body.zh: 展示人物想要什么、改变什么、打断什么或注意到什么。具体选择或行为比静态罗列外貌和生平更容易记住。

heading.en: Filter description through a viewpoint
heading.zh: 用视角人物筛选介绍信息

body.en: Choose details the viewpoint character would notice because of attraction, suspicion, status, or immediate need. Avoid a full dossier on first appearance; keep background for the moment it affects a decision.
body.zh: 选择视角人物会因吸引、怀疑、身份或眼前需求留意的细节。首次登场不必交代完整档案，背景等到影响决定时再补充。

heading.en: Make the entrance affect the next beat
heading.zh: 让登场影响下一节拍

body.en: Give the new person a role in the ongoing goal, obstacle, or relationship. After they appear, something should become easier, harder, riskier, or newly possible; otherwise consider delaying the introduction.
body.zh: 让新人物参与当前目标、阻碍或关系。登场后，事情应变得更容易、更困难、更危险或出现新可能；否则可以考虑推迟介绍。

q.en: Should a novel describe a new character’s appearance first?
q.zh: 小说要先描写新人物外貌吗？

a.en: Only include appearance details that help readers picture the moment or understand the viewpoint character’s response. Action, voice, and choices often make a stronger first impression.
a.zh: 只写有助读者想象当下或理解视角人物反应的外貌细节。行动、声音和选择往往能留下更强的第一印象。
