title.en: How to Outline a Video Essay Around One Clear Argument
title.zh: 如何围绕一个清晰论点搭建视频 essay 大纲

seo_title.en: Outline a Video Essay
seo_title.zh: 搭建视频 essay 大纲

description.en: Turn a broad subject into a focused claim, supporting sections, source evidence, and a conclusion that answers the opening question.
description.zh: 把宽泛主题转成明确观点、分段论据、来源证据和回应开场问题的结尾。

answer.en: A video essay outline organizes a claim and the evidence needed to support it. Write the argument in one sentence, arrange sections so each adds a reason or complication, and attach examples before drafting narration.
answer.zh: 视频 essay 大纲要组织观点及其所需证据。用一句话写出论点，安排各段逐步补充理由或复杂性，并在起草旁白前附上例证。

heading.en: Narrow the subject into an answerable question
heading.zh: 把主题收窄成可回答的问题

body.en: A topic such as “the director's style” is too broad by itself. Ask what the work does, how it does it, and why the result matters to viewers; use that question to limit the essay.
body.zh: “导演风格”这样的主题本身过于宽泛。追问作品做了什么、如何做到、为何值得观众关注，再用问题限制篇幅。

heading.en: Give each section a distinct job
heading.zh: 让每一段承担不同任务

body.en: One section might establish a pattern, another test it against an exception, and a later one explain the effect. Cut sections that repeat the claim without adding evidence or changing the audience's understanding.
body.zh: 一段可以提出模式，另一段用反例检验，之后再解释效果。删掉只重复观点、没有增加证据或改变理解的部分。

heading.en: Attach footage or source evidence to every claim
heading.zh: 为每个观点配上画面或来源证据

body.en: List the scene, timestamp, quotation, or document that supports each point. If no example can demonstrate a section, revise the claim before writing polished narration.
body.zh: 为每个观点列出对应场景、时间码、引语或文件。如果找不到能说明该段的例子，就先修改观点，再润色旁白。

q.en: How detailed should a video essay outline be?
q.zh: 视频 essay 大纲需要多详细？

a.en: Detailed enough to show the argument, evidence, and transitions. You can discover exact wording while scripting, but should not have to invent the thesis during the final edit.
a.zh: 要足以看清论证、证据和转接。脚本阶段可以再推敲措辞，但不应等到最终剪辑才临时发明中心论点。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Write a Video Essay Conclusion That Answers the Hook
title.zh: 如何写出回应开场问题的视频 essay 结尾

seo_title.en: Write a Video Essay Conclusion
seo_title.zh: 写好视频 essay 结尾

description.en: Synthesize the evidence, answer the opening question, and leave viewers with a useful implication instead of a repeated summary.
description.zh: 综合证据、回应开场问题，并留下有启发的延伸，而非重复摘要。

answer.en: A video essay conclusion should show what the evidence adds up to. Return to the opening question, answer it with the reasoning developed in the video, and explain what viewers can now notice or reconsider.
answer.zh: 视频 essay 结尾要说明证据最终指向什么。回到开场问题，用视频中的推理作答，并说明观众现在可以注意或重新思考什么。

heading.en: Return to the opening question
heading.zh: 回应开场提出的问题

body.en: Bring back the problem or example that started the essay, now with the evidence viewers have seen. Avoid repeating the introduction word for word; show how the question has become more precise.
body.zh: 重新提及开场问题或例子，并结合观众刚看过的证据。不要逐字重复引言，而要指出问题如何变得更明确。

heading.en: Synthesize rather than list the sections
heading.zh: 综合论证，不要罗列章节

body.en: Explain how the examples work together, including a tension or exception that matters. A conclusion can refine the claim without pretending every source supports a simple answer.
body.zh: 说明例子如何共同支持观点，也包括重要矛盾或例外。可以修正论点，不必假装所有材料都指向简单答案。

heading.en: Give viewers a clear final implication
heading.zh: 为观众留下明确的延伸意义

body.en: State what the interpretation changes about how we watch, read, or discuss the work. End on a final image or sentence that completes the argument instead of adding a new topic.
body.zh: 说清这种解读如何改变我们观看、阅读或讨论作品的方式。用收束论证的画面或句子结束，不要临时另开话题。

q.en: Should a video essay end with a call to action?
q.zh: 视频 essay 结尾应该加行动号召吗？

a.en: Only if it fits the creator's voice and does not displace the conclusion. Finish the argument first, then add a brief invitation if it feels natural.
a.zh: 只有符合创作者口吻且不挤掉结论时才加。先结束论证，再自然地补一句邀请即可。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Storyboard a Video Essay Before You Edit
title.zh: 剪辑前如何为视频 essay 做分镜计划

seo_title.en: Storyboard a Video Essay
seo_title.zh: 为视频 essay 做分镜

description.en: Match narration sections with footage, on-screen text, and pauses so the argument stays visible and easy to follow.
description.zh: 为各段旁白匹配画面、屏幕文字和停顿，让论点清晰可见、易于跟随。

answer.en: A video essay storyboard maps each spoken point to visuals that help viewers understand it. Mark the claim, footage or graphic, on-screen text, and transition for each beat, then check whether the edit would still make sense without decorative images.
answer.zh: 视频 essay 分镜把每个口头观点映射到帮助观众理解的画面。逐个节拍标出观点、素材或图表、屏幕文字和转接，再检查删掉装饰画面后剪辑是否仍然清晰。

heading.en: Assign a visual job to each narration beat
heading.zh: 为每个旁白节拍分配画面任务

body.en: Choose whether footage proves, contextualizes, contrasts, or gives the viewer a pause. When one image cannot support the claim, add a second example or narrow the line.
body.zh: 判断画面用于证明、补充背景、形成对比还是让观众喘息。一张图无法支撑观点时，就补第二个例子或收窄表述。

heading.en: Plan labels and evidence on screen
heading.zh: 规划屏幕标注和证据

body.en: Add names, dates, or short citations where viewers need them. Keep text readable at the intended screen size and place it where it does not hide the visual detail being discussed.
body.zh: 在观众需要的位置标出姓名、日期或简短来源。确保文字在目标屏幕上易读，且不要遮住正在讨论的画面细节。

heading.en: Leave time to see important examples
heading.zh: 给重要例子留出观看时间

body.en: Do not cut away the moment a useful detail appears. Hold or replay footage only when it helps observation, and use transitions to show how the next example advances the argument.
body.zh: 有用细节出现时不要立刻切走。只有帮助观察时才延长或重放素材，并用转接说明下个例子如何推进论证。

q.en: Does every video essay sentence need a new shot?
q.zh: 视频 essay 每句话都要换新镜头吗？

a.en: No. A stable shot can give viewers time to study evidence. Change the visual when the argument, example, or information changes, not to create motion for its own sake.
a.zh: 不必。稳定画面能让观众仔细观察证据。论点、例子或信息变化时再换画面，不要为了动感而动。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Recap a TV Season Finale Clearly
title.zh: 如何清晰解说电视剧季终集

seo_title.en: Recap a TV Season Finale

description.en: Explain the finale's resolved arcs, new revelations, and open questions without confusing confirmed events with theories.
description.zh: 讲清季终集解决的故事线、新揭示和未解问题，区分事实与推测。

answer.en: A season-finale recap must explain what the episode resolves and what it deliberately leaves open. Track each major character arc, verify reveals against the episode, and label predictions as interpretation rather than confirmed story fact.
answer.zh: 季终集解说要说明本集解决了什么、刻意留下了什么。追踪重要人物弧线，对照剧集核实揭示，并把预测标成解读而非既定事实。

heading.en: Separate resolved questions from open ones
heading.zh: 区分已解决与仍未解决的问题

body.en: Make a short list of what the finale answers, what changes, and what remains unknown. A cliffhanger can suggest possibilities, but do not state one theory as the next season's confirmed direction.
body.zh: 列出季终集回答了什么、改变了什么、还有什么未知。悬念可以暗示多种可能，但不要把某种猜测说成下一季已确认走向。

heading.en: Track the main character arcs through the payoff
heading.zh: 追踪主要人物弧线如何兑现

body.en: Note the choice each character faces and the consequence that follows. Compress repeated subplots, but preserve the decisions that explain why the finale changes the group or world.
body.zh: 记录人物面对的选择及其后果。可压缩重复支线，但要保留能说明季终集如何改变群体或世界的决定。

heading.en: Set up the next season without inventing it
heading.zh: 为下一季留钩子，但不要替它编剧情

body.en: End on the new danger, promise, or unresolved relationship the episode actually presents. If you speculate, signal that it is a reading of the clues, not information confirmed by the source.
body.zh: 以本集实际呈现的新危险、承诺或未解关系收尾。若作推测，要说明这是对线索的解读，而非原片已确认的信息。

q.en: Can a finale recap explain fan theories?
q.zh: 季终集解说可以谈粉丝理论吗？

a.en: Yes, after clearly separating the episode's facts from interpretation. Tie each theory to an observable clue and avoid presenting speculation as a confirmed plot detail.
a.zh: 可以，但要先清楚区分剧集事实与解读。让理论对应可观察线索，别把推测说成已确认剧情。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Write a Narrative Design Brief for a Game Adaptation
title.zh: 如何为游戏改编撰写叙事设计简报

seo_title.en: Game Adaptation Narrative Brief

description.en: Define the player promise, source elements to preserve, interactive goals, and open adaptation decisions in one usable brief.
description.zh: 用一份可执行简报明确玩家承诺、需保留的原作内容、互动目标和待定改编决定。

answer.en: A narrative design brief aligns the team on what the game should make players do, feel, and understand. State the player promise, identify source elements worth preserving, describe how play carries them, and list assumptions the prototype still needs to test.
answer.zh: 叙事设计简报让团队对玩家要做什么、感受什么和理解什么达成一致。写明玩家承诺、值得保留的原作元素、玩法如何承载它们，以及原型还需验证的假设。

heading.en: State the experience in player-facing terms
heading.zh: 用玩家体验的语言描述目标

body.en: Describe a repeated player action, the response it creates, and the feeling or question that should follow. Avoid defining the game only by its source plot or genre label.
body.zh: 描述玩家反复执行的行动、由此产生的回应，以及接下来的感受或问题。不要只用原作剧情或类型标签定义游戏。

heading.en: Name what the adaptation must keep
heading.zh: 列出改编必须保留的内容

body.en: Record source rules, relationships, signature choices, and emotional turns that create the original promise. Separate fixed requirements from elements the team can reshape to support interactivity.
body.zh: 记录塑造原作承诺的规则、关系、关键选择和情绪转折。区分必须保留的要求与可为互动性重塑的内容。

heading.en: Turn unknowns into prototype questions
heading.zh: 把未知之处变成原型问题

body.en: List uncertainties such as whether players understand a world rule or care about a companion decision. Make each test observable so production can answer it before content expands.
body.zh: 列出玩家是否理解世界规则、是否在意伙伴决定等不确定点。让每项测试都可观察，以便扩展内容前得到答案。

q.en: How long should a narrative design brief be?
q.zh: 叙事设计简报要写多长？

a.en: Long enough to align the team and guide a prototype, but short enough that decisions are easy to find. Put unresolved questions beside the assumptions they depend on.
a.zh: 要足以统一团队并指导原型，又要短到容易找到决定。把未解决问题放在依赖它们的假设旁。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Map a Branching Game Story Before Writing Dialogue
title.zh: 写对白前如何绘制游戏分支故事图

seo_title.en: Map a Branching Game Story

description.en: Map decisions, state changes, convergence points, and endings so branches remain understandable and producible.
description.zh: 标出决定、状态变化、汇合点和结局，让分支清晰且可制作。

answer.en: A branching story map shows where players decide, what each path changes, and how scenes reconnect or reach different endings. Draw the player-facing choice, track its state, and map only the branches that create a distinct experience worth producing.
answer.zh: 分支故事图展示玩家何时决定、各路线改变什么，以及场景如何汇合或通往不同结局。画出玩家可见的选择，追踪状态，并只保留值得制作的差异化路线。

heading.en: Mark choices as decision points
heading.zh: 把选择标成决定节点

body.en: For every node, record the context, available options, and what the player understands before choosing. A choice without a readable reason or consequence is difficult to test.
body.zh: 为每个节点记录情境、可选项和决定前玩家掌握的信息。缺少清晰理由或后果的选择难以测试。

heading.en: Track state changes on each path
heading.zh: 追踪每条路线上的状态变化

body.en: Note the facts learned, resources spent, and relationship changes produced by each branch. Show where those states are checked later so the map connects narrative design to implementation.
body.zh: 记录每条分支带来的新信息、资源消耗和关系变化。标出后续检查这些状态的位置，让叙事图能指导实现。

heading.en: Review branch length and convergence
heading.zh: 检查分支长度和汇合位置

body.en: Look for paths that diverge without changing the experience or grow so large that production cannot support them. Converge after meaningful effects are shown, and reserve separate routes for changes the player can recognize.
body.zh: 检查无体验差异却分叉的路线，以及制作难以承担的过长分支。在有意义的影响呈现后汇合；只有玩家能察觉的变化才保留独立路线。

q.en: Do I need a branching narrative tool to make the map?
q.zh: 绘制分支图一定要用专门工具吗？

a.en: No. A whiteboard or simple diagram works for a small story. Choose a tool that makes nodes, state changes, and ownership easy for the team to review.
a.zh: 不必。小型故事用白板或简单图表即可。选择能让团队查看节点、状态变化和负责人都方便的工具。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Test Every Route in a Branching Story
title.zh: 如何测试互动故事中的每条分支路线

seo_title.en: Test Branching Story Routes

description.en: Walk paths through choices and state changes to catch unreachable scenes, missing consequences, and inconsistent character knowledge.
description.zh: 沿选择和状态变化逐路检查，找出不可达场景、缺失后果和人物认知矛盾。

answer.en: Test a branching story by following each intended path and checking that scenes, flags, and character knowledge remain consistent. Create a route checklist, include combinations that change later dialogue, and verify that every ending is reachable under the stated rules.
answer.zh: 测试分支故事时，逐条走完预期路线，检查场景、标记和人物认知是否一致。建立路线清单，覆盖会改变后续对话的组合，并确认每个结局都能按规则抵达。

heading.en: Create route cases from meaningful state changes
heading.zh: 围绕有意义的状态变化建立测试路线

body.en: List decisions that affect trust, inventory, evidence, or access. Test at least one path for each relevant combination, and note the state expected when a scene begins.
body.zh: 列出影响信任、道具、证据或权限的决定。为相关组合各测一条路径，并记录进入场景时应有的状态。

heading.en: Check reachability and continuity
heading.zh: 检查场景可达性和连续性

body.en: Confirm that no route skips required context or points to a scene with missing information. Check that characters do not refer to a fact the player never learned on that path.
body.zh: 确认路线没有跳过必要背景，也不会进入缺少信息的场景。检查人物是否提到了玩家在该路径上从未得知的事实。

heading.en: Record the result and retest after changes
heading.zh: 记录结果，并在改动后重新测试

body.en: For each route, log the choices, expected consequence, observed output, and defect. When a shared scene or flag changes, rerun paths that depend on it rather than only the last route you opened.
body.zh: 逐条记录选择、预期后果、实际输出和问题。共同场景或标记改变时，重新跑依赖它的路线，不要只测试最近打开的一条。

q.en: Do I need to test every possible choice combination?
q.zh: 需要测试所有可能的选择组合吗？

a.en: Test every distinct state interaction that affects content, and prioritize combinations with shared flags or endings. A route map helps identify redundant combinations that produce the same result.
a.zh: 要覆盖所有会改变内容的独特状态组合，优先测共享标记或结局相关组合。路线图能帮助识别结果相同的冗余组合。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Turn Character Relationships into Gameplay
title.zh: 如何把人物关系转化为游戏玩法

seo_title.en: Turn Character Relationships into Gameplay

description.en: Let repeated player actions change access, trust, cooperation, or conflict instead of tracking relationships as a score alone.
description.zh: 让玩家反复行动改变权限、信任、合作或冲突，而不只把关系记成分数。

answer.en: Relationships become gameplay when player actions affect how characters cooperate, share information, or respond under pressure. Choose visible behaviors that express changing trust, then let those changes open or close ways to solve problems.
answer.zh: 玩家行动会影响人物如何合作、分享信息或应对压力时，关系才成为玩法。选择能体现信任变化的可见行为，再让变化开启或关闭解决问题的方式。

heading.en: Choose actions that build or strain the relationship
heading.zh: 选择能建立或损害关系的行动

body.en: A promise kept, resource shared, secret exposed, or boundary crossed can change cooperation. Tie the change to a specific event players understand instead of an invisible affection meter.
body.zh: 守约、分享资源、暴露秘密或越过边界都能改变合作。把变化连到玩家理解的具体事件，不要只靠看不见的好感值。

heading.en: Show changed behavior in later play
heading.zh: 在后续游玩中体现行为变化

body.en: An ally might volunteer help, withhold a clue, or refuse a risky order. The response should match what happened and remain consistent across dialogue, abilities, and story scenes.
body.zh: 盟友可能主动帮忙、保留线索，或拒绝危险命令。回应要符合已经发生的事，并在对白、能力和剧情中保持一致。

heading.en: Let the relationship affect the solution
heading.zh: 让关系影响问题的解决方式

body.en: Trust may let characters coordinate or accept a plan; damaged trust may force the player to use another route. Keep the central challenge solvable while making the relationship matter to how it is solved.
body.zh: 信任可以让人物配合或接受计划；信任受损则可能迫使玩家另寻路线。核心挑战仍应可解，同时让关系影响解决方式。

q.en: Do I need a numerical relationship score?
q.zh: 人物关系一定要用数值表示吗？

a.en: No. A few named states or remembered events can be easier to write and test. Use numbers only when gradual progression gives players meaningful feedback.
a.zh: 不必。少量命名状态或记忆事件可能更易编写和测试。只有渐进变化能给玩家有效反馈时，才采用数值。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Read Bestseller Charts for Novel Research
title.zh: 如何通过畅销榜研究小说读者与类型

seo_title.en: Read Bestseller Charts for Writers

description.en: Use chart patterns to research reader demand, then verify the signals against individual books before planning your story.
description.zh: 用榜单观察读者需求，再结合具体作品核实信号后规划故事。

answer.en: Bestseller charts can suggest which genres, themes, or reading experiences currently attract readers, but they cannot explain why a book succeeds. Compare repeated patterns across titles, read examples directly, and treat chart signals as research questions rather than formulas.
answer.zh: 畅销榜能提示当前受欢迎的类型、主题或阅读体验，却不能说明单本书为何成功。比较多部作品的共同特征，亲自阅读例子，并把榜单信号当作研究问题而非公式。

heading.en: Compare patterns across more than one chart position
heading.zh: 比较多个榜位的共同模式

body.en: Note recurring genres, formats, hooks, or series placement across a group of books. One breakout title may reflect a specific audience or promotion; repeated signals deserve closer reading.
body.zh: 记录一组书中反复出现的类型、形式、开篇吸引点或系列位置。单本爆款可能来自特定读者群或推广；重复信号更值得深入阅读。

heading.en: Check the books behind the signal
heading.zh: 阅读榜单背后的具体作品

body.en: Inspect descriptions, opening chapters, pacing, and reader feedback where available. Ask what promise the book makes and how its actual scenes deliver it, rather than inferring craft from rank alone.
body.zh: 阅读作品简介、开篇、节奏及可查的读者反馈。判断它承诺了什么、实际场景如何兑现，而不是只凭排名推测写法。

heading.en: Turn research into a story decision
heading.zh: 把研究转成故事决定

body.en: Choose one audience signal that fits your own interests and skills. Write a test premise or scene, then judge whether the idea can sustain a distinct character arc and plot beyond the trend label.
body.zh: 选一个符合自己兴趣和能力的读者信号。试写故事构想或场景，再判断它能否在趋势标签之外支撑独特人物弧线和情节。

q.en: Can a bestseller chart predict what will sell next?
q.zh: 畅销榜能预测下一个畅销题材吗？

a.en: No. A chart is a snapshot affected by timing and audience. Use it to notice questions worth researching, and make story choices based on a promise you can write convincingly.
a.zh: 不能。榜单受时机和读者群影响，只是一个截面。可用它发现值得研究的问题，但创作决定应基于自己能写好的故事承诺。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Write a Contemporary Romance Novel with a Complete Arc
title.zh: 如何写出感情弧线完整的当代言情小说

seo_title.en: Write a Contemporary Romance Novel

description.en: Build attraction, conflict, trust, and a satisfying relationship choice around characters' present-day goals.
description.zh: 围绕人物的当代目标，发展吸引、冲突、信任和令人满足的关系选择。

answer.en: A contemporary romance pairs a developing relationship with the characters' current lives and pressures. Give both leads goals beyond the couple, let attraction meet a believable incompatibility, and make trust grow through choices before the romantic resolution.
answer.zh: 当代言情把发展中的关系与人物当下生活和压力结合。让双方都有恋爱之外的目标，让吸引遇上可信的不合，再通过选择建立信任，最后推进情感结局。

heading.en: Give each lead a present-day goal
heading.zh: 为双方安排当下目标

body.en: Work, family, friendship, or personal plans can create the characters' immediate stakes. Let those goals shape where they meet and what a relationship would change for each person.
body.zh: 工作、家庭、友情或个人计划都能构成人物眼前利害。让这些目标决定两人如何相遇，以及关系会为各自生活带来什么变化。

heading.en: Make attraction and conflict come from the same traits
heading.zh: 让吸引和冲突源自同一特点

body.en: A character's ambition may be exciting and difficult to live with; another's caution may feel safe and limiting. Build friction from values or strategies rather than a misunderstanding that could end with one question.
body.zh: 一个人的野心可能令人心动，却难以相处；另一个人的谨慎可能让人安心，也显得保守。让冲突来自价值观或策略，而非一句话就能解开的误会。

heading.en: Earn the relationship decision
heading.zh: 让关系决定建立在过程之上

body.en: Show the leads listening, repairing harm, and respecting boundaries under pressure. The ending should reflect what they learned and what each is willing to change, while preserving a convincing happy or hopeful future.
body.zh: 在压力中写出双方倾听、修复伤害和尊重边界。结尾要体现他们学到什么、愿意改变什么，并给出可信的幸福或希望未来。

q.en: Does contemporary romance need a happy ending?
q.zh: 当代言情必须有幸福结局吗？

a.en: Readers generally expect a satisfying romantic resolution. If the relationship remains open or bittersweet, make the book's promise clear and resolve the emotional arc this story set up.
a.zh: 读者通常期待令人满足的爱情结局。若关系保持开放或带有苦涩，要提前明确作品承诺，并完成本书建立的情感弧线。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Plan an Epic Fantasy Series One Book at a Time
title.zh: 如何逐卷规划史诗奇幻系列

seo_title.en: Plan an Epic Fantasy Series

description.en: Balance a large world conflict with each volume's own goal, character change, and payoff.
description.zh: 用每卷独立目标、人物变化与回报，平衡宏大世界冲突。

answer.en: An epic fantasy series spans a large conflict without making every book feel like a fragment. Define the long arc, give each volume a local objective and consequence, and track only the world rules and relationships later installments depend on.
answer.zh: 史诗奇幻系列要容纳宏大冲突，也要避免每卷像未完成的片段。明确长线弧线，为每卷设置局部目标和后果，并追踪后续依赖的世界规则与关系。

heading.en: Separate the series question from this volume's question
heading.zh: 区分系列主问题和本卷问题

body.en: The series may ask who should rule while one volume asks whether a city can survive a siege. Resolve the volume's immediate conflict and let its result alter the larger struggle.
body.zh: 系列可以追问谁应统治，本卷则解决一座城市能否挺过围城。完成本卷眼前冲突，并让结果改变长线斗争。

heading.en: Limit worldbuilding to rules that drive choices
heading.zh: 只展开会影响选择的世界规则

body.en: Magic, geography, history, and institutions matter when they create costs or close options. Keep a reference for the facts that recur, and reveal new rules when the plot needs a character to act on them.
body.zh: 魔法、地理、历史和制度在带来代价或关闭选项时才重要。记录会反复使用的事实，等情节需要人物据此行动时再揭示新规则。

heading.en: Track promises and consequences across volumes
heading.zh: 跨卷追踪承诺与后果

body.en: Keep a compact record of unresolved questions, alliances, and world changes. Give each book payoffs from earlier setup while planting the next conflict through consequences rather than an unrelated new threat.
body.zh: 简要记录未解决问题、联盟关系和世界变化。每卷兑现早先铺垫的回报，并通过后果引出下一场冲突，而非突然添加无关威胁。

q.en: Should I outline every volume before writing the first?
q.zh: 第一卷动笔前要把所有卷都列完吗？

a.en: Plan the series direction and major irreversible turns, but leave room to adjust. A clear volume outline and continuity record are more useful than locking every future scene too early.
a.zh: 先规划系列方向和重要不可逆转折，同时保留调整空间。清晰的单卷大纲与连续性记录，比过早锁定每个未来场景更有用。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Write a Historical Mystery with Fair Clues
title.zh: 如何写出线索公平的历史悬疑小说

seo_title.en: Write a Historical Mystery

description.en: Use period-specific access, evidence, and social rules to shape a solvable mystery and a credible investigation.
description.zh: 利用时代特有的权限、证据和社会规则，构建可推理且可信的调查。

answer.en: A historical mystery combines a fair puzzle with the constraints of its period. Give the investigator a credible way to gather evidence, establish social and technical limits, and let historically grounded details affect both suspects' opportunities and the solution.
answer.zh: 历史悬疑结合公平谜题与时代限制。给调查者合理的取证方式，建立社会与技术边界，并让有史实依据的细节影响嫌疑人机会和解答。

heading.en: Choose a mystery the period can shape
heading.zh: 选择能被时代条件塑造的谜案

body.en: A restricted travel route, class rule, communication delay, or record-keeping practice can change who has access and what can be known. Use limits that matter to the case rather than adding period detail as decoration.
body.zh: 受限路线、阶层规矩、通信延迟或记录方式，都能改变谁有权限、什么信息可得。选择影响案件的限制，不要只把时代细节当装饰。

heading.en: Make the investigation possible but difficult
heading.zh: 让调查可行但不容易

body.en: Show why the protagonist can ask questions or inspect evidence, and what social cost they face. Let every clue be available to readers before the solution, with enough context to interpret it.
body.zh: 说明主角为何能够询问或检查证据，以及会面对什么社会代价。确保读者能在解答前看到线索，并获得足够语境来理解。

heading.en: Research details that change causality
heading.zh: 优先研究会改变因果关系的细节

body.en: Verify transport, communication, law, medicine, and daily tools when they determine timing or access. Keep notes with sources and distinguish documented fact from a choice made for the fictional plot.
body.zh: 交通、通信、法律、医疗或日常工具会决定时间和权限时，要核实细节。保存来源记录，并区分有据事实和为剧情做出的虚构选择。

q.en: How much historical detail should I include?
q.zh: 历史细节应该写多少？

a.en: Include details that affect a character's action, evidence, or expectation. A few consequential facts are clearer than a large research dump that pauses the mystery.
a.zh: 写入会影响人物行动、证据或预期的细节。少量有后果的事实，比打断悬疑的大段资料罗列更清楚。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Write a Mystery Series with a Recurring Detective
title.zh: 如何写好由固定侦探贯穿的推理系列

seo_title.en: Write a Detective Mystery Series

description.en: Give every case a fair resolution while changing the detective's life, relationships, or methods over time.
description.zh: 每案都有公平解答，同时逐步改变侦探的生活、关系或方法。

answer.en: A recurring-detective series balances a complete case with a continuing character arc. Make each mystery independently understandable and solvable, then let its outcome alter the detective's relationships, limits, or approach in later books.
answer.zh: 固定侦探系列要平衡单案完整性与长期人物弧线。让每个谜案独立易懂且可推理，再让结果改变侦探后续的人际关系、限制或方法。

heading.en: Design a case that stands on its own
heading.zh: 设计可以独立阅读的案件

body.en: Introduce the victim or problem, the investigator's access, and the clue path within each book. Returning readers can enjoy callbacks, but new readers should understand why this case matters now.
body.zh: 每本书都交代受害者或问题、调查者的权限和线索链。老读者可以享受呼应，新读者也要理解本案为何重要。

heading.en: Let the detective change without repeating the same lesson
heading.zh: 让侦探成长，避免重复同一课题

body.en: Track what the detective believes, what their method costs, and what the last case changed. Each new challenge can test an evolved strategy instead of replaying an old personal conflict.
body.zh: 记录侦探的信念、方法代价，以及上一案带来的变化。新案件可以考验进化后的策略，而不是重演旧的人际冲突。

heading.en: Manage recurring facts and reader entry points
heading.zh: 管理常驻信息与新读者入口

body.en: Keep a short series guide for recurring characters, unresolved changes, and timeline facts. Reintroduce only what the current case needs through action or dialogue, not a page of recap.
body.zh: 用简短系列手册记录常驻人物、未解决变化和时间线事实。只通过行动或对白重提本案所需信息，不要用整页复述。

q.en: Can readers start with any book in the series?
q.zh: 读者可以从系列任意一本开始吗？

a.en: If each case resolves, usually yes. Signal when a major relationship or past outcome changes the current story, and provide enough context to follow without retelling earlier books.
a.zh: 每个案件都有结局时通常可以。若重大关系或旧事影响当前故事，就给出必要背景，但不必重讲前几本。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Write a Short-Film Screenplay from an Idea
title.zh: 如何从一个点子写出短片剧本

seo_title.en: Write a Short-Film Screenplay

description.en: Build a filmable short around one central change, a small cast, and a visual ending that answers the opening setup.
description.zh: 围绕一个核心变化、精简人物和回应开场的视觉结尾，搭建可拍短片。

answer.en: A short-film screenplay centers on one situation that changes within limited time. Choose a filmable premise, give the protagonist a goal and resistance, and use each scene to move toward a final action or image that resolves the short's question.
answer.zh: 短片剧本围绕有限时间内发生变化的一个情境展开。选择可拍的构想，为主角设定目标和阻力，并让每场戏走向回应短片问题的最终行动或画面。

heading.en: Limit the story to one central turn
heading.zh: 把故事限制在一个核心转折

body.en: A short has little room for several full arcs. Pick the decision, discovery, or relationship change the audience should remember, and remove background events that do not lead to it.
body.zh: 短片很难容纳多条完整弧线。选定观众应记住的决定、发现或关系变化，删去与之无关的背景事件。

heading.en: Write for locations and actions you can show
heading.zh: 围绕能呈现的场景和行动写作

body.en: Choose a few controllable locations and moments with clear visual behavior. Let a prop, movement, or interruption communicate information when possible, and plan production constraints into the premise early.
body.zh: 选择少量可控地点和有清晰视觉行动的时刻。尽可能用道具、动作或打断传达信息，并尽早把制作限制纳入构想。

heading.en: Make the last image answer the first
heading.zh: 让最后画面回应开场

body.en: The ending can reverse an opening image, fulfill its promise, or show a cost the character avoided before. Check that the final beat changes the situation rather than simply stopping the action.
body.zh: 结尾可以反转开场画面、兑现它的承诺，或呈现人物此前逃避的代价。检查最后节拍是否改变局势，而非只是停止行动。

q.en: How many characters should a short film have?
q.zh: 短片应该安排多少个人物？

a.en: As many as the story needs, but each should change the pressure or information. A focused cast makes a short screenplay easier to stage and gives limited screen time more weight.
a.zh: 按故事需要安排，但每个人物都应改变压力或信息。人物精简更容易调度，也能让有限篇幅更有分量。
