text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Write a TV Pilot That Introduces a Repeatable Story Engine
title.zh: 如何写出建立持续故事引擎的电视剧试播集

seo_title.en: Write a TV Pilot Script

description.en: Introduce the protagonist, world, and central conflict while showing how future episodes can create new stories.
description.zh: 介绍主角、世界和核心冲突，同时展示后续集数如何持续产生故事。

answer.en: A TV pilot must deliver an engaging episode and demonstrate the series can continue. Introduce a character with a repeatable source of pressure, resolve a local problem, and leave a changed situation that can generate the next episode.
answer.zh: 电视剧试播集既要讲好单集，也要证明系列可以延续。为主角设定可持续的压力来源，解决一个局部问题，并留下能催生下一集的新局面。

heading.en: Show the weekly or ongoing story engine
heading.zh: 展示单集或长线故事引擎

body.en: Identify what brings new cases, conflicts, or decisions to the characters. Let the pilot dramatize that engine in action instead of explaining a list of future episode ideas.
body.zh: 明确什么会持续给人物带来案件、冲突或决定。让试播集实际演示这个引擎，而非解释一串未来选题。

heading.en: Resolve a local problem while opening the series arc
heading.zh: 解决单集问题，同时开启系列主线

body.en: Give the episode a goal and consequence viewers can follow to completion. Seed a larger relationship or mystery that changes the next choice without making the pilot feel like half an episode.
body.zh: 为单集设置观众能跟到底的目标和后果。埋下一条会改变后续决定的关系或谜团，同时别让试播集像只播了一半。

heading.en: Make the format legible through behavior
heading.zh: 通过人物行动让剧集模式清晰

body.en: Show how characters work together, what rules shape their choices, and where conflict tends to arise. A pilot's repeated pattern should feel capable of variation, not like the same plot copied forward.
body.zh: 展示人物如何合作、什么规则影响决定、冲突通常从何而来。试播集建立的模式应有变化空间，而非同一情节反复复制。

q.en: Does a TV pilot need a cliffhanger?
q.zh: 电视剧试播集必须用悬念结尾吗？

a.en: No. It needs a reason to return, which can be an unresolved question, a new responsibility, or a promising character dynamic after the episode's local payoff.
a.zh: 不必。只要有继续观看的理由即可，可以是未解问题、新责任或有潜力的人物关系，并且最好先兑现本集回报。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Create a Short-Drama Series Bible
title.zh: 如何制作短剧系列设定手册

seo_title.en: Create a Short-Drama Series Bible
seo_title.zh: 制作短剧系列设定手册

description.en: Capture the series promise, character goals, world rules, episode engine, and continuity facts the team must share.
description.zh: 记录团队共同需要的系列承诺、人物目标、世界规则、单集引擎和连续性事实。

answer.en: A short-drama series bible gives writers and production teams a shared reference for the story they are building. State the audience promise, character goals, repeatable conflict engine, visual rules, and facts future episodes must preserve.
answer.zh: 短剧系列设定手册为编剧和制作团队提供共同参考。写清受众承诺、人物目标、可持续冲突机制、视觉规则，以及后续集数必须遵守的事实。

heading.en: State the series promise and episode engine
heading.zh: 写明系列承诺和单集引擎

body.en: Describe the central appeal in one or two sentences and explain what repeatedly brings the characters into conflict. Make clear how episodes vary while still feeling like the same series.
body.zh: 用一两句话说明核心吸引力，并解释什么会反复引发人物冲突。写清每集如何变化，同时仍像同一部系列。

heading.en: Record character goals and non-negotiable facts
heading.zh: 记录人物目标和不可改动的事实

body.en: Track what each character wants, what they know, and which relationships or boundaries matter. Note secrets, injuries, prop states, and events that later scenes depend on.
body.zh: 记录每个人物想要什么、知道什么，以及重要关系或边界。标注后续依赖的秘密、伤势、道具状态和事件。

heading.en: Make the guide usable during production
heading.zh: 让手册能在制作过程中使用

body.en: Use concise headings, scene references, and images when they clarify appearance or staging. Update the relevant entry after approved story changes so writers, artists, and editors do not work from conflicting versions.
body.zh: 用简明标题、场次编号和必要的外观或调度参考图。故事修改获批后及时更新相关条目，避免编剧、美术和剪辑使用不同版本。

q.en: Should a series bible include every episode's full outline?
q.zh: 系列手册要包含每集的完整大纲吗？

a.en: Not necessarily. Include the format and continuity facts the team needs, then keep episode outlines in a separate working document that can change more often.
a.zh: 不一定。手册记录团队需要的格式与连续性事实；变化更频繁的单集大纲可以放在单独工作文档中。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Adapt a Short Story into a Film Script
title.zh: 如何把短篇小说改编成电影剧本

seo_title.en: Adapt a Short Story into a Film Script
seo_title.zh: 短篇小说改成电影剧本

description.en: Identify the source's central change, then express it through filmable actions, scenes, and a visual ending.
description.zh: 找出原作的核心变化，再用可拍行动、场景和视觉结局呈现。

answer.en: Adapt a short story by preserving the experience or choice that makes it meaningful while changing prose that depends on narration. Identify the central turn, choose filmable behavior and images, and combine or remove events that do not serve the new runtime.
answer.zh: 改编短篇小说时，保留让作品有意义的体验或选择，同时改写依赖叙述的部分。找出核心转折，选择可拍行为和画面，并合并或删除不适合片长的事件。

heading.en: Find the source story's essential change
heading.zh: 找出原作最重要的变化

body.en: Ask what the protagonist believes or wants at the start and what becomes different by the end. Protect that transformation even if scenes, chronology, or supporting characters change.
body.zh: 判断主角开头相信或想要什么，以及结尾发生何种改变。即便场景、时间顺序或配角调整，也要保留这一转变。

heading.en: Translate narration into playable film evidence
heading.zh: 把叙述转成可拍的影视证据

body.en: Replace interior explanation with a decision, gesture, object, sound, or reaction that lets viewers infer the meaning. Use voice-over only when it adds a perspective the images cannot provide.
body.zh: 把内心解释转成决定、动作、物件、声音或反应，让观众自行理解。只有画面无法呈现某种视角时，才使用旁白。

heading.en: Reshape the events for the new length
heading.zh: 按新的片长重组事件

body.en: Combine characters or locations when they perform the same story function. Keep enough setup for the ending to feel earned, and remove incidents that do not affect the protagonist's decisive choice.
body.zh: 人物或地点承担相同作用时可以合并。保留足以支撑结尾的铺垫，删去不影响主角关键选择的事件。

q.en: Does a film adaptation need to follow the source scene by scene?
q.zh: 影视改编必须逐场照搬原作吗？

a.en: No. Preserve the story's central promise and important consequences, then choose the scenes and order that work for the screen and intended runtime.
a.zh: 不必。保留故事核心承诺和重要后果，再选择适合银幕和目标片长的场景与顺序。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Pitch a TV Series in a Clear One-Page Overview
title.zh: 如何用一页清晰介绍推介电视剧系列

seo_title.en: Write a TV Series Pitch

description.en: Explain the show premise, protagonist, recurring engine, tone, and season direction in a concise pitch.
description.zh: 用简洁推介说明剧集构想、主角、持续故事机制、基调和季节走向。

answer.en: A TV-series pitch should help a reader imagine both the pilot and the episodes that follow. State the premise, protagonist's goal, repeatable source of conflict, tone, and season arc, then make the show's difference concrete with a specific example.
answer.zh: 电视剧推介要让读者想象试播集和后续集数。说明故事构想、主角目标、持续冲突来源、基调和季节弧线，再用具体例子呈现独特之处。

heading.en: Lead with a concise premise
heading.zh: 先用简洁构想开场

body.en: Name who the show follows, what they do, and what keeps making their situation difficult. Avoid a long history of the world before the reader understands the weekly or ongoing story.
body.zh: 说明故事跟随谁、人物做什么、什么会持续让局面困难。读者还不清楚单集或长线故事前，别先讲一大段世界历史。

heading.en: Show how episodes keep generating conflict
heading.zh: 说明每集如何持续产生冲突

body.en: Give an example of a typical case, mission, or relationship problem and explain how it tests the protagonist. This proves the concept can sustain more than one strong opening.
body.zh: 举例说明典型案件、任务或关系问题，以及它如何考验主角。这能证明构想不只适合写一个出彩开场。

heading.en: Describe the season promise and tone
heading.zh: 描述季节承诺与基调

body.en: Summarize the major change or question that will carry the season without revealing every twist. Use specific tonal comparisons or scene details that clarify the viewing experience.
body.zh: 概括贯穿一季的主要变化或问题，不必泄露所有反转。用具体的基调参照或场景细节说明观众会看到什么体验。

q.en: Should a TV pitch include a full episode guide?
q.zh: 电视剧推介需要附完整分集大纲吗？

a.en: Only when requested. A compact pitch should first make the series engine, lead, and season direction easy to understand; detailed episode outlines can follow separately.
a.zh: 只有对方要求时才附。简明推介应先讲清系列机制、主角和季节方向；详细分集大纲可另行提供。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Write Clear Action Lines in a Screenplay
title.zh: 如何写清晰的剧本动作行

seo_title.en: Write Screenplay Action Lines

description.en: Describe observable behavior, essential screen information, and changes that actors and production can execute.
description.zh: 描述可观察行为、必要画面信息，以及演员和制作团队能执行的变化。

answer.en: Screenplay action lines should tell readers what can be seen or heard and what changes in the scene. Use present-tense, concrete verbs, keep paragraphs easy to scan, and include only details that affect performance, story, or production.
answer.zh: 剧本动作行要说明观众能看到或听到什么，以及场景发生了什么变化。使用现在时和具体动词，段落便于浏览，只写影响表演、故事或制作的细节。

heading.en: Describe behavior instead of camera-proof thoughts
heading.zh: 描写行为，不写无法呈现的想法

body.en: Replace “he realizes she lied” with a pause, a look at the receipt, or a changed question. Let the action give performers and viewers evidence without stating a private conclusion.
body.zh: 把“他意识到她撒谎”改成停顿、看向收据或换一个问题。让行动给演员和观众提供证据，而不是直接写出内心结论。

heading.en: Keep the lines short and active
heading.zh: 保持句子简短主动

body.en: Put one main action or image in each paragraph and choose verbs that reveal timing. Short, readable blocks help a producer picture the scene and keep the script moving on the page.
body.zh: 每段集中写一个主要动作或画面，并选择能体现时机的动词。简短易读的段落便于制片想象场景，也让剧本翻页更顺。

heading.en: Include details that affect the next beat
heading.zh: 保留会影响后续节拍的细节

body.en: Track a prop being hidden, a door left open, or a character's changed position when later action depends on it. Cut decorative direction that cannot be filmed or does not alter the scene.
body.zh: 后续行动依赖道具被藏起、门没关或人物位置变化时，就要记录。删掉无法拍摄或不会改变场景的装饰性指示。

q.en: Can action lines include a character's emotion?
q.zh: 动作行可以写人物情绪吗？

a.en: Yes, when the cue helps performers and is supported by visible behavior. Pair a useful emotional direction with a playable action so the scene does not rely on an invisible label.
a.zh: 可以，只要提示有助于表演且有可见行为支撑。把情绪说明和可执行动作结合，避免场景只依赖看不见的标签。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Outline a Documentary Video Around a Clear Story Question
title.zh: 如何围绕清晰问题搭建纪录片视频大纲

seo_title.en: Outline a Documentary Video

description.en: Choose a question the available evidence can answer, then organize people, events, and discoveries into a fair progression.
description.zh: 选择现有证据能够回答的问题，再公平地组织人物、事件和发现。

answer.en: A documentary outline turns a subject into a story question and evidence-led progression. Identify what viewers need to understand, what sources can establish, and how new information changes the question; do not promise a resolution the material cannot support.
answer.zh: 纪录片大纲将主题转成故事问题和证据驱动的推进。明确观众需要理解什么、来源能证明什么、新信息如何改变问题；不要承诺材料无法支持的结论。

heading.en: Choose a question with available evidence
heading.zh: 选择证据能够回答的问题

body.en: A broad subject can hold many films. Narrow it to a decision, conflict, or change that interviews, documents, and images can illuminate, then record what remains unknown.
body.zh: 一个宽泛主题可以拍很多部片。收窄到访谈、文件和画面能够呈现的决定、冲突或变化，并记录仍然未知的部分。

heading.en: Build the sequence from discovery and consequence
heading.zh: 围绕发现与后果组织顺序

body.en: Arrange evidence so viewers understand the context before an important claim. Show what a discovery changes for the people involved, and leave uncertainty visible when the sources disagree.
body.zh: 在重要观点出现前先交代必要背景。展示新发现给相关人物带来的变化；来源不一致时保留不确定性。

heading.en: Plan interviews, images, and narration together
heading.zh: 同步规划访谈、画面和旁白

body.en: Note which source carries each beat and what additional visual evidence is needed. Use narration to connect or clarify material, not to assert a conclusion the interviews cannot substantiate.
body.zh: 标明每个节拍由什么来源承载，以及还需哪些视觉材料。用旁白连接或解释素材，不要宣称访谈无法证明的结论。

q.en: Can I write the documentary outline before filming?
q.zh: 可以在拍摄前写纪录片大纲吗？

a.en: Yes, as a working hypothesis. Update it as interviews and footage reveal new evidence, and distinguish planned scenes from events already verified.
a.zh: 可以，但它只是工作假设。访谈和影像提供新证据时要更新，并区分计划拍摄内容与已经核实的事件。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Build a Character Timeline for a TV Recap
title.zh: 如何为电视剧解说整理人物时间线

seo_title.en: TV Recap Character Timeline
seo_title.zh: 电视剧解说人物时间线

description.en: Track each character's knowledge, actions, and changing goals across episodes to keep a recap accurate.
description.zh: 追踪人物跨集的认知、行动和目标变化，确保解说准确。

answer.en: A character timeline helps a recap writer keep events, knowledge, and motives in the right order across an episode or season. Record when each character learns a fact, makes a choice, and faces a consequence, then check narration against the timeline.
answer.zh: 人物时间线能帮助解说作者在单集或整季中理顺事件、认知和动机。记录每个人何时知道事实、作出选择并面对后果，再对照时间线检查旁白。

heading.en: Track events and knowledge separately
heading.zh: 分别记录事件和人物认知

body.en: The audience may see a clue before one character does. Note both when an event happens and when each person learns about it so the recap does not give someone knowledge too early.
body.zh: 观众可能比角色更早看到线索。分别记下事件发生时间和每个人得知的时间，避免解说让人物过早掌握信息。

heading.en: Note goal changes at each turning point
heading.zh: 在每个转折处记录目标变化

body.en: Record what the character wants before and after a reveal, loss, or alliance. This turns a sequence of appearances into a readable arc instead of a list of scenes.
body.zh: 记录人物在揭示、失去或结盟前后想要什么。这样出场片段就能构成易懂的弧线，而不是场景清单。

heading.en: Check chronology against the source
heading.zh: 对照原片核对时间顺序

body.en: Verify flashbacks, simultaneous events, and episode boundaries with timestamps or source notes. Distinguish a character's belief from what the story later confirms.
body.zh: 用时间码或来源笔记核实闪回、同步事件和分集边界。区分人物的相信与故事后来确认的事实。

q.en: Do I need a timeline for every character?
q.zh: 每个人物都需要单独时间线吗？

a.en: Track the characters whose knowledge or choices affect the explanation. For a large cast, keep one shared event timeline and add character notes only where their paths differ.
a.zh: 追踪认知或选择会影响解说的人物即可。群像较大时，先维护共同事件线，再为路线不同的人补充备注。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Structure a Long-Form Movie Recap Video
title.zh: 如何搭建长篇电影解说视频结构

seo_title.en: Structure a Long-Form Movie Recap

description.en: Divide the film into readable movements, preserve turning points, and keep narration tied to what the source shows.
description.zh: 将影片划分为易懂段落，保留关键转折，并让旁白紧扣原片证据。

answer.en: A long-form movie recap should help viewers follow the protagonist's changing goal and the consequences that lead to the ending. Group scenes into story movements, retain essential turns and evidence, and use transitions to orient the audience without repeating the plot.
answer.zh: 长篇电影解说要让观众跟上主角目标如何变化，以及事件如何导向结局。将场景归入故事段落，保留必要转折和证据，并用转接帮助定位，避免重复剧情。

heading.en: Divide the film by changes in the protagonist's plan
heading.zh: 根据主角计划变化划分段落

body.en: Use the initial goal, major setback, changed strategy, and final confrontation as possible anchors. Each section should leave the character in a different position or with a new question.
body.zh: 可以用初始目标、重大挫折、策略改变和最终对抗作为段落锚点。每段结束时，人物都应处于不同局面或面对新问题。

heading.en: Keep the evidence that explains the turn
heading.zh: 保留解释转折所需的证据

body.en: A recap can compress repeated travel or routine, but should retain the clue, conversation, or choice that makes the next event plausible. Check the original before shortening a reveal.
body.zh: 解说可以压缩重复的路程或日常，但要保留让后续可信的线索、对话或选择。缩短揭示前先回看原片。

heading.en: Vary pace with pauses and visual changes
heading.zh: 通过停顿和画面变化调整节奏

body.en: Use faster narration for familiar movement and give key reactions or clues more room. Break a long sequence when a new goal, location, or relationship changes the viewer's question.
body.zh: 熟悉的过程可讲快些；关键反应或线索则多留空间。新目标、地点或关系改变观众问题时，拆开长段叙述。

q.en: How do I keep a long recap from feeling repetitive?
q.zh: 如何避免长篇解说显得重复？

a.en: Let each section answer a new question or change the story state. Trim narration that repeats visible actions, and use brief transitions to connect causes, time, and consequences.
a.zh: 让每段回应新问题或改变故事状态。删掉重复画面动作的旁白，用简短转接串起因果、时间和后果。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Design a Narrative State Table for a Game
title.zh: 如何为游戏设计叙事状态表

seo_title.en: Game Narrative State Table

description.en: List the facts, relationships, resources, and decisions that later scenes need to check and reflect.
description.zh: 列出后续场景需要读取和体现的事实、关系、资源与决定。

answer.en: A narrative state table records information that changes what scenes, dialogue, or outcomes the game can present. Name each state, define when it changes and where it is checked, then keep only variables that create observable differences for players or writers.
answer.zh: 叙事状态表记录会改变游戏可呈现场景、对白或结果的信息。为每种状态命名，定义何时更新、何处读取，只保留会为玩家或编剧带来可见差异的变量。

heading.en: Define states in plain language
heading.zh: 用通俗语言定义状态

body.en: Examples include whether the player shared a clue, owes a favor, or has access to a location. Make conditions distinct and record the event that sets each state.
body.zh: 例如玩家是否分享过线索、是否欠下人情、能否进入某地点。明确条件差异，并记录触发每个状态的事件。

heading.en: Link each state to scenes that use it
heading.zh: 把状态关联到读取它的场景

body.en: For every variable, list the dialogue, route, or ending it can change. If no content reads the state, remove it or design a visible payoff before implementation grows.
body.zh: 为每个变量列出它能改变的对白、路线或结局。如果没有内容读取它，就删掉，或在实现扩大前设计可见回报。

heading.en: Test combinations that can conflict
heading.zh: 测试可能互相冲突的状态组合

body.en: Check what happens when players have several flags at once, especially when characters know different facts. Define priority or fallback behavior so contradictory lines do not appear together.
body.zh: 检查多个标记同时成立时会发生什么，尤其要关注人物掌握不同事实的情况。定义优先级或备用呈现，避免矛盾台词同时出现。

q.en: Should narrative state use only true-or-false variables?
q.zh: 叙事状态只能用是或否变量吗？

a.en: No. Use a small set of named values when a relationship or world condition has more than two useful states. Choose the simplest representation writers and implementers can test.
a.zh: 不必。关系或世界状态存在多个有意义阶段时，可以用少量命名值。选择编剧和实现人员都能测试的最简单形式。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Write Clear Objectives for a Story-Driven Game Quest
title.zh: 如何为剧情任务写清晰的游戏目标

seo_title.en: Write Clear Game Quest Objectives

description.en: Tell players what action advances the quest, why it matters, and how they can recognize progress without spoiling every discovery.
description.zh: 让玩家知道什么行动能推进任务、为何重要，以及如何察觉进展，同时保留发现空间。

answer.en: A clear quest objective names an action the player can attempt and gives enough context to understand its purpose. Use observable verbs, update the objective when the plan changes, and let the world show progress where possible.
answer.zh: 清晰任务目标会说明玩家可以尝试的行动，并提供理解目的所需背景。使用可观察动词，计划改变时更新目标，并尽可能通过世界反馈进展。

heading.en: Use an action the player can recognize
heading.zh: 使用玩家能识别的行动

body.en: “Find the missing engineer” is easier to act on than “learn more about the station.” Name the person, object, place, or interaction while keeping the discovery itself open.
body.zh: “找到失踪的工程师”比“了解空间站更多情况”更可执行。写明人物、物品、地点或互动，同时保留发现过程。

heading.en: Explain the goal's stakes through context
heading.zh: 通过上下文说明目标利害

body.en: A short line from a character or scene can explain why the task matters. Avoid front-loading a paragraph of lore before the player has seen the problem.
body.zh: 一句人物台词或一个场景就能解释目标为何重要。玩家尚未见到问题前，不要先塞一大段背景设定。

heading.en: Update the objective when evidence changes the plan
heading.zh: 证据改变计划时更新目标

body.en: If the player discovers a blocked route or new suspect, reflect the new task and preserve completed progress. Check that the journal, map marker, and dialogue do not contradict one another.
body.zh: 玩家发现路线被封或出现新嫌疑人时，要更新任务并保留已完成进度。检查日志、地图标记和对白没有互相矛盾。

q.en: Should a quest objective tell players exactly where to go?
q.zh: 任务目标要直接告诉玩家去哪里吗？

a.en: Give precise directions when navigation is the challenge or accessibility requires them. If investigation is part of play, state the goal and useful clues without revealing every step.
a.zh: 导航本身有挑战或出于无障碍需求时，可以给出精确指引。如果玩法包含调查，就说明目标和有效线索，但不必揭晓每一步。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Write Flash Fiction with a Complete Story Arc
title.zh: 如何写出弧线完整的闪小说

seo_title.en: Write a Flash-Fiction Story

description.en: Focus a very short story on one character, one pressure point, and a change the reader can feel.
description.zh: 围绕一个人物、一个压力点和读者能感受到的变化，写好极短篇故事。

answer.en: Flash fiction creates a complete reading experience in very little space. Choose one moment where a character must act or reinterpret something, remove context the reader can infer, and make the ending change how the opening is understood.
answer.zh: 闪小说用很短篇幅创造完整阅读体验。选择人物必须行动或重新理解某事的时刻，删去读者能推断的背景，并让结尾改变开头的含义。

heading.en: Build around one decisive moment
heading.zh: 围绕一个决定性时刻搭建

body.en: Give the character a visible want and a small but real obstacle. A single exchange, object, or interruption can carry the history the story does not have room to explain.
body.zh: 为人物设定可见愿望和虽小但真实的阻碍。一段互动、一件物品或一次打断，都能承载故事来不及解释的背景。

heading.en: Let details do more than one job
heading.zh: 让细节同时承担多种作用

body.en: A recurring object can establish setting, reveal a relationship, and return with a changed meaning. Choose details that also affect action so description does not consume space without moving the story.
body.zh: 反复出现的物件可以交代环境、揭示关系，并在回归时拥有新含义。选择也会影响行动的细节，避免描写占篇幅却不推动故事。

heading.en: End with a shift the reader can recognize
heading.zh: 以读者能察觉的变化收尾

body.en: The ending might reveal what a gesture meant, show the cost of a choice, or alter a relationship in one concrete action. Trim explanations that repeat what the final image already communicates.
body.zh: 结尾可以揭示动作含义、展示选择代价，或用一个具体行动改变关系。删掉重复说明最后画面已经传达的内容。

q.en: Does flash fiction need a twist ending?
q.zh: 闪小说必须有反转结局吗？

a.en: No. A quiet decision, emotional recognition, or completed image can resolve the story. Use a twist only when the setup makes it fair and meaningful.
a.zh: 不必。安静的决定、情感认知或完整画面都能收束故事。只有铺垫充分且有意义时才使用反转。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Write an Epistolary Novel That Feels Like a Story
title.zh: 如何写出有故事推进力的书信体小说

seo_title.en: Write an Epistolary Novel

description.en: Use letters, messages, records, or posts to reveal changing relationships and information with a clear narrative progression.
description.zh: 用信件、消息、记录或帖子展现关系与信息变化，并保持叙事推进。

answer.en: An epistolary novel tells its story through documents such as letters, messages, diaries, or transcripts. Give each document a reason to exist, a writer or source with a point of view, and information that changes what the reader or another character understands.
answer.zh: 书信体小说通过信件、消息、日记或记录讲述故事。每份材料都应有存在理由、带视角的作者或来源，并改变读者或其他人物的认知。

heading.en: Choose a document form that fits the conflict
heading.zh: 选择符合冲突的文档形式

body.en: Private letters can hide or expose intimacy; reports may record evidence; messages can show timing and omission. Use forms the characters would plausibly create or preserve.
body.zh: 私人信件可以隐藏或暴露亲密关系，报告可以记录证据，消息能呈现时机和遗漏。选择人物有理由创作或保存的形式。

heading.en: Make each voice and audience distinct
heading.zh: 区分每份材料的声音和受众

body.en: A document written to persuade differs from one written to remember or perform for an audience. Let vocabulary, omissions, and detail reveal who is speaking and what they want the recipient to believe.
body.zh: 用于说服的材料不同于用于回忆或公开展示的文字。通过用词、遗漏和细节呈现写作者身份，以及希望收件人相信什么。

heading.en: Build a sequence of discoveries and consequences
heading.zh: 通过发现和后果推动材料顺序

body.en: Order documents so each one answers a question, raises another, or changes the meaning of an earlier record. Keep a timeline of when each item was written and when characters receive it.
body.zh: 安排材料顺序，让每一份回应一个问题、提出新问题，或改变旧记录的含义。记录材料写成和人物收到的时间。

q.en: Can an epistolary novel include ordinary prose scenes?
q.zh: 书信体小说可以加入普通叙述段落吗？

a.en: Yes, if the shift has a clear purpose and the chosen format remains coherent. A brief frame or transition can orient readers when the documents cannot carry an essential event.
a.zh: 可以，只要转换有明确作用，整体形式仍连贯。文档无法承载重要事件时，可用简短框架或转场帮助读者定位。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Plan a Short-Story Collection with a Cohesive Arc
title.zh: 如何规划具有整体弧线的短篇小说集

seo_title.en: Plan a Short-Story Collection

description.en: Select stories that work individually and create a meaningful change or progression when read together.
description.zh: 挑选单篇独立成立、合读时又能形成变化与推进的故事。

answer.en: A cohesive short-story collection gives every story room to resolve while creating a larger reading experience across the book. Choose a shared question, setting, theme, or progression, then order the stories so their differences and connections both matter.
answer.zh: 有整体感的短篇集既让每篇独立收束，也让全书合读产生更大的体验。选择共同问题、地点、主题或发展方向，并安排顺序，让差异与联系都发挥作用。

heading.en: Choose a connection that can support variation
heading.zh: 选择能容纳变化的连接方式

body.en: A shared place, generation, theme, or formal experiment can link stories. State what readers should recognize across the book and what each new piece must add rather than repeat.
body.zh: 共同地点、世代、主题或形式探索都能连接故事。说明读者应在全书中认出什么，以及每篇新作需增加什么而非重复什么。

heading.en: Give each story a complete local experience
heading.zh: 让每篇都有完整的局部体验

body.en: Keep a central character goal, change, and payoff in every piece. Connections can deepen meaning, but a story should not require another entry to make its own ending intelligible.
body.zh: 每篇都要有核心人物目标、变化和回报。篇与篇的联系可以深化含义，但单篇结尾不应依赖其他篇章才能看懂。

heading.en: Order stories to create movement
heading.zh: 用篇目顺序形成整体推进

body.en: Try an order that moves from familiar to surprising, private to public, or one generation to another. Read transitions back to back and adjust when two similar moods or revelations weaken each other.
body.zh: 可以从熟悉走向意外、从私密走向公共，或跨越不同世代。连续阅读篇目衔接处；情绪或揭示过于相似、彼此削弱时就调整顺序。

q.en: Do short stories in a collection need the same characters?
q.zh: 短篇集中的故事必须使用同一批人物吗？

a.en: No. They can connect through place, theme, time, or style. Choose a shared element that adds meaning without forcing every story into the same plot.
a.zh: 不必。可以通过地点、主题、时代或风格联系。选择能增加意义、又不强迫每篇讲同一情节的共同元素。

text.en: Use oh-story to research genre expectations, plan character-driven fiction, and revise against the story’s established facts.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 研究类型预期、规划人物驱动的故事，并依据既有设定修改作品。

title.en: How to Make an Animatic from a Storyboard
title.zh: 如何根据分镜制作动态预演

seo_title.en: Make an Animatic from a Storyboard

description.en: Place storyboard frames on a timeline with temporary audio to test shot order, screen time, and story clarity.
description.zh: 把分镜帧和临时声音放入时间线，检查镜头顺序、时长和叙事清晰度。

answer.en: An animatic turns storyboard images into a timed sequence for testing how a scene or episode plays. Add temporary dialogue and sound, hold frames for intended actions, and review whether viewers can follow the story before detailed production begins.
answer.zh: 动态预演把分镜图转成带时长的序列，用来测试场景或单集的节奏。加入临时对白和声音，按动作需要停留画格，并在正式制作前检查观众能否理解故事。

heading.en: Put frames in story order with timing
heading.zh: 按故事顺序安排画格和时长

body.en: Start with a rough duration for each shot and leave room for reading, reaction, or movement. Use the animatic to find beats that feel rushed or wait without adding meaning.
body.zh: 先为每个镜头估算时长，并给阅读、反应或动作留空间。用动态预演找出太赶的节拍，以及没有意义却停留过久的部分。

heading.en: Add temporary sound to test the edit
heading.zh: 加入临时声音测试剪辑

body.en: Scratch dialogue, effects, or music can reveal pacing and transitions that still images hide. Keep placeholders clearly marked so the team does not mistake them for final audio.
body.zh: 临时对白、音效或音乐能揭示静态分镜看不出的节奏和转接。清楚标记占位素材，避免团队误认为是最终声音。

heading.en: Revise the story before polishing frames
heading.zh: 先修改故事，再精修画面

body.en: If a reveal is unclear or a reaction arrives too late, adjust the shot order or beat length first. Update the storyboard and animatic together so the production plan stays consistent.
body.zh: 揭示不清楚或反应太迟时，先调整镜头顺序或节拍时长。同步更新分镜和动态预演，确保制作计划一致。

q.en: Does an animatic need finished artwork?
q.zh: 动态预演必须使用完成画作吗？

a.en: No. Clear rough frames are enough to test order, timing, and screen direction. Add detail only when it helps answer a visual or performance question.
a.zh: 不必。清楚的草图足以检查顺序、时长和画面方向。只有能回答视觉或表演问题时才补充细节。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Write a Short-Drama Trailer That Makes a Clear Promise
title.zh: 如何写出承诺清晰的短剧预告

seo_title.en: Write a Short-Drama Trailer

description.en: Choose footage and lines that show the series premise, emotional stakes, and viewing promise without spoiling the payoff.
description.zh: 用画面和台词呈现系列构想、情感利害与观看承诺，同时避免剧透回报。

answer.en: A short-drama trailer should make the series' central conflict and emotional experience clear. Select shots that establish the protagonist's problem, show escalating pressure, and end on an unanswered question the actual episodes will address.
answer.zh: 短剧预告要让系列核心冲突和情绪体验清晰。挑选能交代主角困境、呈现压力升级的镜头，并以正片会回应的未解问题收尾。

heading.en: Choose footage that proves the premise
heading.zh: 挑选能证明故事构想的素材

body.en: Use a moment that shows who the protagonist is and what makes this situation difficult. Avoid generic dramatic shots that could belong to any story.
body.zh: 选择能体现主角身份及其困境的片段。避免使用可以套在任何故事上的泛化戏剧镜头。

heading.en: Escalate from problem to consequence
heading.zh: 从问题逐步升级到后果

body.en: Arrange images or lines so each adds a new risk, relationship turn, or decision. Keep the trailer focused on one promise rather than naming every subplot and character.
body.zh: 安排画面或台词逐步增加风险、关系转折或决定。围绕一个承诺展开，不要列出所有支线和人物。

heading.en: Protect the story's key reveal
heading.zh: 保护故事关键揭示

body.en: Use questions, reactions, and partial information to build curiosity. Check each cut against the full episode so the trailer does not imply a false event or reveal a payoff too early.
body.zh: 用问题、反应和部分信息激发好奇。对照完整剧集检查剪辑，避免暗示未发生的情节或过早揭示结果。

q.en: Should a short-drama trailer include narration?
q.zh: 短剧预告需要旁白吗？

a.en: Only if it adds context the footage cannot carry. A character line or visual conflict may communicate the premise more naturally and leave more room for performance.
a.zh: 只有画面无法交代背景时才需要。人物台词或视觉冲突可能更自然地传达构想，也能为表演留出空间。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Time a Short-Drama Scene for a Target Runtime
title.zh: 如何按目标时长安排短剧场景节奏

seo_title.en: Time a Short-Drama Scene

description.en: Estimate dialogue, movement, pauses, and visual reveals together so the scene fits without rushing its key beat.
description.zh: 综合估算对白、动作、停顿和视觉揭示，确保时长合适且关键节拍不仓促。

answer.en: Time a short-drama scene by accounting for spoken words, performance, movement, and the moments viewers need to read. Estimate a rough duration, rehearse or build an animatic, then cut repeated setup before removing the reaction or reveal that makes the scene work.
answer.zh: 安排短剧时长时，要同时计算口播字数、表演、动作和观众读画面的时间。先估算并试演或制作动态预演，再删重复铺垫，不要删掉让场景成立的反应或揭示。

heading.en: Estimate speech and action separately
heading.zh: 分别估算台词和动作时间

body.en: Dialogue word count gives a starting point, but movement, overlapping reactions, and prop use take time too. Mark pauses where a character needs to act or viewers need to notice new information.
body.zh: 台词字数只是起点；动作、重叠反应和道具操作也需要时间。标出演员必须行动或观众需要注意新信息的停顿。

heading.en: Test the scene at performance speed
heading.zh: 按表演速度试跑场景

body.en: Read the dialogue with actions or make a rough animatic. Note where meaning gets rushed and where repeated lines or looks add no new change.
body.zh: 带着动作朗读台词，或制作粗略动态预演。记录意义被赶掉的位置，以及没有带来新变化的重复台词或眼神。

heading.en: Cut repetition before cutting clarity
heading.zh: 先删重复，不要牺牲清晰度

body.en: Remove a second explanation or redundant entrance before compressing a key decision. Recheck that the audience can still understand the trigger, choice, and consequence within the shorter runtime.
body.zh: 缩短关键决定前，先删第二次解释或重复出场。调整后再确认观众仍能理解触发点、选择和后果。

q.en: Can I estimate scene time from dialogue word count alone?
q.zh: 只看对白字数能估算场景时长吗？

a.en: Only roughly. Pauses, movement, reaction shots, and subtitle reading all affect runtime, so test the scene with its intended action and visual rhythm.
a.zh: 只能粗略估算。停顿、动作、反应镜头和字幕阅读都会影响时长，最好连同预期动作和画面节奏一起试跑。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Stage a Phone-Call Scene for the Camera
title.zh: 如何为摄影机调度电话场景

seo_title.en: Stage a Phone-Call Scene

description.en: Use reactions, sound, eyelines, and framing to make both sides of a call feel active and understandable.
description.zh: 用反应、声音、视线和构图，让电话两端都显得有行动且易理解。

answer.en: A phone-call scene works on screen when the audience can follow what the present character wants and how the unseen voice changes the situation. Decide whether to stay with one side, cut between locations, or use sound and reaction to imply the other speaker.
answer.zh: 观众能跟上现场人物想要什么，以及电话另一端如何改变局势时，电话场景才适合银幕。决定聚焦一端、切换地点，还是用声音和反应暗示对方。

heading.en: Choose whose experience the scene follows
heading.zh: 选择场景跟随谁的体验

body.en: Staying with one person can preserve suspense about what the caller knows. Cutting between both sides can clarify conflicting goals, but establish each location and keep transitions motivated.
body.zh: 只跟随一方能保留对来电者认知的悬念。两边切换能呈现目标冲突，但要交代地点，并让转场有叙事理由。

heading.en: Use listening behavior to carry the absent voice
heading.zh: 用倾听反应承载画外声音

body.en: A character can interrupt, wait, hide the phone, or change the subject. Give the other speaker's lines a clear trigger and leave pauses long enough for reactions to register.
body.zh: 人物可以打断、等待、藏起手机或转移话题。让对方台词有明确触发，并留出足够停顿让反应被看见。

heading.en: Control sound and visual information
heading.zh: 控制声音和画面信息

body.en: Decide whether viewers hear both sides or only the present character. Keep names and key facts intelligible, and use framing or blocking to show when the call becomes risky or private.
body.zh: 决定观众是否听到双方声音。确保姓名和关键信息清晰，并用构图或走位表现通话何时变得危险或私密。

q.en: Should the caller be shown on screen?
q.zh: 电话另一端的人一定要出镜吗？

a.en: Only if showing them adds a useful contrast or story fact. A focused reaction from the person listening can create tension without cutting away.
a.zh: 只有对方出镜能增加对比或故事信息时才需要。聚焦倾听者的反应，也能在不切镜时营造张力。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Review a Short Drama Before Final Delivery
title.zh: 短剧最终交付前如何复核

seo_title.en: Review a Short Drama Before Delivery

description.en: Check story clarity, shot continuity, dialogue, subtitles, sound, and the exported file against the approved version.
description.zh: 对照通过版本检查故事清晰度、镜头连续性、对白、字幕、声音和导出文件。

answer.en: Review a short drama by watching the exported version from beginning to end and checking story facts, continuity, legibility, and sound. Compare it with the approved script or storyboard, log specific issues with timestamps, and verify fixes in the final export.
answer.zh: 从头到尾观看导出文件，检查故事事实、连续性、字幕可读性和声音。对照通过的剧本或分镜，用时间码记录具体问题，并在最终导出中核对修复结果。

heading.en: Watch once for the story
heading.zh: 第一遍只检查故事

body.en: Ask whether a viewer can follow the goal, action, reveal, and consequence without production notes. Mark unclear transitions or missing reactions, and compare any changed beat against the approved version.
body.zh: 检查观众不看制作备注能否理解目标、行动、揭示和后果。标记不清楚的转场或缺失反应，并对照通过版本核查改动节拍。

heading.en: Check picture, subtitles, and sound together
heading.zh: 一起检查画面、字幕与声音

body.en: Confirm faces and props stay consistent, text appears long enough to read, dialogue is audible, and music does not cover a key line. Watch on the device or frame size viewers will use.
body.zh: 确认面部和道具一致、字幕停留足够长、对白听得清，配乐没有盖住关键台词。使用观众实际会看的设备或画面尺寸检查。

heading.en: Verify the actual export after repairs
heading.zh: 修复后检查实际导出文件

body.en: Track each issue to its timestamp, apply fixes, and review the exported file rather than relying on the editing timeline. Confirm the opening, ending, and any corrected section play without glitches.
body.zh: 用时间码追踪问题、完成修复后检查导出文件，不要只看剪辑时间线。确认开头、结尾和修正片段播放正常。

q.en: Can I review only the corrected parts?
q.zh: 只检查修复过的片段可以吗？

a.en: Review the corrected parts closely, then watch the full export once. A fix can alter timing, sound, or continuity at the edit on either side.
a.zh: 先仔细检查修正部分，再完整看一遍导出。修复可能影响前后剪辑点的时长、声音或连续性。

text.en: Use drama-skills to turn source beats into performable scenes, storyboarded shots, and production references with clear continuity.
text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 将原作节拍转成可表演场景、分镜镜头和连续性清晰的制作参考。

title.en: How to Write a Documentary Trailer Script from Verified Material
title.zh: 如何依据已核实素材写纪录片预告脚本

seo_title.en: Write a Documentary Trailer Script

description.en: Introduce the film's question, people, and evidence without promising a conclusion the documentary cannot support.
description.zh: 介绍纪录片的问题、人物和证据，不承诺素材无法支持的结论。

answer.en: A documentary trailer should create curiosity from events, questions, and evidence the film can substantiate. Choose a clear question, select representative voices and images, and avoid rearranging an interview or quote in a way that changes its meaning.
answer.zh: 纪录片预告要从影片能证明的事件、问题和证据中激发好奇。选定清晰问题，挑选有代表性的声音与画面，避免重排采访或引语以致改变含义。

heading.en: State the film's central question
heading.zh: 说清影片的核心问题

body.en: Give viewers a subject and an open question they can follow. Avoid broad claims such as “the truth they hid” unless the project can show what was hidden and who verified it.
body.zh: 让观众知道主题和可以追踪的问题。除非影片能说明隐藏了什么、由谁核实，否则避免“他们隐瞒的真相”这类宽泛断言。

heading.en: Select quotes with their context attached
heading.zh: 连同上下文一起挑选引语

body.en: Review the full interview segment before cutting a strong line. Keep enough of the question or response to preserve meaning, and log the source timecode for later review.
body.zh: 剪辑有力引语前先听完整采访片段。保留足以维持原意的问题或回答，并记录来源时间码，方便之后复核。

heading.en: Build a promise from verified stakes
heading.zh: 围绕已核实的利害建立承诺

body.en: Arrange images, voices, and on-screen text to show why the question matters. Do not imply that a person, event, or accusation appears in the film if the source footage does not support it.
body.zh: 用画面、声音和屏幕文字呈现问题为何重要。素材不支持时，不要暗示某人、事件或指控会在影片中出现。

q.en: Can a documentary trailer use a question the film does not answer?
q.zh: 纪录片预告可以提出影片无法回答的问题吗？

a.en: It can, if the question honestly frames the subject rather than implying a promised resolution. Make clear what the film investigates and where its evidence ends.
a.zh: 可以，只要问题诚实地界定主题，而非暗示必有答案。说明影片调查什么，以及证据止于何处。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Recap a TV Season Without Listing Every Episode
title.zh: 如何解说电视剧整季，而非逐集罗列

seo_title.en: Recap a TV Season Clearly

description.en: Group episodes by character arcs, turning points, and cause-and-effect changes instead of summarizing them one by one.
description.zh: 按人物弧线、转折和因果变化组织内容，而非逐集复述。

answer.en: A season recap explains how the central conflicts and relationships change from the opening to the finale. Group episodes around turning points and character decisions, preserve the causes that make later events understandable, and distinguish the season's answers from open questions.
answer.zh: 整季解说要说明核心冲突和关系如何从开端发展到季终。围绕转折和人物决定组织集数，保留理解后续所需的原因，并区分本季已解答与仍未解的问题。

heading.en: Map character arcs across episodes
heading.zh: 跨集梳理人物弧线

body.en: Track each major character's goal, changing knowledge, and decisive choices. Combine episodes when they advance the same conflict, and give more space to the turns that reshape the group or season question.
body.zh: 追踪主要人物的目标、认知变化和关键决定。多集推动同一冲突时可以合并讲述，把篇幅留给改变群体关系或季节主问题的转折。

heading.en: Preserve the cause behind each major turn
heading.zh: 保留每个重大转折的原因

body.en: A compressed recap can omit repeated scenes, but should keep the clue, promise, or decision that makes a later outcome fair. Verify the sequence across episodes before rearranging for clarity.
body.zh: 压缩解说可以省略重复场景，但要保留让后续结果合理的线索、承诺或决定。为清晰而重排内容前，先核对跨集顺序。

heading.en: Separate the finale's payoff from its setup
heading.zh: 区分季终回报与后续铺垫

body.en: State which arcs reach a result and which questions remain open. Label theories about the next season as interpretation so predictions do not sound like confirmed events.
body.zh: 说明哪些弧线得到了结果、哪些问题仍未解决。把对下一季的推测标注为解读，避免预测听起来像已确认情节。

q.en: Should a season recap mention every main character?
q.zh: 整季解说要提到每位主角吗？

a.en: Cover characters whose actions change the season's central conflicts or relationships. Introduce others briefly only when a later decision depends on knowing who they are.
a.zh: 覆盖会改变本季核心冲突或关系的人物。其他人物只在后续决定依赖其身份时简要介绍。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Condense a Movie Recap into a Short Video
title.zh: 如何把电影解说压缩成短视频

seo_title.en: Condense a Movie Recap into a Short
seo_title.zh: 把电影解说压缩成短视频

description.en: Choose one complete story movement, preserve its key cause and result, and remove setup the short cannot pay off.
description.zh: 选择一个完整故事段落，保留关键因果与结果，并删去短视频无法兑现的铺垫。

answer.en: A short movie recap cannot carry every plot point. Choose one complete arc, reveal, or question the video can resolve, keep the evidence and consequence that make it understandable, and avoid promising a full-film summary when the runtime only supports a focused beat.
answer.zh: 短视频解说无法容纳所有剧情。选择一个能讲完整的弧线、揭示或问题，保留理解它所需的证据和后果，并避免短时长只够讲一个节拍时承诺完整复述影片。

heading.en: Choose a small story unit with a payoff
heading.zh: 选择有结果的小型故事单元

body.en: A character's plan and reversal, a self-contained mystery, or one relationship change can fit a short. State its starting situation and what changes before cutting secondary events.
body.zh: 人物计划及其逆转、独立谜题或一段关系变化，都可能适合短视频。删次要事件前，先讲清起始局面和变化结果。

heading.en: Keep the cause that makes the result clear
heading.zh: 保留让结果易懂的原因

body.en: Retain the clue, choice, or earlier fact the payoff depends on. If a short cannot include that setup, choose a different moment rather than showing a consequence that seems random.
body.zh: 保留结果所依赖的线索、选择或前置事实。短视频容不下必要铺垫时，就换一个片段，别呈现显得突兀的结果。

heading.en: Set an honest scope in the opening
heading.zh: 在开头诚实说明内容范围

body.en: Tell viewers whether this is one scene, one subplot, or a focused part of the film. Use narration and title text that match the actual coverage.
body.zh: 告诉观众内容是一场戏、一条支线，还是影片的一个重点部分。旁白和标题要与实际覆盖范围一致。

q.en: Can a short recap reveal the movie's ending?
q.zh: 短视频解说可以透露电影结局吗？

a.en: Yes, if that is the clear promise and the ending can be explained accurately in the available time. Otherwise, focus on a complete earlier arc and label the scope.
a.zh: 可以，只要承诺清晰，且时长足够准确讲明结局。否则聚焦前段完整弧线，并说明内容范围。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Edit Interview Quotes Without Losing Context
title.zh: 如何剪辑采访引语而不丢失上下文

seo_title.en: Edit Interview Quotes with Context

description.en: Preserve the speaker's meaning, question, and relevant qualification when shortening interviews for a story.
description.zh: 为叙事而缩短采访时，保留发言者原意、问题和必要限定。

answer.en: Editing an interview quote means selecting a shorter passage while preserving what the speaker meant. Review the surrounding exchange, retain qualifications that change the claim, and use cutaways or narration without implying words were spoken in a different context.
answer.zh: 剪辑采访引语是在缩短内容时保留发言者原意。检查上下文，保留会改变观点的限定，并合理使用插入画面或旁白，避免让人误以为发言发生在不同情境。

heading.en: Listen before and after the selected line
heading.zh: 听取所选内容前后的发言

body.en: The preceding question or following correction may change how a sentence should be understood. Log the full time range and note any hesitation, emphasis, or qualification that matters.
body.zh: 前一个问题或后续纠正可能改变句子含义。记录完整时间范围，并标注重要的迟疑、强调或限定。

heading.en: Shorten without changing the claim
heading.zh: 缩短内容但不改变观点

body.en: Remove repetition only when the remaining words still represent the speaker's position. Do not join separate statements to create a cleaner claim the person did not make.
body.zh: 只有剩余内容仍代表发言者观点时才删重复。不要拼接不同发言，制造一个对方从未表达过的明确结论。

heading.en: Make edits clear to the viewer
heading.zh: 让剪辑衔接对观众自然清楚

body.en: Use pauses, cutaways, or a brief narration bridge when a jump would confuse timing or context. Keep a source note so reviewers can return to the original recording.
body.zh: 剪切会让时间或上下文混乱时，可用停顿、插入画面或简短旁白连接。保留来源记录，方便审核者回到原始录音。

q.en: Can filler words be removed from a documentary interview?
q.zh: 纪录片采访中的语气词可以删吗？

a.en: Usually, if meaning, tone, and hesitation are not important to the scene. Listen to the edit in context to make sure the cut does not make the answer sound more certain or fluent than it was.
a.zh: 通常可以，除非语气、停顿或迟疑对场景重要。要结合上下文听剪辑，确保删减没有让回答听起来比原话更确定或流畅。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Fit Voice-Over to an Existing Video Edit
title.zh: 如何让旁白贴合已有视频剪辑

seo_title.en: Fit Voice-Over to a Video Edit

description.en: Align narration with visible action, leave room for important images, and revise wording before forcing an unnatural read.
description.zh: 让旁白对应画面行动，为重要镜头留空间；先改措辞，再避免生硬赶读。

answer.en: Fit voice-over to an edit by matching each sentence to the image or story information it supports. Mark where narration starts and ends, leave space for visual evidence and source audio, and revise or shorten the script when timing forces rushed delivery.
answer.zh: 让旁白贴合剪辑时，要把每句话对应到它支撑的画面或故事信息。标注旁白起止，给视觉证据和原片声音留空间；时长过紧时先改写或缩短脚本。

heading.en: Map lines to what viewers see
heading.zh: 让旁白对应观众眼前所见

body.en: Put the sentence beside the shot it explains, contrasts, or contextualizes. If the image changes before the line is complete, decide whether to move the line or hold a detail longer.
body.zh: 把句子安排在它解释、对比或补充背景的镜头旁。台词结束前画面已切换时，考虑移动旁白或延长细节镜头。

heading.en: Protect moments that need to be heard or watched
heading.zh: 保护需要听清或看清的时刻

body.en: Leave original dialogue audible when it carries evidence or performance. Pause narration for a clue or reaction viewers need to notice, then resume with a transition that makes the connection clear.
body.zh: 原片对白承载证据或表演时，留出听清的空间。观众需要注意线索或反应时暂停旁白，再用清晰转接恢复叙述。

heading.en: Adjust script before rushing the delivery
heading.zh: 先修改脚本，不要强行加快语速

body.en: Read the line against the timeline and include pauses in the estimate. Remove repeated context or use a shorter sentence when speech must outrun the image.
body.zh: 对着时间线朗读，并将停顿纳入时长估计。旁白赶过画面时，删掉重复背景或改用更短的句子。

q.en: Should narration always finish before a shot changes?
q.zh: 旁白必须在镜头切换前说完吗？

a.en: No. A line can bridge to the next shot when the connection is clear. Avoid carrying it across a cut if the new image changes the subject or makes the wording misleading.
a.zh: 不必。衔接关系清晰时，旁白可以跨镜头延续。如果新画面换了主题，或会让措辞产生误导，就应避免跨切。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Write Transitions That Move a Video Essay Forward
title.zh: 如何写出推动视频 essay 前进的转接句

seo_title.en: Write Video Essay Transitions

description.en: Connect one claim to the next by naming what the evidence changes, complicates, or leaves unanswered.
description.zh: 指出证据改变、复杂化或尚未回答的内容，连接前后观点。

answer.en: A useful video-essay transition tells viewers why the next section follows from the last. Refer to the finding just established, name the question it creates, and introduce the next example without repeating a section summary.
answer.zh: 有效的视频 essay 转接会告诉观众下一段为何承接上一段。提及刚得出的发现，指出由此产生的问题，并引入新例子，避免重复总结。

heading.en: Connect through a result or unresolved question
heading.zh: 用结果或未解问题连接

body.en: A transition can move from a pattern to an exception, from evidence to consequence, or from a claim to its limitation. Choose the relationship the next section actually explores.
body.zh: 转接可以从模式转向例外、从证据转向后果，或从观点转向其限制。选择下一段真正要探讨的关系。

heading.en: Keep the bridge shorter than the argument
heading.zh: 让连接句短于论证本身

body.en: One clear sentence is often enough to orient the audience. Avoid reintroducing every name or claim they just heard unless a time jump or new thread requires it.
body.zh: 一句清晰的话通常足以帮助观众定位。除非遇到时间跳跃或新线索，否则别重讲刚听过的姓名和论点。

heading.en: Check the transition with its visuals
heading.zh: 结合画面检查转接效果

body.en: Read the line over the outgoing and incoming shots. Make sure the wording fits what is on screen and does not imply a causal connection the footage cannot support.
body.zh: 把转接句放在前后镜头中朗读。确认措辞贴合画面，也没有暗示素材无法支持的因果关系。

q.en: Can I use a question as a section transition?
q.zh: 段落转接可以用问题吗？

a.en: Yes, if the next section answers or meaningfully develops it. A question that is never addressed feels like a new hook rather than a bridge.
a.zh: 可以，只要下一段会回应或深入探讨。始终不作回应的问题更像新钩子，而非连接。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Transition Between Scenes in a Movie Recap
title.zh: 电影解说如何在场景间自然转接

seo_title.en: Movie Recap Scene Transitions

description.en: Explain the cause, time shift, or new goal linking two scenes without adding unsupported narration.
description.zh: 说明连接两场戏的原因、时间变化或新目标，不添加无依据旁白。

answer.en: A scene transition in a recap should clarify why the next event follows or where the story has moved. Name the cause, elapsed time, or changed objective the source establishes, and use a brief bridge only when the footage cannot make that connection clear.
answer.zh: 解说中的场景转接要说明后续事件为何发生，或故事时间地点如何变化。说清原片建立的原因、时间间隔或目标变化；画面无法说明时再用简短旁白连接。

heading.en: Identify what changed between the scenes
heading.zh: 明确两场戏之间发生了什么变化

body.en: Check whether time passed, a character made a decision, or a new location changed the available options. Do not invent travel, motive, or conversation to smooth an edit.
body.zh: 确认是否经过时间、人物是否作出决定，或新地点是否改变选项。不要为了剪辑顺滑而虚构行程、动机或对话。

heading.en: Use the shortest bridge that restores context
heading.zh: 用最短旁白补足上下文

body.en: A concise line can orient viewers when an important cause happens off screen. Let the next scene provide detail instead of front-loading facts that the source has not yet revealed.
body.zh: 重要原因发生在画外时，一句简短旁白就能帮助定位。让下一场戏补充细节，不要提前讲原片尚未揭示的事实。

heading.en: Verify the bridge against source order
heading.zh: 对照原片顺序核对转接

body.en: Check timestamps and dialogue so the transition does not move an event earlier or make two separate motives sound connected. Keep the recap's causal link faithful to the film.
body.zh: 核对时间码和对白，避免把事件提前，或让两个无关动机听起来互相造成。解说中的因果关系要忠于影片。

q.en: Should I narrate every location change?
q.zh: 每次地点变化都要用旁白交代吗？

a.en: No. Let an establishing shot or clear action orient the audience when it can. Add narration only when time, motive, or an off-screen cause would otherwise be confusing.
a.zh: 不必。建立镜头或清晰行动能说明地点时就让画面承担。只有时间、动机或画外原因不然会令人困惑时才加旁白。

text.en: Use video-recap to ground the script in source scenes and timestamps, then align narration, evidence, and editing.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 以原片场景和时间码为依据，再对齐旁白、证据与剪辑。

title.en: How to Find Playable Moments in a Novel for Game Adaptation
title.zh: 如何从小说中寻找适合改成玩法的片段

seo_title.en: Find Playable Moments in a Novel
seo_title.zh: 寻找小说中的可玩片段

description.en: Look for goals, decisions, spaces, and systems that can become player actions with meaningful responses.
description.zh: 寻找能转化为玩家行动并得到有效反馈的目标、决定、空间和系统。

answer.en: A playable moment gives the player an action that can change what happens or what they understand. Review the source for goals, obstacles, decisions, and spaces with multiple possible approaches, then test whether interaction adds meaning beyond a narrated scene.
answer.zh: 适合游玩的片段会给玩家一个能改变事件或认知的行动。检查原作中的目标、障碍、决定和可多途径处理的空间，再判断互动是否比直接叙述增加意义。

heading.en: Mark actions the player could own
heading.zh: 标记玩家可能亲自完成的行动

body.en: Look for searching, negotiating, protecting, escaping, choosing, or managing a resource. A passage made only of internal realization may need a different interactive expression.
body.zh: 寻找搜索、谈判、保护、逃离、抉择或资源管理等行动。只有内心领悟的段落可能需要换一种互动表达。

heading.en: Find the obstacle and available approaches
heading.zh: 找出障碍和可用方法

body.en: Note what resists the character and whether the source implies several tactics. If the result is predetermined, interaction might focus on the cost, evidence, or relationship rather than changing the outcome.
body.zh: 记录什么阻碍人物，以及原作是否暗示多种策略。结果若固定，互动可以聚焦代价、证据或关系，而不一定改变结局。

heading.en: Prototype before committing the scene
heading.zh: 决定完整改编前先做原型

body.en: Build a small version of the interaction and observe whether players understand the goal and response. Keep the source moment when play adds a decision; use a scene or dialogue when it does not.
body.zh: 制作小型交互原型，观察玩家能否理解目标和反馈。玩法能增加决定时保留该片段；不能时则用场景或对话呈现。

q.en: Does a playable moment need multiple outcomes?
q.zh: 适合游玩的片段一定要有多个结果吗？

a.en: No. It can let players control timing, method, risk, or interpretation while reaching a fixed story event. The action should still feel consequential during play.
a.zh: 不必。即使最终事件固定，玩家仍可控制时机、方法、风险或理解。行动在游玩过程中仍应有分量。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Extract Player Verbs from a Story Source
title.zh: 如何从故事原作中提取玩家行动动词

seo_title.en: Extract Player Verbs from a Story
seo_title.zh: 从故事中提取玩家行动

description.en: List what the protagonist repeatedly does, then test which actions can form an understandable game loop.
description.zh: 列出主角反复做什么，再测试哪些行动能组成易懂的游戏循环。

answer.en: Player verbs are the actions a game lets players perform, such as investigate, persuade, build, or protect. Extract repeated actions and meaningful decisions from the source, then test which can receive clear feedback and create new situations.
answer.zh: 玩家行动动词是游戏允许玩家执行的行为，例如调查、说服、建造或保护。从原作提取反复行动和重要决定，再测试哪些能得到清晰反馈并产生新局面。

heading.en: List repeated actions and signature decisions
heading.zh: 列出反复行动与标志性决定

body.en: Track what the protagonist does to pursue goals and what choices alter the plan. Separate actions central to the source's identity from one-time movements that do not sustain play.
body.zh: 追踪主角为实现目标做了什么，以及哪些选择改变计划。区分构成原作辨识度的核心行动与无法支撑持续玩法的一次性移动。

heading.en: Test whether the player can affect the action
heading.zh: 测试玩家能否影响行动

body.en: For each verb, ask what input the player gives, what response follows, and what new option appears. An action that always produces the same result may belong in a scene rather than a system.
body.zh: 逐个行动追问玩家输入什么、会收到什么回应、之后出现什么新选项。总产生同一结果的行动可能更适合放在场景中，而非做成系统。

heading.en: Build a loop from the strongest verbs
heading.zh: 用最有力的行动搭建循环

body.en: Choose a small set of related verbs that create a recognizable rhythm and reinforce the source's promise. Prototype their sequence and check that each action produces feedback players can use.
body.zh: 选择一组彼此关联、能形成明确节奏并强化原作承诺的行动。制作流程原型，确认每个行动都能产生玩家可利用的反馈。

q.en: Should a game preserve every action in the novel?
q.zh: 游戏需要保留小说中的所有行动吗？

a.en: No. Preserve actions that define the experience or create worthwhile interaction. Other events can be summarized, combined, or changed to fit the game's core loop.
a.zh: 不必。保留定义体验或能形成有效互动的行动即可。其他事件可以概述、合并或调整，以适应游戏核心循环。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Turn a Story World's Rules into Game Systems
title.zh: 如何把故事世界规则转成游戏系统

seo_title.en: Turn World Rules into Game Systems
seo_title.zh: 把世界规则转成游戏系统

description.en: Translate limits and permissions in the source world into consistent player actions, costs, and feedback.
description.zh: 把原作世界的限制和权限转成一致的玩家行动、代价和反馈。

answer.en: A game system can make a source world's rules usable through play. Identify what characters may do, what prevents them, and what it costs; implement rules that produce readable choices and remain consistent across levels and story states.
answer.zh: 游戏系统能让原作世界规则通过游玩发挥作用。明确人物能做什么、受什么限制、需要付出什么，再实现能产生清晰选择并跨关卡保持一致的规则。

heading.en: Extract rules that create meaningful limits
heading.zh: 提取能产生实际限制的规则

body.en: List permissions, costs, exceptions, and resources that change a character's available action. Decorative lore may inform tone, but a gameplay rule needs to affect what players can do or expect.
body.zh: 列出会改变行动选项的权限、代价、例外和资源。背景设定可以塑造基调，但玩法规则要影响玩家能做什么或能期待什么。

heading.en: Make the rule visible before it is tested
heading.zh: 测试规则前先让玩家看见它

body.en: Show a consequence or example before asking players to rely on the rule. Keep prompts, animation, and feedback aligned so players can infer why an action succeeded or failed.
body.zh: 要求玩家依赖规则前，先展示一个后果或例子。确保提示、动画和反馈一致，让玩家能推断行动为何成功或失败。

heading.en: Test exceptions against the story source
heading.zh: 对照原作检查规则例外

body.en: Build a short rule table and review important source moments for contradictions. If adaptation changes an exception, record the reason and apply it consistently rather than quietly changing the rule in each scene.
body.zh: 制作简短规则表，并检查原作关键事件是否矛盾。改编规则例外时要记录理由并保持一致，不要在不同场景悄悄改规则。

q.en: Should every worldbuilding fact become a game mechanic?
q.zh: 世界观中的每个设定都要变成游戏机制吗？

a.en: No. Mechanize rules that create useful player decisions or feedback. Keep other facts in art, dialogue, or reference material when they do not need to shape play.
a.zh: 不必。只把能产生有效玩家决定或反馈的规则做成机制。其他设定若不影响玩法，就留在美术、对白或背景材料中。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Turn a Novel Location into a Game Level
title.zh: 如何把小说地点改成游戏关卡

seo_title.en: Novel Location to Game Level
seo_title.zh: 小说地点改成游戏关卡

description.en: Preserve what makes a place matter while giving players routes, readable landmarks, and actions that reveal its story.
description.zh: 保留地点的重要意义，同时提供路线、清晰地标和能揭示故事的玩家行动。

answer.en: Adapt a novel location into a game level by preserving its narrative role and redesigning how players move through it. Identify the place's important spaces, obstacles, and discoveries, then build routes that support the intended player goal and reveal information through interaction.
answer.zh: 改编小说地点为游戏关卡时，先保留叙事作用，再重新设计玩家如何穿行。找出重要区域、障碍和发现，并设计服务玩家目标、能通过互动揭示信息的路线。

heading.en: Map spaces by their story function
heading.zh: 按叙事作用梳理地点空间

body.en: Note where characters meet, hide, pursue, or learn something. A level need not copy every room; keep places that affect the conflict or offer a useful player decision.
body.zh: 记录人物在哪些地方会面、躲藏、追逐或得知信息。关卡不必照搬每个房间，只保留影响冲突或能提供有效玩家决定的区域。

heading.en: Design routes around player goals
heading.zh: 围绕玩家目标设计路线

body.en: Use landmarks, doors, sightlines, or resource limits to make progress legible. Offer alternate approaches only when they change risk, information, or cost in a way players can notice.
body.zh: 用地标、门、视线或资源限制让进度清楚。只有替代路线会改变玩家能察觉的风险、信息或代价时，才值得加入。

heading.en: Reveal the location through play
heading.zh: 通过游玩揭示地点信息

body.en: Let a player inspect, unlock, evade, or alter something that matters to the story. Environmental details should reward attention without making a required fact impossible to find.
body.zh: 让玩家检查、解锁、躲避或改变与故事有关的事物。环境细节应奖励观察，但不能让必要事实难以发现。

q.en: Should a game level reproduce the novel's geography exactly?
q.zh: 游戏关卡必须完全复刻小说地理吗？

a.en: Only when exact geography carries a key story fact. Otherwise, rearrange spaces to support navigation and play while preserving the location's recognizable purpose.
a.zh: 只有精确地理承载关键事实时才需要。否则可为导航和玩法调整空间，同时保留该地点可辨认的作用。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Adapt a Novel's Timeline into Game Missions
title.zh: 如何把小说时间线改编成游戏任务

seo_title.en: Novel Timeline to Game Missions
seo_title.zh: 小说时间线改成游戏任务

description.en: Resequence events for play while preserving cause, character knowledge, and the consequences that matter.
description.zh: 为游戏体验重排事件，同时保留因果、人物认知和关键后果。

answer.en: A game adaptation may need a different event order from the novel, but players still need a coherent chain of causes and knowledge. Map when events happen, what characters know, and which decisions depend on them before dividing the material into missions.
answer.zh: 游戏改编可以不同于小说的事件顺序，但仍需保持因果和人物认知连贯。拆分任务前，先整理事件何时发生、人物知道什么，以及哪些决定依赖这些信息。

heading.en: Build a source timeline with knowledge states
heading.zh: 建立带人物认知的原作时间线

body.en: Record event order separately from the order in which the reader learns it. Note who knows each fact, when they learn it, and whether a later reveal changes its meaning.
body.zh: 分别记录事件发生顺序和读者获知顺序。标明谁知道每条事实、何时得知，以及后续揭示是否改变其含义。

heading.en: Group events into missions with clear goals
heading.zh: 按明确目标把事件编成任务

body.en: Join source events that support one player objective and end with a meaningful change. Split a sequence when the goal, location, or knowledge state creates a new decision.
body.zh: 把服务同一玩家目标、并以重要变化收尾的事件编成一项任务。目标、地点或认知状态带来新决定时再拆分。

heading.en: Check every reorder for causal clarity
heading.zh: 检查每次重排是否保留因果

body.en: After changing chronology, ask whether players understand each action with the information available at that point. Add a scene, clue, or dialogue line only when it restores a necessary link.
body.zh: 调整时间顺序后，检查玩家能否凭当时掌握的信息理解行动。只有必要因果缺失时，才补场景、线索或对白。

q.en: Can a game tell the story in a different order from the novel?
q.zh: 游戏能否用不同于小说的顺序讲故事？

a.en: Yes, when reordered events preserve important causes and reveal information at a useful time. Track character knowledge so the new order does not create accidental contradictions.
a.zh: 可以，只要重排后保留重要因果，并在适当时机揭示信息。追踪人物认知，避免新顺序造成意外矛盾。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Choose a Player Perspective for a Novel Adaptation
title.zh: 如何为小说改编游戏选择玩家视角

seo_title.en: Choose a Player Perspective for an Adaptation
seo_title.zh: 为改编游戏选择玩家视角

description.en: Decide whether players inhabit the protagonist, observe a story, or control a new role based on the experience the game promises.
description.zh: 根据游戏承诺的体验，决定玩家扮演主角、观察故事，还是控制新角色。

answer.en: Choose a player perspective by asking what the game needs players to decide and how close they should feel to the source character. Playing the protagonist supports direct agency; an observer or new role can reveal other viewpoints or let players shape a different part of the world.
answer.zh: 选择玩家视角时，先问游戏需要玩家决定什么，以及玩家与原作人物应有多近。扮演主角能直接参与；观察者或新角色则能展现其他视角，或让玩家塑造世界的另一部分。

heading.en: Start from the player's promised role
heading.zh: 从游戏承诺的玩家身份出发

body.en: Write what players are expected to do: make the hero's hard choices, investigate alongside them, or affect people around them. Let that role guide perspective and interaction rather than defaulting to the source's viewpoint.
body.zh: 写清玩家要做什么：代替英雄作艰难决定、跟随调查，还是影响周围人物。让身份决定视角和互动，不要默认照搬原作视角。

heading.en: Check where agency and source facts conflict
heading.zh: 检查玩家能动性与原作事实的冲突

body.en: If players control a fixed protagonist, define which decisions can vary without breaking established motives or outcomes. A new player character may offer freedom but needs a credible reason to affect central events.
body.zh: 玩家控制既定主角时，要明确哪些决定可变而不破坏既有人物动机或结果。新玩家角色自由度更高，但需有可信理由影响核心事件。

heading.en: Prototype the perspective in one scene
heading.zh: 用一个场景测试玩家视角

body.en: Build a short interaction and observe whether players understand what they can influence and what remains fixed. Revise the role if control feels cosmetic or contradicts the story promise.
body.zh: 制作一段简短互动，观察玩家是否理解哪些内容能影响、哪些已经固定。如果控制感流于表面或违背故事承诺，就调整身份设定。

q.en: Should players always control the novel's protagonist?
q.zh: 玩家必须扮演小说主角吗？

a.en: No. Keep that role when the source's key decisions are the best player experience. Choose another perspective when it creates meaningful agency and still respects the story's central promise.
a.zh: 不必。原作关键决定能构成最佳体验时，可以让玩家扮演主角。其他视角能产生有效能动性且尊重核心承诺时，也可采用。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Adapt a Novel's Signature Scene as a Game Set Piece
title.zh: 如何把小说标志性场景改编成游戏关卡亮点

seo_title.en: Adapt a Signature Scene for a Game
seo_title.zh: 把标志性场景改编成游戏

description.en: Preserve what readers remember while giving players an action, challenge, or choice that makes the moment interactive.
description.zh: 保留读者记忆点，同时赋予玩家行动、挑战或选择，让这一刻真正可玩。

answer.en: A signature scene is worth adapting when its meaning can survive a change in medium. Identify the image, decision, or relationship shift readers remember, then give players a connected action or challenge that adds participation without reducing the moment to spectacle.
answer.zh: 标志性场景值得改编，是因为其含义能在媒介转换后保留。找出读者记住的画面、决定或关系变化，再设计相关玩家行动或挑战，增加参与感而不把场景变成纯奇观。

heading.en: Name what makes the scene memorable
heading.zh: 明确场景令人记住的原因

body.en: The key may be a reveal, sacrifice, arrival, or choice rather than its exact sequence of events. Write the emotional or thematic change the adaptation should protect.
body.zh: 关键可能是揭示、牺牲、登场或选择，而非一模一样的事件顺序。写下改编必须保留的情绪或主题变化。

heading.en: Give the player a role in the moment
heading.zh: 让玩家在这一刻拥有角色

body.en: The player might prepare a route, protect someone, decide what to reveal, or act under a time limit. Choose an interaction that supports the source moment instead of delaying it with unrelated tasks.
body.zh: 玩家可以准备路线、保护某人、决定揭露什么，或在期限内行动。选择能支撑原作时刻的互动，不要用无关任务拖延。

heading.en: Keep the payoff tied to the source's meaning
heading.zh: 让回报紧扣原作含义

body.en: After play, show the relationship, knowledge, or world state the scene changes. If player freedom changes the result, preserve the emotional question that made the source moment matter.
body.zh: 游玩之后展示场景改变的关系、认知或世界状态。玩家选择会改变结果时，也要保留让原作时刻重要的情感问题。

q.en: Should a famous scene be playable from start to finish?
q.zh: 著名场景需要从头到尾都可玩吗？

a.en: Not always. Let players control the decisions that deepen their involvement, and use authored sequences for moments where fixed timing or clarity matters more.
a.zh: 不一定。让玩家控制能加深参与的决定；时机或清晰度更重要时，可采用预设演出。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Keep a Game Adaptation Grounded in Its Source
title.zh: 如何让游戏改编扎根于原作

seo_title.en: Keep a Game Adaptation Grounded

description.en: Track source facts, character motives, and world rules while changing scenes to create meaningful player interaction.
description.zh: 改编场景以产生有效互动时，持续追踪原作事实、人物动机和世界规则。

answer.en: A grounded adaptation changes what play requires while preserving the source facts and character logic that support its promise. Keep evidence notes for important rules and motives, mark intentional departures, and check new mechanics against the world and story the team chose to adapt.
answer.zh: 扎根原作的改编会调整玩法需求，同时保留支撑作品承诺的事实与人物逻辑。为重要规则和动机保留证据笔记，标记有意偏离，并对照选定改编的世界与故事核查新机制。

heading.en: Separate fixed source facts from adaptation choices
heading.zh: 区分原作事实与改编决定

body.en: Record character knowledge, world limits, timeline, and signature consequences that must remain true. List changes separately and explain what player experience or production need each change serves.
body.zh: 记录必须保持的认知、世界限制、时间线和关键后果。单独列出改动，并说明每项服务于什么玩家体验或制作需求。

heading.en: Keep evidence beside design decisions
heading.zh: 让来源证据和设计决定并列

body.en: Link a rule or character claim to a passage, event, or source note. This helps the team distinguish a deliberate reinterpretation from a detail that was simply missed.
body.zh: 把规则或人物判断关联到原文、事件或来源笔记，帮助团队区分有意重释和不小心漏掉的细节。

heading.en: Review the playable draft against the promise
heading.zh: 对照改编承诺复核可玩版本

body.en: Ask whether the new interactions still express the intended relationships, conflicts, and world response. Revise systems that require characters to act against established motives without a clear story reason.
body.zh: 检查新互动是否仍表现预期关系、冲突和世界反馈。机制若迫使人物违背既定动机且缺少故事理由，就应调整。

q.en: Does a faithful game adaptation need to copy the plot exactly?
q.zh: 忠于原作的游戏改编必须照搬情节吗？

a.en: No. It can change sequence, perspective, and outcomes to support play while preserving the source's core facts, character logic, and intended experience.
a.zh: 不必。可以为了玩法改变顺序、视角和结果，同时保留原作核心事实、人物逻辑和目标体验。

text.en: Use novel-to-game to analyze source evidence, define player actions and story states, then test a playable adaptation.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 分析原作证据、定义玩家行动与故事状态，再测试可玩的改编方案。

title.en: How to Write a Contemporary Fantasy Novel Rooted in Everyday Life
title.zh: 如何写好扎根日常生活的当代奇幻小说

seo_title.en: Write Contemporary Fantasy

description.en: Make the supernatural rule affect ordinary work, relationships, and choices instead of keeping magic separate from the story.
description.zh: 让超自然规则影响日常工作、关系和选择，而非把魔法与故事分开。

answer.en: Contemporary fantasy places extraordinary forces in a recognizable present-day world. Give the supernatural a rule and a cost, then show how it changes a character's ordinary goal, community, and options.
answer.zh: 当代奇幻把超自然力量放进读者熟悉的现代世界。为其设定规则和代价，再展现它如何改变人物的日常目标、社群和选择。

heading.en: Choose a familiar routine the magic can disrupt
heading.zh: 选择会被魔法打乱的日常

body.en: Work, school, rent, family care, or a commute can anchor the story. Let the supernatural event interfere with a practical need so the world feels lived in before the rules expand.
body.zh: 工作、上学、房租、照护家人或通勤都能锚定故事。让超自然事件干扰实际需求，再逐步展开世界规则。

heading.en: Define what magic can and cannot solve
heading.zh: 说明魔法能解决什么、不能解决什么

body.en: Give the ability boundaries, a cost, or a consequence that matters to the protagonist. Apply the rule consistently, and introduce exceptions only when the story explains why they exist.
body.zh: 为能力设定边界、代价或影响主角的后果。保持规则一致；只有故事能解释例外原因时才引入例外。

heading.en: Let supernatural events change relationships
heading.zh: 让超自然事件改变人物关系

body.en: A secret may alter trust with a friend, family member, or neighbor. Track who knows the truth and let each revelation change what help or risk the protagonist can accept.
body.zh: 秘密可能改变朋友、家人或邻居间的信任。追踪谁知道真相，并让每次揭示改变主角能接受何种帮助或风险。

q.en: Does contemporary fantasy need a hidden magical society?
q.zh: 当代奇幻必须有隐藏的魔法社会吗？

a.en: No. Magic can be public, private, newly discovered, or woven into daily life. Choose the arrangement that creates the story's conflict and reader promise.
a.zh: 不必。魔法可以公开、私密、刚被发现，或融入日常。按故事冲突和读者承诺选择设定。

text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write Magical Realism with a Grounded Human Story
title.zh: 如何写出人物真实可信的魔幻现实主义小说

seo_title.en: Write Magical Realism

description.en: Let extraordinary events sit within an emotionally specific world and shape how characters understand ordinary life.
description.zh: 让奇异事件自然存在于情感具体的世界，并改变人物对日常生活的理解。

answer.en: Magical realism places an extraordinary event inside a recognizable social and emotional world, often without treating it as a puzzle to solve. Ground the relationships and consequences, use a consistent narrative voice, and let the unusual detail deepen the story's human concerns.
answer.zh: 魔幻现实主义让奇异事件存在于熟悉的社会与情感世界中，往往不把它当作待破解谜题。写实关系与后果、保持叙述声音一致，并让异象深化人物关切。

heading.en: Establish a grounded social world
heading.zh: 先建立可信的社会生活

body.en: Give characters work, family, history, and constraints that matter independently of the extraordinary event. Readers need a concrete human situation to understand what the unusual detail changes.
body.zh: 为人物安排独立于奇异事件之外的重要工作、家庭、历史和限制。读者需要具体的人间处境，才能理解异象改变了什么。

heading.en: Let characters respond in a way that fits their world
heading.zh: 让人物反应符合他们所处的世界

body.en: Decide whether an event is familiar, feared, ignored, or disputed in this community. Keep the response consistent with the people and culture rather than pausing to explain a rulebook.
body.zh: 判断该社群把事件视为熟悉、可怕、无关紧要还是有争议。让反应符合人物和文化，不要停下来讲解设定手册。

heading.en: Connect the extraordinary to a human consequence
heading.zh: 把奇异之事连到人物后果

body.en: A strange occurrence can expose grief, inheritance, memory, or an imbalance of power. Show how it alters a relationship or choice, and avoid adding spectacle that does not affect the story.
body.zh: 奇异事件可以显露悲伤、传承、记忆或权力失衡。展示它如何改变关系或选择，避免加入不影响故事的奇观。

q.en: Do I need to explain how the magic works?
q.zh: 需要解释魔法如何运作吗？

a.en: Only to the extent the story's choices depend on it. A mysterious event can remain unexplained if its emotional and social effects are clear.
a.zh: 只需解释到足以支撑故事选择的程度。如果情绪与社会影响清楚，奇异事件可以保持神秘。

text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Fairy-Tale Retelling That Feels New
title.zh: 如何写出有新意的童话改写故事

seo_title.en: Write a Fairy-Tale Retelling

description.en: Identify the original tale's promise, then change the viewpoint, stakes, or power structure with purpose.
description.zh: 找出原童话的核心承诺，再有目的地改变视角、利害关系或权力结构。

answer.en: A fairy-tale retelling borrows a recognizable story pattern and changes what it means through new characters, context, or choices. Identify the original conflict and payoff, choose a purposeful change, and make the new version stand on its own.
answer.zh: 童话改写借用读者熟悉的故事结构，再通过人物、背景或选择改变其含义。找出原作冲突和回报，选择有目的的变化，并让新版本独立成立。

heading.en: Choose the part of the tale you want to question
heading.zh: 确定想重新审视童话的哪一部分

body.en: The rescue, bargain, disguise, or transformation may carry assumptions about power or identity. Name the idea you want to keep, challenge, or reverse before choosing new plot events.
body.zh: 拯救、交易、伪装或变身可能承载关于权力和身份的预设。安排新情节前，先明确要保留、质疑或反转什么。

heading.en: Change more than names and setting
heading.zh: 不要只改名字和背景

body.en: A new viewpoint, motive, obstacle, or consequence can make the familiar pattern matter differently. If the original character choices still produce the same result for the same reason, deepen the redesign.
body.zh: 改变视角、动机、障碍或后果，能让熟悉结构产生不同意义。若人物选择仍以相同原因得到相同结果，就继续深化改写。

heading.en: Make the new payoff follow from the new choices
heading.zh: 让新结局承接新的选择

body.en: The ending should reward the decisions this version introduced, not only reproduce the remembered image. Readers may recognize the source, but the emotional resolution should belong to your characters.
body.zh: 结尾要回报新版本引入的决定，而不只是重现经典画面。读者可以认出原作，但情感收束应属于你的人物。

q.en: Do I need to follow the original fairy tale closely?
q.zh: 需要紧贴原童话改写吗？

a.en: Keep enough of the pattern for recognition if that matters to the project. You can change plot and point of view as long as the new story makes its own choices and consequences coherent.
a.zh: 项目需要辨认度时，保留足够的原故事结构即可。可以改变情节和视角，只要新故事的选择与后果连贯。

text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Myth Retelling with a Fresh Point of View
title.zh: 如何以新视角改写神话故事

seo_title.en: Write a Myth Retelling

description.en: Research the source versions, choose a viewpoint the old telling leaves out, and preserve the myth's central conflict.
description.zh: 研究神话原始版本，选择旧叙事忽略的视角，并保留神话核心冲突。

answer.en: A myth retelling reinterprets a story that has often circulated in multiple versions. Compare source tellings, identify what your version wants to examine, and choose whose choices and consequences will lead the narrative.
answer.zh: 神话改写重新诠释往往有多个流传版本的故事。对照来源叙述，明确新版本想探讨什么，并选择由谁的决定和后果引领叙事。

heading.en: Research more than one source version
heading.zh: 研究不止一种来源版本

body.en: Record differences in relationships, motives, and endings before deciding what counts as a fixed fact. This prevents a later interpretation from treating one popular retelling as the only source.
body.zh: 决定哪些是固定事实前，先记录人物关系、动机和结局的差异。这样不会误把某个流行改编当作唯一来源。

heading.en: Choose whose experience changes the story
heading.zh: 选择谁的经历会改变故事

body.en: A marginal character, descendant, witness, or rival may make a familiar conflict visible from another position. Give that viewpoint an active goal rather than using it only to correct the old story.
body.zh: 边缘人物、后代、见证者或对手可以从新位置呈现熟悉冲突。为新视角设置主动目标，不要只用它来纠正旧故事。

heading.en: Keep the consequences connected to the source
heading.zh: 让后果仍与原神话相连

body.en: If the retelling changes a famous decision, show what new costs follow. Preserve the myth's recognizable question or image while allowing the characters to reach a different meaning.
body.zh: 改动著名决定时，展示由此带来的新代价。保留神话中令人辨识的问题或意象，同时允许人物得出不同含义。

q.en: Can I combine multiple versions of a myth?
q.zh: 可以融合神话的多个版本吗？

a.en: Yes. Note which elements come from which sources and make the combined world consistent. A short author's note can distinguish researched tradition from invention when useful.
a.zh: 可以。记录各元素的来源，并让融合后的世界保持一致。必要时可用简短作者说明区分传统材料与虚构。
