text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write Character Backstory That Affects the Plot
title.zh: 角色背景怎样影响剧情

seo_title.en: How to Write Character Backstory That Affects the Plot
seo_title.zh: 角色背景怎样影响剧情

description.en: Choose backstory details that shape what the character wants, fears, or misunderstands now.
description.zh: 挑选会影响人物当下欲望、恐惧或误解的经历。

answer.en: Choose backstory details that shape what the character wants, fears, or misunderstands now. Reveal them when they change a present decision, rather than pausing the story for a biography.
answer.zh: 挑选会影响人物当下欲望、恐惧或误解的经历。等它能改变现在的决定时再揭示，不要暂停故事来讲人物传记。

heading.en: Connect the past to a present choice
heading.zh: 让过去连接当下选择

body.en: For each important past event, name the belief or habit it left behind. Then connect that belief to a choice the character faces in the current plot. If removing the memory would not change the choice or its cost, it may not need space on the page.
body.zh: 对每段重要经历，写明它留下的信念或习惯，再把它连接到人物眼前的选择。若删掉这段记忆也不会改变选择或代价，或许不必占用篇幅。

heading.en: Reveal through pressure
heading.zh: 在压力下揭示经历

body.en: Let the backstory surface through a triggered action, argument, object, or relationship. Share only the detail needed to understand the current reaction, then let the scene continue. A complete explanation can wait until later evidence makes it more meaningful.
body.zh: 让经历通过触发反应、争执、物件或关系浮现。先透露理解当下反应所需的信息，再让场景继续；完整解释可以等到后续证据让它更有分量时再给。

heading.en: Check cause and change
heading.zh: 检查因果与变化

body.en: Track how the character’s past strategy helps in one situation and fails in another. The arc becomes visible when the character adapts, rejects, or recommits to that strategy. Avoid treating painful history as automatic depth without showing present consequences.
body.zh: 追踪人物过去的应对方式何时有效、何时失灵。人物调整、拒绝或再次选择这种方式时，变化才会显现。不要把痛苦经历本身当作深度，却不写它在当下造成的后果。

q.en: How much backstory should a novel include?
q.zh: 小说应该写多少人物背景？

a.en: Include the amount readers need to understand the current conflict and the character’s decisions. Reveal more only when a new detail changes the stakes or meaning of what is happening now.
a.zh: 只写读者理解当前冲突和人物决定所需要的部分。只有当新信息会改变眼前事件的利害或含义时，才继续揭示。

text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Strong Ending for a Novel
title.zh: 小说结尾怎么写有力

seo_title.en: How to Write a Strong Ending for a Novel

description.en: Resolve the central question through a consequential choice, then show what that choice changes for the characters.
description.zh: 通过一个有后果的选择回应核心问题，再呈现这个选择改变了什么。

answer.en: Resolve the central question through a consequential choice, then show what that choice changes for the characters. A satisfying ending can leave some details open while completing the story’s main emotional and causal arc.
answer.zh: 通过一个有后果的选择回应核心问题，再呈现这个选择改变了什么。结尾可以保留部分开放细节，但要完成故事主要的情感与因果弧线。

heading.en: Return to the story’s central question
heading.zh: 回到故事的核心问题

body.en: State the question the novel has been asking through its conflict: what the protagonist will sacrifice, whom they will trust, or whether a pattern can change. The ending need not deliver the expected outcome, but it should answer through what the character does.
body.zh: 明确小说借冲突不断追问的核心问题：主角愿意牺牲什么、信任谁，或某种循环能否被打破。结局不必给出预期结果，但应通过人物行动作答。

heading.en: Make the climax produce an irreversible result
heading.zh: 让高潮带来不可逆结果

body.en: Put the protagonist in a decision where the old strategy no longer solves the problem. Show the immediate cost and the new condition created by the choice. A victory without change, or a loss without consequence, can make the ending feel detached from the plot.
body.zh: 让主角面对旧办法已无法解决的问题，并做出决定。写出选择的即时代价和新局面；没有改变的胜利、没有后果的失败，都会让结尾脱离剧情。

heading.en: Close what matters and leave room deliberately
heading.zh: 有选择地收束与留白

body.en: Resolve the central relationship, goal, or danger the book promised to address. Leave secondary questions open only when uncertainty is itself meaningful. In revision, compare the final pages with the opening promise and remove explanations that repeat what the ending already shows.
body.zh: 解决本书承诺要回应的核心关系、目标或危险。只有当不确定本身有意义时，才让次要问题保持开放。修改时对照开篇承诺，删去重复解释结尾已呈现内容的段落。

q.en: Does a novel ending need to explain everything?
q.zh: 小说结尾必须解释一切吗？

a.en: No. It should complete the central conflict and make the character’s final position understandable. Secondary mysteries can remain open when the story has prepared readers for that choice.
a.zh: 不必。结尾应完成核心冲突，并让读者理解人物最终处境。若故事已为留白做好铺垫，次要谜团可以不解答。

text.en: Use the oh-story workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 oh-story 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a TV Series Bible
title.zh: 电视剧圣经怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a TV Series Bible

description.en: A TV series bible presents the show’s premise, recurring episode engine, main characters, and season direction.
description.zh: 电视剧圣经要说明剧集前提、可持续的单集引擎、角色和季节走向，让读者既能想象试播集，也能看见整部剧如何持续。

answer.en: A TV series bible presents the show’s premise, recurring episode engine, main characters, and season direction. Keep every detail tied to the viewing experience.
answer.zh: 电视剧圣经要说明剧集前提、可持续的单集引擎、角色和季节走向，让读者既能想象试播集，也能看见整部剧如何持续。每项设定都应服务观看体验。

heading.en: Lead with the series promise
heading.zh: 先说明剧集承诺

body.en: Describe the world, lead character, recurring conflict, and audience appeal in a concise premise. Make clear what happens each week or episode and why the premise can generate more than one story. Separate a compelling setup from a repeatable dramatic engine.
body.zh: 用简洁前提说明世界、主角、反复出现的冲突和观众看点。讲清每集会发生什么，以及这个前提为何能持续产出故事。区分吸引人的设定与可重复运转的戏剧引擎。

heading.en: Show characters through conflict
heading.zh: 通过冲突呈现人物

body.en: For each central character, state what they want, what blocks them, how they behave under pressure, and how their relationships create story. Avoid biography that does not affect an episode. Explain how the cast generates friction and unexpected alliances.
body.zh: 对每位核心角色写清欲望、阻碍、受压时的表现，以及关系如何产生剧情。删掉不会影响单集故事的传记信息，并说明角色如何制造摩擦与意外联盟。

heading.en: Prove the season can move
heading.zh: 证明整季会发展

body.en: Outline the pilot’s inciting conflict, the season’s major turns, and a finale direction without over-summarizing every episode. Show what changes over time and which tensions remain renewable. Read the bible as a pitch: can someone explain the show after one pass?
body.zh: 概述试播集的引爆冲突、整季主要转折和结局方向，不必逐集复述。说明故事如何变化、哪些张力可以持续。把圣经当作提案来读：读完一遍后，别人能否讲清这部剧？

q.en: How long should a TV series bible be?
q.zh: 电视剧圣经应该多长？

a.en: Use the length the buyer or production requests. If there is no specification, include only enough to make the premise, episode engine, characters, and season arc easy to understand.
a.zh: 按平台或制作方的要求控制篇幅。若没有规定，只写清前提、单集引擎、角色和季节弧线所需的信息。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Outline a TV Episode
title.zh: 电视剧单集提纲怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Outline a TV Episode
seo_title.zh: 电视剧单集提纲怎么写

description.en: Build an episode outline from a character goal, the conflict that blocks it, and a turn that changes the next move.
description.zh: 从人物目标、阻碍目标的冲突，以及改变下一步行动的转折搭建单集提纲。

answer.en: Build an episode outline from a character goal, the conflict that blocks it, and a turn that changes the next move. In a continuing series, resolve the episode’s promise while moving at least one longer arc forward.
answer.zh: 从人物目标、阻碍目标的冲突，以及改变下一步行动的转折搭建单集提纲。连续剧既要兑现本集承诺，也要推进至少一条长期故事线。

heading.en: Define the episode question
heading.zh: 确定本集要回答的问题

body.en: Write what the lead is trying to accomplish in this episode and what makes the attempt difficult now. A strong episode question can be answered by the final act even when the larger season story remains unresolved.
body.zh: 写清主角本集要完成什么，以及此刻为何困难。即使季节主线仍未解决，有力的单集问题也能在末幕得到回应。

heading.en: Map turns as consequences
heading.zh: 把转折写成因果

body.en: Outline the setup, first complication, midpoint change, crisis, and result. For every beat, name the action that causes the next one; if a beat only adds information, attach it to a decision or consequence. Track parallel stories separately before checking where they intersect.
body.zh: 依次列出铺垫、首次受阻、中点变化、危机和结果。每个节拍都写明什么行动导致下一步；若某段只增加信息，就把信息连到决定或后果上。先分开追踪支线，再检查交汇点。

heading.en: Balance episode and series movement
heading.zh: 平衡单集与整季推进

body.en: Give the episode a local payoff and make one relationship, belief, or practical situation different by the end. Use the tag or cliffhanger to open the next question, not to undo the resolution viewers just earned.
body.zh: 让本集有阶段性回报，并在结尾改变一段关系、一种信念或现实处境。用尾声或悬念开启新问题，不要推翻观众刚刚得到的解决。

q.en: How detailed should a TV episode outline be?
q.zh: 电视剧单集提纲要多详细？

a.en: Detailed enough to show the causal turns, character choices, and ending, but not so detailed that it becomes a scene-by-scene script unless production asks for one.
a.zh: 应足以呈现因果转折、人物选择和结尾；除非制作方要求，否则不必细到逐场剧本。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Limited Series
title.zh: 限定剧怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Limited Series

description.en: Design a limited series around one story that can reach a meaningful ending in a planned number of episodes.
description.zh: 围绕一个能在计划集数内走向有意义结局的故事来设计限定剧。

answer.en: Design a limited series around one story that can reach a meaningful ending in a planned number of episodes. Give each installment its own movement while making the season’s central question steadily harder to avoid.
answer.zh: 围绕一个能在计划集数内走向有意义结局的故事来设计限定剧。每集都要有自身推进，同时让整季的核心问题越来越无法回避。

heading.en: Choose the story’s natural scope
heading.zh: 确定故事适合的规模

body.en: Identify the event, relationship, investigation, or transformation that can sustain the series and still end. Estimate episodes from the number of genuine changes in the story, not from a desire to stretch one reveal across a season.
body.zh: 找出能支撑整部剧、又能走向终点的事件、关系、调查或转变。依据故事中真实变化的数量估算集数，不要为了拖延一次揭示而拉长整季。

heading.en: Give every episode a turn
heading.zh: 让每集都发生转向

body.en: For each installment, define its immediate goal, obstacle, partial answer, and new question. The episode should change the audience’s understanding or the characters’ options. A cliffhanger works best when it grows from the episode’s result.
body.zh: 为每集定义眼前目标、阻碍、阶段性答案和新问题。单集应改变观众的认识或人物的选择空间。悬念最好从本集结果自然生长出来。

heading.en: Earn the planned ending
heading.zh: 让预设结局有充分铺垫

body.en: Track what the audience knows and what the protagonist is willing to do across the season. Make the finale resolve the central question and show the cost of the answer. Avoid adding a new mystery at the end solely to imply a second season.
body.zh: 追踪观众掌握的信息，以及主角整季逐渐愿意做什么。结局应回应核心问题并呈现答案的代价。不要只为暗示续季而在最后凭空增加谜团。

q.en: Can a limited series have more than one season?
q.zh: 限定剧可以有多季吗？

a.en: It can, but the first season should still complete the story it promised. A later season needs a new reason to continue rather than leaving the original arc unfinished.
a.zh: 可以，但第一季仍应完成原本承诺的故事。续季要有新的继续理由，而不是把原有故事线悬而未决。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Stage Play
title.zh: 舞台剧剧本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Stage Play

description.en: Write a stage play around a conflict that can unfold through performance, dialogue, space, and time in front of an audience.
description.zh: 围绕能通过表演、对白、空间和时间在观众眼前展开的冲突来写舞台剧。

answer.en: Write a stage play around a conflict that can unfold through performance, dialogue, space, and time in front of an audience. Make scene changes and important events clear enough to rehearse without prescribing every directorial choice.
answer.zh: 围绕能通过表演、对白、空间和时间在观众眼前展开的冲突来写舞台剧。场景转换和重要事件要便于排演，同时为导演留下创作空间。

heading.en: Build a playable situation
heading.zh: 建立可演出的局面

body.en: Choose a contained place, a pressing need, and characters who cannot all get what they want. Stage constraints can become dramatic pressure: who can enter, who is overheard, or what object changes hands. Prefer actions an audience can witness to explanation about unseen events.
body.zh: 选择一个集中的地点、迫切需求，以及无法同时如愿的人物。舞台限制也能变成戏剧压力：谁能进入、谁听见了什么、物品如何易手。优先写观众能看到的行动，少解释台下发生之事。

heading.en: Use dialogue to change the room
heading.zh: 让对白改变现场关系

body.en: Give each speaker an immediate objective in the exchange. A line may persuade, evade, threaten, test, or repair; make the next line respond to that attempt. Add pauses and silence when they alter the power between characters, not as decoration.
body.zh: 给每位说话者安排此刻的目的：说服、躲避、威胁、试探或修复。下一句要回应前一句的行动。只有当停顿与沉默改变人物间的力量关系时才使用它们。

heading.en: Draft for rehearsal
heading.zh: 按排演需要修改

body.en: Keep stage directions focused on playable action, timing, and necessary transitions. Read aloud to hear rhythm and identify speeches that explain what the scene already shows. Check that a small production can stage the locations, props, and changes the script requires.
body.zh: 舞台说明聚焦可表演的动作、时机和必要转换。大声朗读，检查节奏，并删掉对场景已呈现内容的解释。确认小型制作也能完成剧本要求的地点、道具和变化。

q.en: How is a stage play different from a screenplay?
q.zh: 舞台剧和电影剧本有什么不同？

a.en: A play is designed to unfold live in shared space and time, often with fewer location changes. Use theatrical presence, dialogue, and visible action rather than relying on frequent cuts or unstageable detail.
a.zh: 舞台剧面向共享空间与实时表演，通常较少切换地点。多利用现场感、对白和可见行动，不要依赖频繁剪切或无法呈现的细节。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Screenplay Logline
title.zh: 电影剧本一句话梗概怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Screenplay Logline
seo_title.zh: 电影剧本一句话梗概怎么写

description.en: A screenplay logline identifies the protagonist, the disruptive situation, the goal, and the obstacle or stakes that make the story compelling.
description.zh: 电影剧本的一句话梗概要交代主角、打破日常的事件、目标，以及构成看点的阻碍或代价。

answer.en: A screenplay logline identifies the protagonist, the disruptive situation, the goal, and the obstacle or stakes that make the story compelling. Use it to communicate the dramatic engine, not to summarize every twist.
answer.zh: 电影剧本的一句话梗概要交代主角、打破日常的事件、目标，以及构成看点的阻碍或代价。它要传达戏剧引擎，而不是复述所有反转。

heading.en: Find the central dramatic engine
heading.zh: 找到核心戏剧引擎

body.en: Write the protagonist’s active goal and the force opposing it. Include the event that starts the story and a specific consequence of failure when it distinguishes the premise. Keep character names out unless a role or relationship is more recognizable than a name.
body.zh: 写出主角主动追求的目标和阻挡他的力量。若失败后果能凸显故事前提，也写明引爆事件与具体代价。除非身份或关系比名字更容易理解，否则先不用角色姓名。

heading.en: Compress without becoming vague
heading.zh: 压缩信息但不空泛

body.en: Replace broad labels such as “a mysterious past” with a concrete problem the protagonist must address. Remove subplots, backstory, and ending details. Every phrase should help a reader picture the main conflict or understand why it is difficult.
body.zh: 把“神秘过去”这类宽泛描述换成主角必须处理的具体难题。删去支线、背景和结局信息。每个短语都应帮助读者想象核心冲突，或理解它为何棘手。

heading.en: Test it against the screenplay
heading.zh: 用剧本检验梗概

body.en: Compare the logline with the first act and the ending. The goal and stakes should truly drive the screenplay, and the ending should resolve the promise the sentence makes. Ask a reader what film they imagine; revise if they describe a different story.
body.zh: 把梗概与第一幕和结局对照，确认目标与代价确实推动剧本，结局也兑现这句话的承诺。问读者想象的是什么电影；若他们描述出另一种故事，就要修改。

q.en: Should a logline reveal the ending?
q.zh: 一句话梗概要透露结局吗？

a.en: Usually no. State the premise, goal, obstacle, and stakes clearly enough to make the story compelling, while saving the specific resolution for the screenplay or a fuller synopsis.
a.zh: 通常不必。把前提、目标、阻碍和代价写清楚，让故事显得有吸引力即可；具体结局留给剧本或更完整的梗概。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Screenplay Spec Script
title.zh: 电影剧本样稿怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Screenplay Spec Script

description.en: A spec script is an unsolicited sample that lets readers judge the writer’s storytelling and command of screenplay form.
description.zh: 剧本样稿是供读者评估编剧叙事能力与格式掌握程度的作品。

answer.en: A spec script is an unsolicited sample that lets readers judge the writer’s storytelling and command of screenplay form. Choose a premise you can execute clearly, follow standard formatting, and revise for character choices, visual action, and pace.
answer.zh: 剧本样稿是供读者评估编剧叙事能力与格式掌握程度的作品。选择能清晰完成的故事前提，遵循标准格式，并修改人物选择、可视化行动和节奏。

heading.en: Choose a focused, filmable premise
heading.zh: 选择聚焦且可拍的前提

body.en: Build the sample around a protagonist, a specific goal, and a conflict that escalates through visible decisions. The idea should be distinctive without depending on expensive spectacle or a franchise the reader must already know.
body.zh: 围绕主角、明确目标和通过可见选择升级的冲突来构思样稿。创意应有辨识度，但不必依赖昂贵奇观或读者必须熟悉的系列背景。

heading.en: Show the writer’s craft in scenes
heading.zh: 在场景中展示编剧功底

body.en: Use scene headings and concise action consistently. Let behavior reveal character, make exposition part of conflict, and give each sequence a change in direction or understanding. A spec is a story sample, not a production manual filled with camera instructions.
body.zh: 持续规范使用场景标题和简洁动作说明。通过行为呈现人物，让背景信息进入冲突，并使每个段落带来方向或认知变化。样稿是故事作品，不是塞满镜头指示的制作手册。

heading.en: Polish for a cold read
heading.zh: 按陌生读者体验打磨

body.en: Ask readers unfamiliar with the story to mark confusion, slow sections, and moments they can picture. Revise repeated information and unclear motivation first. Then check formatting and spelling, and confirm the opening establishes the movie the remaining pages deliver.
body.zh: 请不了解故事的读者标出困惑处、拖慢处和能否想象的场景。先改重复信息与含糊动机，再检查格式和拼写，确认开篇建立的电影体验能由后文兑现。

q.en: Can a spec script be based on an existing franchise?
q.zh: 剧本样稿可以基于已有系列吗？

a.en: For a general writing sample, an original screenplay usually shows that you can create characters and a story independently. Follow the recipient’s submission rules if they explicitly request a sample in an established world.
a.zh: 作为常规写作样稿，原创剧本通常更能展示独立创造人物与故事的能力。若投稿方明确要求在已有世界中创作样稿，则按其要求提交。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Adapt a True Story into a Screenplay
title.zh: 真实事件怎么改编成剧本

seo_title.en: How to Adapt a True Story into a Screenplay
seo_title.zh: 真实事件怎么改编成剧本

description.en: Build a true-story screenplay from verifiable events, a clear dramatic question, and transparent adaptation choices.
description.zh: 以可核实的事件、清晰的戏剧问题和透明的改编选择构建真实故事剧本。

answer.en: Build a true-story screenplay from verifiable events, a clear dramatic question, and transparent adaptation choices. Compress or combine material only when the story remains understandable and does not present invention as documented fact.
answer.zh: 以可核实的事件、清晰的戏剧问题和透明的改编选择构建真实故事剧本。只有在故事依然清楚、且不会把虚构伪装成史实时，才压缩或合并素材。

heading.en: Define what the screenplay can support
heading.zh: 确认剧本有证据支持什么

body.en: Collect reliable sources and separate documented facts from disputed accounts, private motives, and gaps in the record. Choose a bounded period or turning point the evidence can sustain. Do not treat an absence of public information as proof of a convenient dramatic explanation.
body.zh: 收集可靠来源，将已记录事实与争议叙述、私人动机和史料空白分开。选取证据能够支撑的时间段或转折点。公开信息缺失不代表可以用方便剧情的解释填空。

heading.en: Shape events into a dramatic through-line
heading.zh: 把事件组织成戏剧主线

body.en: Choose the person whose decisions let the audience follow the conflict. Preserve cause and consequence while compressing chronology, combining minor roles, or inventing transitions. Keep a record of each change so collaborators can distinguish supported events from dramatic construction.
body.zh: 选择能让观众跟随冲突的人物作为主线。压缩时间、合并次要角色或创作过渡时，保留事件的因果关系。记录每项改动，让合作者分清史实与戏剧加工。

heading.en: Review both drama and responsibility
heading.zh: 同时审查戏剧效果与责任

body.en: Check dates, public claims, and the portrayal of real people against sources. Make composite characters and invented dialogue apparent in the production process, and avoid asserting private thoughts as fact. Finally, read the script without research notes to see if the story itself is clear.
body.zh: 依据来源核对日期、公开说法和真实人物形象。在制作流程中标明合成角色与虚构对白，避免把私人想法说成事实。最后不看研究笔记通读剧本，检查故事本身是否清楚。

q.en: Can a screenplay invent dialogue in a true story?
q.zh: 真实故事剧本可以虚构对白吗？

a.en: It can, but the adaptation should distinguish dramatized dialogue from documented quotations and avoid attributing unsupported statements as fact. The project’s legal and editorial standards also apply.
a.zh: 可以，但改编应区分戏剧化对白与有记录的原话，也不要把无依据的话冒充事实。项目的法律与编辑标准同样适用。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Outline a TV Pilot
title.zh: 电视剧试播集怎么列提纲

seo_title.en: How to Outline a TV Pilot
seo_title.zh: 电视剧试播集怎么列提纲

description.en: A TV pilot introduces the series engine through a complete episode story and leaves a clear reason to watch the next one.
description.zh: 电视剧试播集要通过完整的单集故事介绍整部剧的运转方式，并给出继续观看的理由。

answer.en: A TV pilot introduces the series engine through a complete episode story and leaves a clear reason to watch the next one. Outline the lead, world, recurring conflict, and first irreversible choice before drafting scenes.
answer.zh: 电视剧试播集要通过完整的单集故事介绍整部剧的运转方式，并给出继续观看的理由。写场景前先确定主角、世界、反复冲突和第一个不可逆选择。

heading.en: Introduce the show through action
heading.zh: 用行动介绍剧集

body.en: Open on a situation that shows how the protagonist’s ordinary world works, then disrupt it with the problem that can generate a series. Avoid explaining the world before the audience has a character goal to follow.
body.zh: 从能体现主角日常世界运转方式的情境开场，再用可持续生成剧集的难题打破它。先让观众有目标可追，再解释世界设定。

heading.en: Build a full episode arc
heading.zh: 搭建完整单集弧线

body.en: Give the pilot a local goal, escalating resistance, a turning point, and an outcome. The ending should resolve or materially change that immediate problem while revealing how future episodes will create fresh pressure.
body.zh: 为试播集安排本集目标、升级的阻力、转折点和结果。结尾要解决或实质改变眼前问题，同时揭示后续集数如何产生新压力。

heading.en: Show the series promise
heading.zh: 呈现整部剧的看点

body.en: Check that the final choice changes what the protagonist must do next and demonstrates the repeatable engine. A tag can open a new question, but it should grow from the pilot’s consequences instead of replacing its ending.
body.zh: 检查结尾选择是否改变主角的下一步，并展现可持续的故事引擎。尾声可以开启新问题，但应由试播集的后果引出，而不是取代本集结尾。

q.en: Should a TV pilot resolve its story?
q.zh: 电视剧试播集要解决本集故事吗？

a.en: Yes. Give viewers a meaningful payoff for the episode while leaving the larger series conflict open. The pilot should demonstrate both a complete story and a reason for more.
a.zh: 应该。为本集提供有意义的回报，同时让整部剧的冲突继续发展。试播集既要展示完整故事，也要说明为什么还有后续。

text.zh: 使用 drama-skills 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a TikTok Script with a Clear Payoff
title.zh: TikTok视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a TikTok Script with a Clear Payoff

description.en: Give a TikTok video one recognizable idea, a visual opening, and a payoff that arrives before viewers lose the thread.
description.zh: 让 TikTok 视频围绕一个清楚的想法展开，以可见画面开场，并在观众跟丢之前给出回报。

answer.en: Give a TikTok video one recognizable idea, a visual opening, and a payoff that arrives before viewers lose the thread. Use trends only when they help the audience understand the creator’s point.
answer.zh: 让 TikTok 视频围绕一个清楚的想法展开，以可见画面开场，并在观众跟丢之前给出回报。只有当热点形式能帮助表达内容时才使用。

heading.en: Start with the moment viewers can see
heading.zh: 从观众看得见的瞬间开场

body.en: Choose an action, result, or question that makes sense without a long introduction. The first line and image should work together: show the problem, surprising object, or change the video will explain. Avoid promising a result the footage cannot deliver.
body.zh: 选择不靠长篇介绍也能理解的动作、结果或问题。第一句要与画面配合，呈现视频将解释的问题、意外物件或变化。不要承诺素材无法兑现的结果。

heading.en: Write for a spoken, changing feed
heading.zh: 按口语和滑动场景写稿

body.en: Keep one thought per beat and let demonstrations carry information where possible. Add a new example, visual change, or complication when the idea needs another beat; cut greetings and context viewers do not need to follow.
body.zh: 每个节拍只表达一个想法，能用演示传递的信息就交给画面。需要延展时再增加例子、画面变化或复杂点；删掉观众理解内容不需要的问候和背景。

heading.en: Finish the promise
heading.zh: 兑现开头的承诺

body.en: Show the answer, result, or useful next step the opening implied. Read the script aloud while timing the actions and captions. Remove words that repeat what viewers can see, and verify names, figures, and claims before posting.
body.zh: 给出开头暗示的答案、结果或实用下一步。边读稿边计时演示和字幕，删掉重复描述画面的词，并在发布前核对姓名、数字和事实说法。

q.en: Should a TikTok script follow every trend?
q.zh: TikTok脚本要追每个热点吗？

a.en: No. Use a trend when its format helps deliver the story or joke; otherwise, a clear original idea gives viewers a better reason to watch.
a.zh: 不必。只有当热点形式有助于讲故事或呈现笑点时才借用；否则，清晰的原创想法更能说明观看价值。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write an Instagram Reels Script
title.zh: Instagram Reels脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write an Instagram Reels Script

description.en: Structure a Reel around one fast-to-understand idea, a strong visual, and a useful or entertaining finish.
description.zh: 围绕一个能迅速理解的想法、一处醒目画面和有用或好看的收尾来安排Reels。

answer.en: Structure a Reel around one fast-to-understand idea, a strong visual, and a useful or entertaining finish. Write the spoken line, on-screen text, and action as one sequence so the story remains clear with the sound off.
answer.zh: 围绕一个能迅速理解的想法、一处醒目画面和有用或好看的收尾来安排Reels。把口播、屏幕文字和动作连成一条顺序，让静音观看也看得懂。

heading.en: Make the first frame do work
heading.zh: 让第一帧承担信息

body.en: Plan what viewers see before reading the caption: a result, a question, a person demonstrating something, or a clear before-and-after. The opening image should establish the subject without relying on a long title card.
body.zh: 先设计观众看到的画面：结果、问题、演示、前后对比都可以。开场画面应直接交代主题，避免依赖长标题卡。

heading.en: Pair text with visible action
heading.zh: 让文字配合动作

body.en: Write short narration and captions that add information rather than duplicate every image. If viewers need a sequence of steps, number or visually separate them. Keep key instructions on screen long enough to read.
body.zh: 让简短口播和字幕补充信息，而不是逐字重复画面。若观众需要按步骤操作，就编号或用画面分隔，并给关键指令足够的阅读时间。

heading.en: Close with a natural next step
heading.zh: 用自然的下一步收尾

body.en: Finish the idea before asking for a save, comment, or follow. Choose one action tied to the content, such as saving a recipe or sharing a result, and make sure the Reel still feels complete without it.
body.zh: 先把内容讲完整，再提出收藏、评论或关注。选择与内容有关的一项行动，例如保存食谱或分享成果；即使观众不操作，视频也应完整。

q.en: Do Reels scripts need voice-over?
q.zh: Reels脚本一定要配旁白吗？

a.en: No. On-screen text, demonstrations, natural sound, or direct-to-camera delivery can carry the idea. Choose the format that makes the key point easiest to understand.
a.zh: 不一定。屏幕文字、操作演示、现场声音或面对镜头讲述都能传递内容。选最容易让人理解重点的形式即可。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a YouTube Shorts Script
title.zh: YouTube Shorts脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a YouTube Shorts Script

description.en: Write a Short around one question or story turn, make the premise clear immediately, and deliver a complete payoff within the chosen runtime.
description.zh: 让Shorts围绕一个问题或情节转折展开，开头马上交代前提，并在目标时长内给出完整回报。

answer.en: Write a Short around one question or story turn, make the premise clear immediately, and deliver a complete payoff within the chosen runtime. A concise setup helps viewers understand the clip even if they have not seen the channel before.
answer.zh: 让Shorts围绕一个问题或情节转折展开，开头马上交代前提，并在目标时长内给出完整回报。简洁铺垫能让没看过频道的观众也跟上内容。

heading.en: Choose one idea per Short
heading.zh: 每条Shorts只讲一个重点

body.en: Write the main point in one sentence, then remove background that does not change how viewers understand it. If the topic needs several conclusions, make a connected series rather than squeezing a full lesson into one clip.
body.zh: 先用一句话写清核心，再删去不会改变观众理解的背景。若主题需要多个结论，就规划成系列，不要把整堂课挤进一条短片。

heading.en: Build a fast setup and turn
heading.zh: 快速铺垫并制造变化

body.en: Use the opening to name the question, show a result, or start an action. Add one clear complication or new piece of evidence, then move directly to the payoff. Track seconds against spoken words and visible pauses during rehearsal.
body.zh: 用开场提出问题、展示结果或直接开始行动。接着只增加一个清晰阻碍或新证据，然后进入回报。排练时按口播字数和画面停顿核算时长。

heading.en: Make the ending satisfying
heading.zh: 让结尾有交代

body.en: Answer the question or complete the action you set up. If the clip is part of a series, provide a small payoff before pointing to the next part. Review without sound and confirm captions preserve the logic.
body.zh: 回答开头的问题，或完成已经开始的行动。若属于系列，先给小结论再引向下一集。静音复看，确认字幕保留了内容逻辑。

q.en: How many ideas should a YouTube Short cover?
q.zh: 一条YouTube Shorts讲几个观点？

a.en: Usually one central idea with just enough context to understand it. More points can make the clip hard to follow; split them when each one deserves an example or payoff.
a.zh: 通常一个核心想法，并给足理解它所需的背景。观点过多会让短片难以跟上；若每个观点都需要例子或回报，就拆开讲。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Turn a Long Video into Short Clips
title.zh: 长视频怎么剪成短片

seo_title.en: How to Turn a Long Video into Short Clips

description.en: Find self-contained moments in the long video that make sense to a new viewer, then rewrite the opening and ending for the short format.
description.zh: 从长视频中找出新观众也能看懂的完整片段，再为短视频重写开头和结尾。

answer.en: Find self-contained moments in the long video that make sense to a new viewer, then rewrite the opening and ending for the short format. Do not assume a clip works just because it contains a memorable sentence.
answer.zh: 从长视频中找出新观众也能看懂的完整片段，再为短视频重写开头和结尾。片段里有一句精彩话，并不代表它脱离上下文后仍然成立。

heading.en: Find a complete moment
heading.zh: 找到完整片段

body.en: Look for a question, demonstration, disagreement, or story beat that has its own setup and result. Note the original timestamp and any context needed to understand names, claims, or reactions. Exclude moments whose key meaning comes from material outside the clip.
body.zh: 寻找自带铺垫和结果的问题、演示、分歧或故事节拍。记录原始时间点及理解人名、论点或反应所需的背景，并剔除必须依赖片段之外内容才能成立的段落。

heading.en: Rebuild the clip for a new viewer
heading.zh: 为新观众重组片段

body.en: Open with enough context to identify the subject and stakes. Trim repeated setup, but preserve the reasoning or sequence that makes the result credible. Add captions and visuals that clarify terms without changing what the speaker meant.
body.zh: 开头交代主题和利害，让新观众能进入。删掉重复铺垫，但保留让结论可信的推理或过程。添加解释术语的字幕与画面时，不要改变讲话者原意。

heading.en: Check rights, accuracy, and destination
heading.zh: 检查版权、准确性与发布位置

body.en: Review the cut with its caption, title, and thumbnail. Confirm that quotes remain in context and that music, footage, and guest permissions allow reuse. Give each platform a tailored opening rather than relying on the long video’s original introduction.
body.zh: 连同标题、封面和说明一起检查剪辑，确认引语没有脱离语境，音乐、素材和嘉宾授权允许二次使用。为各平台设计开场，不要照搬长视频的原始介绍。

q.en: Can I use a clip without changing the original video?
q.zh: 可以不改原视频直接截取片段吗？

a.en: Sometimes, but a new opening, captions, and context often make a clip understandable on its own. Check reuse permissions and ensure the edit does not change the speaker’s meaning.
a.zh: 有时可以，但补充开场、字幕和背景往往能让片段独立成立。检查素材授权，并确保剪辑没有改变讲话者的意思。

text.en: Use the video-recap workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Turn a Podcast into Short Video Clips
title.zh: 播客怎么剪成短视频片段

seo_title.en: How to Turn a Podcast into Short Video Clips
seo_title.zh: 播客怎么剪成短视频片段

description.en: Select a podcast exchange with a complete point, then add enough visual context for viewers who did not hear the episode.
description.zh: 选择观点完整的播客对话，并为没听过整期节目的观众补上必要画面背景。

answer.en: Select a podcast exchange with a complete point, then add enough visual context for viewers who did not hear the episode. Preserve the speakers’ meaning, label edits where needed, and use captions that are readable on a phone.
answer.zh: 选择观点完整的播客对话，并为没听过整期节目的观众补上必要画面背景。保留说话者原意，必要时标明剪辑，并使用手机上易读的字幕。

heading.en: Choose an exchange, not just a sound bite
heading.zh: 选一段对话而非孤立金句

body.en: Prefer an answer, disagreement, or short story with a setup and consequence. Listen to the surrounding conversation before cutting so a joke, caveat, or question is not misrepresented. Capture the episode timestamp and speaker names for review.
body.zh: 优先挑选有铺垫和后果的回答、分歧或短故事。剪辑前听完上下文，避免歪曲笑话、限定条件或问题，并记录节目时间点和说话者姓名以便复核。

heading.en: Make the conversation watchable
heading.zh: 让对话适合观看

body.en: Use a clean split-screen, active speaker framing, or relevant supporting visuals. Add captions in short readable phrases and distinguish speakers consistently. The visual treatment should help follow the exchange rather than distract from a nuanced point.
body.zh: 采用清晰分屏、当前说话者画面或相关补充素材。字幕分段易读，并稳定区分不同说话者。画面要帮助观众跟进讨论，而不是盖过细腻观点。

heading.en: Connect the clip to the full episode honestly
heading.zh: 诚实连接到完整节目

body.en: A caption can state the question the excerpt answers and name the episode for viewers who want more. Do not add a claim the speakers did not make just to create a stronger hook, and check guest approval and music rights before posting.
body.zh: 用说明指出片段回答的问题，并标明完整节目供观众继续收听。不要为了吸引点击添加嘉宾未表达的论点；发布前核实嘉宾授权和音乐版权。

q.en: Should a podcast clip include the whole answer?
q.zh: 播客片段要保留完整回答吗？

a.en: Keep enough of the question and answer for viewers to understand the point and its limits. If a meaningful caveat changes the interpretation, include it or choose another excerpt.
a.zh: 保留足够的问题和回答，让观众理解观点及其适用范围。若限定条件会改变理解，就应保留或另选片段。

text.en: Use the video-recap workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a UGC Video Script That Feels Credible
title.zh: UGC视频脚本怎么写得可信

seo_title.en: How to Write a UGC Video Script That Feels Credible
seo_title.zh: UGC视频脚本怎么写得可信

description.en: Write a user-generated content script around a specific experience, a demonstrable product detail, and an honest claim the speaker can support.
description.zh: 围绕具体体验、可演示的产品细节和说话者能够证实的评价撰写UGC脚本。

answer.en: Write a user-generated content script around a specific experience, a demonstrable product detail, and an honest claim the speaker can support. Keep the language conversational and disclose the commercial relationship where required.
answer.zh: 围绕具体体验、可演示的产品细节和说话者能够证实的评价撰写UGC脚本。语言保持自然，并按要求披露商业合作关系。

heading.en: Start from a real use case
heading.zh: 从真实使用情境出发

body.en: Name who the product is for and what moment it helps with. Give the speaker a clear situation to describe—before, during, and after use—instead of generic praise. Use only product facts and personal experiences the creator can verify.
body.zh: 说明产品适合谁、解决什么时刻的问题。让创作者描述具体使用前后过程，而不是泛泛夸赞；只使用其能够核实的产品事实与个人体验。

heading.en: Keep the voice personal
heading.zh: 保留个人表达

body.en: Write a short structure with a visual opening, a specific observation, and a reason the viewer might care. Leave room for the creator’s own wording, and avoid claims like guaranteed results unless they are substantiated and approved.
body.zh: 用画面开场、具体观察和观众关心的理由搭建简短结构。留出创作者自己的表达空间，避免使用“保证有效”等未经证实或批准的承诺。

heading.en: Make disclosure part of the plan
heading.zh: 把合作披露纳入脚本

body.en: Decide how sponsorship or gifted-product disclosure appears and is spoken so it is clear to the audience. Show the product in the stated use, not a misleading scenario. Review the finished cut for claim accuracy, subtitles, and required disclosures.
body.zh: 提前决定如何在画面和口播中清楚披露赞助或赠品关系。产品展示要符合所述使用情境，避免误导。成片需核对宣传说法、字幕和必要披露。

q.en: Can a UGC script sound spontaneous if it is planned?
q.zh: 提前写好的UGC脚本能自然吗？

a.en: Yes. Plan the key facts and sequence, then let the creator phrase them naturally. A short outline often sounds more authentic than memorized copy, while still keeping claims accurate.
a.zh: 可以。先规划关键信息和顺序，再由创作者自然表达。简短提纲常比背诵文案更真实，同时能保证说法准确。

text.en: Use the video-recap workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write an Influencer Brand Deal Script
title.zh: 达人品牌合作视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write an Influencer Brand Deal Script
seo_title.zh: 达人品牌合作视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Fit the sponsor’s required message into a video that still delivers the creator’s usual value.
description.zh: 把品牌要求的信息融入仍能提供创作者日常价值的视频。

answer.en: Fit the sponsor’s required message into a video that still delivers the creator’s usual value. Agree on claims, disclosure, and review requirements first, then connect the product to a credible use case rather than interrupting the story.
answer.zh: 把品牌要求的信息融入仍能提供创作者日常价值的视频。先确认宣传说法、合作披露和审稿要求，再用可信的使用情境连接产品与内容。

heading.en: Clarify the brief before drafting
heading.zh: 动笔前确认合作简报

body.en: Confirm the audience, key message, prohibited claims, product facts, disclosure language, and approval steps. Ask which points are mandatory and which are optional. This prevents late revisions that make the segment feel bolted onto the creator’s idea.
body.zh: 确认受众、核心信息、禁止说法、产品事实、披露用语和审批步骤，并区分必讲项与可选项。提前澄清能避免临时修改把植入硬塞进创作者的想法里。

heading.en: Build a natural bridge
heading.zh: 设计自然的内容连接

body.en: Start with the video’s own question or story, then introduce the product at the point where it genuinely helps or illustrates the subject. Demonstrate a supported feature and explain the creator’s actual experience without expanding it into a universal promise.
body.zh: 先从视频本身的问题或故事开场，在产品确实能帮忙或说明问题时引入。演示有依据的功能，说明创作者真实体验，不要夸大成普遍保证。

heading.en: Review the whole video
heading.zh: 通篇审查成片

body.en: Make the sponsorship disclosure easy to notice, and include it in speech or text as applicable. Check every claim against the approved brief, make the sponsored segment useful on its own, and ensure it does not contradict the rest of the video.
body.zh: 让商业合作披露清楚可见，并按需加入口播或文字。逐项对照批准的简报核实说法，确保赞助段落本身有用，且与视频其他内容不矛盾。

q.en: How early should a sponsored segment appear?
q.zh: 赞助内容应该多早出现？

a.en: Place it where it fits the video’s subject and the agreement’s requirements. Disclose the relationship clearly when the promotion begins, and avoid delaying disclosure to preserve a surprise.
a.zh: 放在与视频主题和合作要求相符的位置。推广开始时清楚披露合作关系，不要为了保留悬念而延迟说明。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Plan a Live Q&A Stream
title.zh: 直播问答怎么规划

seo_title.en: How to Plan a Live Q&A Stream

description.en: Give a live Q&A one clear topic, a way to collect audience questions, and a run of show that can adapt when participation changes.
description.zh: 为直播问答确定一个主题、收集观众问题的方法，以及能随参与情况调整的流程。

answer.en: Give a live Q&A one clear topic, a way to collect audience questions, and a run of show that can adapt when participation changes. Prepare useful answers and boundaries without scripting every response.
answer.zh: 为直播问答确定一个主题、收集观众问题的方法，以及能随参与情况调整的流程。提前准备有用答复与讨论边界，但不必逐字写好每个回答。

heading.en: Set the audience promise
heading.zh: 明确观众能得到什么

body.en: State who the session is for and what kinds of questions it will answer. Ask for questions before the stream and explain which topics are out of scope. This helps viewers decide to join and keeps the host from improvising a vague session.
body.zh: 说明直播面向谁、会回答哪类问题；提前征集问题并标明讨论范围，让观众知道是否值得参加，也避免主持人临场面对模糊主题。

heading.en: Order questions for a live room
heading.zh: 按直播节奏安排问题

body.en: Group questions by theme, then begin with a useful orientation before moving into detailed examples. Leave flexible time for follow-ups and audience contributions. Keep backup questions ready in case participation is slow, and a short transition if one topic runs long.
body.zh: 按主题归类问题，先做有用的背景说明，再进入具体例子。为追问和互动留出弹性时间；参与冷淡时准备备用题，某话题超时时准备简短转场。

heading.en: Prepare clear operating rules
heading.zh: 准备清晰的互动规则

body.en: Assign someone to monitor chat if possible, confirm how viewers can submit questions, and plan what the host will do with personal or unsafe requests. End by summarizing useful answers and telling viewers where to find the promised follow-up.
body.zh: 尽可能安排人员查看聊天，说明如何提交问题，并计划如何处理涉及隐私或不安全的请求。结尾总结重点，并告知观众如何获取承诺的后续资料。

q.en: Should a live Q&A be scripted?
q.zh: 直播问答需要写逐字稿吗？

a.en: Script the opening, transitions, key facts, and close. Keep the answers flexible so the host can respond to the questions viewers actually ask.
a.zh: 为开场、转场、关键事实和结束语写稿即可。回答保持灵活，以便主持人回应观众实际提出的问题。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Script a Live Product Launch
title.zh: 产品发布直播脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Script a Live Product Launch
seo_title.zh: 产品发布直播脚本怎么写

description.en: Plan a live launch as a timed demonstration: explain the customer problem, show what is new, answer predictable questions, and state the next step.
description.zh: 把产品发布直播写成有节奏的演示：说明用户问题、展示新品、回答常见疑问并讲明下一步。

answer.en: Plan a live launch as a timed demonstration: explain the customer problem, show what is new, answer predictable questions, and state the next step. Keep room for interaction and verify every product claim before going live.
answer.zh: 把产品发布直播写成有节奏的演示：说明用户问题、展示新品、回答常见疑问并讲明下一步。为互动留出时间，直播前核实所有产品说法。

heading.en: Open with the customer problem
heading.zh: 从用户问题切入

body.en: Name the audience and the task or frustration the product addresses. Preview what viewers will see during the launch, and avoid unsupported claims about performance, availability, or results. Give late arrivals a short orientation point in the run of show.
body.zh: 说清目标用户以及产品解决的任务或困扰，预告直播内容。不要对性能、库存或效果作无依据承诺，并在流程中安排简短补充，方便迟到观众跟上。

heading.en: Demonstrate before listing features
heading.zh: 先演示，再讲功能

body.en: Show the product handling a realistic task, then explain the feature that made the difference. Plan camera or screen changes, speaker handoffs, and backup materials. A demo should reveal what the audience can judge, not just what the brand wants to announce.
body.zh: 让产品先完成一项真实任务，再解释起作用的功能。预排机位或屏幕切换、讲者交接和备用材料。演示应展示观众可判断的效果，而非只宣布品牌想说的内容。

heading.en: Make questions and next steps specific
heading.zh: 让提问与后续行动具体

body.en: Reserve time for questions about fit, limitations, setup, and support. State exactly where viewers can learn more or purchase, along with relevant conditions. Close with a recap so the stream remains useful for replay viewers.
body.zh: 预留时间回答适用人群、限制、设置和支持等问题。准确说明了解详情或购买的渠道及相关条件。结尾做简短回顾，方便回放观众理解。

q.en: How long should a product launch livestream be?
q.zh: 产品发布直播应该多长？

a.en: Long enough for the demo, questions, and next steps your audience needs. Build the rundown around those tasks, then trim repeated announcements instead of extending time without a purpose.
a.zh: 只需覆盖演示、提问和观众所需的后续说明。围绕这些任务安排流程，删掉重复介绍，不要无目的延长时长。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write an Online Course Promo Video
title.zh: 线上课程宣传视频怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write an Online Course Promo Video
seo_title.zh: 线上课程宣传视频怎么写

description.en: Show who the course serves, what learners will be able to do, and how a sample lesson teaches it.
description.zh: 展示课程适合谁、学完能做什么，以及示范课程如何教学。

answer.en: Show who the course serves, what learners will be able to do, and how a sample lesson teaches it. Support outcome claims with the course design and avoid promising results that depend on each learner’s circumstances.
answer.zh: 展示课程适合谁、学完能做什么，以及示范课程如何教学。学习成果应有课程设计支撑，不要承诺取决于个人情况的结果。

heading.en: Name the learner and the problem
heading.zh: 说清学习者与难题

body.en: Describe the learner’s starting point in familiar terms and identify the skill or task they want to handle. Avoid listing every module before viewers know why the course might matter to them.
body.zh: 用熟悉的说法描述学习者的起点和想掌握的技能或任务。先说明课程为何有用，再介绍模块清单。

heading.en: Demonstrate the teaching
heading.zh: 展示课程如何教

body.en: Use a brief lesson excerpt, exercise, or before-and-after example to show the instructor’s approach. Connect each promised outcome to a topic or practice included in the course. Distinguish skills the course teaches from external results it cannot guarantee.
body.zh: 用简短课堂片段、练习或前后对比展示教学方式。将每项学习成果对应到具体主题或练习，并区分课程教授的能力与无法保证的外部结果。

heading.en: Give a clear enrollment next step
heading.zh: 说明报名下一步

body.en: State who should enroll, what access includes, and where to review schedule, prerequisites, price, and refund details. Use a direct call to action, then reread the promo to remove claims not supported by the course itself.
body.zh: 说明适合报名的人、课程包含的内容，以及查询时间、先修要求、价格和退款信息的入口。直接邀请观众行动，并删去课程本身无法支撑的宣传说法。

q.en: Can a course promo promise career results?
q.zh: 课程宣传能承诺职业结果吗？

a.en: Describe the skills and support the course provides, but do not guarantee a job, income, or promotion unless the claim is substantiated and its conditions are clear.
a.zh: 可以介绍课程提供的技能与支持，但除非有充分依据且条件清楚，否则不要保证就业、收入或晋升结果。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Company About Us Video
title.zh: 企业介绍视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Company About Us Video
seo_title.zh: 企业介绍视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Tell a company story through the customer problem, the choices that shaped the business, and evidence of how it works today.
description.zh: 通过客户问题、塑造公司的选择，以及企业今天如何运作来讲公司故事。

answer.en: Tell a company story through the customer problem, the choices that shaped the business, and evidence of how it works today. Replace broad mission statements with specific people, products, and examples viewers can verify.
answer.zh: 通过客户问题、塑造公司的选择，以及企业今天如何运作来讲公司故事。用具体人物、产品和可核实案例取代宽泛的使命宣言。

heading.en: Choose the audience and purpose
heading.zh: 明确受众和用途

body.en: Decide whether the viewer is a customer, candidate, partner, or community member. Choose one question the video should answer for that audience; a single short film cannot explain every team, product, and milestone equally well.
body.zh: 先确定观众是客户、求职者、合作伙伴还是社区成员，再选一个视频要回答的问题。一支短片无法同等解释每个团队、产品和里程碑。

heading.en: Show the company through decisions
heading.zh: 用选择展现公司

body.en: Use a founding moment, customer challenge, or current practice to demonstrate what the company values. Include evidence such as a real process, product, or employee perspective, with permission. Avoid unsupported superlatives and anonymous claims of impact.
body.zh: 用创业时刻、客户难题或当前做法展示企业重视什么。经授权后加入真实流程、产品或员工视角作为证据，避免无依据的最高级和匿名影响力说法。

heading.en: End with a useful next step
heading.zh: 以有用行动结束

body.en: Summarize what the company offers in language viewers understand, then direct each audience to a relevant page or contact. Keep the invitation proportionate to the story and make names, dates, locations, and claims easy to verify.
body.zh: 用观众听得懂的话总结企业提供什么，再把不同受众引向相关页面或联系人。行动邀请要符合故事内容，姓名、日期、地点和论据都应便于核实。

q.en: How long should an About Us video be?
q.zh: 企业介绍视频应该多长？

a.en: Use the shortest runtime that answers the audience’s main question with a concrete story and useful next step. Let the intended placement and viewer attention guide the edit.
a.zh: 以能用具体故事和实用下一步回答受众核心问题的最短时长为准，并依据播放位置与观众注意力剪辑。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Script an Event Highlight Video
title.zh: 活动精彩回顾视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Script an Event Highlight Video
seo_title.zh: 活动精彩回顾视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Build an event highlight video around a clear takeaway, representative moments, and a closing that tells viewers what happened next.
description.zh: 围绕一个明确收获、具代表性的现场瞬间和说明后续的结尾来制作活动回顾。

answer.en: Build an event highlight video around a clear takeaway, representative moments, and a closing that tells viewers what happened next. Plan coverage and permissions in advance so the edit has more than a montage of attractive shots.
answer.zh: 围绕一个明确收获、具代表性的现场瞬间和说明后续的结尾来制作活动回顾。提前安排拍摄与授权，让成片不只是好看镜头的拼接。

heading.en: Decide whose event story to tell
heading.zh: 明确要讲谁的活动故事

body.en: Choose the event’s audience and the impression or result they should remember. Select moments that demonstrate that outcome: a speaker’s idea, a participant response, a product demonstration, or a community interaction.
body.zh: 确定活动面向谁，以及观众应该记住的印象或成果。挑选能体现成果的片段，例如演讲观点、参与者反应、产品演示或社区互动。

heading.en: Plan a beginning, middle, and finish
heading.zh: 规划开端、发展和结尾

body.en: Open with the event identity and stakes, move through varied moments in a purposeful sequence, and finish with an outcome, quote, or future date. Capture room tone, names, and establishing shots that help make the edit understandable.
body.zh: 开头交代活动身份与看点，中段按目的呈现不同瞬间，结尾给出成果、引语或下一次日期。拍摄现场环境声、姓名信息和交代场景的镜头，方便剪辑理解。

heading.en: Get usable footage responsibly
heading.zh: 负责任地取得可用素材

body.en: List must-have shots and identify anyone who needs consent before recording or publication. Verify speaker names, captions, sponsor mentions, and event details. Build alternate edits if participants or music cannot be included in every destination.
body.zh: 列出必拍画面，并确认哪些人需要在拍摄或发布前同意。核对讲者姓名、字幕、赞助商和活动信息；若参与者或音乐无法用于所有渠道，准备替代版本。

q.en: Should an event highlight video include interviews?
q.zh: 活动回顾视频需要采访吗？

a.en: Short attendee or speaker comments can add perspective when they support the event’s takeaway. Plan focused questions and permission in advance, and use the comments with enough context to represent speakers fairly.
a.zh: 若能支持活动重点，简短的参与者或讲者评价可以增加视角。提前准备聚焦问题并取得授权，保留足够背景，公平呈现发言。

title.en: How to Write a Personal Brand Video Script
title.zh: 个人品牌视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Personal Brand Video Script
seo_title.zh: 个人品牌视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Make a personal brand video useful by connecting a real experience to a specific point of view or skill.
description.zh: 把真实经历连接到明确观点或技能，让个人品牌视频对观众有用。

answer.en: Make a personal brand video useful by connecting a real experience to a specific point of view or skill. Give viewers evidence of how you work, then state who you help and what they can do next.
answer.zh: 把真实经历连接到明确观点或技能，让个人品牌视频对观众有用。展示工作方式的证据，再说明你服务谁、观众可以采取什么行动。

heading.en: Choose one audience problem
heading.zh: 从一个受众难题切入

body.en: Name the people you want to reach and the question they are trying to answer. Choose one moment from your work that helps explain your approach. A biography timeline usually has less value than a focused story about a meaningful decision.
body.zh: 明确希望触达的人群及其正在解决的问题。选取一个能说明你做事方式的真实经历；相比履历时间线，聚焦一次重要决定通常更有价值。

heading.en: Support your point with proof
heading.zh: 用证据支持观点

body.en: Show a process, example, result, or lesson and explain your role accurately. Separate what you observed from what you infer. Avoid turning one success into a claim that the same method guarantees results for everyone.
body.zh: 展示流程、例子、结果或经验，并准确说明自己的角色。把观察到的事实与个人推断分开，不要把一次成功说成人人照做都能保证结果。

heading.en: Invite the right next conversation
heading.zh: 邀请合适的后续交流

body.en: End with one relevant next step: a resource, a question, a portfolio, or a service page. Keep the invitation consistent with what the video demonstrated and include captions so viewers can follow without sound.
body.zh: 结尾给出一个相关下一步：资料、问题、作品集或服务页面。邀请内容要与视频展示一致，并配上字幕，让静音观看者也能跟上。

q.en: Should a personal brand video be a personal story?
q.zh: 个人品牌视频要讲个人故事吗？

a.en: A personal example can help, but connect it to a lesson, service, or audience need. Share only details that clarify your perspective and respect other people’s privacy.
a.zh: 可以用个人经历，但要连接到经验、服务或受众需求。只分享能说明观点的细节，并尊重他人隐私。

text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a LinkedIn Video Script
title.zh: LinkedIn视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a LinkedIn Video Script

description.en: Give a LinkedIn video a professional audience, one practical insight, and an example that supports it.
description.zh: 为LinkedIn视频明确职业受众、一个实用观点和支撑观点的例子。

answer.en: Give a LinkedIn video a professional audience, one practical insight, and an example that supports it. Make the opening understandable in a feed, use captions, and end with a useful prompt for discussion rather than a generic engagement request.
answer.zh: 为LinkedIn视频明确职业受众、一个实用观点和支撑观点的例子。开头应适合信息流浏览，配上字幕，结尾提出有价值的讨论问题，而不是泛泛求互动。

heading.en: Lead with a work-related question
heading.zh: 从工作相关问题开场

body.en: Open on a decision, mistake, or process your intended audience recognizes. State why it matters before presenting your credentials. Avoid confidential company details and obtain approval for examples that involve a client or employer.
body.zh: 从目标观众熟悉的决定、错误或流程切入。先讲问题为何重要，再介绍资历。避免泄露公司机密；涉及客户或雇主的案例要先获批准。

heading.en: Teach one point with an example
heading.zh: 通过案例讲透一个观点

body.en: Explain the insight in plain language and show how it applies to one realistic situation. Use a chart, screen recording, or brief story only if it makes the reasoning easier to follow. Distinguish personal opinion from a documented result.
body.zh: 用直白语言说明观点，并通过一个真实情境展示如何应用。只有当图表、录屏或短故事能帮助理解推理时才加入，同时区分个人看法和有记录的结果。

heading.en: Close with a substantive prompt
heading.zh: 用实质问题收尾

body.en: Ask viewers to compare approaches or share a specific challenge related to the topic. Offer a resource or next step if one exists. Check subtitles, names, numbers, and accessibility before publishing.
body.zh: 邀请观众比较做法，或分享与主题相关的具体难题。若有相关资料或下一步，也可提供入口。发布前检查字幕、姓名、数字和无障碍体验。

q.en: Should a LinkedIn video use formal language?
q.zh: LinkedIn视频需要正式用语吗？

a.en: Use clear professional language, not jargon for its own sake. A conversational delivery can work well when the example and advice remain accurate and relevant to the audience.
a.zh: 使用清楚、专业的表达，不要为显得专业而堆术语。只要例子与建议准确且符合受众，口语化讲述也很合适。

title.en: How to Script Clips from a Livestream
title.zh: 直播回放怎么剪成短片

seo_title.en: How to Script Clips from a Livestream
seo_title.zh: 直播回放怎么剪成短片

description.en: Find a complete moment in the stream, then add a concise opening and context for viewers who missed it live.
description.zh: 从直播中寻找完整片段，再为错过直播的观众补上简洁开头和背景。

answer.en: Find a complete moment in the stream, then add a concise opening and context for viewers who missed it live. Preserve the chronology and meaning of the exchange, and identify any edits that could change how a participant appears.
answer.zh: 从直播中寻找完整片段，再为错过直播的观众补上简洁开头和背景。保留对话顺序与原意，并识别可能改变参与者形象的剪辑。

heading.en: Mark moments during the stream
heading.zh: 直播时标记精彩片段

body.en: Use timestamps or a moderator’s notes to record strong answers, demonstrations, and audience reactions. Note what happened immediately before and after; a memorable line may depend on a question or qualification outside the apparent highlight.
body.zh: 用时间戳或主持人笔记记录有价值的回答、演示和观众反应，并注明前后发生了什么。精彩话语可能依赖片段外的问题或限定条件。

heading.en: Reshape without changing meaning
heading.zh: 重组内容但不改原意

body.en: Give the clip enough context to stand alone and trim pauses that add no meaning. Preserve the order of claims, disclose edits where appropriate, and avoid joining separate answers in a way that invents a statement the speaker never made.
body.zh: 补足让片段独立成立的背景，删去没有意义的停顿。保留说法顺序，必要时说明剪辑；不要把不同回答拼接成说话者从未表达的意思。

heading.en: Prepare the clip for replay
heading.zh: 让回放片段适合单独观看

body.en: Add readable captions, speaker names, and an opening that identifies the topic. Check guest permissions, music, and private information in chat. End with the stream date or a link to the full session when viewers may want context.
body.zh: 加入易读字幕、说话者姓名和主题开场。检查嘉宾授权、音乐及聊天区隐私；若观众可能需要背景，可注明直播日期或完整回放入口。

q.en: Can a livestream clip be edited for pacing?
q.zh: 直播片段可以剪快一点吗？

a.en: Yes, as long as the edit preserves the sequence, qualifications, and intended meaning. Do not remove a pause or response if doing so changes the impression of what someone said.
a.zh: 可以，只要剪辑保留顺序、限定条件和原意。若删掉停顿或回应会改变观众对发言的理解，就不应这样处理。

title.en: How to Write a Podcast Intro That Sets Up the Episode
title.zh: 播客开场白怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Podcast Intro That Sets Up the Episode

description.en: A podcast intro tells listeners why this episode matters, who is speaking, and what question or experience will carry it forward.
description.zh: 播客开场要让听众知道本期为何值得听、谁在参与，以及什么问题或经历会贯穿节目。

answer.en: A podcast intro tells listeners why this episode matters, who is speaking, and what question or experience will carry it forward. Keep recurring show information brief so the episode begins before attention drifts.
answer.zh: 播客开场要让听众知道本期为何值得听、谁在参与，以及什么问题或经历会贯穿节目。固定节目介绍应简短，让内容尽快开始。

heading.en: Start with this episode’s reason to listen
heading.zh: 先讲本期看点

body.en: Choose the most useful question, unexpected result, or guest perspective from the episode. Write a line that makes the value clear without giving away every answer. Avoid generic greetings that could introduce any episode.
body.zh: 选出本期最实用的问题、意外结果或嘉宾视角。用一句话说明听下去的价值，同时不泄露全部答案。避免任何一期都能套用的泛泛问候。

heading.en: Introduce names and context clearly
heading.zh: 清楚交代姓名与背景

body.en: State the host and guest names, relevant credentials, and subject in language a first-time listener can follow. Explain specialist terms briefly, and do not imply a guest endorses a product or claim they did not approve.
body.zh: 说明主持人、嘉宾姓名、相关资历和主题，让新听众听得懂。简短解释专业术语，也不要暗示嘉宾认可其未批准的产品或说法。

heading.en: Move into the conversation
heading.zh: 自然进入正题

body.en: End on a question or scene that leads directly to the first segment. Time the intro aloud, remove repeated show branding, and make sure the episode title and opening promise match what the recording delivers.
body.zh: 以能直接带入第一段的问题或场景结束。朗读计时，删去重复的节目介绍，并核对标题与开场承诺是否符合实际内容。

q.en: How long should a podcast intro be?
q.zh: 播客开场应该多长？

a.en: Long enough to orient a new listener and establish the episode’s value. Keep repeated show details short and let the first substantive segment begin promptly.
a.zh: 只需足以帮助新听众定位并了解本期价值。重复的节目介绍应简短，让实质内容尽快开始。

title.en: How to Create a Podcast Interview Outline
title.zh: 播客访谈提纲怎么列

seo_title.en: How to Create a Podcast Interview Outline

description.en: Build a podcast interview around a central question, the guest’s firsthand knowledge, and follow-ups that reveal detail.
description.zh: 围绕一个核心问题、嘉宾的亲身经验和能挖掘细节的追问来设计播客访谈。

answer.en: Build a podcast interview around a central question, the guest’s firsthand knowledge, and follow-ups that reveal detail. Share the subject and boundaries in advance, but leave enough flexibility for useful discoveries during the conversation.
answer.zh: 围绕一个核心问题、嘉宾的亲身经验和能挖掘细节的追问来设计播客访谈。提前沟通主题与边界，同时为现场发现新内容留出弹性。

heading.en: Find the episode’s central question
heading.zh: 找到本期核心问题

body.en: Write what listeners should understand by the end, then select a guest whose experience can answer it. Gather background from reliable sources and note the difference between questions already answered publicly and questions worth asking in conversation.
body.zh: 写明听众听完后应该理解什么，再邀请有相关经验的嘉宾。通过可靠来源查背景，区分公开信息已有答案的问题与适合在对话中追问的问题。

heading.en: Order questions from context to depth
heading.zh: 从背景提问逐步深入

body.en: Begin with an accessible story or decision, then explore how it happened, what changed, and what remains uncertain. Add follow-ups that invite examples and clarify terms. Place sensitive or personal topics only when relevant and agreed in advance.
body.zh: 从容易进入的故事或决定开始，再追问经过、变化和未解之处。准备能引出例子、澄清术语的追问。只有相关且事先沟通过时才涉及敏感或私人话题。

heading.en: Prepare a flexible rundown
heading.zh: 准备灵活流程

body.en: Group questions into segments, set approximate time, and mark optional prompts to skip if the conversation runs long. End with one question that reflects on the central topic and a concise next step for listeners.
body.zh: 把问题分成环节并估算时长，标注超时可跳过的选问。用一个回应核心主题的问题结束，再给听众简洁的下一步。

q.en: Should interview questions be sent to a podcast guest beforehand?
q.zh: 需要提前把访谈问题发给播客嘉宾吗？

a.en: Share the topics, format, and any questions that involve sensitive material. You can keep follow-ups open so the conversation remains natural, while helping the guest prepare accurate details.
a.zh: 可以提前沟通主题、形式及涉及敏感内容的问题。追问则可保留开放，让对话自然，同时帮助嘉宾准备准确细节。

title.en: How to Introduce a Podcast Guest
title.zh: 播客嘉宾怎么介绍

seo_title.en: How to Introduce a Podcast Guest

description.en: Introduce a podcast guest by naming the experience that makes them relevant to the episode and the question they will help explore.
description.zh: 介绍嘉宾时说明与本期主题相关的经验，以及他们将帮助探讨的问题。

answer.en: Introduce a podcast guest by naming the experience that makes them relevant to the episode and the question they will help explore. Keep the bio accurate and focused so listeners reach the conversation quickly.
answer.zh: 介绍嘉宾时说明与本期主题相关的经验，以及他们将帮助探讨的问题。嘉宾简介要准确、聚焦，让听众尽快进入对话。

heading.en: Select credentials that fit the topic
heading.zh: 挑选与主题有关的资历

body.en: Choose one or two verified roles, projects, or experiences that directly support the episode’s subject. Ask how the guest wishes their name and title pronounced or presented. Avoid a full résumé that delays the conversation.
body.zh: 挑选一两项经核实且与本期主题直接相关的职位、作品或经历。确认嘉宾希望如何读姓名、介绍头衔，避免念完整履历而拖延节目。

heading.en: Connect the guest to the audience question
heading.zh: 把嘉宾与听众问题连接起来

body.en: Explain why this person can offer useful perspective, then name the question the episode will investigate. Do not inflate expertise or imply the guest speaks for an entire group or organization without permission.
body.zh: 说明嘉宾为何能提供有用视角，再点出本期要探讨的问题。不要夸大专业能力，也不要未经允许就说嘉宾代表整个群体或机构发言。

heading.en: Move from intro to first question
heading.zh: 从介绍自然过渡到首问

body.en: Write the final line so it invites the guest into a concrete story or decision. Keep sponsor messages and show identification separate where required, then read the intro aloud to catch awkward titles or repeated phrases.
body.zh: 用最后一句引导嘉宾讲具体故事或决定。按要求单独安排赞助信息和节目名称，再朗读检查别扭头衔和重复表达。

q.en: Should a podcast intro list every guest credential?
q.zh: 播客开场要列出嘉宾所有资历吗？

a.en: No. Include only credentials that help listeners understand why the guest is relevant to this episode. Link to fuller biographies in the show notes when useful.
a.zh: 不必。只介绍有助于听众理解嘉宾为何适合本期的资历。需要时可在节目说明中链接完整简介。

title.en: How to Plan a Video Content Series
title.zh: 视频系列内容怎么规划

seo_title.en: How to Plan a Video Content Series
seo_title.zh: 视频系列内容怎么规划

description.en: Create a video series from one audience need that can support distinct episodes with a consistent promise.
description.zh: 从能支撑多期内容的一项受众需求出发，规划承诺一致、每期各有重点的视频系列。

answer.en: Create a video series from one audience need that can support distinct episodes with a consistent promise. Define what stays the same, what changes each time, and where a new viewer should begin.
answer.zh: 从能支撑多期内容的一项受众需求出发，规划承诺一致、每期各有重点的视频系列。明确固定元素、每期变化，以及新观众从哪里开始观看。

heading.en: Define the repeatable promise
heading.zh: 定义可持续兑现的承诺

body.en: Write a one-sentence description of what viewers gain from any episode. Choose a subject with enough real examples or questions for a season, and state the intended audience so the series does not become a collection of unrelated ideas.
body.zh: 用一句话说明观众每期都能获得什么。选择有足够真实案例或问题支撑一季的主题，并写明受众，避免系列变成无关选题合集。

heading.en: Give each episode its own payoff
heading.zh: 让每集有独立收获

body.en: Create episode questions that stand alone while contributing to the larger subject. Vary examples, guests, or demonstrations without changing the core promise. Track what earlier episodes assume so a new viewer is not lost.
body.zh: 为每集设计独立问题，同时服务更大主题。可以变化案例、嘉宾或演示，但不改变核心承诺；记录前期内容依赖，避免新观众跟不上。

heading.en: Plan production and entry points
heading.zh: 安排制作与观看入口

body.en: Choose a realistic release rhythm based on research, recording, and editing time. Prepare a short series trailer or playlist description, and link episodes in a useful order. Review the first few releases before committing to a schedule you cannot maintain.
body.zh: 根据研究、录制和剪辑时间设定可实现的发布节奏。准备系列预告或播放列表说明，并按观看逻辑串联各集。先复盘前几期，再承诺能持续执行的计划。

q.en: How many videos should a series have?
q.zh: 视频系列应该做几集？

a.en: Enough to answer the subject’s main questions without repeating the format. Set a first season length that fits your capacity and the number of useful episodes you can actually produce.
a.zh: 以能回答主题主要问题、又不重复内容为准。第一季集数应符合制作能力和真正有价值的选题数量。

title.en: How to Write a Launch Video Script
title.zh: 产品或项目发布视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Launch Video Script
seo_title.zh: 产品或项目发布视频脚本怎么写

description.en: A launch video explains what is new, who it is for, and why the change matters through a clear demonstration or story.
description.zh: 发布视频要通过清晰演示或故事说明新品是什么、适合谁、为何重要。

answer.en: A launch video explains what is new, who it is for, and why the change matters through a clear demonstration or story. Verify availability, features, and claims, then give viewers one next step.
answer.zh: 发布视频要通过清晰演示或故事说明新品是什么、适合谁、为何重要。核实可用时间、功能和宣传说法，再告诉观众一个下一步。

heading.en: Lead with the change
heading.zh: 从变化切入

body.en: Show the problem, need, or moment that prompted the launch. Introduce the new product or project after viewers understand the context, and distinguish what is available now from what is planned for later.
body.zh: 展示促成发布的问题、需求或时刻。观众理解背景后再介绍新品，并区分当前可用功能和未来计划。

heading.en: Demonstrate the central benefit
heading.zh: 演示核心价值

body.en: Choose one task the audience can judge on screen. Show the steps and result, then explain which feature makes the difference. Avoid stacking claims or comparing competitors without evidence.
body.zh: 挑选一项观众能在画面中判断的任务，展示过程与结果，再解释相关功能。不要堆叠说法，也不要在缺乏依据时比较竞品。

heading.en: End with a single action
heading.zh: 结尾只安排一个行动

body.en: Tell viewers where to try, buy, sign up, or learn more, with relevant timing and conditions. Add a clear link or on-screen direction and make sure the closing does not promise more than the launch delivers.
body.zh: 说明观众在哪里试用、购买、报名或了解详情，并交代时间和条件。给出清晰链接或画面指引，结尾承诺不要超过此次发布的实际内容。

q.en: What should a launch video include?
q.zh: 发布视频需要包含什么？

a.en: Show what changed, who benefits, one piece of evidence or demonstration, and the next step. Include only details the audience needs to make sense of the launch.
a.zh: 说明变化、受益人群、一项证据或演示，以及下一步。只加入观众理解发布内容所需的信息。

title.en: How to Write a Campaign Video Script
title.zh: 活动宣传视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Campaign Video Script
seo_title.zh: 活动宣传视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Give a campaign video one audience, one message, and a specific action viewers can take.
description.zh: 为活动宣传视频设定一个受众、一条核心信息和观众可以采取的具体行动。

answer.en: Give a campaign video one audience, one message, and a specific action viewers can take. Support the message with a human story or verifiable evidence, then state timing and participation details clearly.
answer.zh: 为活动宣传视频设定一个受众、一条核心信息和观众可以采取的具体行动。用真实人物故事或可核实证据支撑信息，并清楚说明时间和参与方式。

heading.en: Choose the campaign objective
heading.zh: 明确活动目标

body.en: Decide whether the video needs to inform, recruit, raise funds, or prompt attendance. Identify the intended audience and the action they can realistically take. If the campaign has multiple goals, give each a separate asset or segment.
body.zh: 确定视频是用于告知、招募、筹款还是邀请参加，并明确受众及其实际可行的行动。若活动目标不止一个，就拆分素材或环节。

heading.en: Support the message with specifics
heading.zh: 用具体内容支撑主张

body.en: Use a participant story, documented result, demonstration, or clearly attributed statement. Explain context and avoid implying one person’s experience represents everyone. Verify names, numbers, dates, eligibility, and any outcome claims.
body.zh: 使用参与者故事、有记录的成果、演示或明确注明来源的说法。补充背景，避免暗示个别经历代表所有人，并核实姓名、数字、日期、资格和效果主张。

heading.en: Make participation straightforward
heading.zh: 让参与方式一目了然

body.en: State the action, deadline, location or link, and any conditions in plain language. Put essential details on screen long enough to read and repeat them in captions or the description. End with a direct invitation tied to the campaign purpose.
body.zh: 用直白语言说明行动、截止时间、地点或链接及相关条件。关键信息要在屏幕上停留足够久，并在字幕或说明中重复。结尾的邀请应紧扣活动目标。

q.en: Should a campaign video use emotional storytelling?
q.zh: 活动宣传视频要用情感故事吗？

a.en: It can, when the story is truthful, relevant, and shared with permission. Pair emotion with clear facts about the campaign and what viewers can do.
a.zh: 可以，但故事必须真实、相关且经过当事人许可。还要配合清楚的活动事实和观众可采取的行动。

title.en: How to Write a Customer Case Study Video
title.zh: 客户案例视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Customer Case Study Video
seo_title.zh: 客户案例视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Tell a customer case study through the customer’s problem, decision, implementation, and documented outcome.
description.zh: 按客户面临的问题、选择、实施和有记录的结果来讲述案例。

answer.en: Tell a customer case study through the customer’s problem, decision, implementation, and documented outcome. Use approved evidence and keep the customer’s voice central instead of turning the story into unsupported product claims.
answer.zh: 按客户面临的问题、选择、实施和有记录的结果来讲述案例。使用经批准的证据，让客户声音成为主线，避免把故事变成无依据的产品宣传。

heading.en: Confirm the evidence and permissions
heading.zh: 确认事实与授权

body.en: Agree on what the customer can discuss and which metrics, names, visuals, and quotes may be published. Review the relevant period and comparison so a result is not presented without context. Record source material for every factual claim.
body.zh: 确认客户能谈论哪些内容，哪些数据、姓名、画面和引语可以发布。核实指标的统计时间与对比背景，避免脱离语境呈现结果；为每项事实保存来源。

heading.en: Follow the customer’s decision path
heading.zh: 沿着客户的选择过程讲

body.en: Structure the interview around the situation before using the product, alternatives considered, implementation, and what changed. Ask for a concrete example and the limits of the result. Let the customer explain their own decision in their own words.
body.zh: 访谈围绕使用前情况、考虑过的替代方案、实际落地和变化展开。追问具体例子与效果边界，让客户用自己的话说明决定。

heading.en: Edit for credibility
heading.zh: 以可信度为剪辑标准

body.en: Keep context around quotes, identify the company relationship, and distinguish measured outcomes from impressions. Remove repeated praise and show supporting material where permissions allow. Finish with a next step that fits the viewer’s needs.
body.zh: 保留引语上下文，说明合作关系，并区分测量结果与主观感受。在授权范围内展示支持材料，删掉重复赞美。结尾给出符合观众需求的下一步。

q.en: Can a case study video include estimated results?
q.zh: 客户案例视频可以展示估算结果吗？

a.en: Only when the estimate is clearly labeled, the method is explained, and the customer has approved its use. Do not present projections as measured outcomes.
a.zh: 只有在清楚标注估算、解释方法并获得客户批准时才可以。不要把预测说成已经测得的结果。

title.en: How to Script an Educational YouTube Video
title.zh: 教育类YouTube视频脚本怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Script an Educational YouTube Video
seo_title.zh: 教育类YouTube视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Teach one learning objective in an order viewers can follow: explain the problem, model the idea, show an example, and check understanding.
description.zh: 按观众容易理解的顺序讲清一个学习目标：说明问题、示范思路、展示例子并检查理解。

answer.en: Teach one learning objective in an order viewers can follow: explain the problem, model the idea, show an example, and check understanding. Plan visuals alongside narration and cite sources for factual claims.
answer.zh: 按观众容易理解的顺序讲清一个学习目标：说明问题、示范思路、展示例子并检查理解。旁白要配合画面规划，事实说法注明来源。

heading.en: Set one learning outcome
heading.zh: 设定一个学习结果

body.en: Write what a viewer should be able to explain or do after watching. Use that outcome to decide what background is essential and what can become another video. Define unfamiliar terms before relying on them.
body.zh: 写清观众看完后应该能解释或完成什么。依据学习目标决定必要背景，其他内容可另做一集；使用陌生术语前先解释。

heading.en: Teach with a worked example
heading.zh: 用完整例子进行教学

body.en: Introduce the method briefly, then demonstrate it on a realistic problem from beginning to end. Narrate why each step matters and show intermediate states. Include a common mistake so viewers can recognize and correct it.
body.zh: 简要介绍方法，再用真实问题从头到尾演示，并解释每步作用、展示中间结果。加入常见错误，帮助观众识别并纠正。

heading.en: Check comprehension and sources
heading.zh: 检查理解与来源

body.en: End with a short recap, practice question, or next step that lets viewers use the lesson. Verify factual claims and put sources where viewers can find them. Review whether diagrams and captions remain readable on a small screen.
body.zh: 用简短回顾、练习题或下一步收尾，让观众实际运用所学。核实事实并提供来源入口，检查图表和字幕在小屏幕上是否清晰。

q.en: How many learning goals should one video cover?
q.zh: 一条教学视频讲几个学习目标？

a.en: Usually one main outcome. Related details can support it, but separate goals when viewers need distinct background, examples, or practice to master them.
a.zh: 通常一个主要目标即可。相关细节可以辅助教学；若不同目标需要各自的背景、例子或练习，就拆成多条视频。

text.en: Use the video-recap workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 video-recap 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Game Narrative Design Document
title.zh: 游戏叙事设计文档怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Game Narrative Design Document
seo_title.zh: 游戏叙事设计文档怎么写

description.en: Document the player’s role, the story experience, and how narrative content connects to playable systems.
description.zh: 记录玩家身份、故事体验，以及叙事内容如何连接可玩系统。

answer.en: Document the player’s role, the story experience, and how narrative content connects to playable systems. Give the team shared decisions, dependencies, and open questions so writing, design, and production can plan together.
answer.zh: 记录玩家身份、故事体验，以及叙事内容如何连接可玩系统。把团队共同决策、依赖项和待确认问题写清楚，方便编剧、设计和制作协作。

heading.en: Define the player-facing promise
heading.zh: 定义玩家体验承诺

body.en: State what the player will do and feel, not only what the plot is about. Describe the premise, protagonist or player role, central conflict, and the decisions that make the story interactive. Keep the document focused on information another discipline needs.
body.zh: 说明玩家会做什么、感受到什么，而不只是剧情讲什么。写明前提、主角或玩家身份、核心冲突，以及让故事产生互动的决定；重点放在其他职能需要的信息上。

heading.en: Map narrative content to play
heading.zh: 把叙事内容对应到玩法

body.en: List the main story beats, delivery methods, player actions, state changes, and required assets. Mark where dialogue, exploration, missions, or cinematic scenes depend on gameplay systems. Include a small example flow to expose unclear assumptions.
body.zh: 列出主要故事节拍、呈现方式、玩家行动、状态变化和所需素材。标出对白、探索、任务或过场依赖哪些玩法系统，并用一段示例流程暴露含糊假设。

heading.en: Make decisions and unknowns visible
heading.zh: 让决策与未知事项可见

body.en: Separate confirmed rules from proposals and questions. Record owners and dependencies for items that affect scope, branching, or production time. Review the document with design and engineering before expanding content so the story plan remains buildable.
body.zh: 把已确定规则、提议和问题分开记录。为影响范围、分支或制作时间的事项注明负责人及依赖。扩写剧情前先和设计、工程一起审阅，确保方案可以落地。

q.en: How detailed should a narrative design document be?
q.zh: 游戏叙事设计文档要多详细？

a.en: Detailed enough for collaborators to understand player experience, content needs, and dependencies. Expand sections when they support a decision; avoid writing a full novel where a flow or table is clearer.
a.zh: 应足以让合作者理解玩家体验、内容需求和依赖关系。能帮助决策的部分再展开；流程图或表格更清楚时，不必写成完整小说。

text.en: Use the novel-to-game workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Create a Game Story Bible
title.zh: 游戏故事圣经怎么建

seo_title.en: How to Create a Game Story Bible

description.en: Keep a game story bible as the shared reference for canon, characters, world rules, timelines, and branching outcomes.
description.zh: 用游戏故事圣经统一管理正史、角色、世界规则、时间线和分支结果。

answer.en: Keep a game story bible as the shared reference for canon, characters, world rules, timelines, and branching outcomes. Organize it so writers can find the current answer and distinguish confirmed facts from ideas still in development.
answer.zh: 用游戏故事圣经统一管理正史、角色、世界规则、时间线和分支结果。按编剧容易查找的方式组织，并区分已确认事实与仍在开发的构想。

heading.en: Record canon at useful levels
heading.zh: 按实用层级记录正史

body.en: Start with the premise and rules that constrain every story, then add character histories, locations, factions, and event chronology. Store only detail that helps writers make consistent decisions or understand what players can discover.
body.zh: 先记录约束所有剧情的前提与规则，再补充人物经历、地点、阵营和事件时间线。只保存能帮助编剧保持一致、或理解玩家可发现内容的细节。

heading.en: Track branches and versions
heading.zh: 追踪分支与版本

body.en: For each major choice, note its conditions, effects, and what remains shared across routes. Label approved, draft, and retired material; connect entries to the relevant script or design document. This prevents an old branch from becoming accidental canon.
body.zh: 为每项重要选择记录触发条件、影响及各路线共通部分。标注已批准、草稿和废弃内容，并链接相关剧本或设计文档，避免旧分支意外变成正史。

heading.en: Make the bible easy to maintain
heading.zh: 让资料便于维护

body.en: Assign an owner, date meaningful changes, and provide a concise index or search tags. When a story decision changes, update related characters, missions, and dialogue references. Review the bible at milestones rather than letting it become an unread archive.
body.zh: 明确维护负责人，为重要改动注明日期，并提供简洁目录或检索标签。故事决定改变时同步更新相关人物、任务和对白引用；按项目节点复查，别让资料变成无人翻阅的档案。

q.en: Who should maintain a game story bible?
q.zh: 游戏故事圣经由谁维护？

a.en: Assign one narrative owner or a small editorial group to resolve consistency questions. Contributors can update their material, while a named owner keeps shared rules and canon aligned.
a.zh: 指定叙事负责人或小型编辑组处理一致性问题。各位贡献者可以更新自己的内容，由明确负责人维护共同规则与正史。

text.en: Use the novel-to-game workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Pitch a Game Story to a Studio
title.zh: 怎么向游戏团队提案故事

seo_title.en: How to Pitch a Game Story to a Studio
seo_title.zh: 怎么向游戏团队提案故事

description.en: Pitch a game story by explaining the player fantasy, the core conflict, and what players will actually do.
description.zh: 提案时说明玩家幻想、核心冲突和玩家实际会做什么。

answer.en: Pitch a game story by explaining the player fantasy, the core conflict, and what players will actually do. Show how the story fits the game’s audience and scope, then support the proposal with a small playable or scripted example.
answer.zh: 提案时说明玩家幻想、核心冲突和玩家实际会做什么。展示故事如何适配游戏受众与制作规模，并用一段小型可玩或剧本示例支撑提案。

heading.en: Lead with the playable idea
heading.zh: 先讲可玩的创意

body.en: Summarize the protagonist or player role, the conflict, and the action that makes this story a game. A dramatic plot alone is not enough; explain what decisions, exploration, or cooperation the player experiences.
body.zh: 概括玩家身份、冲突，以及让故事成为游戏的行动。只有戏剧性剧情还不够；还要说明玩家会经历哪些决定、探索或合作。

heading.en: Show fit and feasible scope
heading.zh: 说明适配度与可行规模

body.en: Connect the premise to the studio’s genre, audience, team, and production constraints. Identify the story’s essential content and what can be reduced if time changes. Do not rely on large volumes of dialogue or cinematics unless the project can support them.
body.zh: 把前提与团队的类型、受众、人员和制作限制相连。指出故事不可缺少的内容，以及工期变化时可缩减之处。除非项目能承担，否则不要依赖大量对白或过场。

heading.en: Prove the experience with a sample
heading.zh: 用示例证明体验

body.en: Prepare a concise sequence showing setup, player action, feedback, and consequence. Explain what the sample validates and what still needs testing. Close with the support, decision, or next meeting you need from the team.
body.zh: 准备一段简洁示例，展现铺垫、玩家行动、反馈和后果。说明示例验证了什么、还有什么需要测试。最后明确希望团队提供的支持、决定或后续会议。

q.en: Should a game story pitch include a full plot summary?
q.zh: 游戏故事提案需要完整剧情梗概吗？

a.en: Give enough of the plot to show direction and payoff, but focus on the player’s role and repeatable experience. Follow the studio’s requested format and submission limits.
a.zh: 说明足以展示方向和回报的剧情即可，重点放在玩家角色与可持续体验上。遵循团队要求的格式和提交限制。
