text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Build a Game Narrative Design Portfolio
title.zh: 游戏叙事设计作品集怎么做

seo_title.en: How to Build a Game Narrative Design Portfolio
seo_title.zh: 游戏叙事设计作品集怎么做

description.en: Show how you solve narrative problems for play, not only that you can write polished scenes.
description.zh: 展示你如何解决玩法中的叙事问题，而不只是能写出润色过的场景。

answer.en: Show how you solve narrative problems for play, not only that you can write polished scenes. Include samples with their design context, constraints, choices, and the reasoning behind revisions.
answer.zh: 展示你如何解决玩法中的叙事问题，而不只是能写出润色过的场景。作品应说明设计背景、限制、玩家选择和修改依据。

heading.en: Select complementary samples
heading.zh: 选择互补的作品样本

body.en: Include a mix such as a short scene, branching conversation, quest outline, narrative brief, or implementation-ready dialogue sample. Choose pieces that demonstrate different skills rather than several versions of the same prose scene.
body.zh: 选择互补样本，例如短场景、分支对话、任务提纲、叙事简报或可交付实现的对白。让作品展示不同能力，不要只放多篇相似的文字场景。

heading.en: Explain the design problem
heading.zh: 说明设计问题

body.en: For each piece, state the intended player experience, audience, format, and limits. Show what the player can do and how the story responds. If the work is adapted from existing material, identify what you changed and why.
body.zh: 每份作品说明目标体验、受众、格式和限制，展示玩家能做什么、故事如何回应。若由已有素材改编，应指出改动内容与理由。

heading.en: Make the portfolio easy to review
heading.zh: 让作品集便于评阅

body.en: Put the strongest relevant sample first, use clear labels, and link to playable builds or readable documents. Credit collaborators and explain your contribution precisely. Remove confidential material and check that every link opens without special access.
body.zh: 把最相关的强项作品放在前面，使用清晰标签，并链接可玩的版本或易读文档。注明合作者和自己的具体贡献，移除机密内容，并确认链接无需特殊权限即可打开。

q.en: How many samples should a game narrative portfolio contain?
q.zh: 游戏叙事作品集需要多少样本？

a.en: Use enough to demonstrate the range the role requires, while keeping each sample short and relevant. A few well-explained pieces are easier to evaluate than a large uncurated archive.
a.zh: 样本数量以能展示岗位所需能力为准，每份都应简短相关。少量说明清楚的作品比未经筛选的大量存档更易评估。

text.en: Use the novel-to-game workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write Dialogue for an Open-World Game
title.zh: 开放世界游戏对白怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write Dialogue for an Open-World Game
seo_title.zh: 开放世界游戏对白怎么写

description.en: Write open-world dialogue in pieces that stay clear when players encounter them in different orders.
description.zh: 把开放世界对白写成可按不同顺序遇见也能理解的单元。

answer.en: Write open-world dialogue in pieces that stay clear when players encounter them in different orders. Use character voice, situation, and state-aware context to make optional conversations feel specific without repeating the main story.
answer.zh: 把开放世界对白写成可按不同顺序遇见也能理解的单元。通过人物声音、情境和状态背景，让可选对话具体自然，又不重复主线。

heading.en: Assume players arrive out of order
heading.zh: 假设玩家会按不同顺序遇到内容

body.en: Give each exchange enough context to stand alone and avoid references that only make sense after a mission most players may not have completed. Use short recaps or alternate lines when a character’s knowledge changes with progress.
body.zh: 让每段对话都有足够背景独立成立。避免依赖玩家可能尚未完成任务的信息；角色认知随进度变化时，准备简短回顾或替换台词。

heading.en: Write for interaction and interruption
heading.zh: 为互动与打断写对白

body.en: Keep ambient lines brief and purposeful; reserve longer exchanges for conversations players choose to start. Mark conditions, speaker, location, and interruption points so the dialogue can respond to combat, movement, or nearby events.
body.zh: 环境对白简短且有作用；较长交流留给玩家主动开启的对话。标注触发条件、说话者、地点和中断点，让对白能回应战斗、移动或附近事件。

heading.en: Check variation and repetition
heading.zh: 检查变化与重复

body.en: Track how often players can hear a line and what alternate lines replace it. Read quest and ambient dialogue together to find repeated exposition. Test lines in motion, with gameplay audio and subtitles, not only in a document.
body.zh: 记录玩家听到每句的频率及替换台词，把任务对白与环境对白合并检查重复信息。要在移动状态、游戏音效和字幕环境下测试，不能只在文档里读。

q.en: How long should open-world NPC dialogue be?
q.zh: 开放世界NPC对白应该多长？

a.en: Match length to the interaction. Ambient lines should be brief; an optional conversation can run longer when players choose to engage and it adds character or consequence.
a.zh: 长度应符合互动方式。环境台词宜简短；玩家主动开启且能补充人物或后果的可选对话可以更长。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Reveal Game Lore Through Player Discovery
title.zh: 如何通过探索揭示游戏背景

seo_title.en: How to Reveal Game Lore Through Player Discovery
seo_title.zh: 如何通过探索揭示游戏背景

description.en: Let players discover game lore through places, objects, dialogue, and consequences that make the world easier to understand.
description.zh: 通过地点、物件、对白和后果让玩家逐步理解游戏世界。

answer.en: Let players discover game lore through places, objects, dialogue, and consequences that make the world easier to understand. Each clue should reward curiosity while leaving the player free to continue playing.
answer.zh: 通过地点、物件、对白和后果让玩家逐步理解游戏世界。每条线索都应奖励好奇心，同时不妨碍玩家继续游玩。

heading.en: Start with what players need to know
heading.zh: 先确定玩家必须知道什么

body.en: Separate information needed to act from history that deepens the setting. Put essential rules where players can understand them before a meaningful decision, and make optional discoveries enrich rather than repair a confusing main plot.
body.zh: 区分行动所需信息与丰富设定的历史。在重要决定前让玩家理解关键规则；可选发现应丰富主线，而不是补救主线不清的问题。

heading.en: Tie clues to exploration
heading.zh: 让线索融入探索

body.en: Place evidence where it connects to a visible question: why a room is abandoned, who used an object, or what changed in a location. Use environmental details, short texts, and character reactions as complementary clues rather than repeating the same exposition.
body.zh: 把证据放在能回应明显问题的地点：房间为何废弃、物品曾被谁使用、场所发生了什么变化。用环境细节、短文本和人物反应互补呈现，避免反复说同一段背景。

heading.en: Check readability and payoff
heading.zh: 检查可读性与回报

body.en: Test whether players can notice and interpret clues during ordinary play. Give optional discoveries a payoff, such as a clearer motive, route, or consequence. Do not make a single easy-to-miss note the only source of information required to finish.
body.zh: 测试玩家在正常游玩时能否发现并理解线索。让可选发现带来回报，例如更清楚的动机、路线或后果。不要把通关必需的信息只藏在一份容易错过的笔记里。

q.en: Does every player need to find optional lore?
q.zh: 每位玩家都必须找到可选背景吗？

a.en: No. Optional lore should reward players who explore without blocking the main story. Put essential goals, rules, and consequences in content every player is likely to encounter.
a.zh: 不必。可选背景应奖励探索者，却不能阻断主线。关键目标、规则和后果应放在大多数玩家都会遇见的内容里。

text.en: Use the novel-to-game workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Design a Game Prologue
title.zh: 游戏序章怎么设计

seo_title.en: How to Design a Game Prologue

description.en: Use a game prologue to orient players, introduce the immediate goal, and create the first meaningful action.
description.zh: 用游戏序章帮助玩家定位、理解眼前目标并完成第一次有意义的行动。

answer.en: Use a game prologue to orient players, introduce the immediate goal, and create the first meaningful action. Keep backstory subordinate to play, then end with a change that launches the main experience.
answer.zh: 用游戏序章帮助玩家定位、理解眼前目标并完成第一次有意义的行动。背景故事要让位于玩法，并以推动主体验的变化收尾。

heading.en: Orient players through the first task
heading.zh: 通过首个任务帮助玩家进入

body.en: Show where the player is, what they can do, and why an immediate action matters. Teach controls in the context of a goal rather than stopping for a long explanation. Delay details that do not affect the first decision.
body.zh: 让玩家看懂身处何处、可以做什么，以及眼前行动为何重要。把操作教学放进任务目标中，别因长篇解释而停下；暂缓不影响第一次决定的背景。

heading.en: Connect tutorial moments to story
heading.zh: 让教学环节连接故事

body.en: Give each taught action a dramatic reason and feedback the player can read. Introduce characters and world rules through what the player must notice or choose. Avoid requiring a cinematic scene to explain mechanics that play could demonstrate.
body.zh: 给每项教学动作安排剧情理由和玩家看得懂的反馈。通过玩家必须注意或选择的内容介绍人物与世界规则；玩法能演示的机制不必全靠过场解释。

heading.en: End with a changed objective
heading.zh: 以变化后的目标收尾

body.en: Let the prologue produce a clear consequence: a new destination, a broken plan, or an ally the player must protect. Confirm that the main game begins with momentum and that players know what to do next.
body.zh: 让序章产生明确后果，例如新目的地、被打乱的计划或需要保护的伙伴。确认主游戏接得上动力，并让玩家知道接下来做什么。

q.en: How long should a game prologue be?
q.zh: 游戏序章应该多长？

a.en: Only as long as needed to make the player’s role, controls, immediate goal, and first story change clear. Test the opening with new players and remove steps that do not help them begin.
a.zh: 只需足以说明玩家身份、操作、眼前目标和首次剧情变化。让新玩家试玩开场，并删掉无法帮助他们开始游戏的环节。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Outline a Game Story Before Writing
title.zh: 游戏剧情动笔前怎么列大纲

seo_title.en: How to Outline a Game Story Before Writing
seo_title.zh: 游戏剧情动笔前怎么列大纲

description.en: Outline the player’s goal, the sequence of playable problems, and the story changes caused by action.
description.zh: 先梳理玩家目标、可玩问题的顺序，以及行动造成的故事变化。

answer.en: Outline the player’s goal, the sequence of playable problems, and the story changes caused by action. Mark where choice can alter outcomes and where production needs a stable shared path before drafting dialogue.
answer.zh: 先梳理玩家目标、可玩问题的顺序，以及行动造成的故事变化。标出选择会改变结果之处和制作需要保持共通的部分，再动笔写对白。

heading.en: Begin with the player’s goal
heading.zh: 从玩家目标开始

body.en: Write what the player is trying to accomplish and what blocks progress. Separate the character’s motivation from the player’s immediate objective so the game gives clear direction without dictating every emotion.
body.zh: 写清玩家要完成什么、什么阻碍进展。将角色动机和玩家眼前目标分开，既提供明确方向，也不替玩家规定所有感受。

heading.en: Map playable turns and consequences
heading.zh: 梳理可玩转折与后果

body.en: For each major beat, name the action, challenge, new information, and consequence. Track choices that change relationship, resources, access, or ending; do not branch merely to offer different wording with the same result.
body.zh: 为每个主要节拍注明行动、挑战、新信息和后果。追踪会改变关系、资源、通路或结局的选择；不要只换措辞却给出相同结果的伪分支。

heading.en: Plan variation before dialogue
heading.zh: 先规划变化，再写对白

body.en: Identify the shared scenes, optional moments, and state-dependent lines. Estimate which branches need unique content and where routes can rejoin without erasing player impact. Review the outline with design so progression works as gameplay.
body.zh: 标出共通场景、可选环节和依状态变化的台词。估算哪些分支需要专属内容、哪些路线能自然汇合而不抹掉玩家影响，并与设计一起检查进度是否可玩。

q.en: Should a game story outline include every dialogue choice?
q.zh: 游戏剧情大纲需要列出每个对白选项吗？

a.en: Include choices that change goals, relationships, information, or outcomes. Small wording variations can wait until dialogue drafting if they do not alter the player’s understanding or state.
a.zh: 要列出会改变目标、关系、信息或结果的选择。若措辞变化不影响理解或状态，可留到对白阶段处理。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Faction Conflict for a Game
title.zh: 游戏阵营冲突怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Faction Conflict for a Game

description.en: Give each game faction a concrete goal, a reason it cannot compromise, and a different approach the player can observe.
description.zh: 为每个游戏阵营设定具体目标、无法妥协的理由，以及玩家能观察到的不同做法。

answer.en: Give each game faction a concrete goal, a reason it cannot compromise, and a different approach the player can observe. Make the conflict affect missions, relationships, or world state so faction lore leads to play.
answer.zh: 为每个游戏阵营设定具体目标、无法妥协的理由，以及玩家能观察到的不同做法。让冲突影响任务、关系或世界状态，使阵营设定能推动玩法。

heading.en: Give factions competing needs
heading.zh: 为阵营设置相互冲突的需求

body.en: Define what each group wants, what resource or belief is at stake, and who pays if it fails. Avoid making one side purely good and another purely evil; different priorities help players understand why agreement is difficult.
body.zh: 明确各方追求什么、争夺的资源或信念是什么、失败由谁承担代价。避免把一方写成纯粹正义、另一方写成纯粹邪恶；不同优先事项能解释妥协为何困难。

heading.en: Connect conflict to player action
heading.zh: 让冲突影响玩家行动

body.en: Show the disagreement through mission requests, controlled spaces, character reactions, and visible consequences. Give the player options to support, negotiate, delay, or refuse when the game allows, and make the response proportionate to the choice.
body.zh: 通过任务请求、控制区域、人物反应和可见后果呈现分歧。玩法允许时给玩家支持、谈判、拖延或拒绝的选择，并让回应与决定分量相称。

heading.en: Track relationships and shared canon
heading.zh: 追踪关系与共同设定

body.en: Record which events each faction knows, what alliances change, and which facts remain true on every route. Test the story when players encounter the factions in different orders so motives remain legible.
body.zh: 记录各阵营知道哪些事件、联盟如何变化，以及哪些事实在所有路线都成立。测试玩家按不同顺序遇见阵营时的剧情，确保动机依然清楚。

q.en: Should players have to choose one faction?
q.zh: 玩家必须选择一个阵营吗？

a.en: Not always. The choice should reflect the game’s intended agency. Players can negotiate or remain independent when those options create meaningful consequences, not just extra dialogue.
a.zh: 不一定。选择应符合游戏设定的玩家自主度。谈判或保持独立只有在带来有意义的后果时才值得作为选项。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Design a Protagonist for a Story-Driven Game
title.zh: 剧情向游戏主角怎么设计

seo_title.en: How to Design a Protagonist for a Story-Driven Game
seo_title.zh: 剧情向游戏主角怎么设计

description.en: Give a game protagonist a clear motivation, playable actions, and room for players to shape the experience.
description.zh: 让剧情向游戏主角拥有明确动机、可玩的行动和供玩家塑造体验的空间。

answer.en: Give a game protagonist a clear motivation, playable actions, and room for players to shape the experience. The character should make the story understandable while leaving meaningful space for the player’s decisions.
answer.zh: 让剧情向游戏主角拥有明确动机、可玩的行动和供玩家塑造体验的空间。角色既要帮助玩家理解故事，也要为玩家决定留下余地。

heading.en: Separate character want from player goal
heading.zh: 区分人物欲望与玩家目标

body.en: Write what the protagonist wants personally and what the current mission asks the player to accomplish. Connect the two without assuming they are identical. This gap can create tension, but players still need a legible reason to take action.
body.zh: 分别写出主角个人欲望和当前任务要求玩家完成什么。将两者关联起来，但不要默认完全一致。差异能产生张力，玩家仍需知道行动的理由。

heading.en: Make identity visible in play
heading.zh: 让人物特质体现在玩法中

body.en: Choose actions, skills, relationships, and limits that express the character under pressure. Let the player learn who the protagonist is through what they can do and how others respond, not only through biography or cutscenes.
body.zh: 选择能在压力下体现人物的行动、技能、关系和限制。让玩家从主角能做什么、他人如何回应来认识角色，而不只靠传记和过场。

heading.en: Define where player agency begins
heading.zh: 明确玩家自主从何处开始

body.en: Decide which beliefs, emotions, and outcomes the game fixes and where players can choose. Signal those boundaries through dialogue and consequences so player input feels meaningful without promising control the design cannot support.
body.zh: 确定游戏固定哪些信念、情绪和结果，又在哪些地方允许玩家选择。通过对白和后果传达边界，让选择有意义，同时不虚假承诺设计无法支持的控制权。

q.en: Should a game protagonist have a fixed personality?
q.zh: 游戏主角需要固定性格吗？

a.en: A protagonist can have a defined voice and history while still leaving room for player decisions. Make the balance clear through actions the player controls and outcomes the story reserves.
a.zh: 主角可以有明确声音和经历，同时为玩家决定留出空间。通过玩家可控制的行动和故事保留的结果，把这种平衡说明白。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Design an Antagonist for a Game
title.zh: 游戏反派怎么设计

seo_title.en: How to Design an Antagonist for a Game

description.en: Make a game antagonist actively challenge the player’s goal with methods, resources, and beliefs the player can understand.
description.zh: 让游戏反派用玩家能理解的手段、资源和信念主动阻挠目标。

answer.en: Make a game antagonist actively challenge the player’s goal with methods, resources, and beliefs the player can understand. Let the conflict escalate through missions and consequences, not only through appearances in cutscenes.
answer.zh: 让游戏反派用玩家能理解的手段、资源和信念主动阻挠目标。通过任务和后果升级冲突，而不只是让反派在过场里露面。

heading.en: Give the antagonist a working plan
heading.zh: 让反派有可执行的计划

body.en: Define what the antagonist wants, why it matters now, and what steps they are taking. Their plan should change the player’s available options. A personal history can add meaning, but the antagonist still needs an objective beyond opposing the hero.
body.zh: 明确反派想要什么、为何此刻重要、正在采取什么步骤，并让计划改变玩家的选择空间。过往经历可以增加意义，但反派仍需拥有超越“反对主角”的目标。

heading.en: Put pressure into playable situations
heading.zh: 把压力放进可玩情境

body.en: Connect the antagonist’s actions to mission stakes, resources, allies, or locations. Let the player observe evidence of the plan and respond to it. Use direct confrontations sparingly enough that their timing changes the experience.
body.zh: 将反派行动连接到任务利害、资源、伙伴或地点。让玩家看见计划证据并作出回应；控制正面交锋的次数，使每次出现都能改变体验。

heading.en: Make the final conflict answer the story
heading.zh: 让最终冲突回应故事主题

body.en: Set up a clash of goals or beliefs that can be resolved through player action. The antagonist’s defeat, escape, or change should follow from choices and established rules, not a sudden ability or motivation introduced at the end.
body.zh: 建立能通过玩家行动解决的目标或信念冲突。反派的败退、逃脱或转变应源自既有选择和规则，而非结尾突然出现的能力或动机。

q.en: Does a game antagonist need to be sympathetic?
q.zh: 游戏反派一定要让人同情吗？

a.en: No. They need a legible goal and a credible effect on the player’s experience. Sympathy can add complexity, but it is not required for a compelling conflict.
a.zh: 不必。反派需要有可理解的目标，并真实影响玩家体验。同情感可以增加复杂度，但不是构成有力冲突的必要条件。

title.en: How to Give Game Characters Distinct Voices
title.zh: 游戏角色的声音怎么区分

seo_title.en: How to Give Game Characters Distinct Voices
seo_title.zh: 游戏角色的声音怎么区分

description.en: Differentiate game characters through what they notice, how they phrase goals, and how they react to pressure.
description.zh: 通过角色关注什么、如何表达目标以及受压时的反应来区分声音。

answer.en: Differentiate game characters through what they notice, how they phrase goals, and how they react to pressure. Keep lines concise enough for play and make voice differences survive repetition, branching, and performance.
answer.zh: 通过角色关注什么、如何表达目标以及受压时的反应来区分声音。对白要适合游玩节奏，并经得起重复、分支和配音演绎。

heading.en: Build a voice from character choices
heading.zh: 从人物选择建立声音

body.en: Give each character a distinct attention, vocabulary range, sentence rhythm, and way of avoiding or confronting a subject. Tie these choices to background and motivation rather than assigning a superficial accent or catchphrase.
body.zh: 为每位角色设定不同的关注点、词汇范围、句子节奏和回避或直面问题的方式。让声音选择源于经历与动机，而不是只贴口音或口头禅标签。

heading.en: Write for the moment and medium
heading.zh: 按情境与媒介写对白

body.en: Let urgency, relationship, and player context shape the line. Keep combat barks brief, while an optional conversation can carry more texture. Use branching choices to reveal how the same character responds differently, not to abandon their core voice.
body.zh: 让紧迫程度、关系和玩家情境影响台词。战斗短句要简洁，可选对话则能更有层次。用分支展现角色回应的变化，而不丢掉核心声音。

heading.en: Read lines in performance
heading.zh: 通过表演检查台词

body.en: Read dialogue aloud or with actors, then check whether speakers remain identifiable without name labels. Review repeated lines and localized phrasing. Revise any line that is hard to deliver, too long during action, or indistinguishable from another character’s voice.
body.zh: 大声朗读或与演员试演，检查去掉姓名标签后能否分辨说话者。检查重复台词和本地化表达，修改难以演绎、行动中太长或与他人声音难区分的句子。

q.en: Should every game character have a catchphrase?
q.zh: 每个游戏角色都要有口头禅吗？

a.en: No. Distinct attention, rhythm, vocabulary, and reactions usually create a more natural voice. Use a repeated phrase only when it fits the person and situation.
a.zh: 不需要。独特的关注点、节奏、词汇和反应通常更自然。只有符合人物与情境时才使用重复短语。

title.en: How to Write a Story for a Game Demo
title.zh: 游戏试玩版的故事怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Story for a Game Demo
seo_title.zh: 游戏试玩版的故事怎么写

description.en: Give a game demo a focused story arc that showcases the core play and leaves players with a meaningful outcome.
description.zh: 为试玩版设计聚焦的故事弧线，展示核心玩法并给玩家有意义的结果。

answer.en: Give a game demo a focused story arc that showcases the core play and leaves players with a meaningful outcome. Include only enough context to make the sample understandable, then end before the demo’s scope overwhelms its purpose.
answer.zh: 为试玩版设计聚焦的故事弧线，展示核心玩法并给玩家有意义的结果。只提供理解片段所需的背景，并在试玩范围偏离目的前收尾。

heading.en: Choose what the demo needs to prove
heading.zh: 确定试玩要证明什么

body.en: Pick the central gameplay and narrative experience the team wants players to understand. Select a short situation that demonstrates both, rather than trying to summarize the entire game’s world or plot.
body.zh: 选出团队希望玩家理解的核心玩法与叙事体验。安排能同时展示两者的短情境，不要试图概述整部游戏的世界或剧情。

heading.en: Build a complete sample sequence
heading.zh: 构建完整示例流程

body.en: Give the demo a clear setup, playable challenge, story response, and payoff. Make sure players can tell why they are acting and how the result changes the immediate situation. End on a decision, reveal, or arrival that invites continuation.
body.zh: 为试玩版设置明确铺垫、可玩挑战、剧情回应和回报。让玩家理解行动理由及结果如何改变处境，并以决定、揭示或抵达收尾，引出后续。

heading.en: Match writing to production limits
heading.zh: 让写作适配制作限制

body.en: Reuse assets and systems where possible and identify what must be custom-built. Include alternate lines or scenes only when they demonstrate an important feature. Test that the story remains clear if a player takes longer or skips optional material.
body.zh: 尽量复用素材与系统，并标出必须定制开发的部分。只有在展示关键功能时才加入替代台词或场景。测试玩家耗时较长或跳过可选内容时，故事是否依然清楚。

q.en: Should a demo end on a cliffhanger?
q.zh: 试玩版结尾一定要留悬念吗？

a.en: Not necessarily. A completed short arc can make a stronger impression. Use a cliffhanger only when it follows a meaningful payoff and gives players a clear reason to continue.
a.zh: 不一定。完整的短故事弧线往往更有印象。只有在兑现阶段性回报后，且能给出继续游玩的明确理由时，才用悬念收尾。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Story for a Multiplayer Game
title.zh: 多人游戏的故事怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Story for a Multiplayer Game
seo_title.zh: 多人游戏的故事怎么写

description.en: Give players a shared objective and a reason each participant can contribute.
description.zh: 为玩家安排共同目标，并让每位参与者都能有所贡献。

answer.en: Give players a shared objective and a reason each participant can contribute. Make story information resilient to interruptions and repeated matches, and avoid relying on one player as the permanent hero while everyone else watches.
answer.zh: 为玩家安排共同目标，并让每位参与者都能有所贡献。故事信息要适应中断和重复对局，避免长期由一人当主角、其他人旁观。

heading.en: Design a shared reason to act
heading.zh: 设计共同参与的理由

body.en: State what the group is trying to accomplish and why cooperation matters. Give roles different tools, information, or responsibilities that support one outcome. If player-versus-player conflict is central, make its narrative meaning understandable without slowing the match.
body.zh: 说明团队要完成什么、合作为何重要。为不同角色安排支持同一目标的工具、信息或职责。若玩家对抗是核心，要让叙事意义清晰，又不拖慢对局。

heading.en: Keep story beats readable in play
heading.zh: 让游戏中的故事节点容易理解

body.en: Use brief objectives, environmental changes, and optional exchanges that survive players moving at different speeds. Repeat essential information in a natural way, and avoid blocking the next match on a long unskippable explanation.
body.zh: 用简短目标、环境变化和可选对话适应不同玩家的推进速度。自然重复关键消息，不要用很长且不可跳过的解释挡住下一局。

heading.en: Account for player-made outcomes
heading.zh: 纳入玩家创造的结果

body.en: Decide what the fiction can acknowledge, such as team success, individual contribution, or a match result. Use flexible language or authored variations that respect those outcomes without promising unique cinematics for every possible match.
body.zh: 确定故事会承认哪些结果，例如团队成功、个人贡献或对局胜负。用灵活表述或预设变化尊重结果，同时不承诺为每种对局制作专属过场。

q.en: Can a multiplayer game tell a linear story?
q.zh: 多人游戏可以讲线性故事吗？

a.en: Yes. A linear arc can work when matches provide meaningful participation and story delivery fits play. Give players enough agency in how they contribute even if the final outcome is authored.
a.zh: 可以。只要玩家能在对局中实际参与、故事呈现不打断游玩，线性弧线也能成立。即使结局预设，也要让玩家有足够参与空间。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Design a Story for an MMO
title.zh: 大型多人在线游戏剧情怎么设计

seo_title.en: How to Design a Story for an MMO
seo_title.zh: 大型多人在线游戏剧情怎么设计

description.en: Design an MMO story for a persistent world where players arrive at different times and progress at different rates.
description.zh: 为持续存在、玩家进入时间和进度各异的世界设计MMO剧情。

answer.en: Design an MMO story for a persistent world where players arrive at different times and progress at different rates. Give updates clear goals, preserve shared world history, and make major changes legible to returning players.
answer.zh: 为持续存在、玩家进入时间和进度各异的世界设计MMO剧情。让版本更新目标清楚、保留共同世界历史，并帮助回归玩家理解重大变化。

heading.en: Set a shared world baseline
heading.zh: 建立共同世界基线

body.en: Define what every player needs to know about the current world and which events are optional history. Give new players an entry point that does not require years of prior quests, while preserving consequences veterans recognize.
body.zh: 明确所有玩家需要了解的当前世界信息，以及哪些属于可选历史。为新玩家提供无需补完多年任务的入口，同时保留老玩家能认出的后果。

heading.en: Plan updates with a beginning and payoff
heading.zh: 为更新安排开端与回报

body.en: Give each content update a focused conflict, playable objectives, and a clear result for its size. Connect it to longer arcs with recurring characters, locations, or unresolved questions. Avoid ending every update with a new emergency that erases the previous payoff.
body.zh: 让每次内容更新都有聚焦冲突、可玩目标和符合规模的明确结果。通过常驻角色、地点或未解问题连接长期故事线；不要每次都用新危机抹掉上次的回报。

heading.en: Respect asynchronous participation
heading.zh: 尊重玩家异步参与

body.en: Assume players may miss an event or return after the world changes. Summarize essential developments in quests, journals, or short introductions, and make time-limited story decisions clear. Coordinate narrative cadence with the team’s actual release capacity.
body.zh: 假设玩家可能错过活动，或在世界变化后才回来。通过任务、日志或简短引导回顾关键信息，明确限时剧情决定，并让叙事节奏符合团队实际更新能力。

q.en: How can an MMO story handle new players?
q.zh: MMO剧情怎么照顾新玩家？

a.en: Offer a clear current objective and a concise recap of essential events. Keep older story available for players who want it, but do not make every historical chapter mandatory for basic understanding.
a.zh: 提供清晰的当前目标和必要事件回顾。让老剧情仍可供感兴趣的玩家阅读，但不要把所有历史章节都设为基础理解的必修内容。

text.en: Use the novel-to-game workflow to plan, draft, and revise the work while keeping decisions and consistency visible.
text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Story for a Dating Sim
title.zh: 恋爱模拟游戏剧情怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Story for a Dating Sim
seo_title.zh: 恋爱模拟游戏剧情怎么写

description.en: Build a dating sim around relationships that develop through player choices, character goals, and meaningful time together.
description.zh: 围绕玩家选择、角色目标和共同经历推动恋爱模拟游戏关系。

answer.en: Build a dating sim around relationships that develop through player choices, character goals, and meaningful time together. Make each route distinct, let choices reveal compatibility, and treat consent and boundaries as part of the romance.
answer.zh: 围绕玩家选择、角色目标和共同经历推动恋爱模拟游戏关系。让路线各有特点，用选择展现契合度，并把同意与边界融入爱情故事。

heading.en: Give each character an independent life
heading.zh: 让每位角色都有自己的生活

body.en: Define each character’s goal, obligations, and conflict beyond romance. The player should meet someone with agency, not a reward waiting at the route’s end. Connect relationship scenes to the character’s decisions and wider story.
body.zh: 为每位角色设定爱情之外的目标、责任和冲突。玩家遇到的应是有自主性的人，而非路线终点的奖励。让关系场景连接角色决定与更大故事。

heading.en: Make choices reveal compatibility
heading.zh: 让选项体现关系契合

body.en: Offer choices that show the player’s values or preferred response, then let characters react in a way consistent with their own needs. Avoid treating every kind response as a guaranteed romantic point; disagreement can deepen characterization.
body.zh: 设计能体现玩家价值观或回应方式的选项，并让角色依据自身需求作出反应。不要把所有友善回应都当作恋爱加分；分歧也能深化人物。

heading.en: Design routes with clear payoffs
heading.zh: 让各路线有清楚回报

body.en: Plan how routes share setup and where their conflicts diverge. Give each path a relationship arc, a consequential decision, and an ending that follows from established choices. Make boundaries legible and avoid framing ignored refusal as romance.
body.zh: 规划路线共用的铺垫与分歧点。每条路线都要有关系弧线、重要决定和源自既有选择的结局。清楚呈现边界，不要把无视拒绝写成浪漫。

q.en: Should every dating sim route have a happy ending?
q.zh: 恋爱模拟游戏每条路线都要幸福结局吗？

a.en: No. Each ending should feel earned by the route’s conflicts and choices. Hopeful, bittersweet, and unresolved endings can all work when the player understands what led there.
a.zh: 不必。结局应由路线冲突和选择自然导出。只要玩家理解原因，充满希望、苦乐参半或开放式结局都可以成立。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Design a Story for a Sandbox Game
title.zh: 沙盒游戏的故事怎么设计

seo_title.en: How to Design a Story for a Sandbox Game
seo_title.zh: 沙盒游戏的故事怎么设计

description.en: Give a sandbox game a world problem, tools, and character goals that create story without forcing every player through the same sequence.
description.zh: 为沙盒游戏设置世界难题、工具和人物目标，不强迫所有玩家经历同一顺序。

answer.en: Give a sandbox game a world problem, tools, and character goals that create story without forcing every player through the same sequence. Let systems and authored moments reinforce each other so player-made outcomes still feel part of the world.
answer.zh: 为沙盒游戏设置世界难题、工具和人物目标，不强迫所有玩家经历同一顺序。让系统与预设剧情互相支撑，使玩家创造的结果仍属于这个世界。

heading.en: Create a flexible story frame
heading.zh: 搭建灵活的故事框架

body.en: Define the situation, stakes, and groups or characters trying to change it. Keep the player’s role broad enough for different play styles, but make the world respond to actions in consistent ways.
body.zh: 明确局势、利害，以及试图改变它的组织或人物。玩家身份应足以容纳不同玩法，同时确保世界对行动作出一致回应。

heading.en: Let systems produce story moments
heading.zh: 让系统生成故事时刻

body.en: Identify combinations of tools, resources, and world rules that can create surprising but understandable outcomes. Place authored characters or events where they add context to what players do, rather than interrupting every emergent moment with exposition.
body.zh: 找出能产生意外但可理解结果的工具、资源和世界规则组合。在适当位置安排角色或事件，为玩家行动补充背景，而不是用解释打断每个涌现时刻。

heading.en: Support different orders and endings
heading.zh: 支持不同顺序与结果

body.en: Make objectives discoverable from several routes and track consequences the game can afford to remember. Use a small set of meaningful world-state changes rather than writing bespoke scenes for every possible action. Test stories created by players who ignore the intended path.
body.zh: 让玩家能从多条路线发现目标，并追踪制作上可实现的后果。优先设计少量有意义的世界变化，而非为每种行动写专属场景。测试偏离预设路线的玩家会遇到什么。

q.en: Can a sandbox game have a main story?
q.zh: 沙盒游戏可以有主线剧情吗？

a.en: Yes. Offer a clear main path while leaving room for exploration and self-directed play. Make the story’s structure understandable without implying that every player must follow it in one order.
a.zh: 可以。提供清晰主线，同时给探索和自主游玩留空间。故事结构要易懂，但不必要求所有玩家按同一顺序推进。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Story for a First-Person Shooter
title.zh: 第一人称射击游戏剧情怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Story for a First-Person Shooter
seo_title.zh: 第一人称射击游戏剧情怎么写

description.en: Tie an FPS story to the objectives players pursue, the information they encounter, and the consequences of combat.
description.zh: 把FPS剧情连接到玩家追求的任务、遇到的信息和战斗后果。

answer.en: Tie an FPS story to the objectives players pursue, the information they encounter, and the consequences of combat. Keep mission goals readable during action and use quieter moments to develop character without disrupting play.
answer.zh: 把FPS剧情连接到玩家追求的任务、遇到的信息和战斗后果。行动中要让任务目标清晰，并用较安静的时刻发展人物而不打断玩法。

heading.en: Make the objective understandable
heading.zh: 让任务目标清楚

body.en: State where the player is going, what they need to accomplish, and what changes if they succeed or fail. Use brief dialogue, mission framing, and environmental cues before combat becomes intense.
body.zh: 交代玩家要去哪里、要完成什么，以及成功或失败会带来什么变化。在战斗激烈起来前，通过简短对白、任务说明和环境线索传递目标。

heading.en: Deliver story during movement
heading.zh: 在移动过程中呈现剧情

body.en: Use radio exchanges, visible events, environmental storytelling, and short pauses to add information. Keep critical lines concise enough to hear over action and repeat essential directions in the interface or level design.
body.zh: 用无线电交流、可见事件、环境叙事和短暂停顿补充信息。关键台词要短到能在行动中听清，并通过界面或关卡设计重复必要指引。

heading.en: Connect combat to consequence
heading.zh: 让战斗产生剧情后果

body.en: Show what changes because of the mission and how characters respond. Avoid treating civilians, allies, or destruction as decoration when the story asks players to care about them. Check that required story moments do not demand attention while players must fight.
body.zh: 呈现任务造成的变化及人物反应。若故事要求玩家关心平民、同伴或破坏，就不要把他们当背景装饰。检查关键剧情是否安排在玩家必须战斗、无法关注的时刻。

q.en: How can an FPS explain its story during combat?
q.zh: FPS怎样在战斗中讲清剧情？

a.en: Keep urgent instructions short and reinforce them with visuals or interface cues. Place deeper character and world information in quieter moments or optional material.
a.zh: 让紧急指令简短，并用画面或界面提示配合。人物与世界的深入信息可放在较安静的时刻或可选内容中。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Write a Story for a Racing Game
title.zh: 赛车游戏的故事怎么写

seo_title.en: How to Write a Story for a Racing Game
seo_title.zh: 赛车游戏的故事怎么写

description.en: Give a racing game a character goal that can evolve across events, teams, and rivalries.
description.zh: 为赛车游戏设置能在赛事、车队和竞争中发展的角色目标。

answer.en: Give a racing game a character goal that can evolve across events, teams, and rivalries. Let races change relationships or opportunities, and make progression meaningful without forcing long scenes between rounds.
answer.zh: 为赛车游戏设置能在赛事、车队和竞争中发展的角色目标。让比赛改变关系或机会，并使成长有意义，又不在每轮之间强塞冗长剧情。

heading.en: Choose a story frame that fits racing
heading.zh: 选适合竞速的故事框架

body.en: Use a season, championship, team rescue, personal comeback, or rivalry as the organizing goal. Give the player a reason to care about the next event that fits the driving experience. Avoid unrelated plot twists that could belong in any game.
body.zh: 以赛季、锦标赛、拯救车队、个人复出或宿敌竞争作为主线目标。为下一场比赛提供符合驾驶体验的理由，避免任何游戏都能套用的无关反转。

heading.en: Make races change the story
heading.zh: 让赛事改变故事

body.en: Connect results, rival behavior, and team resources to new choices. Use short conversations, garage scenes, or broadcast commentary to show consequences. Provide catch-up paths when players lose so a single race does not break the whole arc.
body.zh: 让比赛结果、对手行为和车队资源影响新选择。用简短对话、车库场景或赛事解说呈现后果；为落败玩家安排追赶路线，避免一场失利摧毁整条故事线。

heading.en: Keep progression player-paced
heading.zh: 让剧情跟随玩家节奏

body.en: Let players move quickly between races when they prefer driving, while offering optional character scenes for those who want context. Summarize the season’s stakes and update relationships in ways players can notice.
body.zh: 允许偏爱驾驶的玩家快速进入下一场，也为需要背景的玩家提供可选角色场景。总结赛季利害，并用玩家看得出的方式更新关系。

q.en: Does a racing game need a voiced story?
q.zh: 赛车游戏一定要有配音剧情吗？

a.en: No. Brief dialogue, radio messages, standings, and changing team conditions can carry a clear arc. Use longer voiced scenes only when they add something the race and surrounding presentation cannot.
a.zh: 不一定。简短对白、无线电、排名和车队变化也能讲清故事。只有在长配音场景能带来比赛及周边呈现无法提供的内容时才使用。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。

title.en: How to Adapt a Novel Character into a Game Protagonist
title.zh: 如何把小说人物改编成游戏主角

seo_title.en: How to Adapt a Novel Character into a Game Protagonist
seo_title.zh: 如何把小说人物改编成游戏主角

description.en: Preserve the character’s defining motivation while giving players actions that express it.
description.zh: 保留人物最核心的动机，同时设计能表达它的玩家行动。

answer.en: Preserve the character’s defining motivation while giving players actions that express it. Rework internal conflict into playable choices, relationships, or constraints, and let the game reveal character through what the player can do.
answer.zh: 保留人物最核心的动机，同时设计能表达它的玩家行动。把内心冲突转化为可玩的选择、关系或限制，让游戏通过玩家能做什么来展现人物。

heading.en: Identify the character’s dramatic core
heading.zh: 找出人物的戏剧核心

body.en: Separate the character’s essential desire, fear, and contradiction from events that depend on the novel’s narration. Ask what readers value about the character and which traits need to remain recognizable after the medium changes.
body.zh: 将人物核心欲望、恐惧和矛盾，与依赖小说叙述的事件分开。确认读者看重什么，以及换媒介后哪些特质仍须辨认得出。

heading.en: Turn inner conflict into player action
heading.zh: 把内心冲突转化为玩家行动

body.en: Find actions that embody the character’s struggle: whom to trust, what to investigate, when to retreat, or which cost to accept. Give the player room to make a choice while preserving the conflict that made the character compelling.
body.zh: 寻找能体现人物挣扎的行动：信任谁、调查什么、何时撤退、接受哪种代价。让玩家有选择空间，同时保留使人物吸引人的冲突。

heading.en: Keep the adaptation recognizable and playable
heading.zh: 让改编既可辨认又可游玩

body.en: Compare the character’s decisions and relationships with the source, then explain changes needed for agency and pacing. Use dialogue, mechanics, and reactions to express traits the novel once stated directly. Test whether a new player understands the character without reading the book.
body.zh: 对照原作中的人物决定和关系，说明为自主度与节奏所作的改动。用对白、机制和回应表达原文直接说明的特质，并测试没读过原著的新玩家能否理解角色。

q.en: Should a game adaptation let players change a famous character?
q.zh: 游戏改编可以让玩家改变知名人物吗？

a.en: It can, when the project makes the player’s influence and the character’s defining traits clear. Decide which outcomes may change and which relationships or values anchor the adaptation.
a.zh: 可以，但项目要明确玩家能影响什么、角色的核心特质是什么。提前决定哪些结果可变，以及哪些关系或价值观构成改编锚点。

text.zh: 使用 novel-to-game 工作流规划、起草和修改作品，同时看清创作决定与前后连续。
